// hooks/useChatMessages.js - COMPLETE FIXED VERSION
function useChatMessages(chatId, currentUserId) {
  const [messages, setMessages] = React.useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [loadingMore, setLoadingMore] = React.useState(false);
  const [hasMore, setHasMore] = React.useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState('');
  
  // ===== ONLINE STATUS STATE =====
  const [otherUserOnline, setOtherUserOnline] = React.useState(false);
  const [otherUserLastSeen, setOtherUserLastSeen] = React.useState(null);
  const [otherUserId, setOtherUserId] = React.useState(null);
  
  const lastMessageRef = React.useRef(null);
  const unsubscribeRef = React.useRef(null);
  const messageIds = React.useRef(new Set());
  const heartbeatUnsubscribeRef = React.useRef(null);
  
  // Store temp messages with their client timestamps for matching
  const pendingTempMessages = React.useRef(new Map()); // clientTimestamp -> tempId
  
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!chatId || !currentUserId) return;
    
    if (unsubscribeRef.current) {
      unsubscribeRef.current();
    }
    
    setMessages([]);
    setLoading(true);
    setHasMore(true);
    messageIds.current.clear();
    pendingTempMessages.current.clear();
    lastMessageRef.current = null;
    
    const chatRef = db.collection('chats').doc(chatId);
    
    // ===== GET OTHER USER ID FROM CHAT =====
    const getOtherUserId = async () => {
      try {
        const chatDoc = await chatRef.get();
        if (chatDoc.exists) {
          const participants = chatDoc.data().participants || [];
          const otherId = participants.find(id => id !== currentUserId);
          setOtherUserId(otherId);
          return otherId;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error getting other user ID:', err);
      }
      return null;
    };
    
    // ===== LISTEN TO OTHER USER'S ONLINE STATUS =====
    const setupUserStatusListener = async () => {
      const otherId = await getOtherUserId();
      if (!otherId) return;
      
      const userStatusRef = db.collection('users').doc(otherId);
      
      const unsubscribe = userStatusRef.onSnapshot((doc) => {
        if (doc.exists) {
          const data = doc.data();
          const lastActive = data.lastActive;
          const isOnline = data.isOnline || false;
          
          setOtherUserOnline(isOnline);
          setOtherUserLastSeen(lastActive);
        }
      });
      
      return unsubscribe;
    };
    
    const statusUnsubscribe = setupUserStatusListener();
    
    // ===== MESSAGE LISTENER =====
    unsubscribeRef.current = chatRef.collection('messages')
      .orderBy('createdAt', 'asc')
      .limitToLast(30)
      .onSnapshot(
        (snapshot) => {
          // Process each change
          snapshot.docChanges().forEach((change) => {
            const messageId = change.doc.id;
            const data = change.doc.data();
            
            if (change.type === 'added' || change.type === 'modified') {
              // Check if this real message matches a pending temp message
              const clientTimestamp = data.clientTimestamp;
              
              setMessages(prev => {
                // Case 1: Look for a matching temp message by clientTimestamp
                if (clientTimestamp && pendingTempMessages.current.has(clientTimestamp)) {
                  const tempId = pendingTempMessages.current.get(clientTimestamp);
                  
                  // Find the temp message in the current list
                  const existingTempIndex = prev.findIndex(m => m.id === tempId);
                  
                  if (existingTempIndex !== -1) {
                    // Found matching temp message - replace it with real one
                    const updated = [...prev];
                    
                    // Preserve the sortTime from temp message to maintain position
                    const sortTime = prev[existingTempIndex].sortTime || clientTimestamp;
                    
                    updated[existingTempIndex] = {
                      id: messageId,
                      senderId: data.senderId,
                      text: data.text || '',
                      createdAt: data.createdAt,
                      clientTimestamp: data.clientTimestamp,
                      serverTimestamp: data.createdAt?.seconds || 0,
                      sortTime: sortTime,
                      read: data.read || false,
                      isTemp: false,
                      receivedAt: Date.now()
                    };
                    
                    // Update message tracking
                    messageIds.current.delete(tempId);
                    messageIds.current.add(messageId);
                    pendingTempMessages.current.delete(clientTimestamp);
                    
                    return updated;
                  }
                }
                
                // Case 2: No matching temp message, add as new (but check for duplicates)
                if (!messageIds.current.has(messageId)) {
                  messageIds.current.add(messageId);
                  
                  const serverTime = data.createdAt?.seconds || 0;
                  const clientTime = data.clientTimestamp || 0;
                  const sortTime = serverTime > 0 ? serverTime : clientTime;
                  
                  // Create new message object
                  const newMessage = {
                    id: messageId,
                    senderId: data.senderId,
                    text: data.text || '',
                    createdAt: data.createdAt,
                    clientTimestamp: data.clientTimestamp,
                    serverTimestamp: serverTime,
                    sortTime: sortTime,
                    read: data.read || false,
                    isTemp: false,
                    receivedAt: Date.now()
                  };
                  
                  // Add to list and sort
                  const updated = [...prev, newMessage].sort((a, b) => {
                    return (a.sortTime || 0) - (b.sortTime || 0);
                  });
                  
                  // Update last message ref
                  if (updated.length > 0) {
                    lastMessageRef.current = updated[0];
                  }
                  
                  return updated;
                }
                
                return prev;
              });
            }
          });
          
          setLoading(false);
        },
        (err) => {
          console.error('Message listener error:', err);
          setError('Failed to load messages');
          setLoading(false);
        }
      );
    
    return () => {
      if (unsubscribeRef.current) {
        unsubscribeRef.current();
      }
      if (statusUnsubscribe) {
        statusUnsubscribe.then(unsub => unsub?.());
      }
    };
  }, [chatId, currentUserId]);
  
  // ===== LOAD MORE MESSAGES =====
  const loadMore = React.useCallback(async () => {
    if (!chatId || !hasMore || loadingMore || loading || !lastMessageRef.current) return;
    
    setLoadingMore(true);
    
    try {
      const chatRef = db.collection('chats').doc(chatId);
      const oldestMessage = lastMessageRef.current;
      
      const snapshot = await chatRef.collection('messages')
        .orderBy('createdAt', 'desc')
        .startAfter(oldestMessage.createdAt)
        .limit(20)
        .get();
      
      if (snapshot.empty) {
        setHasMore(false);
        setLoadingMore(false);
        return;
      }
      
      const olderMessages = [];
      snapshot.docs.forEach(doc => {
        const messageId = doc.id;
        if (!messageIds.current.has(messageId)) {
          messageIds.current.add(messageId);
          const data = doc.data();
          
          const serverTime = data.createdAt?.seconds || 0;
          const clientTime = data.clientTimestamp || 0;
          const sortTime = serverTime > 0 ? serverTime : clientTime;
          
          olderMessages.push({
            id: messageId,
            senderId: data.senderId,
            text: data.text || '',
            createdAt: data.createdAt,
            clientTimestamp: data.clientTimestamp,
            serverTimestamp: serverTime,
            sortTime: sortTime,
            read: data.read || false,
            isTemp: false,
            receivedAt: Date.now()
          });
        }
      });
      
      if (olderMessages.length > 0) {
        setMessages(prev => {
          const combined = [...prev, ...olderMessages].sort((a, b) => {
            return (a.sortTime || 0) - (b.sortTime || 0);
          });
          
          if (combined.length > 0) {
            lastMessageRef.current = combined[0];
          }
          
          setHasMore(snapshot.docs.length === 20);
          return combined;
        });
      } else {
        setHasMore(false);
      }
      
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error loading more messages:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoadingMore(false);
    }
  }, [chatId, hasMore, loadingMore, loading]);
  
  // ===== SEND MESSAGE =====
  const sendMessage = React.useCallback(async (text) => {
    if (!chatId || !currentUserId || !text.trim()) return null;
    
    const tempId = 'temp_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9);
    const nowSeconds = Date.now() / 1000;
    
    // Store mapping of clientTimestamp to tempId for later matching
    pendingTempMessages.current.set(nowSeconds, tempId);
    
    // Create temp message
    const tempMessage = {
      id: tempId,
      senderId: currentUserId,
      text: text.trim(),
      createdAt: { seconds: nowSeconds },
      clientTimestamp: nowSeconds,
      serverTimestamp: 0,
      sortTime: nowSeconds,
      read: false,
      isTemp: true,
      receivedAt: Date.now()
    };
    
    // Add temp message to UI immediately
    setMessages(prev => {
      const updated = [...prev, tempMessage].sort((a, b) => {
        return (a.sortTime || 0) - (b.sortTime || 0);
      });
      messageIds.current.add(tempId);
      return updated;
    });
    
    try {
      // Send actual message to server
      const realMessageId = await ChatHelpers.sendMessage(chatId, currentUserId, text.trim(), {
        clientTimestamp: nowSeconds
      });
      
      return realMessageId;
      
    } catch (err) {
      // Remove temp message on error
      setMessages(prev => prev.filter(m => m.id !== tempId));
      messageIds.current.delete(tempId);
      pendingTempMessages.current.delete(nowSeconds);
      throw err;
    }
  }, [chatId, currentUserId]);
  
  return {
    messages,
    loading,
    loadingMore,
    hasMore,
    error,
    loadMore,
    sendMessage,
    otherUserOnline,
    otherUserLastSeen,
    otherUserId
  };
}

window.useChatMessages = useChatMessages;

// hooks/usePageState.js
function usePageState(pageName, initialState = {}) {
  const [state, setState] = React.useState(() => {
    // Try to load from cache first
    const cached = window.RouteCache?.get(window.location.pathname);
    if (cached && cached.pageName === pageName) {
      return cached.state || initialState;
    }
    return initialState;
  });
  
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState(null);
  
  // Save state to cache whenever it changes
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (Object.keys(state).length > 0) {
      window.RouteCache?.set(window.location.pathname, {
        pageName,
        state,
        timestamp: Date.now()
      });
    }
  }, [state, pageName]);
  
  // Save scroll position
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleScroll = () => {
      const scrollY = window.scrollY;
      window.RouteCache?.set(window.location.pathname, {
        pageName,
        state,
        scrollPosition: scrollY,
        timestamp: Date.now()
      });
    };
    
    window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll, { passive: true });
    
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
    };
  }, [state, pageName]);
  
  // Load data with caching
  const loadData = React.useCallback(async (fetchFn, options = {}) => {
    const { forceRefresh = false, cacheKey = null } = options;
    
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    
    try {
      // Check cache first
      if (!forceRefresh && !cacheKey) {
        const cached = window.RouteCache?.get(window.location.pathname);
        if (cached && cached.data) {
          setState(prev => ({ ...prev, data: cached.data }));
          setLoading(false);
          return cached.data;
        }
      }
      
      // Fetch fresh data
      const data = await fetchFn();
      
      // Cache the data
      window.RouteCache?.set(window.location.pathname, {
        pageName,
        state,
        data,
        timestamp: Date.now()
      });
      
      setState(prev => ({ ...prev, data }));
      setLoading(false);
      return data;
      
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
      setLoading(false);
      throw err;
    }
  }, [pageName, state]);
  
  // Clear page state
  const clearState = React.useCallback(() => {
    setState(initialState);
    window.RouteCache?.remove(window.location.pathname);
  }, [initialState]);
  
  // Update specific field
  const updateField = React.useCallback((field, value) => {
    setState(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
  }, []);
  
  // Batch update multiple fields
  const updateFields = React.useCallback((newState) => {
    setState(prev => ({ ...prev, ...newState }));
  }, []);
  
  return {
    state,
    setState,
    loading,
    error,
    loadData,
    clearState,
    updateField,
    updateFields
  };
}

window.usePageState = usePageState;
console.log('‚úÖ usePageState hook loaded');

// hooks/usePersistentState.js
// Simple hook for persisting state in sessionStorage

function usePersistentState(key, initialState) {
  
  const [state, setState] = React.useState(() => {
    try {
      const saved = sessionStorage.getItem(`persist_${key}`);
      return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : initialState;
    } catch (e) {
      return initialState;
    }
  });
  
  
  React.useEffect(() => {
    try {
      sessionStorage.setItem(`persist_${key}`, JSON.stringify(state));
    } catch (e) {
    }
  }, [key, state]);
  
  return [state, setState];
}

window.usePersistentState = usePersistentState;

// hooks/useReactions.js
function useReactions(contentType, contentId) {
  const [reactions, setReactions] = React.useState({
    counts: {},
    userReaction: null,
    loading: true
  });
  
  const [toggling, setToggling] = React.useState(false);
  const user = auth?.currentUser;
  
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!contentType || !contentId) return;
    
    setReactions(prev => ({ ...prev, loading: true }));
    
    const unsubscribe = ReactionHelpers.listenToReactions(
      contentType,
      contentId,
      user?.uid,
      (data) => {
        setReactions(prev => ({
          ...prev,
          ...data,
          loading: false
        }));
      }
    );
    
    return unsubscribe;
  }, [contentType, contentId, user?.uid]);
  
  const toggleReaction = React.useCallback(async (reactionType) => {
    if (!user) {
      window.__openAuthModal?.('login', window.location.pathname);
      return;
    }
    
    setToggling(true);
    
    // Optimistic update
    const newActive = reactions.userReaction === reactionType ? null : reactionType;
    const newCounts = { ...reactions.counts };
    
    if (reactions.userReaction === reactionType) {
      // Removing
      newCounts[reactionType] = Math.max(0, (newCounts[reactionType] || 0) - 1);
    } else {
      // Adding (and removing previous if exists)
      if (reactions.userReaction) {
        newCounts[reactions.userReaction] = Math.max(0, (newCounts[reactions.userReaction] || 0) - 1);
      }
      newCounts[reactionType] = (newCounts[reactionType] || 0) + 1;
    }
    
    setReactions(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      userReaction: newActive,
      counts: newCounts
    }));
    
    try {
      const result = await ReactionHelpers.toggleReaction({
        contentType,
        contentId,
        userId: user.uid,
        reactionType
      });
      
      // Update with actual server data
      setReactions(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        userReaction: result.active ? result.type : null,
        counts: result.counts
      }));
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error toggling reaction:', error);
      // Revert optimistic update on error
      setReactions(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        userReaction: reactions.userReaction,
        counts: reactions.counts
      }));
    } finally {
      setToggling(false);
    }
  }, [contentType, contentId, user, reactions.userReaction, reactions.counts]);
  
  const getUserReaction = React.useCallback(() => {
    return reactions.userReaction;
  }, [reactions.userReaction]);
  
  const getCount = React.useCallback((reactionType) => {
    return reactions.counts[reactionType] || 0;
  }, [reactions.counts]);
  
  const getTotalCount = React.useCallback(() => {
    return Object.values(reactions.counts).reduce((sum, count) => sum + count, 0);
  }, [reactions.counts]);
  
  return {
    ...reactions,
    toggling,
    toggleReaction,
    getUserReaction,
    getCount,
    getTotalCount
  };
}

window.useReactions = useReactions;

// hooks/useScrollDirection.js
function useScrollDirection(options = {}) {
  const { container = null, threshold = 10 } = options;
  const [scrollDirection, setScrollDirection] = React.useState('up');
  const [scrollY, setScrollY] = React.useState(0);
  const [atTop, setAtTop] = React.useState(true);
  const lastScrollY = React.useRef(0);
  
  React.useEffect(() => {
    let element = null;
    
    try {
      element = container?.current || window;
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Cannot access scroll container:', e);
      return;
    }
    
    if (!element) return;
    
    const updateScrollDirection = () => {
      try {
        let currentScrollY = 0;
        
        if (container?.current) {
          currentScrollY = container.current.scrollTop;
        } else {
          currentScrollY = window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset;
        }
        
        const direction = currentScrollY > lastScrollY.current ? 'down' : 'up';
        
        setScrollY(currentScrollY);
        setAtTop(currentScrollY < 50);
        
        if (direction !== scrollDirection &&
          Math.abs(currentScrollY - lastScrollY.current) > threshold) {
          setScrollDirection(direction);
        }
        
        lastScrollY.current = currentScrollY;
      } catch (e) {
        // Silently fail if cross-origin error
      }
    };
    
    try {
      updateScrollDirection();
      element.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollDirection, { passive: true });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Cannot add scroll listener:', e);
    }
    
    return () => {
      try {
        element.removeEventListener('scroll', updateScrollDirection);
      } catch (e) {
        // Ignore cleanup errors
      }
    };
  }, [scrollDirection, container, threshold]);
  
  return {
    scrollDirection,
    scrollY,
    atTop
  };
}

window.useScrollDirection = useScrollDirection;

// hooks/useSimilarListings.js
// Algorithm: region ‚Üí price range ‚Üí property type, infinite scroll

function useSimilarListings(currentListing, allListings = []) {
  const [similarListings, setSimilarListings] = React.useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const [hasMore, setHasMore] = React.useState(true);
  const [page, setPage] = React.useState(1);
  const [lastVisible, setLastVisible] = React.useState(null);
  const ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 12;

  // Score function for similarity
  const calculateScore = React.useCallback((listing) => {
    if (!currentListing || listing.id === currentListing.id) return -1;
    if (listing.status === 'deleted') return -1;

    let score = 0;

    // 1. Same LGA (highest weight)
    if (listing.lga === currentListing.lga) score += 100;
    // 2. Same state (medium weight)
    else if (listing.state === currentListing.state) score += 50;

    // 3. Price range within ¬±20%
    if (currentListing.price && listing.price) {
      const priceDiff = Math.abs(listing.price - currentListing.price);
      const pricePercent = priceDiff / currentListing.price;
      if (pricePercent <= 0.2) score += 30;
      else if (pricePercent <= 0.5) score += 15;
    }

    // 4. Same property type
    if (listing.propertyType === currentListing.propertyType) score += 20;

    // 5. Same bedrooms
    if (listing.bedrooms === currentListing.bedrooms) score += 10;

    // 6. Same furnishing
    if (listing.furnishing === currentListing.furnishing) score += 5;

    return score;
  }, [currentListing]);

  // Load initial similar listings
  const loadSimilar = React.useCallback(async (reset = false) => {
    if (!currentListing) return;
    
    setLoading(true);
    
    try {
      // For now, use allListings from props (will be replaced with Firestore query)
      let scored = allListings
        .map(l => ({ ...l, score: calculateScore(l) }))
        .filter(l => l.score > 0)
        .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);

      // Paginate
      const start = reset ? 0 : (page - 1) * ITEMS_PER_PAGE;
      const paginated = scored.slice(start, start + ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
      
      if (reset) {
        setSimilarListings(paginated);
        setPage(2);
      } else {
        setSimilarListings(prev => [...prev, ...paginated]);
        setPage(prev => prev + 1);
      }
      
      setHasMore(paginated.length === ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
      
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error loading similar listings:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [currentListing, allListings, page, calculateScore]);

  // Load more for infinite scroll
  const loadMore = React.useCallback(() => {
    if (!loading && hasMore) {
      loadSimilar();
    }
  }, [loading, hasMore, loadSimilar]);

  // Reset when listing changes
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (currentListing) {
      setSimilarListings([]);
      setPage(1);
      setHasMore(true);
      loadSimilar(true);
    }
  }, [currentListing?.id]);

  return {
    similarListings,
    loading,
    hasMore,
    loadMore
  };
}

window.useSimilarListings = useSimilarListings;
--- ./hooks/useSmartValidation.js ---

function useSmartValidation(initialData, validators, options = {}) {
  const {
    validateOnChange = true,
      validateOnBlur = true,
      debounceMs = 300,
      autoSave = true,
      draftKey = null
  } = options;
  
  const [data, setData] = React.useState(() => {
    if (autoSave && draftKey) {
      try {
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(`draft_${draftKey}`);
        return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : initialData;
      } catch (e) {
        return initialData;
      }
    }
    return initialData;
  });
  
  const [errors, setErrors] = React.useState({});
  const [touched, setTouched] = React.useState({});
  const [isValidating, setIsValidating] = React.useState({});
  const [isFormValid, setIsFormValid] = React.useState(false);
  
  const validationTimers = React.useRef({});
  
  
  React.useEffect(() => {
    
    const requiredFields = Object.keys(validators);
    const allFieldsFilled = requiredFields.every(field => {
      const value = data[field];
      return value && value.toString().trim().length > 0;
    });
    
    const noErrors = Object.values(errors).every(error => error === null || error === undefined);
    
    setIsFormValid(allFieldsFilled && noErrors);
  }, [data, errors, validators]);
  
  
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (autoSave && draftKey && Object.keys(data).length > 0) {
      const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
        localStorage.setItem(`draft_${draftKey}`, JSON.stringify(data));
      }, 1000);
      
      return () => clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    }
  }, [data, autoSave, draftKey]);
  
  
  const validateField = React.useCallback((field, value, isBlur = false) => {
    
    if (validationTimers.current[field]) {
      clearTimeout(validationTimers.current[field]);
      delete validationTimers.current[field];
    }
    
    
    if (!validateOnChange && !isBlur) return;
    if (!validateOnBlur && isBlur) return;
    
    const validator = validators[field];
    if (!validator) return;
    
    
    if (value && window.ValidationPatterns?.isDangerous(value)) {
      setErrors(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        [field]: { type: 'error', message: 'Invalid content detected' }
      }));
      setIsValidating(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: false }));
      return;
    }
    
    
    setIsValidating(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: true }));
    
    
    validationTimers.current[field] = setTimeout(() => {
      const result = validator(value, data);
      
      
      setErrors(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        [field]: result || null
      }));
      
      
      setIsValidating(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: false }));
      
      
      delete validationTimers.current[field];
    }, isBlur ? 0 : debounceMs);
  }, [validators, data, validateOnChange, validateOnBlur, debounceMs]);
  
  
  const handleChange = React.useCallback((field) => (e) => {
    const value = e.target.value;
    
    setData(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    
    
    if (!value && errors[field]) {
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: null }));
    }
    
    
    if (touched[field]) {
      validateField(field, value);
    }
  }, [touched, errors, validateField]);
  
  
  const handleBlur = React.useCallback((field) => () => {
    setTouched(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: true }));
    validateField(field, data[field], true);
  }, [data, validateField]);
  
  
  const handleFocus = React.useCallback((field) => () => {
    
    if (errors[field]?.type === 'hint' || errors[field]?.type === 'warning') {
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: null }));
    }
  }, [errors]);
  
  
  const getFieldProps = React.useCallback((field, type = 'text') => {
    return {
      name: field,
      type,
      value: data[field] || '',
      onChange: handleChange(field),
      onBlur: handleBlur(field),
      onFocus: handleFocus(field),
      error: errors[field],
      isValidating: isValidating[field],
      touched: touched[field]
    };
  }, [data, errors, isValidating, touched, handleChange, handleBlur, handleFocus]);
  
  
  const resetForm = React.useCallback((newData = initialData) => {
    setData(newData);
    setErrors({});
    setTouched({});
    setIsValidating({});
    
    
    Object.keys(validationTimers.current).forEach(key => {
      clearTimeout(validationTimers.current[key]);
    });
    validationTimers.current = {};
    
    if (autoSave && draftKey) {
      localStorage.removeItem(`draft_${draftKey}`);
    }
  }, [initialData, autoSave, draftKey]);
  
  
  const clearDraft = React.useCallback(() => {
    if (draftKey) {
      localStorage.removeItem(`draft_${draftKey}`);
      setData(initialData);
      setErrors({});
      setTouched({});
    }
  }, [draftKey, initialData]);
  
  return {
    data,
    errors,
    touched,
    isValidating,
    isFormValid,
    handleChange,
    handleBlur,
    handleFocus,
    validateField,
    resetForm,
    clearDraft,
    getFieldProps,
    setData,
    setTouched
  };
}

window.useSmartValidation = useSmartValidation;

// hooks/useToast.js - Hook for toast functionality

function useToast() {
  const [toast, setToast] = React.useState({ show: false, message: '', type: 'success' });
  const timeoutRef = React.useRef(null);
  
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleToast = (e) => {
      show(e.detail.message, e.detail.type, e.detail.duration);
    };
    
    window.addEventListener('show-toast', handleToast);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('show-toast', handleToast);
  }, []);
  
  const show = React.useCallback((message, type = 'success', duration = 3000) => {
    if (timeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    
    setToast({ show: true, message, type });
    
    timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setToast({ show: false, message: '', type: 'success' });
    }, duration);
  }, []);
  
  React.useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (timeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    };
  }, []);
  
  const ToastComponent = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!toast.show) return null;
    
    const bgColor = toast.type === 'success' ? 'bg-green-600' :
      toast.type === 'error' ? 'bg-red-600' :
      toast.type === 'warning' ? 'bg-yellow-600' :
      'bg-blue-600';
    
    return React.createElement('div', {
      className: `fixed bottom-24 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 z-50 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-lg text-white text-sm animate-fade-in-up ${bgColor}`
    }, toast.message);
  }, [toast]);
  
  return {
    showToast: show,
    toast,
    ToastComponent
  };
}

window.useToast = useToast;

// hooks/useVerification.js - Hook for verification checks

function useVerification() {
  const [showWarning, setShowWarning] = React.useState(false);
  const [warningMessage, setWarningMessage] = React.useState('');
  
  // Listen for verification warning events
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleVerificationWarning = (e) => {
      setWarningMessage(e.detail.message);
      setShowWarning(true);
      setTimeout(() => setShowWarning(false), 5000);
    };
    
    window.addEventListener('show-verification-warning', handleVerificationWarning);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('show-verification-warning', handleVerificationWarning);
  }, []);
  
  const checkVerification = React.useCallback((user, action) => {
    if (!user) {
      window.__openAuthModal?.('login', window.location.pathname);
      return false;
    }
    
    const check = window.VerificationHelpers.checkEmailVerification(user, action);
    if (!check.allowed) {
      window.VerificationHelpers.showVerificationWarning(check.message);
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }, []);
  
  const resendVerification = React.useCallback(async (user) => {
    const success = await window.VerificationHelpers.resendVerificationEmail(user);
    if (success) {
      const toastEvent = new CustomEvent('show-toast', {
        detail: { message: 'Verification email sent! Check your inbox.', type: 'success' }
      });
      window.dispatchEvent(toastEvent);
    } else {
      const toastEvent = new CustomEvent('show-toast', {
        detail: { message: 'Failed to send verification email', type: 'error' }
      });
      window.dispatchEvent(toastEvent);
    }
    return success;
  }, []);
  
  return {
    showWarning,
    warningMessage,
    checkVerification,
    resendVerification
  };
}

window.useVerification = useVerification;

    <!-- Dynamic CSS loading based on screen size -->
    <script>
        (function() {
            function loadCSS(href) {
                var link = document.createElement('link');
                link.rel = 'stylesheet';
                link.href = href;
                document.head.appendChild(link);
            }
            
            function loadAppropriateCSS() {
                var width = window.innerWidth;
                if (width < 768) {
                    loadCSS('/styles/mobile.css');
                } else {
                    loadCSS('/styles/desktop.css');
                }
            }
            
            // Load on initial page load
            loadAppropriateCSS();
            
            // Reload on resize (debounced)
            var resizeTimer;
            window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
                clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
                resizeTimer = setTimeout(function() {
                    // Remove old CSS
                    var links = document.querySelectorAll('link[rel="stylesheet"][href*="mobile.css"], link[rel="stylesheet"][href*="desktop.css"]');
                    links.forEach(function(link) { link.remove(); });
                    
                    // Load new CSS
                    loadAppropriateCSS();
                }, 250);
            });
        })();
    </script>

    <!-- ===== CRITICAL: DARK MODE - MUST RUN BEFORE ANY RENDERING ===== -->
    <script>
        (function() {
            // Check dark mode preference - runs BEFORE anything renders
            var isDark = localStorage.getItem('darkMode') === 'true';
            
            if (isDark) {
                // Apply to body immediately
                document.body.classList.add('dark-mode');
                
                // Update theme-color meta tag
                var themeColor = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');
                if (themeColor) {
                    themeColor.setAttribute('content', '#0f1722');
                }
                
                // Create style tag that applies dark mode BEFORE any content renders
                var style = document.createElement('style');
                style.textContent =
                    '.splash-screen { background-color: #0f1722 !important; } ' +
                    '.splash-logo { filter: brightness(1.1); } ' +
                    '.typewriter, .typewriter-top, .typewriter-bottom { color: #34d399 !important; } ' +
                    '.typewriter-cursor { background-color: #34d399 !important; }';
                document.head.appendChild(style);
                
                // Also directly target splash if it exists (double protection)
                if (document.getElementById('splash-screen')) {
                    document.getElementById('splash-screen').style.backgroundColor = '#0f1722';
                }
            } else {
                // Ensure light mode theme color
                var themeColor = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');
                if (themeColor) {
                    themeColor.setAttribute('content', '#C8E9BE');
                }
            }
        })();
    </script>

                setTimeout(() => {

    <script>
        // Store the last attempted URL
        let lastAttemptedUrl = '/';
        
        // Detect offline status
        window.addEventListener('offline', function() {
            // Save current URL before going offline
            if (window.location.pathname !== '/offline.html') {
                lastAttemptedUrl = window.location.pathname + window.location.search;
                sessionStorage.setItem('offline_return_url', lastAttemptedUrl);
            }
            
            const toast = document.createElement('div');
            toast.className = 'fixed bottom-24 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 z-50 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-lg text-white text-sm animate-fade-in-up bg-yellow-600';
            toast.innerText = 'üì° You are offline - showing cached content';
            toast.id = 'offline-toast';
            document.body.appendChild(toast);
            setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 3000);
        });
        
        window.addEventListener('online', function() {
            const toast = document.createElement('div');
            toast.className = 'fixed bottom-24 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 z-50 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-lg text-white text-sm animate-fade-in-up bg-green-600';
            toast.innerText = '‚úÖ Back online!';
            toast.id = 'online-toast';
            document.body.appendChild(toast);
            setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 3000);
            
            // If we're on offline page, go back to where we came from
            if (window.location.pathname === '/offline.html') {
                const returnUrl = sessionStorage.getItem('offline_return_url') || '/';
                window.location.href = returnUrl;
            }
        });
    </script>

        if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
            window.addEventListener('load', function() {
                navigator.serviceWorker.register('/service-worker.js').catch(function(err) {
                    
                });
            });

--- ./pages/AdminPage.js ---
// pages/AdminPage.js - ENHANCED with full content moderation
// Features:
// - Delete any listing from the platform (permanent)
// - Hide any listing (soft delete, can be restored)
// - View all listings with filters
// - Search across all content
// - Bulk actions
// - SEPARATE Landlord & Agent verifications

function AdminPage({ user, navigate }) {
  const [isAdmin, setIsAdmin] = React.useState(null);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = React.useState('listings'); // listings, pending, reports, landlord_verifications, agent_verifications
  const [isCreatingAdmin, setIsCreatingAdmin] = React.useState(false);
  
  // ===== ALL LISTINGS STATE (for content moderation) =====
  const [allListings, setAllListings] = React.useState([]);
  const [allListingsLoading, setAllListingsLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const [allListingsFilter, setAllListingsFilter] = React.useState('all');
  const [allListingsSearch, setAllListingsSearch] = React.useState('');
  const [allListingsUsingIndex, setAllListingsUsingIndex] = React.useState(true);
  const [selectedListings, setSelectedListings] = React.useState([]);
  const [bulkActionLoading, setBulkActionLoading] = React.useState(false);
  
  // Reports state
  const [reports, setReports] = React.useState([]);
  const [reportsLoading, setReportsLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const [reportsFilter, setReportsFilter] = React.useState('pending');
  const [reportsUsingIndex, setReportsUsingIndex] = React.useState(true);
  
  // ===== LANDLORD VERIFICATIONS STATE =====
  const [landlordVerifications, setLandlordVerifications] = React.useState([]);
  const [landlordVerificationsLoading, setLandlordVerificationsLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const [landlordVerificationsUsingIndex, setLandlordVerificationsUsingIndex] = React.useState(true);
  const [landlordRejectReason, setLandlordRejectReason] = React.useState({});
  const [landlordRejectOpen, setLandlordRejectOpen] = React.useState(null);
  
  // ===== AGENT VERIFICATIONS STATE =====
  const [agentVerifications, setAgentVerifications] = React.useState([]);
  const [agentVerificationsLoading, setAgentVerificationsLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const [agentVerificationsUsingIndex, setAgentVerificationsUsingIndex] = React.useState(true);
  const [agentRejectReason, setAgentRejectReason] = React.useState({});
  const [agentRejectOpen, setAgentRejectOpen] = React.useState(null);

  // Pending listings state
  const [pendingListings, setPendingListings] = React.useState([]);
  const [pendingListingsLoading, setPendingListingsLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const [pendingListingsUsingIndex, setPendingListingsUsingIndex] = React.useState(true);
  const [rejectionReason, setRejectionReason] = React.useState({});
  const [rejectListingOpen, setRejectListingOpen] = React.useState(null);

  // Confirmation modal state
  const [confirmModal, setConfirmModal] = React.useState({
    show: false,
    title: '',
    message: '',
    action: null,
    data: null
  });

  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = React.useState({});

  const { openModal } = window.useAuthModal();
  
  // ===== HARDCODED ADMIN EMAIL =====
  const ADMIN_EMAIL = 'oboobotenefiok@gmail.com';
  
  React.useEffect(function() {
    if (!user) {
      navigate('/');
      openModal('login', '/admin');
      return;
    }

    if (user.email === ADMIN_EMAIL) {
      const ensureAdminDocument = async () => {
        setIsCreatingAdmin(true);
        try {
          const adminDoc = await db.collection('admins').doc(user.uid).get();
          
          if (!adminDoc.exists) {
            await db.collection('admins').doc(user.uid).set({
              email: user.email,
              uid: user.uid,
              createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
              createdBy: 'system',
              role: 'super-admin',
              permissions: ['all']
            });
          }
          setIsAdmin(true);
        } catch (err) {
          setIsAdmin(true);
        } finally {
          setIsCreatingAdmin(false);
        }
      };
      
      ensureAdminDocument();
      return;
    }

    db.collection('admins').doc(user.uid).get()
      .then(function(doc) {
        setIsAdmin(doc.exists);
      })
      .catch(function(err) {
        setIsAdmin(false);
      });
  }, [user, navigate, openModal]);
  
  // ===== FETCH ALL LISTINGS =====
  React.useEffect(function() {
    if (!isAdmin || activeTab !== 'listings') return;
    fetchAllListings();
  }, [isAdmin, activeTab, allListingsFilter, allListingsSearch]);

  async function fetchAllListings(reset = true) {
    setAllListingsLoading(true);
    
    try {
      let queryOptions = {
        collection: 'listings',
        orderBy: 'createdAt',
        orderDirection: 'desc',
        limit: 50
      };
      
      if (allListingsFilter !== 'all') {
        if (allListingsFilter === 'active') {
          queryOptions.where = [['status', '==', 'available']];
        } else if (allListingsFilter === 'hidden') {
          queryOptions.where = [['status', '==', 'hidden_by_admin']];
        } else if (allListingsFilter === 'deleted') {
          queryOptions.where = [['status', '==', 'deleted']];
        } else if (allListingsFilter === 'pending') {
          queryOptions.where = [['status', '==', 'pending_review']];
        }
      }
      
      const result = await FirestoreQueries.query(queryOptions);
      
      setAllListingsUsingIndex(result.usingIndex);
      
      let filteredData = result.data;
      if (allListingsSearch.trim()) {
        const searchTerm = allListingsSearch.toLowerCase().trim();
        filteredData = result.data.filter(listing => 
          (listing.title && listing.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm)) ||
          (listing.description && listing.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm)) ||
          (listing.address && listing.address.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm)) ||
          (listing.lga && listing.lga.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm)) ||
          (listing.state && listing.state.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm)) ||
          (listing.userName && listing.userName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm)) ||
          (listing.id && listing.id.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm))
        );
      }
      
      setAllListings(filteredData);
      
    } catch (err) {
      
    } finally {
      setAllListingsLoading(false);
    }
  }
  
  // Fetch reports
  React.useEffect(function() {
    if (!isAdmin || activeTab !== 'reports') return;
    fetchReports();
  }, [isAdmin, activeTab, reportsFilter]);

  async function fetchReports() {
    setReportsLoading(true);
    
    try {
      const result = await FirestoreQueries.query({
        collection: 'reports',
        where: [['status', '==', reportsFilter]],
        orderBy: 'createdAt',
        orderDirection: 'desc',
        limit: 50
      });
      
      setReportsUsingIndex(result.usingIndex);
      setReports(result.data);
      
    } catch (err) {
      
    } finally {
      setReportsLoading(false);
    }
  }
  
  // ===== FETCH LANDLORD VERIFICATIONS =====
  React.useEffect(function() {
    if (!isAdmin || activeTab !== 'landlord_verifications') return;
    fetchLandlordVerifications();
  }, [isAdmin, activeTab]);

  async function fetchLandlordVerifications() {
    setLandlordVerificationsLoading(true);
    
    try {
      // Get all users with pending landlord verification
      const result = await FirestoreQueries.query({
        collection: 'users',
        where: [['verified.landlord.status', '==', 'pending']],
        orderBy: 'createdAt',
        orderDirection: 'desc',
        limit: 50
      });
      
      setLandlordVerificationsUsingIndex(result.usingIndex);
      setLandlordVerifications(result.data);
      
    } catch (err) {
      
    } finally {
      setLandlordVerificationsLoading(false);
    }
  }
  
  // ===== FETCH AGENT VERIFICATIONS =====
  React.useEffect(function() {
    if (!isAdmin || activeTab !== 'agent_verifications') return;
    fetchAgentVerifications();
  }, [isAdmin, activeTab]);

  async function fetchAgentVerifications() {
    setAgentVerificationsLoading(true);
    
    try {
      // Get all users with pending agent verification
      const result = await FirestoreQueries.query({
        collection: 'users',
        where: [['verified.agent.status', '==', 'pending']],
        orderBy: 'createdAt',
        orderDirection: 'desc',
        limit: 50
      });
      
      setAgentVerificationsUsingIndex(result.usingIndex);
      setAgentVerifications(result.data);
      
    } catch (err) {
      
    } finally {
      setAgentVerificationsLoading(false);
    }
  }

  // Fetch pending listings
  React.useEffect(function() {
    if (!isAdmin || activeTab !== 'pending') return;
    fetchPendingListings();
  }, [isAdmin, activeTab]);

  async function fetchPendingListings() {
    setPendingListingsLoading(true);
    
    try {
      const result = await FirestoreQueries.query({
        collection: 'listings',
        where: [['status', '==', 'pending_review']],
        orderBy: 'createdAt',
        orderDirection: 'desc',
        limit: 50
      });
      
      setPendingListingsUsingIndex(result.usingIndex);
      setPendingListings(result.data);
      
    } catch (err) {
        } finally {
      setPendingListingsLoading(false);
    }
  }

  // ===== CONTENT MODERATION ACTIONS ===== (same as before, keeping existing)
  async function permanentlyDeleteListing(listing) {
    setConfirmModal({
      show: true,
      title: '‚ö†Ô∏è Permanently Delete Listing',
      message: `Are you sure you want to PERMANENTLY delete "${listing.title}"? This action CANNOT be undone.`,
      action: async () => {
        setLoading(listing.id, true);
        try {
          await db.collection('listings').doc(listing.id).delete();
          
          try {
            const commentsRef = db.collection('listings').doc(listing.id).collection('comments');
            const comments = await commentsRef.get();
            const batch = db.batch();
            comments.docs.forEach(doc => batch.delete(doc.ref));
            await batch.commit();
          } catch (e) {}
          
          setAllListings(prev => prev.filter(l => l.id !== listing.id));
          if (selectedListings.includes(listing.id)) {
            setSelectedListings(prev => prev.filter(id => id !== listing.id));
          }
          
          await db.collection('adminLogs').add({
            action: 'permanent_delete',
            targetId: listing.id,
            targetTitle: listing.title,
            performedBy: user.uid,
            performedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
          });
          
          alert(`‚úÖ Listing "${listing.title}" permanently deleted`);
        } catch (err) {
          alert('‚ùå Failed to delete listing.');
        } finally {
          setLoading(listing.id, false);
          setConfirmModal({ ...confirmModal, show: false });
        }
      }
    });
  }

  async function hideListing(listing) {
    setLoading(listing.id, true);
    try {
      await db.collection('listings').doc(listing.id).update({
        status: 'hidden_by_admin',
        hiddenAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        hiddenBy: user.uid
      });
      
      setAllListings(prev => prev.map(l => 
        l.id === listing.id ? { ...l, status: 'hidden_by_admin' } : l
      ));
      
      try {
        await db.collection('users').doc(listing.userId)
          .collection('notifications').add({
            type: 'listing_hidden',
            title: 'üì¢ Your listing has been hidden',
            body: `Your listing "${listing.title}" has been hidden by an admin.`,
            listingId: listing.id,
            read: false,
            createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
          });
      } catch (e) {}
      
      alert(`‚úÖ Listing "${listing.title}" hidden`);
    } catch (err) {
      alert('‚ùå Failed to hide listing');
    } finally {
      setLoading(listing.id, false);
    }
  }

  async function restoreListing(listing) {
    setLoading(listing.id, true);
    try {
      await db.collection('listings').doc(listing.id).update({
        status: 'available',
        restoredAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        restoredBy: user.uid
      });
      
      setAllListings(prev => prev.map(l => 
        l.id === listing.id ? { ...l, status: 'available' } : l
      ));
      
      try {
        await db.collection('users').doc(listing.userId)
          .collection('notifications').add({
            type: 'listing_restored',
            title: '‚úÖ Your listing has been restored',
            body: `Your listing "${listing.title}" has been restored.`,
            listingId: listing.id,
            read: false,
            createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
          });
      } catch (e) {}
      
      alert(`‚úÖ Listing "${listing.title}" restored`);
    } catch (err) {
      alert('‚ùå Failed to restore listing');
    } finally {
      setLoading(listing.id, false);
    }
  }

  async function bulkHide() {
    if (selectedListings.length === 0) return;
    
    setConfirmModal({
      show: true,
      title: `Hide ${selectedListings.length} Listings`,
      message: `Hide ${selectedListings.length} selected listings?`,
      action: async () => {
        setBulkActionLoading(true);
        try {
          const batch = db.batch();
          selectedListings.forEach(id => {
            const ref = db.collection('listings').doc(id);
            batch.update(ref, {
              status: 'hidden_by_admin',
              hiddenAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
              hiddenBy: user.uid
            });
          });
          await batch.commit();
          
          setAllListings(prev => prev.map(l => 
            selectedListings.includes(l.id) ? { ...l, status: 'hidden_by_admin' } : l
          ));
          setSelectedListings([]);
          
          alert(`‚úÖ ${selectedListings.length} listings hidden`);
        } catch (err) {
          alert('‚ùå Failed to hide some listings');
        } finally {
          setBulkActionLoading(false);
          setConfirmModal({ ...confirmModal, show: false });
        }
      }
    });
  }

  async function bulkDelete() {
    if (selectedListings.length === 0) return;
    
    setConfirmModal({
      show: true,
      title: '‚ö†Ô∏è PERMANENTLY DELETE Multiple Listings',
      message: `Delete ${selectedListings.length} listings permanently?`,
      action: async () => {
        setBulkActionLoading(true);
        try {
          for (let i = 0; i < selectedListings.length; i += 10) {
            const batch = db.batch();
            const batchIds = selectedListings.slice(i, i + 10);
            
            batchIds.forEach(id => {
              const ref = db.collection('listings').doc(id);
              batch.delete(ref);
            });
            
            await batch.commit();
          }
          
          setAllListings(prev => prev.filter(l => !selectedListings.includes(l.id)));
          setSelectedListings([]);
          
          alert(`‚úÖ ${selectedListings.length} listings deleted`);
        } catch (err) {
          alert('‚ùå Failed to delete some listings');
        } finally {
          setBulkActionLoading(false);
          setConfirmModal({ ...confirmModal, show: false });
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function toggleSelectListing(id) {
    setSelectedListings(prev => 
      prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter(i => i !== id) : [...prev, id]
    );
  }

  function selectAll() {
    if (selectedListings.length === allListings.length) {
      setSelectedListings([]);
    } else {
      setSelectedListings(allListings.map(l => l.id));
    }
  }

  function setLoading(id, val) {
    setActionLoading(function(prev) {
      const next = { ...prev };
      if (val) next[id] = true;
      else delete next[id];
      return next;
    });
  }

  function removeReport(reportId) {
    setReports(function(prev) { return prev.filter(function(r) { return r.id !== reportId; }); });
  }

  function removeLandlordVerification(userId) {
    setLandlordVerifications(function(prev) { return prev.filter(function(v) { return v.id !== userId; }); });
  }

  function removeAgentVerification(userId) {
    setAgentVerifications(function(prev) { return prev.filter(function(v) { return v.id !== userId; }); });
  }

  function removePendingListing(listingId) {
    setPendingListings(function(prev) { return prev.filter(function(l) { return l.id !== listingId; }); });
  }

  async function dismissReport(report) {
    setLoading(report.id, true);
    try {
      await db.collection('reports').doc(report.id).update({
        status: 'dismissed',
        reviewedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        reviewedBy: user.uid
      });
      removeReport(report.id);
    } catch (err) {
      alert('Failed to dismiss report.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(report.id, false);
    }
  }

  async function removeContent(report) {
    if (!window.confirm('Remove this ' + report.targetType + '?')) return;

    setLoading(report.id, true);
    try {
      const batch = db.batch();

      if (report.targetType === 'listing') {
        batch.update(db.collection('listings').doc(report.targetId), {
          status: 'removed_by_admin',
          removedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
          removedBy: user.uid,
          removedReason: report.reason
        });
      }

      batch.update(db.collection('reports').doc(report.id), {
        status: 'resolved',
        reviewedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        reviewedBy: user.uid,
        adminNote: 'Content removed'
      });

      await batch.commit();
      removeReport(report.id);
    } catch (err) {
      alert('Failed to remove content.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(report.id, false);
    }
  }

  async function banUser(report) {
    const userId = report.targetType === 'user' ? report.targetId : null;
    if (!userId) {
      alert('Cannot ban: no user target.');
      return;
    }

    if (!window.confirm('Ban user ' + userId + '?')) return;

    setLoading(report.id, true);
    try {
      const batch = db.batch();

      batch.update(db.collection('users').doc(userId), {
        status: 'banned',
        bannedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        bannedBy: user.uid,
        banReason: report.reason
      });

      batch.update(db.collection('reports').doc(report.id), {
        status: 'resolved',
        reviewedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        reviewedBy: user.uid,
        adminNote: 'User banned'
      });

      await batch.commit();
      removeReport(report.id);
    } catch (err) {
      alert('Failed to ban user.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(report.id, false);
    }
  }

  // ===== LANDLORD VERIFICATION ACTIONS =====
  async function approveLandlordVerification(targetUser) {
    setLoading(targetUser.id, true);
    try {
      await db.collection('users').doc(targetUser.id).update({
        'verified.landlord.status': 'approved',
        'verified.landlord.approvedAt': firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'verified.landlord.approvedBy': user.uid
      });
      removeLandlordVerification(targetUser.id);
      
      // Send notification
      await db.collection('users').doc(targetUser.id)
        .collection('notifications').add({
          type: 'verification_approved',
          title: '‚úÖ Landlord Verification Approved',
          body: 'Your landlord verification has been approved! You now have a Landlord badge.',
          read: false,
          createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
        });
        
      alert('‚úÖ Landlord verification approved');
    } catch (err) {
      alert('Failed to approve.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(targetUser.id, false);
    }
  }

  async function rejectLandlordVerification(targetUser) {
    const reason = landlordRejectReason[targetUser.id] || '';
    if (!reason.trim()) {
      alert('Please enter a rejection reason.');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(targetUser.id, true);
    try {
      await db.collection('users').doc(targetUser.id).update({
        'verified.landlord.status': 'rejected',
        'verified.landlord.rejectionReason': reason.trim(),
        'verified.landlord.reviewedAt': firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'verified.landlord.reviewedBy': user.uid
      });
      removeLandlordVerification(targetUser.id);
      setLandlordRejectOpen(null);
      
      // Send notification
      await db.collection('users').doc(targetUser.id)
        .collection('notifications').add({
          type: 'verification_rejected',
          title: '‚úï Landlord Verification Rejected',
          body: `Your landlord verification was rejected. Reason: ${reason}`,
          read: false,
          createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
        });
        
      alert('‚úï Landlord verification rejected');
    } catch (err) {
      alert('Failed to reject.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(targetUser.id, false);
    }
  }

async function approveListing(listing) {
  setLoading(listing.id, true);
  try {
    // ===== GENERATE LISTING CODE ON APPROVAL =====
    let listingCode = null;
    try {
      listingCode = await window.IDGenerator.generateUniqueListingCode();
    } catch (codeErr) {
      console.error('Error generating listing code:', codeErr);
      alert('Failed to generate listing code. Please try again.');
      setLoading(listing.id, false);
      return;
    }
    
    await db.collection('listings').doc(listing.id).update({
      status: 'available',
      listingCode: listingCode, // ‚Üê NEW FIELD
      approvedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      approvedBy: user.uid
    });
    
    removePendingListing(listing.id);
    
    const notificationRef = db.collection('users').doc(listing.userId)
      .collection('notifications').doc();
    await notificationRef.set({
      type: 'listing_approved',
      title: 'Listing Approved! ‚úÖ',
      body: `Your listing "${listing.title}" has been approved and is now live. Share it at: /listing/${listingCode}`,
      listingId: listing.id,
      listingCode: listingCode,
      read: false,
      createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
    });
    
  } catch (err) {
    alert('Failed to approve listing.');
  } finally {
    setLoading(listing.id, false);
  }
}
  async function rejectListing(listing) {
    const reason = rejectionReason[listing.id] || '';
    if (!reason.trim()) {
      alert('Please enter a rejection reason.');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(listing.id, true);
    try {
      await db.collection('listings').doc(listing.id).update({
        status: 'rejected',
        rejectionReason: reason.trim(),
        rejectedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        rejectedBy: user.uid
      });
      removePendingListing(listing.id);
      setRejectListingOpen(null);
      
      const notificationRef = db.collection('users').doc(listing.userId)
        .collection('notifications').doc();
      await notificationRef.set({
        type: 'listing_rejected',
        title: 'Listing Needs Changes ‚úèÔ∏è',
        body: `Your listing "${listing.title}" was not approved. Reason: ${reason}`,
        listingId: listing.id,
        read: false,
        createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
      });
      
    } catch (err) {
      alert('Failed to reject listing.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(listing.id, false);
    }
  }

  function maskId(str) {
    if (!str || str.length < 4) return '****';
    return str.slice(0, 3) + '****' + str.slice(-3);
  }

  function formatTimestamp(ts) {
    if (!ts) return '‚Äî';
    const date = ts.seconds ? new Date(ts.seconds * 1000) : new Date(ts);
    return date.toLocaleDateString('en-NG', { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  }

  function ConfirmationModal() {
    if (!confirmModal.show) return null;
    
    return React.createElement('div', {
      className: 'fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm',
      onClick: (e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) setConfirmModal({ ...confirmModal, show: false }); }
    },
      React.createElement('div', {
        className: 'bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden'
      },
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'p-6' },
          React.createElement('h3', { className: 'text-xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2' }, confirmModal.title),
          React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-600 mb-6' }, confirmModal.message),
          
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex gap-3' },
            React.createElement('button', {
              onClick: () => setConfirmModal({ ...confirmModal, show: false }),
              className: 'flex-1 px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50 transition font-medium'
            }, 'Cancel'),
            
            React.createElement('button', {
              onClick: confirmModal.action,
              className: 'flex-1 px-4 py-2 bg-red-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-red-700 transition font-medium'
            }, 'Confirm')
          )
        )
      )
    );
  }

  if (!user) {
    return React.createElement('div', { className: 'min-h-screen bg-green-50 flex items-center justify-center' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-gray-200 animate-pulse mx-auto' })
    );
  }

  if (isAdmin === null || isCreatingAdmin) {
    return React.createElement('div', { className: 'min-h-screen bg-green-50 flex items-center justify-center' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-center' },
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gray-200 animate-pulse mx-auto mb-4' }),
        React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-600' }, 
          isCreatingAdmin ? 'Setting up admin access...' : 'Verifying admin access...'
        )
      )
    );
  }

  if (!isAdmin) {
    return React.createElement('div', { className: 'min-h-screen bg-green-50 flex items-center justify-center' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-center max-w-sm mx-auto px-4' },
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-6xl mb-4' }, 'üîí'),
        React.createElement('h2', { className: 'text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2' }, 'Access Denied'),
        React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-600 mb-6' }, 'You do not have admin privileges.'),
        React.createElement('button', {
          onClick: function() { navigate('/'); },
          className: 'bg-green-950 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-green-800 transition cursor-pointer'
        }, 'Go Home')
      )
    );
  }

  function TabBtn(label, key) {
    const active = activeTab === key;
    return React.createElement('button', {
      key: key,
      onClick: function() { setActiveTab(key); },
      className: 'px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-t-lg transition border-b-2 ' +
        (active ? 'border-green-950 text-green-950 bg-white' : 'border-transparent text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 hover:border-gray-300')
    }, label);
  }

  function StatusBadge(status) {
    const colours = {
      pending: 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800',
      pending_review: 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800',
      resolved: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700',
      dismissed: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600',
      rejected: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700',
      available: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700',
      hidden_by_admin: 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800',
      deleted: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 line-through',
      scam: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700',
      approved: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700'
    };
    return React.createElement('span', {
      className: 'inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium ' + (colours[status] || 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700')
    }, status);
  }

  // ===== ALL LISTINGS TAB (same as before) =====
  function AllListingsTab() {
    if (allListingsLoading) {
      return React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex justify-center py-16' },
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-gray-200 animate-pulse mx-auto' })
      );
    }

    return React.createElement('div', null,
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'mb-4 space-y-3' },
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap' },
          React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-sm text-gray-500' }, 'Filter:'),
          ['all', 'active', 'hidden', 'deleted', 'pending'].map(function(f) {
            return React.createElement('button', {
              key: f,
              onClick: function() { setAllListingsFilter(f); },
              className: `px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg border transition capitalize ${
                allListingsFilter === f
                  ? 'bg-green-950 text-white border-green-950'
                  : 'bg-white text-gray-600 border-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50'
              }`
            }, f);
          })
        ),
        
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex gap-2' },
          React.createElement('input', {
            type: 'text',
            placeholder: 'Search listings...',
            value: allListingsSearch,
            onChange: (e) => setAllListingsSearch(e.target.value),
            className: 'flex-1 p-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-950'
          }),
          React.createElement('button', {
            onClick: () => fetchAllListings(),
            className: 'px-4 py-2 bg-green-950 text-white rounded-lg text-sm hover:bg-green-800 transition'
          }, 'Search')
        ),
        
        selectedListings.length > 0 && React.createElement('div', { 
          className: 'flex items-center justify-between bg-blue-50 p-3 rounded-lg border border-blue-200'
        },
          React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-sm font-medium text-blue-800' },
            `${selectedListings.length} listing${selectedListings.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} selected`
          ),
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex gap-2' },
            React.createElement('button', {
              onClick: bulkHide,
              disabled: bulkActionLoading,
              className: 'px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium bg-orange-500 text-white rounded hover:bg-orange-600 transition disabled:opacity-50'
            }, bulkActionLoading ? '...' : 'Hide Selected'),
            React.createElement('button', {
              onClick: bulkDelete,
              disabled: bulkActionLoading,
              className: 'px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium bg-red-600 text-white rounded hover:bg-red-700 transition disabled:opacity-50'
            }, bulkActionLoading ? '...' : 'Delete Permanently')
          )
        )
      ),

      React.createElement('div', { className: 'mb-2 text-xs text-right ' + 
        (allListingsUsingIndex ? 'text-green-600' : 'text-yellow-600')
      },
        allListingsUsingIndex ? '‚ö° Using Index' : 'üîÑ JS Fallback'
      ),

      allListings.length > 0 && React.createElement('div', { className: 'mb-2 flex items-center gap-2' },
        React.createElement('input', {
          type: 'checkbox',
          id: 'select-all',
          checked: selectedListings.length === allListings.length,
          onChange: selectAll,
          className: 'w-4 h-4 accent-green-900'
        }),
        React.createElement('label', { htmlFor: 'select-all', className: 'text-sm text-gray-600' }, 'Select All')
      ),

      allListings.length === 0
        ? React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-center py-16 bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200' },
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-5xl mb-3' }, 'üì≠'),
            React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-600 font-medium' }, 'No listings found.')
          )
        : React.createElement('div', { className: 'space-y-4' },
            allListings.map(function(listing) {
              const busy = actionLoading[listing.id];
              const isSelected = selectedListings.includes(listing.id);

              return React.createElement('div', {
                  key: listing.id,
                  className: `bg-white rounded-xl border p-5 shadow-sm transition ${
                    isSelected ? 'border-blue-500 bg-blue-50/30' : 'border-gray-200'
                  }`
                },
                React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-start gap-3' },
                  React.createElement('input', {
                    type: 'checkbox',
                    checked: isSelected,
                    onChange: () => toggleSelectListing(listing.id),
                    className: 'mt-1 w-4 h-4 accent-green-900 flex-shrink-0'
                  }),
                  
                  React.createElement('div', { className: 'w-16 h-16 rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-gray-200 flex-shrink-0' },
                    listing.images && listing.images[0] ?
                      React.createElement('img', {
                        src: CloudinaryHelpers?.getThumbnailUrl(listing.images[0]),
                        className: 'w-full h-full object-cover'
                      }) :
                      React.createElement('div', { className: 'w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center text-gray-400' }, 'üì∑')
                  ),
                  
                  React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex-1' },
                    React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2 mb-1' },
                      React.createElement('div', null,
                        React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center gap-2 mb-1' },
                          StatusBadge(listing.status || 'unknown'),
                          React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-xs bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full' },
                            listing.propertyType || 'Property'
                          )
                        ),
                        React.createElement('p', { className: 'font-semibold text-gray-900' }, listing.title),
                        React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-xs text-gray-500' },
                          `By: ${listing.userName || 'Unknown'} ‚Ä¢ ID: ${listing.id.slice(0, 8)}...`
                        )
                      ),
                      React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-lg font-bold text-green-950' },
                        '‚Ç¶' + (listing.price ? listing.price.toLocaleString() : '0')
                      )
                    ),
                    
                    React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-xs text-gray-600 mb-2' },
                      'üìç ' + [listing.address, listing.lga, listing.state].filter(Boolean).join(', ')
                    ),
                    
                    React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-3' },
                      React.createElement('button', {
                        onClick: () => navigate('/listing/' + listing.id),
                        className: 'px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded hover:bg-gray-200 transition'
                      }, 'üëÅÔ∏è Preview'),
                      
                      listing.status === 'hidden_by_admin' ?
                        React.createElement('button', {
                          onClick: () => restoreListing(listing),
                          disabled: busy,
                          className: 'px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium bg-green-600 text-white rounded hover:bg-green-700 transition'
                        }, busy ? '...' : 'üîÑ Restore') :
                        React.createElement('button', {
                          onClick: () => hideListing(listing),
                          disabled: busy,
                          className: 'px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium bg-orange-500 text-white rounded hover:bg-orange-600 transition'
                        }, busy ? '...' : 'üëÅÔ∏è Hide'),
                      
                      React.createElement('button', {
                        onClick: () => permanentlyDeleteListing(listing),
                        disabled: busy,
                        className: 'px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium bg-red-600 text-white rounded hover:bg-red-700 transition'
                      }, busy ? '...' : 'üóëÔ∏è Delete'),
                      
                      React.createElement('button', {
                        onClick: () => navigate('/profile/' + listing.userId),
                        className: 'px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 rounded hover:bg-purple-200 transition'
                      }, 'üë§ User')
                    )
                  )
                )
              );
            })
          )
    );
  }

  // ===== REPORTS TAB (same as before) =====
  function ReportsTab() {
    const filterBtns = ['pending', 'resolved', 'dismissed'].map(function(f) {
      return React.createElement('button', {
        key: f,
        onClick: function() { setReportsFilter(f); },
        className: 'px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg border transition capitalize ' +
          (reportsFilter === f
            ? 'bg-green-950 text-white border-green-950'
            : 'bg-white text-gray-600 border-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50')
      }, f);
    });

    if (reportsLoading) {
      return React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex justify-center py-16' },
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-gray-200 animate-pulse mx-auto' })
      );
    }

    return React.createElement('div', null,
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'mb-2 text-xs text-right ' + 
        (reportsUsingIndex ? 'text-green-600' : 'text-yellow-600')
      },
        reportsUsingIndex ? '‚ö° Using Index' : 'üîÑ JS Fallback'
      ),

      React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center gap-2 mb-6' },
        React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-sm text-gray-500 mr-1' }, 'Status:'),
        ...filterBtns
      ),

      reports.length === 0
        ? React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-center py-16 bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200' },
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-5xl mb-3' }, '‚úÖ'),
            React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-600 font-medium' }, 'No ' + reportsFilter + ' reports.')
          )
        : React.createElement('div', { className: 'space-y-4' },
            reports.map(function(report) {
              const busy = actionLoading[report.id];
              return React.createElement('div', {
                  key: report.id,
                  className: 'bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-5 shadow-sm'
                },
                React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3 mb-3' },
                  React.createElement('div', null,
                    React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center gap-2 mb-1' },
                      StatusBadge(report.status),
                      React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-xs bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium capitalize' },
                        report.targetType
                      ),
                      React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-xs bg-red-50 text-red-700 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium' },
                        (report.reason || '').replace(/_/g, ' ')
                      )
                    ),
                    React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-xs text-gray-400' },
                      'Filed ' + formatTimestamp(report.createdAt) + ' by ' + (report.reportedBy || 'anonymous')
                    )
                  )
                ),

                React.createElement('div', { className: 'bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-3 mb-4 font-mono text-xs text-gray-600 break-all' },
                  React.createElement('span', { className: 'font-semibold text-gray-800' }, 'Target ID: '),
                  report.targetId,
                  report.targetType === 'listing' && React.createElement('button', {
                    onClick: function() { navigate('/listing/' + report.targetId); },
                    className: 'ml-2 text-blue-600 hover:underline'
                  }, '‚Üó View Listing')
                ),

                report.description && React.createElement('div', { className: 'mb-4' },
                  React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 mb-1' }, 'Reporter\'s note:'),
                  React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-sm text-gray-700 italic bg-yellow-50 p-2 rounded-lg border border-yellow-100' },
                    '"' + report.description + '"'
                  )
                ),

                report.status === 'pending' && React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex flex-wrap gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-gray-100' },
                  React.createElement('button', {
                    onClick: function() { dismissReport(report); },
                    disabled: busy,
                    className: 'px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-gray-600 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-100 transition'
                  }, busy ? '...' : 'Dismiss'),

                  report.targetType === 'listing' && React.createElement('button', {
                    onClick: function() { removeContent(report); },
                    disabled: busy,
                    className: 'px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-red-600 border border-red-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-50 transition'
                  }, busy ? '...' : 'üóë Remove Listing'),

                  report.targetType === 'user' && React.createElement('button', {
                    onClick: function() { banUser(report); },
                    disabled: busy,
                    className: 'px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-red-600 border border-red-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-50 transition'
                  }, busy ? '...' : 'üö´ Ban User')
                )
              );
            })
          )
    );
  }

  function PendingListingsTab() {

        pendingListingsUsingIndex ? '‚ö° Using Index' : 'üîÑ JS Fallback'
      ),

      pendingListings.map(function(listing) {

        const isRejecting = rejectListingOpen === listing.id;

        return React.createElement('div', {
            key: listing.id,

          },

              React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center gap-2 mb-1' },
                StatusBadge('pending_review'),
