                  listing.propertyType || 'Property'
                )
              ),
              React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900' }, listing.title),
              React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-xs text-gray-500' }, 
                'By: ' + (listing.userName || 'Unknown') + ' ‚Ä¢ ' + formatTimestamp(listing.createdAt)
              )
            ),
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-right' },
              React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-lg font-bold text-green-950' },
                '‚Ç¶' + (listing.price ? listing.price.toLocaleString() : '0')
              )
            )
          ),

          listing.images && listing.images.length > 0 &&
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex gap-2 mb-4 overflow-x-auto pb-2' },
            listing.images.slice(0, 3).map(function(img, i) {
              return React.createElement('img', {
                key: i,
                src: CloudinaryHelpers?.getThumbnailUrl(img) || '/vault/img/no-image.jpg',
                className: 'w-16 h-16 rounded-lg object-cover',
                onError: (e) => e.target.src = '/vault/img/no-image.jpg'
              });
            }),
            listing.images.length > 3 &&
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'w-16 h-16 rounded-lg bg-gray-100 flex items-center justify-center text-xs text-gray-500' },
              '+' + (listing.images.length - 3)
            )
          ),

          React.createElement('div', { className: 'bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-3 mb-3 text-xs text-gray-600' },
            React.createElement('span', { className: 'font-semibold text-gray-800' }, 'üìç '),
            [listing.address, listing.lga, listing.state].filter(Boolean).join(', ')
          ),

          React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-sm text-gray-700 mb-4 line-clamp-2' },
            listing.description || 'No description provided.'
          ),

          isRejecting && React.createElement('div', { className: 'mb-4' },
            React.createElement('label', { className: 'block text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5' }, 'Rejection reason (required):'),
            React.createElement('textarea', {
              value: rejectionReason[listing.id] || '',
              onChange: function(e) {
                setRejectionReason(function(prev) { return { ...prev, [listing.id]: e.target.value }; });
              },
              placeholder: 'e.g., Incomplete information, inappropriate content...',
              rows: 2,
              className: 'w-full p-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm resize-none focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-950'
            })
          ),

          React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex flex-wrap gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-gray-100' },
            !isRejecting && React.createElement('button', {
              onClick: function() { approveListing(listing); },
              disabled: busy,
              className: 'px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium bg-green-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-green-700 transition'
            }, busy ? '...' : '‚úÖ Approve'),

            !isRejecting && React.createElement('button', {
              onClick: function() { setRejectListingOpen(listing.id); },
              disabled: busy,
              className: 'px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-red-600 border border-red-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-50 transition'
            }, '‚úï Reject'),

            isRejecting && React.createElement('button', {
              onClick: function() { rejectListing(listing); },
              disabled: busy || !(rejectionReason[listing.id] || '').trim(),
              className: 'px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium bg-red-500 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-red-600 transition'
            }, busy ? '...' : 'Confirm Reject'),

            isRejecting && React.createElement('button', {
              onClick: function() { setRejectListingOpen(null); },
              className: 'px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-gray-600 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50 transition'
            }, 'Cancel'),

            React.createElement('button', {
              onClick: function() { navigate('/listing/' + listing.id); },
              className: 'px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-blue-600 border border-blue-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-50 transition'
            }, 'üëÅÔ∏è Preview')
          )
        );
      })
    );
  }

  return React.createElement('div', { className: 'min-h-screen bg-green-50 py-8' },
    React.createElement(ConfirmationModal, null),
    
    React.createElement('div', { className: 'max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4' },

      React.createElement('div', { className: 'mb-6' },
        React.createElement('h1', { className: 'text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900' }, 'üõ° Admin Dashboard'),
        React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-500 mt-1' }, 'Logged in as ' + (user.email || user.uid))
      ),

      React.createElement('div', { className: 'bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-800 p-3 rounded-lg mb-6 text-sm' },
        '‚ö†Ô∏è Actions taken here are permanent. Always review content before approving or rejecting.'
      ),

      React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex gap-1 border-b border-gray-200 mb-6 flex-wrap' },
        TabBtn('üìã All Listings', 'listings'),
        TabBtn('üìù Pending Review', 'pending'),
        TabBtn('üìä Reports', 'reports'),
        TabBtn('üè† Landlord Verifications', 'landlord_verifications'),
        TabBtn('ü§ù Agent Verifications', 'agent_verifications')
      ),

      activeTab === 'listings' && React.createElement(AllListingsTab, null),
      activeTab === 'pending' && React.createElement(PendingListingsTab, null),
      activeTab === 'reports' && React.createElement(ReportsTab, null),
      activeTab === 'landlord_verifications' && React.createElement(LandlordVerificationsTab, null),
      activeTab === 'agent_verifications' && React.createElement(AgentVerificationsTab, null)
    )
  );
}

// pages/ChatPage.js - COMPLETE FIXED VERSION
function ChatPage({ user, navigate }) {
  // ===== SYNCHRONOUS DETECTION =====
  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const initialChatId = params.get('chat');
  const initialMessage = params.get('message');
  
  const [selectedChat, setSelectedChat] = React.useState(null);
  const [view, setView] = React.useState(initialChatId ? 'chat' : 'list');
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const { openModal } = window.useAuthModal();
  
  // ===== DETECT DESKTOP MODE =====
  const [isDesktop, setIsDesktop] = React.useState(() => {
    return typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.innerWidth >= 768 : false;
  });
  
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleResize = () => {
      setIsDesktop(window.innerWidth >= 768);
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
  }, []);
  
  // ===== FETCH CHAT DATA =====
  React.useEffect(function() {
    if (!user) {
      navigate('/');
      openModal('login', '/chat');
      return;
    }
    
    const chatId = initialChatId;
    
    if (chatId) {
      fetchChatById(chatId);
    }
    
    const t = setTimeout(function() { setLoading(false); }, 300);
    return function() { clearTimeout(t); };
  }, [user]);
  
  // ===== SET BODY CLASS IMMEDIATELY =====
  React.useLayoutEffect(function() {
    if (view === 'chat') {
      document.body.classList.add('chat-open', 'hide-bottom-nav');
    } else {
      document.body.classList.remove('chat-open', 'hide-bottom-nav');
    }
    return function() {
      document.body.classList.remove('chat-open', 'hide-bottom-nav');
    };
  }, [view]);
  
  const fetchChatById = async function(chatId) {
    try {
      
      const chatDoc = await db.collection('chats').doc(chatId).get();
      
      if (chatDoc.exists) {
        const chatData = { id: chatDoc.id, ...chatDoc.data() };
        const otherId = chatData.participants.find(function(id) { return id !== user.uid; });
        
        
        
        const userDoc = await db.collection('users').doc(otherId).get();
        const otherUser = userDoc.exists ? userDoc.data() : { name: 'User' };
        
        setSelectedChat({
          ...chatData,
          otherUser
        });
        
        
      } else {
        
      }
    } catch (err) {
      
    }
  };
  
  const handleSelectChat = function(chat) {
    setSelectedChat(chat);
    setView('chat');
    const url = new URL(window.location);
    url.searchParams.set('chat', chat.id);
    window.history.pushState({}, '', url);
    if (chat && user) {
      NotificationHelpers.markChatAsRead(chat.id, user.uid).catch(function() {});
    }
  };
  
  const handleBackToList = function() {
    setView('list');
    setSelectedChat(null);
    const url = new URL(window.location);
    url.searchParams.delete('chat');
    url.searchParams.delete('message');
    window.history.pushState({}, '', url);
  };
  
  React.useEffect(function() {
    const handlePop = function() {
      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const chatId = params.get('chat');
      if (chatId && view === 'list') {
        setView('chat');
        fetchChatById(chatId);
      }
      else if (!chatId && view === 'chat') {
        setView('list');
        setSelectedChat(null);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('popstate', handlePop);
    return function() { window.removeEventListener('popstate', handlePop); };
  }, [view]);
  
  if (!user) {
    return React.createElement('div', { className: 'min-h-screen bg-green-50' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'p-4 space-y-3' },
        Array.from({ length: 5 }).map(function(_, i) {
          return React.createElement('div', { key: i, className: 'bg-white rounded-lg p-4 flex gap-3 animate-pulse' },
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-gray-200 flex-shrink-0' }),
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex-1 space-y-2' },
              React.createElement('div', { className: 'h-4 bg-gray-200 rounded w-1/3' }),
              React.createElement('div', { className: 'h-3 bg-gray-200 rounded w-2/3' })
            )
          );
        })
      )
    );
  }
  
  return React.createElement('div', { className: 'min-h-screen bg-green-50' },
    React.createElement('div', {
        className: view === 'chat' ?
          isDesktop ?
          'absolute inset-0 top-0 left-0 right-0 bottom-0' :
          'fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-green-50 pt-0' :
          isDesktop ?
          'max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 py-8' :
          'max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 py-8'
      },
      view === 'list' ?
      (loading ?
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'pt-4 space-y-2' },
          Array.from({ length: 6 }).map(function(_, i) {
            return React.createElement('div', { key: i, className: 'bg-white rounded-lg p-4 flex gap-3 animate-pulse' },
              React.createElement('div', { className: 'w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-gray-200 flex-shrink-0' }),
              React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex-1 space-y-2' },
                React.createElement('div', { className: 'h-4 bg-gray-200 rounded w-1/3' }),
                React.createElement('div', { className: 'h-3 bg-gray-200 rounded w-2/3' })
              )
            );
          })
        ) :
        React.createElement(ChatList, { userId: user.uid, onSelectChat: handleSelectChat })
      ) :
      React.createElement('div', {
          className: isDesktop ?
            'w-full max-w-4xl h-full flex flex-col mx-auto' :
            'h-full flex flex-col w-full'
        },
        React.createElement(ChatInterface, {
          chatId: selectedChat?.id,
          currentUserId: user.uid,
          otherUserId: selectedChat?.participants?.find(function(id) { return id !== user.uid; }),
          otherUserName: selectedChat?.otherUser?.name,
          otherUserPhoto: selectedChat?.otherUser?.photoURL,
          onClose: handleBackToList
        })
      )
    )
  );
}

window.ChatPage = ChatPage;

// pages/CheckoutNoticePage.js
function CheckoutNoticePage({ user, navigate }) {
  const [form, setForm] = React.useState({
    propertyAddress: '',
    moveOutDate: '',
    reason: ''
  });
  const [errors, setErrors] = React.useState({});
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const [loadingNotices, setLoadingNotices] = React.useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState('');
  const [notices, setNotices] = React.useState([]);
  const [usingIndex, setUsingIndex] = React.useState(true);
  const { openModal } = window.useAuthModal();
  
  React.useEffect(function() {
    if (!user) {
      navigate('/');
      openModal('login', '/checkout');
      return;
    }
    
    fetchNotices();
  }, [user, navigate, openModal]);
  
  async function fetchNotices() {
    setLoadingNotices(true);
    
    try {
      const result = await FirestoreQueries.query({
        collection: 'checkoutNotices',
        where: [['tenantId', '==', user.uid]],
        orderBy: 'createdAt',
        orderDirection: 'desc',
        limit: 50
      });
      
      setUsingIndex(result.usingIndex);
      setNotices(result.data);
      
    } catch (err) {
      
      setError('Failed to load your checkout notices');
    } finally {
      setLoadingNotices(false);
    }
  }
  
  const validateForm = () => {
    const newErrors = {};
    const v = ValidationHelpers;
    
    const addressError = v.validateAddress(form.propertyAddress, true);
    if (addressError) newErrors.propertyAddress = addressError;
    
    const dateError = v.validateDate(form.moveOutDate, true, { futureOnly: true });
    if (dateError) newErrors.moveOutDate = dateError;
    
    if (form.reason && form.reason.trim()) {
      const reasonError = v.validateText(form.reason, 'Reason', {
        required: false,
        maxLength: 500,
        allowHtml: false
      });
      if (reasonError) newErrors.reason = reasonError;
    }
    
    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  };
  
  const handleSubmit = async function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!validateForm()) return;
    
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    
    try {
      const sanitizedAddress = ValidationHelpers.sanitizeInput(form.propertyAddress, 'address');
      const sanitizedReason = form.reason ? ValidationHelpers.sanitizeInput(form.reason, 'text') : '';
      
      await db.collection('checkoutNotices').add({
        propertyAddress: sanitizedAddress,
        moveOutDate: new Date(form.moveOutDate),
        reason: sanitizedReason,
        tenantId: user.uid,
        verified: false,
        createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
      });
      
      setForm({
        propertyAddress: '',
        moveOutDate: '',
        reason: ''
      });
      setErrors({});
      
      fetchNotices();
      
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };
  
  const handleChange = (field, value) => {
    setForm({ ...form, [field]: value });
    if (errors[field]) {
      setErrors({ ...errors, [field]: null });
    }
  };
  
  if (!user) return null;
  
  return React.createElement('div', { className: 'min-h-screen bg-gray-50 py-12' },
    React.createElement('div', { className: 'max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4' },

      React.createElement('div', { className: 'mb-6 flex justify-between items-center' },
        React.createElement('a', {
          href: '/profile',
          onClick: function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            navigate('/profile');
          },
          className: 'text-blue-600 hover:underline cursor-pointer'
        }, '‚Üê Back to Profile'),
        
        React.createElement('a', {
          href: '/',
          onClick: function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            navigate('/');
          },
          className: 'text-gray-600 hover:underline cursor-pointer'
        }, 'Home')
      ),
      
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'bg-white rounded-lg shadow-md p-8 mb-8' },
        React.createElement('h1', { className: 'text-3xl font-bold mb-8' }, 'Post Checkout Notice'),
        
        error && React.createElement('div', { className: 'bg-red-50 text-red-600 p-4 rounded mb-6' }, error),
        
        React.createElement('form', { onSubmit: handleSubmit, className: 'space-y-6' },
          React.createElement('div', null,
            React.createElement('label', { className: 'block text-gray-700 font-bold mb-2' }, 'Property Address'),
            React.createElement('input', {
              type: 'text',
              name: 'propertyAddress',
              value: form.propertyAddress,
              onChange: function(e) { handleChange('propertyAddress', e.target.value); },
              className: `w-full p-3 border rounded-lg ${errors.propertyAddress ? 'border-red-500' : ''}`,
              required: true,
              placeholder: "Full address of property you're leaving"
            }),
            errors.propertyAddress &&
            React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-red-500 text-sm mt-1' }, errors.propertyAddress)
          ),
          
          React.createElement('div', null,
            React.createElement('label', { className: 'block text-gray-700 font-bold mb-2' }, 'Move-out Date'),
            React.createElement('input', {
              type: 'date',
              name: 'moveOutDate',
              value: form.moveOutDate,
              onChange: function(e) { handleChange('moveOutDate', e.target.value); },
              className: `w-full p-3 border rounded-lg ${errors.moveOutDate ? 'border-red-500' : ''}`,
              required: true,
              min: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]
            }),
            errors.moveOutDate &&
            React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-red-500 text-sm mt-1' }, errors.moveOutDate)
          ),
          
          React.createElement('div', null,
            React.createElement('label', { className: 'block text-gray-700 font-bold mb-2' }, 'Reason (optional)'),
            React.createElement('textarea', {
              name: 'reason',
              value: form.reason,
              onChange: function(e) { handleChange('reason', e.target.value); },
              rows: '3',
              className: `w-full p-3 border rounded-lg ${errors.reason ? 'border-red-500' : ''}`,
              placeholder: 'e.g., Lease ended, relocation, etc.'
            }),
            errors.reason &&
            React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-red-500 text-sm mt-1' }, errors.reason)
          ),
          
          React.createElement('button', {
            type: 'submit',
            disabled: loading,
            className: 'w-full bg-blue-600 text-white py-4 rounded-lg font-bold hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer'
          }, loading ? 'Posting...' : 'Post Checkout Notice')
        )
      ),
      
      notices.length > 0 && React.createElement('div', { className: 'bg-white rounded-lg shadow-md p-8' },
        React.createElement('h2', { className: 'text-xl font-bold mb-6' }, 'Your Checkout Notices'),
        
        loadingNotices ? 
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex justify-center py-8' },
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-gray-200 animate-pulse mx-auto' })
        ) :
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'space-y-4' },
          notices.map(function(notice) {
            return React.createElement('div', { key: notice.id, className: 'border-b pb-4 last:border-0' },
              React.createElement('p', { className: 'font-medium' }, notice.propertyAddress),
              React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-sm text-gray-600' },
                'Moving out: ' + (notice.moveOutDate?.seconds ?
                  new Date(notice.moveOutDate.seconds * 1000).toLocaleDateString() :
                  new Date(notice.moveOutDate).toLocaleDateString())
              ),
              notice.reason && React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1' }, notice.reason),
              notice.verified && React.createElement('span', {
                className: 'inline-block mt-2 text-xs bg-green-100 text-green-700 px-2 py-1 rounded'
              }, '‚úì Verified Move-out')
            );
          })
        )
      )
    )
  );
}

window.CheckoutNoticePage = CheckoutNoticePage;

function FavoritesPage({ user, navigate, cachedState, locationState }) {
  const [favorites, setFavorites] = React.useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [toast, setToast] = React.useState({ show: false, message: '', type: 'success' });
  const { openModal } = window.useAuthModal();
  const toastTimeoutRef = React.useRef(null);
  const unsubscribeRef = React.useRef(null);
  const pageRef = React.useRef(null);

  
  const showToast = (message, type = 'success') => {
    if (toastTimeoutRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(toastTimeoutRef.current);
    }
    
    setToast({ show: true, message, type });
    
    toastTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setToast({ show: false, message: '', type: 'success' });
    }, 3000);
  };

  
// pages/FavoritesPage.js - FIND THE handleCardMessageClick FUNCTION AND REPLACE

const handleCardMessageClick = async (listingId, userId, e) => {
  e.stopPropagation();
  
  if (!user) {
    openModal('login', window.location.pathname);
    return;
  }
  
  // ===== USE CENTRALIZED VERIFICATION CHECK =====
  const verificationCheck = window.VerificationHelpers?.checkEmailVerification(user, 'send messages');
  if (!verificationCheck?.allowed) {
    const message = verificationCheck?.message || 'Please verify your email to send messages';
    ToastHelpers?.warning(message);
    
    const warningEvent = new CustomEvent('show-verification-warning', {
      detail: { message }
    });
    window.dispatchEvent(warningEvent);
    
    return;
  }
  
  if (user.uid === userId) {
    showToast('You cannot message yourself', 'error');
    return;
  }
  
  try {
    showToast('Starting conversation...', 'info');
    
    const chatId = await ChatHelpers.getOrCreateListingChat(
      user.uid,
      userId,
      listingId,
      'Is this still available?'
    );
    
    navigate('/chat?chat=' + chatId);
    
  } catch (error) {
    showToast('Failed to start chat. Please try again.', 'error');
  }
};

  
  const handleShare = async (listing, e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    await ShareHelpers.shareListing(listing, { showToast });
  };

  // ===== Remove from favorites with proper database call =====
  const handleRemoveFromFavorites = async (listingId, e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    
    if (!user) {
      openModal('login', window.location.pathname);
      return;
    }
    
    // Store current state for potential rollback
    const previousFavorites = [...favorites];
    
    // Optimistic UI update
    setFavorites(function(prev) { 
      return prev.filter(function(f) { return f.id !== listingId; }); 
    });
    
    try {
      
      
      // Call database to actually remove
      const result = await FavoritesHelpers.toggleFavorite(user.uid, listingId);
      
      
      
      // Show success toast
      showToast('‚úì Removed from favorites', 'success');
      
      // Force a refresh of the favorites list
      if (unsubscribeRef.current) {
        unsubscribeRef.current();
      }
      
      // Re-subscribe to get fresh data
      const unsubscribe = FavoritesHelpers.listenToFavorites(user.uid, function(result) {
        if (!result.loading) {
          
          setFavorites(result.favorites || []);
          setLoading(false);
        }
      });
      
      unsubscribeRef.current = unsubscribe;
      
    } catch (error) {
      
      
      // Rollback on error
      setFavorites(previousFavorites);
      showToast('Failed to remove from favorites', 'error');
    }
  };

  // ===== Remove all unavailable listings =====
  const handleRemoveAllUnavailable = async () => {
    if (!confirm('Remove all unavailable listings from your favourites?')) return;
    
    const unavailableIds = deletedFavorites.map(f => f.id);
    const previousFavorites = [...favorites];
    
    // Optimistic update
    setFavorites(activeFavorites);
    
    try {
      for (const listingId of unavailableIds) {
        await FavoritesHelpers.toggleFavorite(user.uid, listingId);
        
      }
      
      showToast('All unavailable listings removed', 'success');
      
      // Force refresh
      if (unsubscribeRef.current) {
        unsubscribeRef.current();
      }
      
      const unsubscribe = FavoritesHelpers.listenToFavorites(user.uid, function(result) {
        if (!result.loading) {
          setFavorites(result.favorites || []);
        }
      });
      
      unsubscribeRef.current = unsubscribe;
      
    } catch (error) {
      
      setFavorites(previousFavorites);
      showToast('Failed to remove all listings', 'error');
    }
  };

  // ===== Setup favorites listener =====
  React.useEffect(function() {
    if (!user) {
      navigate('/');
      openModal('login', '/favorites');
      return;
    }
    
    setLoading(true);
    
    
    const unsubscribe = FavoritesHelpers.listenToFavorites(user.uid, function(result) {
            if (!result.loading) {
        setFavorites(result.favorites || []);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    });
    
    unsubscribeRef.current = unsubscribe;
    
    return function() { 
      
      if (unsubscribeRef.current) {
        unsubscribeRef.current(); 
      }
    };
  }, [user, navigate, openModal]);
  
  // ===== Restore scroll position from cache =====
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (cachedState?.scrollPosition && pageRef.current) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        pageRef.current.scrollTop = cachedState.scrollPosition;
      }, 50);
    }
  }, [cachedState]);
  
  // ===== Save state before unload =====
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const saveState = () => {
      const scrollPosition = pageRef.current?.scrollTop || 0;
      
      window.__favoritesPageState = {
        scrollPosition,
        timestamp: Date.now()
      };
      
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('favorites_state', JSON.stringify({
          timestamp: Date.now()
        }));
      } catch (e) {}
    };
    
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', saveState);
    
    return () => {
      saveState(); // Save when component unmounts
      window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', saveState);
      delete window.__favoritesPageState;
    };
  }, []);
  
  // ===== Toast cleanup =====
  React.useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (toastTimeoutRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(toastTimeoutRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, []);

  if (!user) {
    return React.createElement('div', { className: 'min-h-screen bg-green-50 flex items-center justify-center' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-center' },
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gray-200 animate-pulse mx-auto mb-4' }),
        React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-600' }, 'Redirecting to login...')
      )
    );
  }
  
  if (loading) {
    return React.createElement('div', { className: 'min-h-screen bg-green-50 py-8' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4' },
        React.createElement(SkeletonLoader.ListingGrid, { count: 8, cols: 4 })
      )
    );
  }
  
  const activeFavorites = favorites.filter(function(f) { return f && f.status !== 'deleted'; });
  const deletedFavorites = favorites.filter(function(f) { return f && f.status === 'deleted'; });
  
  if (favorites.length === 0) {
    return React.createElement('div', { className: 'min-h-screen bg-green-50 py-8' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4' },
        React.createElement('h1', { className: 'text-3xl font-bold mb-8' }, 'Saved Listings'),
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-center py-16 bg-white rounded-lg shadow-md' },
          React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-20 h-20 mx-auto text-gray-400 mb-4', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' },
            React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M4.318 6.318a4.5 4.5 0 000 6.364L12 20.364l7.682-7.682a4.5 4.5 0 00-6.364-6.364L12 7.636l-1.318-1.318a4.5 4.5 0 00-6.364 0z' })
          ),
          React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-500 text-lg mb-2' }, 'No saved listings yet'),
          React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-400 mb-6' }, 'Tap the heart icon on any listing to save it here'),
          React.createElement('a', {
            href: '/listings',
            onClick: function(e) { e.preventDefault();
              navigate('/'); },
            className: 'inline-block bg-green-950 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-green-800 transition'
          }, 'Browse Listings')
        )
      )
    );
  }
  
  return React.createElement(React.Fragment, null,
    
    toast.show && React.createElement('div', {
      className: 'fixed bottom-24 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 z-50 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-lg text-white text-sm animate-fade-in-up ' +
        (toast.type === 'success' ? 'bg-green-600' : 
         toast.type === 'error' ? 'bg-red-600' : 
         'bg-blue-600')
    }, toast.message),

    React.createElement('div', { 
      ref: pageRef,
      className: 'min-h-screen bg-green-50 py-8 overflow-y-auto' 
    },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4' },
        
    
        
        activeFavorites.length > 0 &&
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'mb-8' },
          React.createElement('h2', { className: 'text-xl font-semibold mb-4 text-gray-700' }, 'Available Listings'),
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4' },
            activeFavorites.map(function(listing) {
              const isOwner = user && user.uid === listing.userId;
              
              return React.createElement('div', {
                key: listing.id,
                className: 'bg-white rounded-lg shadow-md overflow-hidden cursor-pointer hover:shadow-lg transition',
                onClick: function() { navigate('/listing/' + listing.id); }
              },
                
                React.createElement('div', { className: 'relative h-40 bg-gray-200' },
                  React.createElement('img', {
                    src: listing.images?.[0]
                      ? window.CloudinaryHelpers.getCardUrl(listing.images[0])
                      : '/vault/img/no-image.jpg',
                    alt: listing.title,
                    className: 'w-full h-full object-cover',
                    loading: 'lazy',
                    onError: (e) => { e.target.src = '/vault/img/no-image.jpg'; }
                  }),
                  
                  React.createElement('div', { className: 'absolute bottom-1 left-1 bg-green-950 text-white px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold text-sm' },

                  )
                ),

                  React.createElement('h3', { className: 'font-bold text-gray-900 mb-0.5 line-clamp-1 text-sm' }, listing.title),
                  React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-600 mb-1 line-clamp-1 text-xs' }, listing.address),
                  
                  // ===== UPDATED: Role badge using listingRole =====
                  React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex flex-wrap gap-0.5 mb-1' },

                  ),

                        },
                        className: 'text-gray-500 hover:text-green-950 p-1 rounded hover:bg-gray-100 transition text-xs',

                      },

                          React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M8 12h.01M12 12h.01M16 12h.01M21 12c0 4.418-4.03 8-9 8a9.863 9.863 0 01-4.255-.949L3 20l1.395-3.72C3.512 15.042 3 13.574 3 12c0-4.418 4.03-8 9-8s9 3.582 9 8z' })

                      ),

                          handleShare(listing, e);
                        },
                        className: 'text-gray-500 hover:text-blue-600 p-1 rounded hover:bg-gray-100 transition text-xs',
                        title: 'Share'
                      },
                        React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-4 h-4', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' },
                          React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M8.684 13.342C8.886 12.938 9 12.482 9 12c0-.482-.114-.938-.316-1.342m0 2.684a3 3 0 110-2.684m0 2.684l6.632 3.316m-6.632-6l6.632-3.316m0 0a3 3 0 105.367-2.684 3 3 0 00-5.367 2.684zm0 9.316a3 3 0 105.368 2.684 3 3 0 00-5.368-2.684z' })
                        )
                      )
                    ),
                    
                    React.createElement('button', {
                      onClick: function(e) { 
                        handleRemoveFromFavorites(listing.id, e);
                      },
                      className: 'p-1 rounded hover:bg-gray-100 transition text-xs text-red-500 hover:text-red-700',
                      title: 'Remove from favorites'
                    },
                      React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-4 h-4', fill: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 20 20' },
                        React.createElement('path', { fillRule: 'evenodd', d: 'M3.172 5.172a4 4 0 015.656 0L10 6.343l1.172-1.171a4 4 0 115.656 5.656L10 17.657l-6.828-6.829a4 4 0 010-5.656z', clipRule: 'evenodd' })
                      )
                    )
                  )
                )
              );
            })
          )
        ),
        
        deletedFavorites.length > 0 &&
        React.createElement('div', null,
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center justify-between mb-4' },
            React.createElement('h2', { className: 'text-xl font-semibold text-gray-500' }, 'Unavailable Listings'),
            React.createElement('button', {
              onClick: handleRemoveAllUnavailable,
              className: 'text-sm text-red-600 hover:text-red-800 cursor-pointer'
            }, 'Remove all')
          ),
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 opacity-75' },
            deletedFavorites.map(function(listing) {
              return React.createElement('div', {
                key: listing.id,
                className: 'bg-white rounded-lg shadow-md overflow-hidden opacity-75',
                onClick: function() { navigate('/listing/' + listing.id); }
              },
                
                React.createElement('div', { className: 'relative h-40 bg-gray-200' },
                  React.createElement('img', {
                    src: listing.images?.[0]
                      ? window.CloudinaryHelpers.getCardUrl(listing.images[0])
                      : '/vault/img/no-image.jpg',
                    alt: listing.title,
                    className: 'w-full h-full object-cover grayscale',
                    loading: 'lazy',
                    onError: (e) => { e.target.src = '/vault/img/no-image.jpg'; }
                  }),
                  
                  React.createElement('div', { className: 'absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center' },
                    React.createElement('span', { className: 'bg-red-500 text-white px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-bold' }, 'Removed')
                  ),
                  
                  React.createElement('div', { className: 'absolute bottom-1 left-1 bg-green-950 text-white px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold text-sm' },
                    '‚Ç¶' + (listing.price ? listing.price.toLocaleString() : '0')
                  )
                ),
                
                React.createElement('div', { className: 'p-2' },
                  React.createElement('h3', { className: 'font-bold text-gray-900 mb-0.5 line-clamp-1 text-sm line-through' }, listing.title),
                  React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-600 mb-1 line-clamp-1 text-xs' }, listing.address),
                  
                  React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex flex-wrap gap-0.5 mb-1' },
                    React.createElement('span', {
                      className: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px]'
                    }, 'Removed')
                  ),
                  
                  React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center justify-between pt-1 border-t border-gray-100' },
                    React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex gap-1' },
                      
                      React.createElement('button', {
                        disabled: true,
                        className: 'text-gray-300 p-1 rounded text-xs cursor-not-allowed',
                        title: 'Cannot message on removed listing'
                      },
                        React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-4 h-4', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' },
                          React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M8 12h.01M12 12h.01M16 12h.01M21 12c0 4.418-4.03 8-9 8a9.863 9.863 0 01-4.255-.949L3 20l1.395-3.72C3.512 15.042 3 13.574 3 12c0-4.418 4.03-8 9-8s9 3.582 9 8z' })
                        )
                      ),
                      
                      React.createElement('button', {
                        disabled: true,
                        className: 'text-gray-300 p-1 rounded text-xs cursor-not-allowed',
                        title: 'Cannot share removed listing'
                      },
                        React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-4 h-4', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' },
                          React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M8.684 13.342C8.886 12.938 9 12.482 9 12c0-.482-.114-.938-.316-1.342m0 2.684a3 3 0 110-2.684m0 2.684l6.632 3.316m-6.632-6l6.632-3.316m0 0a3 3 0 105.367-2.684 3 3 0 00-5.367 2.684zm0 9.316a3 3 0 105.368 2.684 3 3 0 00-5.368-2.684z' })
                        )
                      )
                    ),
                    
                    React.createElement('button', {
                      onClick: function(e) { 
                        handleRemoveFromFavorites(listing.id, e);
                      },
                      className: 'p-1 rounded hover:bg-gray-100 transition text-xs text-red-500 hover:text-red-700',
                      title: 'Remove from favorites'
                    },
                      React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-4 h-4', fill: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 20 20' },
                        React.createElement('path', { fillRule: 'evenodd', d: 'M3.172 5.172a4 4 0 015.656 0L10 6.343l1.172-1.171a4 4 0 115.656 5.656L10 17.657l-6.828-6.829a4 4 0 010-5.656z', clipRule: 'evenodd' })
                      )
                    )

        )

    )
  );
}

// pages/ListingByCodePage.js
// Resolves listing codes like /listing/250322-001-a1b to actual listing IDs

function ListingByCodePage({ navigate }) {
  const [error, setError] = React.useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);
  
  const listingCode = window.location.pathname.split('/')[2];
  
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!listingCode) {
      setError('No listing code provided');
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    
    const resolveListingCode = async () => {
      try {
        // Validate format
        if (window.IDGenerator && !window.IDGenerator.validateListingCode(listingCode)) {
          setError('Invalid listing code format');
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }
        
        // Query by listingCode
        const result = await FirestoreQueries.query({
          collection: 'listings',
          where: [['listingCode', '==', listingCode]],
          limit: 1
        });
        
        if (result.data.length === 0) {
          setError('Listing not found');
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }
        
        const listing = result.data[0];
        
        // Check if listing is deleted
        if (listing.status === 'deleted') {
          setError('This listing has been removed');
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }
        
        // Check if listing is pending review (not yet live)
        if (listing.status === 'pending_review') {
          setError('This listing is pending review and not yet available');
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }
        
        // Redirect to the listing detail page (by Firestore ID)
        navigate('/listing/' + listing.id);
        
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error resolving listing code:', err);
        setError('Failed to load listing. Please try again.');
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    resolveListingCode();
  }, [listingCode, navigate]);
  
  if (loading) {
    return React.createElement('div', { className: 'min-h-screen bg-green-50 flex items-center justify-center' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-center' },
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gray-200 animate-pulse mx-auto mb-4' }),
        React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-600' }, 'Finding listing...')
      )
    );
  }
  
  if (error) {
    return React.createElement('div', { className: 'min-h-screen bg-green-50 flex items-center justify-center' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-center max-w-md mx-auto px-4' },
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-6xl mb-4' }, 'üè†'),
        React.createElement('h2', { className: 'text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2' }, 'Listing Not Available'),
        React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-600 mb-6' }, error),
        React.createElement('button', {
          onClick: () => navigate('/'),
          className: 'bg-green-950 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-green-800 transition cursor-pointer'
        }, 'Go Home')
      )
    );
  }
  
  return null;
}

window.ListingByCodePage = ListingByCodePage;

// pages/PublicProfilePage.js - Username-based profile (FIXED)
function PublicProfilePage({ user, navigate }) {
  
  // Extract username from URL (e.g., /johnd1234)
  const username = window.location.pathname.slice(1); // Remove leading /

  const [profileUser, setProfileUser] = React.useState(null);
  const [listings, setListings] = React.useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [listingsLoading, setListingsLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState('');
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = React.useState('listings');
  const [usingIndex, setUsingIndex] = React.useState(true);
  const [favorites, setFavorites] = React.useState({});
  const [checkingFavorites, setCheckingFavorites] = React.useState({});
  const [toast, setToast] = React.useState({ show: false, message: '', type: 'success' });
  
  const { openModal } = window.useAuthModal();
  const toastTimeoutRef = React.useRef(null);
  
  // ===== STATE FOR CURRENT USER'S USERNAME (for self-profile detection) =====
  const [currentUserUsername, setCurrentUserUsername] = React.useState(null);
  const [currentUserUid, setCurrentUserUid] = React.useState(null);

  const showToast = (message, type = 'success') => {
    if (toastTimeoutRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(toastTimeoutRef.current);
    }
    
    setToast({ show: true, message, type });
    
    toastTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setToast({ show: false, message: '', type: 'success' });
    }, 3000);
  };

  // ===== FETCH CURRENT USER'S USERNAME AND UID =====
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;
    
    setCurrentUserUid(user.uid);
    
    const fetchCurrentUser = async () => {
      try {
        const userDoc = await db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).get();
        if (userDoc.exists) {
          setCurrentUserUsername(userDoc.data().username);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error fetching current user:', err);
      }
    };
    
    fetchCurrentUser();
  }, [user]);

  // ===== FETCH USER BY USERNAME =====
  React.useEffect(function() {
    if (!username) {
      setError('No username provided');
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    // ===== FIXED: Check if viewing own profile by comparing usernames =====
    // Also check if the URL username equals current user's username
    if (user && currentUserUsername && currentUserUsername === username) {
      navigate('/profile');
      return;
    }

    var isMounted = true;
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');

    async function fetchUserByUsername() {
      try {
        // Query Firestore by username
        const result = await FirestoreQueries.query({
          collection: 'users',
          where: [['username', '==', username.toLowerCase()]],
          limit: 1
        });
        
        if (result.data.length === 0) {
          if (isMounted) {
            setError('User not found');
            setLoading(false);
          }
          return;
        }

        var userData = { id: result.data[0].id, ...result.data[0] };
        
        // ===== CRITICAL FIX: Verify we actually got the correct user =====
        // Make sure the fetched user's username matches exactly what we searched for
        if (userData.username && userData.username.toLowerCase() !== username.toLowerCase()) {
          if (isMounted) {
            setError('User not found');
            setLoading(false);
          }
          return;
        }
        
        // Use displayName (new field) with fallback to name (old field)
        if (!userData.displayName && userData.name) {
          userData.displayName = userData.name;
        }
        if (!userData.displayName) {
          userData.displayName = 'User';
        }

        if (isMounted) {
          setProfileUser(userData);
          setLoading(false);
        }

      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error fetching user by username:', err);
        if (isMounted) {
          setError('Failed to load profile');
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    fetchUserByUsername();

    return function() {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [username, user, currentUserUsername, navigate]);

  // ===== FETCH USER'S LISTINGS =====
  React.useEffect(function() {
    if (!profileUser) return;
    
    var isMounted = true;
    setListingsLoading(true);

    async function fetchListings() {
      try {
        const result = await FirestoreQueries.query({
          collection: 'listings',
          where: [
            ['userId', '==', profileUser.id],
            ['status', '==', 'available']
          ],
          orderBy: 'createdAt',
          orderDirection: 'desc',
          limit: 50
        });
        
        setUsingIndex(result.usingIndex);

        if (isMounted) {
          setListings(result.data);
          setListingsLoading(false);
          
          if (user) {
            checkAllFavorites(result.data);
          }
        }

      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error fetching listings:', err);
        if (isMounted) {
          setListings([]);
          setListingsLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    fetchListings();

    return function() {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [profileUser, user]);

  const checkAllFavorites = async (listingsArray) => {
    if (!user) return;
    
    const favoritesMap = {};
    
    for (const listing of listingsArray) {
      try {
        const isFav = await FavoritesHelpers.checkIsFavorite(user.uid, listing.id);
        favoritesMap[listing.id] = isFav;
      } catch (error) {
        
      }
    }
    
    setFavorites(favoritesMap);
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (listingId, e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    
    if (!user) {
      openModal('login', window.location.pathname);
      return;
    }
    
    const currentStatus = favorites[listingId] || false;
    
    setFavorites(prev => ({ ...prev, [listingId]: !currentStatus }));
    setCheckingFavorites(prev => ({ ...prev, [listingId]: true }));
    
    try {
      const newStatus = await FavoritesHelpers.toggleFavorite(user.uid, listingId);
      setFavorites(prev => ({ ...prev, [listingId]: newStatus }));
      
      showToast(
        newStatus ? '‚úì Saved to favorites' : '‚úì Removed from favorites',
        'success'
      );
      
    } catch (error) {
      
      setFavorites(prev => ({ ...prev, [listingId]: currentStatus }));
      showToast('Failed to update favorites', 'error');
    } finally {
      setCheckingFavorites(prev => ({ ...prev, [listingId]: false }));
    }
  };

  const handleCardMessageClick = async (listingId, userId, e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    
    if (!user) {
      openModal('login', window.location.pathname);
      return;
    }
    
    const verificationCheck = window.VerificationHelpers?.checkEmailVerification(user, 'send messages');
    if (!verificationCheck?.allowed) {
      const message = verificationCheck?.message || 'Please verify your email to send messages';
      ToastHelpers?.warning(message);
      
      const warningEvent = new CustomEvent('show-verification-warning', {
        detail: { message }
      });
      window.dispatchEvent(warningEvent);
      
      return;
    }
    
    if (user.uid === userId) {
      showToast('You cannot message yourself', 'error');
      return;
    }
    
    try {
      showToast('Starting conversation...', 'info');
      
      const chatId = await ChatHelpers.getOrCreateListingChat(
        user.uid,
        userId,
        listingId,
        'Is this still available?'
      );
      
      navigate('/chat?chat=' + chatId);
      
    } catch (error) {
      showToast('Failed to start chat. Please try again.', 'error');
    }
  };
  
  const handleShare = async (listing, e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    
    await ShareHelpers.shareListing(listing, {
      showToast,
      includePrice: true
    });
  };

  const formatJoinDate = function(timestamp) {
    if (!timestamp) return 'Recently';
    try {
      var date = timestamp.seconds ? new Date(timestamp.seconds * 1000) : new Date(timestamp);
      return date.toLocaleDateString('en-NG', { year: 'numeric', month: 'long' });
    } catch (e) {
      return 'Recently';
    }
  };

  const getResponseRate = function() {
    return (profileUser && profileUser.replyRate) ? profileUser.replyRate : 98;
  };

  // ===== HELPER TO CHECK VERIFICATION STATUS =====
  const isLandlordVerified = profileUser?.verified?.landlord?.status === 'approved';
  const isAgentVerified = profileUser?.verified?.agent?.status === 'approved';

  // ===== RENDER ROLE BADGES (can show both) =====
  const renderRoleBadges = () => {
    const badges = [];
    
    if (isLandlordVerified) {
      badges.push(
        React.createElement('span', {
          key: 'landlord',
          className: 'inline-flex items-center bg-green-100 text-green-700 border border-green-200 rounded-full font-medium text-sm px-2.5 py-1'
        }, 'Landlord')
      );
    }
    
    if (isAgentVerified) {
      badges.push(
        React.createElement('span', {
          key: 'agent',
          className: 'inline-flex items-center bg-gray-700 text-white border border-gray-800 rounded-full font-medium text-sm px-2.5 py-1'
        }, 'Agent')
      );
    }
    
    if (badges.length === 0) return null;
    
    return React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center gap-2 mt-1' }, ...badges);
  };

  React.useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (toastTimeoutRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(toastTimeoutRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, []);

  if (loading) {
    return React.createElement('div', { className: 'min-h-screen bg-green-50' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 py-8' },
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex justify-center items-center h-64' },
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-gray-200 animate-pulse mx-auto' })
        )
      )
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return React.createElement('div', { className: 'min-h-screen bg-green-50 flex items-center justify-center' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-center max-w-sm mx-auto px-4' },
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-6xl mb-4' }, 'üòï'),
        React.createElement('h2', { className: 'text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2' }, 'User Not Found'),
        React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-600 mb-6' }, error),
        React.createElement('button', {
          onClick: function() { navigate('/'); },
          className: 'bg-green-950 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-green-800 transition cursor-pointer'
        }, 'Go Home')
      )
    );
  }

  if (!profileUser) {
    return React.createElement('div', { className: 'min-h-screen bg-green-50 flex items-center justify-center' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-center max-w-sm mx-auto px-4' },
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-6xl mb-4' }, 'üë§'),
        React.createElement('h2', { className: 'text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2' }, 'No Profile Data'),
        React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-600 mb-6' }, 'This user profile could not be loaded.'),
        React.createElement('button', {
          onClick: function() { navigate('/'); },
          className: 'bg-green-950 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-green-800 transition cursor-pointer'
        }, 'Go Home')
      )
    );
  }

  var isOwnProfile = user && user.uid === profileUser.id;
  var joinDate = formatJoinDate(profileUser.createdAt);
  var responseRate = getResponseRate();

  return React.createElement(React.Fragment, null,
    
    toast.show && React.createElement('div', {
      className: 'fixed bottom-24 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 z-50 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-lg text-white text-sm animate-fade-in-up ' +
        (toast.type === 'success' ? 'bg-green-600' : 
         toast.type === 'error' ? 'bg-red-600' : 
         'bg-blue-600')
    }, toast.message),

    React.createElement('div', { className: 'min-h-screen bg-green-50' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 py-8' },

        
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'bg-white rounded-xl shadow-md overflow-hidden mb-6' },
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'h-32 bg-gradient-to-r from-green-800 to-green-600 relative' },
            React.createElement('div', { 
              className: 'absolute -bottom-12 left-6 w-24 h-24 rounded-full border-4 border-white bg-green-200 overflow-hidden shadow-lg'
            },
              profileUser.photoURL ?
                React.createElement('img', {
                  src: profileUser.photoURL,
                  alt: profileUser.displayName,
                  className: 'w-full h-full object-cover',
                  onError: function(e) {
                    e.target.style.display = 'none';
                    e.target.parentNode.innerHTML = '<div class="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center bg-green-200"><span class="text-3xl font-bold text-green-800">' + 
                      (profileUser.displayName ? profileUser.displayName.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : 'U') + '</span></div>';
                  }
                }) :
                React.createElement('div', { className: 'w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center bg-green-200' },
                  React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-3xl font-bold text-green-800' },
                    profileUser.displayName ? profileUser.displayName.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : 'U'
                  )
                )
            )
          ),

          React.createElement('div', { className: 'pt-14 p-6' },
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex flex-wrap justify-between items-start gap-4' },
              React.createElement('div', null,
                // Display Name
                React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center gap-2 mb-1' },
                  React.createElement('h1', { className: 'text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900' },
                    profileUser.displayName || 'User'
                  )
                ),
                
                // Username with @
                React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-sm text-gray-500 mb-2' },

// pages/VerificationPage.js - Two-Way Verification (Landlord & Agent)

function VerificationPage({ user, navigate }) {
  const [profile, setProfile] = React.useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState('');
  const [uploadingDocs, setUploadingDocs] = React.useState(false);
  
  // ===== ROLE SELECTION =====
  const [selectedRole, setSelectedRole] = React.useState('landlord'); // 'landlord' or 'agent'
  
  // ===== LANDLORD FORM STATE =====
  const [landlordForm, setLandlordForm] = React.useState({
    idType: 'nin',
    idNumber: '',
    phoneNumber: '',
    propertyProofUrl: null
  });
  
  // ===== AGENT FORM STATE =====
  const [agentForm, setAgentForm] = React.useState({
    idType: 'nin',
    idNumber: '',
    phoneNumber: '',
    businessRegUrl: null,
    agencyLicenseUrl: null  // optional
  });
  
  const [errors, setErrors] = React.useState({});
  
  const { openModal } = window.useAuthModal();
  const CLOUD_NAME = window.__ENV.CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME;
  const UPLOAD_PRESET = window.__ENV.CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET;
  
  React.useEffect(function() {
    if (!user) {
      navigate('/');
      openModal('login', '/verify');
      return;
    }
    
    const fetchProfile = async function() {
      try {
        const userDoc = await db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).get();
        
        if (userDoc.exists) {
          setProfile({ id: userDoc.id, ...userDoc.data() });
          
          // Pre-fill forms if previously submitted
          const verified = userDoc.data().verified || {};
          
          if (verified.landlord) {
            setLandlordForm({
              idType: verified.landlord.idType || 'nin',
              idNumber: verified.landlord.idNumber || '',
              phoneNumber: verified.landlord.phoneNumber || '',
              propertyProofUrl: verified.landlord.propertyProofUrl || null
            });
          }
          
          if (verified.agent) {
            setAgentForm({
              idType: verified.agent.idType || 'nin',
              idNumber: verified.agent.idNumber || '',
              phoneNumber: verified.agent.phoneNumber || '',
              businessRegUrl: verified.agent.businessRegUrl || null,
              agencyLicenseUrl: verified.agent.agencyLicenseUrl || null
            });
          }
        } else {
          await db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).set({
            email: user.email,
            createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
            verified: { landlord: null, agent: null }
          });
          setProfile({
            id: user.uid,
            email: user.email,
            verified: { landlord: null, agent: null }
          });
        }
      } catch (err) {
        setError('Failed to load profile. Please refresh the page.');
      }
    };
    
    fetchProfile();
  }, [user, navigate, openModal]);
  
  // Upload document to Cloudinary
  const uploadDocument = async (file, onSuccess) => {
    if (!file) return;
    
    setUploadingDocs(true);
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('file', file);
    formData.append('upload_preset', UPLOAD_PRESET);
    formData.append('cloud_name', CLOUD_NAME);
    
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/${CLOUD_NAME}/image/upload`, {
        method: 'POST',
        body: formData
      });
      
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Upload failed');
      
      const data = await response.json();
      onSuccess(data.public_id);
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to upload document. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setUploadingDocs(false);
    }
  };
  
  const handleLandlordChange = (field, value) => {
    setLandlordForm(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    if (errors[field]) setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: null }));
  };
  
  const handleAgentChange = (field, value) => {
    setAgentForm(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    if (errors[field]) setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: null }));
  };
  
  const validateLandlordForm = () => {
    const newErrors = {};
    const v = ValidationHelpers;
    
    if (!landlordForm.idNumber.trim()) newErrors.idNumber = 'ID Number is required';
    if (!landlordForm.phoneNumber.trim()) newErrors.phoneNumber = 'Phone number is required';
    if (!landlordForm.propertyProofUrl) newErrors.propertyProofUrl = 'Property ownership proof is required';
    
    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  };
  
  const validateAgentForm = () => {
    const newErrors = {};
    const v = ValidationHelpers;
    
    if (!agentForm.idNumber.trim()) newErrors.idNumber = 'ID Number is required';
    if (!agentForm.phoneNumber.trim()) newErrors.phoneNumber = 'Phone number is required';
    if (!agentForm.businessRegUrl) newErrors.businessRegUrl = 'Business registration is required';
    
    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  };
  
  const handleSubmitLandlord = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!validateLandlordForm()) return;
    
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    
    try {
      const sanitizedIdNumber = ValidationHelpers.sanitizeInput(landlordForm.idNumber, 'text');
      const sanitizedPhone = ValidationHelpers.sanitizeInput(landlordForm.phoneNumber, 'phone');
      
      const currentVerified = profile?.verified || {};
      
      await db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).update({
        'verified.landlord': {
          status: 'pending',
          idType: landlordForm.idType,
          idNumber: sanitizedIdNumber,
          phoneNumber: sanitizedPhone,
          propertyProofUrl: landlordForm.propertyProofUrl,
          submittedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
        }
      });
      
      // Refresh profile
      const userDoc = await db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).get();
      setProfile({ id: userDoc.id, ...userDoc.data() });
      
      ToastHelpers?.success('Landlord verification submitted! Pending review.');
      
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to submit verification. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };
  
  const handleSubmitAgent = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!validateAgentForm()) return;
    
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    
    try {
      const sanitizedIdNumber = ValidationHelpers.sanitizeInput(agentForm.idNumber, 'text');
      const sanitizedPhone = ValidationHelpers.sanitizeInput(agentForm.phoneNumber, 'phone');
      
      const currentVerified = profile?.verified || {};
      
      await db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).update({
        'verified.agent': {
          status: 'pending',
          idType: agentForm.idType,
          idNumber: sanitizedIdNumber,
          phoneNumber: sanitizedPhone,
          businessRegUrl: agentForm.businessRegUrl,
          agencyLicenseUrl: agentForm.agencyLicenseUrl || null,
          submittedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
        }
      });
      
      // Refresh profile
      const userDoc = await db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).get();
      setProfile({ id: userDoc.id, ...userDoc.data() });
      
      ToastHelpers?.success('Agent verification submitted! Pending review.');
      
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to submit verification. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };
  
  if (!user) {
    return React.createElement('div', { className: 'min-h-screen bg-green-50 flex items-center justify-center' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-center' },
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gray-200 animate-pulse mx-auto mb-4' }),
        React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-600' }, 'Redirecting to login...')
      )
    );
  }
  
  const landlordVerified = profile?.verified?.landlord;
  const agentVerified = profile?.verified?.agent;
  
  const landlordStatus = landlordVerified?.status || null;
  const agentStatus = agentVerified?.status || null;
  
  const landlordRejectionReason = landlordVerified?.rejectionReason || '';
  const agentRejectionReason = agentVerified?.rejectionReason || '';
  
  return React.createElement('div', { className: 'min-h-screen bg-green-50' },
    React.createElement('div', { className: 'max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-12' },
      
     
      
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'bg-white rounded-lg shadow-md p-8' },
        React.createElement('h1', { className: 'text-3xl font-bold mb-4 text-gray-900' }, 'Verification'),
        React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-600 mb-6' },
          'Get verified to build trust. Verified users receive badges on their profiles and listings.'
        ),
        
        // ===== ROLE SELECTION RADIO BUTTONS =====
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'mb-8 pb-6 border-b border-gray-200' },
          React.createElement('label', { className: 'block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-3' }, 'Choose what to verify as:'),
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex gap-6' },
            React.createElement('label', { className: 'flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer' },
              React.createElement('input', {
                type: 'radio',
                name: 'role',
                value: 'landlord',
                checked: selectedRole === 'landlord',
                onChange: () => setSelectedRole('landlord'),
                className: 'w-4 h-4 accent-green-950'
              }),
              React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-gray-700' }, 'üè† Landlord')
            ),
            React.createElement('label', { className: 'flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer' },
              React.createElement('input', {
                type: 'radio',
                name: 'role',
                value: 'agent',
                checked: selectedRole === 'agent',
                onChange: () => setSelectedRole('agent'),
                className: 'w-4 h-4 accent-green-950'
              }),
              React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-gray-700' }, 'ü§ù Agent')
            )
          )
        ),
        
        // ===== LANDLORD FORM =====
        selectedRole === 'landlord' && React.createElement('div', null,
          // Status display
          landlordStatus === 'approved' && React.createElement('div', { className: 'bg-green-50 border border-green-200 rounded-lg p-4 mb-6' },
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center gap-3' },
              React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-6 h-6 text-green-600', fill: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 20 20' },
                React.createElement('path', { fillRule: 'evenodd', d: 'M10 18a8 8 0 100-16 8 8 0 000 16zm3.707-9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414-1.414L9 10.586 7.707 9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414l2 2a1 1 0 001.414 0l4-4z', clipRule: 'evenodd' })
              ),
              React.createElement('div', null,
                React.createElement('p', { className: 'font-bold text-green-800' }, '‚úì Landlord Verified'),
                React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-sm text-green-700' }, 'Your landlord status has been verified.')

          ),
          
          landlordStatus === 'pending' && React.createElement('div', { className: 'bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200 rounded-lg p-4 mb-6' },

          (landlordStatus !== 'approved' && landlordStatus !== 'pending') && React.createElement(React.Fragment, null,
            error && React.createElement('div', { className: 'bg-red-50 text-red-600 p-4 rounded-lg mb-6 border border-red-200' }, error),
            
            React.createElement('form', { onSubmit: handleSubmitLandlord, className: 'space-y-5' },
              React.createElement('h2', { className: 'text-xl font-bold text-gray-800' }, 'Landlord Verification'),
              
              // ID Type
              React.createElement('div', null,
                React.createElement('label', { className: 'block text-gray-700 font-bold mb-2' }, 'ID Type *'),
                React.createElement('select', {
                  value: landlordForm.idType,
                  onChange: (e) => handleLandlordChange('idType', e.target.value),
                  className: 'w-full p-3 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-950'
                },
                  React.createElement('option', { value: 'nin' }, 'National ID (NIN)'),
                  React.createElement('option', { value: 'bvn' }, 'Bank Verification Number (BVN)'),

              React.createElement('div', null,
                React.createElement('label', { className: 'block text-gray-700 font-bold mb-2' }, 'ID Number *'),
                React.createElement('input', {
                  type: 'text',
                  value: landlordForm.idNumber,
                  onChange: (e) => handleLandlordChange('idNumber', e.target.value),
                  className: `w-full p-3 border rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-950 ${errors.idNumber ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'}`,

                }),
                errors.idNumber && React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-red-500 text-sm mt-1' }, errors.idNumber)

              // Phone Number
              React.createElement('div', null,
                React.createElement('label', { className: 'block text-gray-700 font-bold mb-2' }, 'Phone Number *'),

                errors.phoneNumber && React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-red-500 text-sm mt-1' }, errors.phoneNumber)

              // Property Proof Upload
              React.createElement('div', null,
                React.createElement('label', { className: 'block text-gray-700 font-bold mb-2' }, 'Property Ownership Proof *'),
                React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-xs text-gray-500 mb-2' }, 'Upload deed of assignment, title document, or any proof of property ownership'),
                
                landlordForm.propertyProofUrl ?
                  React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center gap-2 p-3 bg-green-50 rounded-lg border border-green-200' },
                    React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-5 h-5 text-green-600', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' },

                    React.createElement('input', {

                        const file = e.target.files[0];
                        if (file) uploadDocument(file, (url) => handleLandlordChange('propertyProofUrl', url));
                      },
                      className: 'w-full p-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm'

                    uploadingDocs && React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1' }, 'Uploading...')
                  ),
                errors.propertyProofUrl && React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-red-500 text-sm mt-1' }, errors.propertyProofUrl)
              ),
              
              React.createElement('button', {
                type: 'submit',
                disabled: loading || uploadingDocs,
                className: 'w-full bg-green-950 text-white py-3 rounded-lg font-bold hover:bg-green-800 transition disabled:opacity-50'

          )
        ),
        
        // ===== AGENT FORM =====
        selectedRole === 'agent' && React.createElement('div', null,
          // Status display
          agentStatus === 'approved' && React.createElement('div', { className: 'bg-green-50 border border-green-200 rounded-lg p-4 mb-6' },
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center gap-3' },

              React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-6 h-6 text-yellow-600', fill: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 20 20' },
                React.createElement('path', { fillRule: 'evenodd', d: 'M10 18a8 8 0 100-16 8 8 0 000 16zm1-12a1 1 0 10-2 0v4a1 1 0 00.293.707l2.828 2.829a1 1 0 101.415-1.415L11 9.586V6z', clipRule: 'evenodd' })
              ),
              React.createElement('div', null,
                React.createElement('p', { className: 'font-bold text-yellow-800' }, '‚è≥ Agent Verification Pending'),

          ),
          
          agentStatus === 'rejected' && React.createElement('div', { className: 'bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-lg p-4 mb-6' },
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center gap-3' },
              React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-6 h-6 text-red-600', fill: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 20 20' },

            error && React.createElement('div', { className: 'bg-red-50 text-red-600 p-4 rounded-lg mb-6 border border-red-200' }, error),
            
            React.createElement('form', { onSubmit: handleSubmitAgent, className: 'space-y-5' },
              React.createElement('h2', { className: 'text-xl font-bold text-gray-800' }, 'Agent Verification'),
              
              // ID Type
              React.createElement('div', null,
                React.createElement('label', { className: 'block text-gray-700 font-bold mb-2' }, 'ID Type *'),
                React.createElement('select', {
                  value: agentForm.idType,

                  React.createElement('option', { value: 'nin' }, 'National ID (NIN)'),

              // ID Number

                React.createElement('label', { className: 'block text-gray-700 font-bold mb-2' }, 'ID Number *'),
                React.createElement('input', {
                  type: 'text',
                  value: agentForm.idNumber,
                  onChange: (e) => handleAgentChange('idNumber', e.target.value),

                  placeholder: 'e.g., 08012345678'
                }),
                errors.phoneNumber && React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-red-500 text-sm mt-1' }, errors.phoneNumber)
              ),
              
              // Business Registration (MANDATORY)
              React.createElement('div', null,
                React.createElement('label', { className: 'block text-gray-700 font-bold mb-2' }, 'Business Registration (CAC) *'),
                React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-xs text-gray-500 mb-2' }, 'Upload your business registration certificate (CAC)'),
                
                agentForm.businessRegUrl ?
                  React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center gap-2 p-3 bg-green-50 rounded-lg border border-green-200' },
                    React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-5 h-5 text-green-600', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' },
                      React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M5 13l4 4L19 7' })
                    ),

                    React.createElement('button', {

                      onClick: () => handleAgentChange('businessRegUrl', null),
                      className: 'ml-auto text-red-500 text-xs hover:text-red-700'
                    }, 'Remove')
                  ) :
                  React.createElement('div', null,
                    React.createElement('input', {
                      type: 'file',

                      onChange: (e) => {
                        const file = e.target.files[0];
                        if (file) uploadDocument(file, (url) => handleAgentChange('businessRegUrl', url));
                      },
                      className: 'w-full p-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm'
                    }),
                    uploadingDocs && React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1' }, 'Uploading...')
                  ),
                errors.businessRegUrl && React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-red-500 text-sm mt-1' }, errors.businessRegUrl)
              ),
              
              // Agency License (OPTIONAL)
              React.createElement('div', null,
                React.createElement('label', { className: 'block text-gray-700 font-bold mb-2' }, 'Agency License (Optional)'),
                React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-xs text-gray-500 mb-2' }, 'Upload your agency license if available'),
                
                agentForm.agencyLicenseUrl ?
                  React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center gap-2 p-3 bg-green-50 rounded-lg border border-green-200' },
                    React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-5 h-5 text-green-600', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' },
                      React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M5 13l4 4L19 7' })
                    ),
                    React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-sm text-green-700' }, 'License uploaded'),
                    React.createElement('button', {
                      type: 'button',
                      onClick: () => handleAgentChange('agencyLicenseUrl', null),
                      className: 'ml-auto text-red-500 text-xs hover:text-red-700'
                    }, 'Remove')
                  ) :
                  React.createElement('input', {
                    type: 'file',
                    accept: 'image/*,.pdf',
                    onChange: (e) => {
                      const file = e.target.files[0];
                      if (file) uploadDocument(file, (url) => handleAgentChange('agencyLicenseUrl', url));
                    },
                    className: 'w-full p-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm'
                  })
              ),
              
              React.createElement('button', {
                type: 'submit',
                disabled: loading || uploadingDocs,
                className: 'w-full bg-green-950 text-white py-3 rounded-lg font-bold hover:bg-green-800 transition disabled:opacity-50'
              }, loading ? 'Submitting...' : 'Submit Agent Verification')
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  );
}
