// pages/home/components/AccessibilityModal.js
function AccessibilityModal({ onClose, settings, updateSetting, resetSettings }) {
  return React.createElement('div', {
      className: 'fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm',
      onClick: function(e) { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose(); }
    },
    React.createElement('div', { className: 'relative w-64 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center justify-between p-3 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50' },
        React.createElement('h3', { className: 'font-bold text-sm text-gray-900' }, 'Accessibility'),
        React.createElement('button', {
            onClick: onClose,
            className: 'text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 p-1 rounded-full hover:bg-gray-200'
          },
          React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-3 h-3', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' },
            React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12' })
          )
        )
      ),
      
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'p-3 space-y-4' },
        
        // Dark mode
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'mb-3 pb-3 border-b border-gray-200' },
          React.createElement('label', { className: 'flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer' },
            React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 flex items-center gap-1' },
              React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-base' }, 'üåô'), 'Dark Mode'
            ),
            React.createElement('button', {
                onClick: function(e) {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  const isDark = !document.body.classList.contains('dark-mode');
                  document.body.classList.toggle('dark-mode', isDark);
                  localStorage.setItem('darkMode', isDark);
                  if (window.useAccessibility) {
                    const { updateSetting: us } = window.useAccessibility();
                    us('darkMode', isDark);
                  }
                },
                className: 'relative inline-flex h-5 w-9 items-center rounded-full transition-colors focus:outline-none ' +
                  (document.body.classList.contains('dark-mode') ? 'bg-green-950' : 'bg-gray-300'),
                role: 'switch',
                'aria-checked': document.body.classList.contains('dark-mode')
              },
              React.createElement('span', {
                className: 'inline-block h-4 w-4 transform rounded-full bg-white transition-transform ' +
                  (document.body.classList.contains('dark-mode') ? 'translate-x-5' : 'translate-x-0.5')
              })
            )
          )
        ),
        
        // Text size
        React.createElement('div', null,
          React.createElement('label', { className: 'block text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1' }, 'Text Size'),
          React.createElement('select', {
              value: settings.fontSize,
              onChange: function(e) { updateSetting('fontSize', e.target.value); },
              className: 'w-full p-1.5 text-xs border border-gray-300 rounded-lg bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-green-950'
            },
            React.createElement('option', { value: 'small' }, 'Small'),
            React.createElement('option', { value: 'normal' }, 'Normal'),
            React.createElement('option', { value: 'large' }, 'Large'),
            React.createElement('option', { value: 'x-large' }, 'Extra Large')
          )
        ),
        
        // Accessibility toggles
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'space-y-2' },
          [
            { key: 'highContrast', label: 'High Contrast' },
            { key: 'reduceMotion', label: 'Reduce Motion' },
            { key: 'dyslexicFont', label: 'Dyslexia Font' },
            { key: 'showLinks', label: 'Underline Links' }
          ].map(function(item) {
            return React.createElement('label', {
                key: item.key,
                className: 'flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer p-1.5 bg-gray-50 rounded hover:bg-gray-100'
              },
              React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-xs font-medium text-gray-700' }, item.label),
              React.createElement('input', {
                type: 'checkbox',
                checked: settings[item.key],
                onChange: function(e) { updateSetting(item.key, e.target.checked); },
                className: 'w-3.5 h-3.5 accent-green-900'
              })
            );
          })
        ),
        
        // Reset button
        React.createElement('button', {
          onClick: function() {
            resetSettings();
            document.body.classList.remove('dark-mode');
            localStorage.setItem('darkMode', 'false');
          },
          className: 'w-full mt-2 py-1.5 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200 transition font-medium text-xs'
        }, 'Reset to Default')
      )
    )
  );
}

// pages/home/components/Carousel.js - Full width on all devices
function Carousel({ 
  listings, 
  currentIndex,
  loading,
  onSlideChange,
  onPrev,
  onNext,
  touchHandlers,
  user,
  favorites,
  checkingFavorites,
  onToggleFavorite,
  onStartChat,
  onShare,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  onNavigate,
  cardSizes,
  headingSize
}) {
  if (loading) {
    return React.createElement('div', { className: 'px-0 py-4' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'h-6 w-40 bg-gray-200 rounded animate-pulse mb-3 ml-4' }),
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'relative w-full overflow-hidden shadow-lg animate-pulse' },
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'aspect-[16/9] bg-gray-200 w-full' })
      )
    );
  }

  if (!listings.length || !listings[currentIndex]) return null;

  const currentListing = listings[currentIndex];
  const isOwner = user && user.uid === currentListing.userId;

  return React.createElement('div', { className: 'w-full px-0 py-4' },
    React.createElement('h2', { className: 'font-bold text-gray-900 mb-3 px-0 ' + headingSize }, 'Welcome Home üíö'),
    
    React.createElement('div', {
      className: 'relative w-full overflow-hidden shadow-lg touch-pan-y',
      onTouchStart: touchHandlers.onTouchStart,
      onTouchMove: touchHandlers.onTouchMove,
      onTouchEnd: touchHandlers.onTouchEnd
    },
      React.createElement('div', {
        className: 'relative aspect-[16/9] bg-gray-200 w-full cursor-pointer',
        onClick: function() { 
          AffinityHelpers.saveAffinity(currentListing); 
          onNavigate('/listing/' + currentListing.id); 
        }
      },
        React.createElement('img', {
          src: currentListing.images?.[0]
            ? window.CloudinaryHelpers.getCarouselUrl(currentListing.images[0])
            : '/vault/img/no-image.jpg',
          alt: currentListing.title,
          className: 'w-full h-full object-cover',
          loading: 'eager',
          onError: function(e) { e.target.src = '/vault/img/no-image.jpg'; }
        }),
        
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 via-transparent to-transparent' }),
        
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 p-4 text-white' },
          React.createElement('h3', { className: 'font-bold mb-1 line-clamp-1 ' + cardSizes.title }, currentListing.title),
          React.createElement('p', { className: 'opacity-90 mb-1 ' + cardSizes.price }, 
            '‚Ç¶' + (currentListing.price?.toLocaleString() || '0') + '/month'
          ),
          React.createElement('p', { className: 'opacity-75 line-clamp-1 ' + cardSizes.address }, currentListing.address)
        ),
        
        // Navigation arrows (visible on desktop only)
        React.createElement('button', { 
          onClick: function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); onPrev(); }, 
          className: 'absolute left-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 bg-black/30 hover:bg-black/50 text-white p-2 rounded-full transition backdrop-blur-sm hidden md:block' 
        },
          React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-5 h-5', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' }, 
            React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M15 19l-7-7 7-7' })
          )
        ),
        React.createElement('button', { 
          onClick: function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); onNext(); }, 
          className: 'absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 bg-black/30 hover:bg-black/50 text-white p-2 rounded-full transition backdrop-blur-sm hidden md:block' 
        },
          React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-5 h-5', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' }, 
            React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M9 5l7 7-7 7' })
          )
        ),
        
        // Owner controls
        isOwner && React.createElement('div', { className: 'absolute top-2 right-2 flex gap-1 z-10' },
          React.createElement('button', { 
            onClick: function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); onEdit(currentListing.id); }, 
            className: 'bg-blue-600 text-white p-2 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:bg-blue-700 transition', 
            title: 'Edit' 
          },
            React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-4 h-4', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' }, 
              React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M11 5H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v11a2 2 0 002 2h11a2 2 0 002-2v-5m-1.414-9.414a2 2 0 112.828 2.828L11.828 15H9v-2.828l8.586-8.586z' })
            )
          ),
          React.createElement('button', { 
            onClick: function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); onDelete(currentListing.id); }, 
            className: 'bg-red-500 text-white p-2 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:bg-red-600 transition', 
            title: 'Delete' 
          },
            React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-4 h-4', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' }, 
              React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16' })
            )
          )
        ),
        
        // Action buttons
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'absolute bottom-2 right-2 flex gap-1 z-10' },
          // Favorite
          React.createElement('button', {
            onClick: function(e) { onToggleFavorite(currentListing.id, e); },
            disabled: checkingFavorites[currentListing.id],
            className: 'p-1 ' + (favorites[currentListing.id] ? 'text-red-500' : 'text-white drop-shadow-lg') + 
                      (checkingFavorites[currentListing.id] ? ' opacity-50 cursor-wait' : '')
          },
            favorites[currentListing.id]
              ? React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-5 h-5', fill: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 20 20' }, 
                  React.createElement('path', { fillRule: 'evenodd', d: 'M3.172 5.172a4 4 0 015.656 0L10 6.343l1.172-1.171a4 4 0 115.656 5.656L10 17.657l-6.828-6.829a4 4 0 010-5.656z', clipRule: 'evenodd' })
                )
              : React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-5 h-5', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' }, 
                  React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M4.318 6.318a4.5 4.5 0 000 6.364L12 20.364l7.682-7.682a4.5 4.5 0 00-6.364-6.364L12 7.636l-1.318-1.318a4.5 4.5 0 00-6.364 0z' })
                )
          ),
          
          // Chat button - UPDATED with verification check
          user && user.uid !== currentListing.userId && React.createElement('button', {
            onClick: function(e) {
              e.stopPropagation();
              
              // ===== USE CENTRALIZED VERIFICATION CHECK =====
              if (!user) {
                window.__openAuthModal?.('login', window.location.pathname);
                return;
              }
              
              const verificationCheck = window.VerificationHelpers?.checkEmailVerification(user, 'send messages');
              if (!verificationCheck?.allowed) {
                const message = verificationCheck?.message || 'Please verify your email to send messages';
                const toastEvent = new CustomEvent('show-toast', {
                  detail: { message, type: 'warning' }
                });
                window.dispatchEvent(toastEvent);
                return;
              }
              
              onStartChat(currentListing.userId, currentListing.id, e);
            },
            className: 'p-1 text-white drop-shadow-lg hover:text-green-300',
            title: 'Send message'
          },
            React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-5 h-5', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' }, 
              React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M8 12h.01M12 12h.01M16 12h.01M21 12c0 4.418-4.03 8-9 8a9.863 9.863 0 01-4.255-.949L3 20l1.395-3.72C3.512 15.042 3 13.574 3 12c0-4.418 4.03-8 9-8s9 3.582 9 8z' })
            )
          ),
          
          // Share
          React.createElement('button', { 
            onClick: function(e) { onShare(currentListing, e); }, 
            className: 'p-1 text-white drop-shadow-lg hover:text-blue-300' 
          },
            React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-5 h-5', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' }, 
              React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M8.684 13.342C8.886 12.938 9 12.482 9 12c0-.482-.114-.938-.316-1.342m0 2.684a3 3 0 110-2.684m0 2.684l6.632 3.316m-6.632-6l6.632-3.316m0 0a3 3 0 105.367-2.684 3 3 0 00-5.367 2.684zm0 9.316a3 3 0 105.368 2.684 3 3 0 00-5.368-2.684z' })
            )
          )
        )
      ),
      
      // Indicators
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'absolute bottom-2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 flex gap-1.5 z-10' },
        listings.map(function(_, i) {
          return React.createElement('button', {
            key: i,
            onClick: function() { onSlideChange(i); },
            className: 'w-2 h-2 rounded-full transition ' + (i === currentIndex ? 'bg-white scale-125' : 'bg-white/50')
          });
        })
      )
    )
  );
}

window.Carousel = Carousel;

// pages/home/components/FilterBar.js
function FilterBar({
  activeFilterCount,
  onOpenFilters,
  touchTargetSize
}) {
  return React.createElement('div', { className: 'relative' },
    React.createElement('button', {
        onClick: onOpenFilters,
        className: 'p-2 text-gray-600 hover:text-green-950 rounded-full hover:bg-gray-100 transition ' + touchTargetSize,
        'aria-label': 'Filter listings'
      },
      React.createElement('svg', {
          className: 'w-5 h-5',
          fill: 'none',
          stroke: 'currentColor',
          viewBox: '0 0 24 24'
        },
        React.createElement('path', {
          strokeLinecap: 'round',
          strokeLinejoin: 'round',
          strokeWidth: '2',
          d: 'M12 6V4m0 2a2 2 0 100 4m0-4a2 2 0 110 4m-6 8a2 2 0 100-4m0 4a2 2 0 110-4m0 4v2m0-6V4m6 6v10m6-2a2 2 0 100-4m0 4a2 2 0 110-4m0 4v2m0-6V4'
        })
      )
    ),
    activeFilterCount > 0 && React.createElement('span', {
      className: 'absolute -top-1 -right-1 bg-red-500 text-white text-xs rounded-full min-w-[18px] h-[18px] flex items-center justify-center text-[10px]'
    }, activeFilterCount)
  );
}

function FilterModal({
  show,
  onClose,
  filters,
  tempFilters,
  availableLgas,
  onUpdateFilter,
  onApply,
  onClear,
  activeFilterCount,
  onLocationSelect, // ‚Üê NEW: function to center map on selected location
  mapInstance // ‚Üê NEW: map instance for centering
}) {
  if (!show) return null;
  
  // ===== NEW: Handle location selection =====
  const handleLocationApply = () => {
    // If state and LGA are selected, center map there
    if (tempFilters.state && tempFilters.lga && onLocationSelect && mapInstance) {
      // Find the LGA coordinates from nigeria-states.js
      const stateData = (window.nigeriaStates || []).find(s => s.name === tempFilters.state);
      if (stateData) {
        const lgaData = stateData.lgas?.find(l => l.name === tempFilters.lga);
        if (lgaData && lgaData.lat && lgaData.lng) {
          // Center map on LGA
          mapInstance.setView([lgaData.lat, lgaData.lng], 12);
          onLocationSelect({
            lat: lgaData.lat,
            lng: lgaData.lng,
            display: `${tempFilters.lga}, ${tempFilters.state}`
          });
        } else if (stateData.lat && stateData.lng) {
          // Fallback to state center
          mapInstance.setView([stateData.lat, stateData.lng], 8);
          onLocationSelect({
            lat: stateData.lat,
            lng: stateData.lng,
            display: tempFilters.state
          });
        }
      }
    }
    
    // Apply all filters
    onApply();
  };
  
  return React.createElement('div', {
      className: 'fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm',
      onClick: function(e) { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose(); }
    },
    React.createElement('div', { className: 'relative w-full max-w-md bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center justify-between p-3 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50' },
        React.createElement('h3', { className: 'font-bold text-base text-gray-900' }, 'Filter Listings',
          activeFilterCount > 0 && React.createElement('span', {
            className: 'ml-2 text-xs font-normal text-gray-500'
          }, '(' + activeFilterCount + ')')
        ),
        React.createElement('button', {
            onClick: onClose,
            className: 'text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 p-1 rounded-full hover:bg-gray-200'
          },
          React.createElement('svg', {
              className: 'w-4 h-4',
              fill: 'none',
              stroke: 'currentColor',
              viewBox: '0 0 24 24'
            },
            React.createElement('path', {
              strokeLinecap: 'round',
              strokeLinejoin: 'round',
              strokeWidth: '2',
              d: 'M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12'
            })
          )
        )
      ),
      
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'p-3 max-h-[50vh] overflow-y-auto' },
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'grid grid-cols-2 gap-2' },
          
          // Price range - ALWAYS SHOW
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'col-span-2 mb-1' },
            React.createElement('label', { className: 'block text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1' }, 'Price (‚Ç¶)'),
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex gap-1' },
              React.createElement('input', {
                type: 'number',
                placeholder: 'Min',
                value: tempFilters.minPrice,
                onChange: function(e) { onUpdateFilter('minPrice', e.target.value); },
                className: 'w-full p-1.5 text-xs border rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-green-950'
              }),
              React.createElement('input', {
                type: 'number',
                placeholder: 'Max',
                value: tempFilters.maxPrice,
                onChange: function(e) { onUpdateFilter('maxPrice', e.target.value); },
                className: 'w-full p-1.5 text-xs border rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-green-950'
              })
            )
          ),
          
          // State - ALWAYS SHOW NOW
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'col-span-1' },
            React.createElement('label', { className: 'block text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1' }, 'State'),
            React.createElement('select', {
                value: tempFilters.state,
                onChange: function(e) { onUpdateFilter('state', e.target.value); },
                className: 'w-full p-1.5 text-xs border rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-green-950'
              },
              React.createElement('option', { value: '' }, 'All'),
              (window.nigeriaStates || []).map(function(s) {
                return React.createElement('option', { key: s.name, value: s.name }, s.name);
              })
            )
          ),
          
          // LGA - ALWAYS SHOW NOW
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'col-span-1' },
            React.createElement('label', { className: 'block text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1' }, 'LGA'),
            React.createElement('select', {
                value: tempFilters.lga,
                onChange: function(e) { onUpdateFilter('lga', e.target.value); },
                disabled: !tempFilters.state,
                className: 'w-full p-1.5 text-xs border rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-green-950' + (!tempFilters.state ? ' bg-gray-100 cursor-not-allowed' : '')
              },
              React.createElement('option', { value: '' }, 'All'),
              availableLgas.map(function(lga) {
                return React.createElement('option', { key: lga, value: lga }, lga);
              })
            )
          ),
          
          // Bedrooms - ALWAYS SHOW
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'col-span-1' },
            React.createElement('label', { className: 'block text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1' }, 'Bedrooms'),
            React.createElement('select', {
                value: tempFilters.bedrooms,
                onChange: function(e) { onUpdateFilter('bedrooms', e.target.value); },
                className: 'w-full p-1.5 text-xs border rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-green-950'
              },
              React.createElement('option', { value: '' }, 'Any'),
              React.createElement('option', { value: 'Self-contain' }, 'Self'),
              React.createElement('option', { value: '1' }, '1'),
              React.createElement('option', { value: '2' }, '2'),
              React.createElement('option', { value: '3' }, '3'),
              React.createElement('option', { value: '4' }, '4'),
              React.createElement('option', { value: '5+' }, '5+')
            )
          ),
          
          // Property Type - ALWAYS SHOW
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'col-span-1' },
            React.createElement('label', { className: 'block text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1' }, 'Type'),
            React.createElement('select', {
                value: tempFilters.propertyType,
                onChange: function(e) { onUpdateFilter('propertyType', e.target.value); },
                className: 'w-full p-1.5 text-xs border rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-green-950'
              },
              React.createElement('option', { value: '' }, 'Any'),
              React.createElement('option', { value: 'Apartment' }, 'Apt'),
              React.createElement('option', { value: 'House' }, 'House'),
              React.createElement('option', { value: 'Self Contain' }, 'SC'),
              React.createElement('option', { value: 'Room' }, 'Room'),
              React.createElement('option', { value: 'Duplex' }, 'Duplex')
            )
          ),
          
          // Furnishing - ALWAYS SHOW
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'col-span-1' },
            React.createElement('label', { className: 'block text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1' }, 'Furnishing'),
            React.createElement('select', {
                value: tempFilters.furnishing,
                onChange: function(e) { onUpdateFilter('furnishing', e.target.value); },
                className: 'w-full p-1.5 text-xs border rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-green-950'
              },
              React.createElement('option', { value: '' }, 'Any'),
              React.createElement('option', { value: 'Furnished' }, 'Full'),
              React.createElement('option', { value: 'Semi-furnished' }, 'Semi'),
              React.createElement('option', { value: 'Unfurnished' }, 'Empty')
            )
          ),
          
          // Sort - ALWAYS SHOW
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'col-span-1' },
            React.createElement('label', { className: 'block text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1' }, 'Sort'),
            React.createElement('select', {
                value: tempFilters.sortBy,
                onChange: function(e) { onUpdateFilter('sortBy', e.target.value); },
                className: 'w-full p-1.5 text-xs border rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-green-950'
              },
              React.createElement('option', { value: 'smart' }, 'Smart'),
              React.createElement('option', { value: 'price_low' }, 'Price ‚Üì'),
              React.createElement('option', { value: 'price_high' }, 'Price ‚Üë')
            )
          ),
          
          // Agent toggles - ALWAYS SHOW
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'col-span-1' },
            React.createElement('label', { className: 'flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer p-1.5 bg-gray-50 rounded hover:bg-gray-100' },
              React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-xs font-medium text-gray-700' }, 'Agent Only'),
              React.createElement('input', {
                type: 'checkbox',
                checked: tempFilters.agentOnly,
                onChange: function(e) { onUpdateFilter('agentOnly', e.target.checked); },
                className: 'w-3.5 h-3.5 accent-green-900'
              })
            )
          ),
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'col-span-1' },
            React.createElement('label', { className: 'flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer p-1.5 bg-gray-50 rounded hover:bg-gray-100' },
              React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-xs font-medium text-gray-700' }, 'No Fees'),
              React.createElement('input', {
                type: 'checkbox',
                checked: tempFilters.noAgentFees,
                onChange: function(e) { onUpdateFilter('noAgentFees', e.target.checked); },
                className: 'w-3.5 h-3.5 accent-green-900'
              })
            )
          )
        )
      ),
      
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex gap-2 p-3 border-t border-gray-200 bg-gray-50' },
        React.createElement('button', {
          onClick: onClear,
          className: 'flex-1 border border-gray-300 text-gray-700 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200 transition font-medium text-xs'
        }, 'Clear'),
        React.createElement('button', {
          onClick: handleLocationApply, // ‚Üê Use new handler that centers map
          className: 'flex-1 bg-green-950 text-white py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-green-800 transition font-bold text-xs'
        }, 'Apply Filters')
      )
    )
  );
}

window.FilterBar = FilterBar;
window.FilterModal = FilterModal;

// pages/home/components/ListingGrid.js - ENHANCED VERSION

function ListingGrid({ 
  listings,
  filteredCount,
  searchTerm,
  loading,
  loadingMore,
  hasMore,
  user,
  favorites,
  checkingFavorites,
  onToggleFavorite,
  onStartChat,
  onShare,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  onListingClick,
  gridCols,
  cardSizes,
  spacing,
  bodyTextSize,
  
  // NEW PROPS for location-based recommendations
  allListings = [], // All available listings (not just filtered)
  currentFilters = {}, // Current filters applied
  onLocationFilter // Function to filter by location
}) {
  
  // ===== STATE FOR EXPANDED LOCATIONS =====
  const [expandedLocations, setExpandedLocations] = React.useState({});
  const [locationListings, setLocationListings] = React.useState({});
  
  // ===== ANALYZE SEARCH CONTEXT =====
  const searchContext = React.useMemo(function() {
    if (!searchTerm || listings.length > 0) return null;
    
    const context = {
      originalSearch: searchTerm,
      suggestedState: null,
      suggestedLGA: null,
      otherStates: [],
      nearbyLGAs: []
    };
    
    // Try to extract location from search term
    const lowerSearch = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
    
    // Check if search matches any state or LGA
    if (window.nigeriaStates) {
      // Find matching state
      const matchingState = window.nigeriaStates.find(s => 
        s.name.toLowerCase().includes(lowerSearch)
      );
      
      if (matchingState) {
        context.suggestedState = matchingState.name;
        
        // Get listings from this state (all LGAs)
        const stateListings = allListings.filter(l => 
          l.state === matchingState.name && 
          l.status === 'available'
        );
        
        if (stateListings.length > 0) {
          context.stateListings = stateListings;
        }
      }
      
      // Find matching LGA across states
      const matchingLGAs = [];
      window.nigeriaStates.forEach(state => {
        state.lgas.forEach(lga => {
          if (lga.name.toLowerCase().includes(lowerSearch)) {
            matchingLGAs.push({
              state: state.name,
              lga: lga.name,
              lat: lga.lat,
              lng: lga.lng
            });
          }
        });
      });
      
      if (matchingLGAs.length > 0) {
        context.matchingLGAs = matchingLGAs;
        
        // Get listings from these LGAs
        const lgaListings = {};
        matchingLGAs.forEach(match => {
          const listingsInLGA = allListings.filter(l => 
            l.state === match.state && 
            l.lga === match.lga &&
            l.status === 'available'
          );
          if (listingsInLGA.length > 0) {
            lgaListings[`${match.state}|${match.lga}`] = listingsInLGA;
          }
        });
        context.lgaListings = lgaListings;
      }
      
      // Get other states with available listings (excluding the matched one)
      const statesWithListings = new Set();
      allListings.forEach(l => {
        if (l.state && l.status === 'available') {
          statesWithListings.add(l.state);
        }
      });
      
      context.otherStates = Array.from(statesWithListings)
        .filter(state => state !== context.suggestedState)
        .slice(0, 5); // Limit to 5 other states
    }
    
    return context;
  }, [searchTerm, allListings, listings.length]);
  
  // ===== TOGGLE LOCATION EXPANSION =====
  const toggleLocation = function(locationKey) {
    setExpandedLocations(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [locationKey]: !prev[locationKey]
    }));
  };
  
  // ===== LOAD LISTINGS FOR A LOCATION =====
  const loadLocationListings = React.useCallback(function(locationType, state, lga = null) {
    const key = lga ? `${state}|${lga}` : state;
    
    // Check if already loaded
    if (locationListings[key]) return;
    
    let filtered = allListings.filter(l => l.status === 'available');
    
    if (lga) {
      filtered = filtered.filter(l => l.state === state && l.lga === lga);
    } else {
      filtered = filtered.filter(l => l.state === state);
    }
    
    // Apply existing filters (except location filters)
    if (currentFilters) {
      if (currentFilters.minPrice) {
        filtered = filtered.filter(l => l.price >= Number(currentFilters.minPrice));
      }
      if (currentFilters.maxPrice) {
        filtered = filtered.filter(l => l.price <= Number(currentFilters.maxPrice));
      }
      if (currentFilters.bedrooms) {
        filtered = filtered.filter(l => 
          currentFilters.bedrooms === '5+' 
            ? Number(l.bedrooms) >= 5 
            : l.bedrooms === currentFilters.bedrooms
        );
      }
      if (currentFilters.propertyType) {
        filtered = filtered.filter(l => l.propertyType === currentFilters.propertyType);
      }
      if (currentFilters.furnishing) {
        filtered = filtered.filter(l => l.furnishing === currentFilters.furnishing);
      }
    }
    
    setLocationListings(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [key]: filtered.slice(0, 8) // Limit to 8 listings per location
    }));
  }, [allListings, currentFilters, locationListings]);
  
  // ===== HANDLE "SHOW IN THIS LOCATION" CLICK =====
  const handleShowInLocation = function(state, lga = null) {
    if (onLocationFilter) {
      onLocationFilter({
        state: state,
        lga: lga || ''
      });
    }
  };
  
  // ===== RENDER LOCATION SECTION =====
  const renderLocationSection = function(title, locationKey, listings, state, lga = null) {
    if (!listings || listings.length === 0) return null;
    
    const isExpanded = expandedLocations[locationKey];
    const displayListings = isExpanded ? listings : listings.slice(0, 4);
    
    return React.createElement('div', { 
      key: locationKey,
      className: 'mt-8 pt-6 border-t border-gray-200' 
    },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center justify-between mb-4' },
        React.createElement('h3', { className: 'font-bold text-gray-800' }, title),
        React.createElement('button', {
          onClick: function() { handleShowInLocation(state, lga); },
          className: 'text-xs text-green-950 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1'
        },
          React.createElement('span', null, 'Show all in this location'),
          React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-3 h-3', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' },
            React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M9 5l7 7-7 7' })
          )
        )
      ),
      
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'grid ' + gridCols + ' gap-3 mb-2' },
        displayListings.map(function(listing) {
          const isOwner = user && user.uid === listing.userId;
          const isFav = favorites[listing.id] || false;
          const isChecking = checkingFavorites[listing.id] || false;

          return React.createElement('div', {
            key: listing.id,
            'data-listing-card': '1',
            className: 'bg-white rounded-lg shadow-md overflow-hidden cursor-pointer hover:shadow-lg transition page-transition',
            onClick: function() { onListingClick(listing); }
          },
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'relative ' + cardSizes.image + ' bg-gray-200' },
              React.createElement('img', {
                src: listing.images?.[0]
                  ? window.CloudinaryHelpers.getCardUrl(listing.images[0])
                  : '/vault/img/no-image.jpg',
                alt: listing.title,
                className: 'w-full h-full object-cover',
                loading: 'lazy',
                onError: function(e) { e.target.src = '/vault/img/no-image.jpg'; }
              }),
              React.createElement('div', { className: 'absolute bottom-1 left-1 bg-green-950 text-white px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold ' + cardSizes.price },
                '‚Ç¶' + (listing.price ? listing.price.toLocaleString() : '0')
              ),
              
              // Location badge
              React.createElement('div', { className: 'absolute top-1 left-1 bg-black/60 text-white text-[8px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full backdrop-blur-sm' },
                listing.lga || listing.state
              )
            ),
            
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'p-2 ' + spacing },
              React.createElement('h3', { className: 'font-bold text-gray-900 mb-0.5 line-clamp-1 ' + cardSizes.title }, 
                listing.title
              ),
              React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-600 mb-1 line-clamp-1 text-[10px]' }, 
                [listing.address, listing.lga, listing.state].filter(Boolean).join(', ')
              ),
              
              React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center justify-between pt-1 border-t border-gray-100 mt-1' },
                React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex gap-1' },
                  user && user.uid !== listing.userId && React.createElement('button', { 
                    onClick: function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); onStartChat(listing.userId, listing.id, e); }, 
                    className: 'text-gray-500 hover:text-green-950 p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-gray-100 transition' 
                  },
                    React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-3 h-3', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' }, 
                      React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M8 12h.01M12 12h.01M16 12h.01M21 12c0 4.418-4.03 8-9 8a9.863 9.863 0 01-4.255-.949L3 20l1.395-3.72C3.512 15.042 3 13.574 3 12c0-4.418 4.03-8 9-8s9 3.582 9 8z' })
                    )
                  ),
                  
                  React.createElement('button', { 
                    onClick: function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); onShare(listing, e); }, 
                    className: 'text-gray-500 hover:text-blue-600 p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-gray-100 transition' 
                  },
                    React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-3 h-3', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' }, 
                      React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M8.684 13.342C8.886 12.938 9 12.482 9 12c0-.482-.114-.938-.316-1.342m0 2.684a3 3 0 110-2.684m0 2.684l6.632 3.316m-6.632-6l6.632-3.316m0 0a3 3 0 105.367-2.684 3 3 0 00-5.367 2.684zm0 9.316a3 3 0 105.368 2.684 3 3 0 00-5.368-2.684z' })
                    )
                  )
                ),
                
                React.createElement('button', {
                  onClick: function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); onToggleFavorite(listing.id, e); },
                  disabled: isChecking,
                  className: 'p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-gray-100 transition ' + 
                            (isFav ? 'text-red-500' : 'text-gray-500')
                },
                  isFav
                    ? React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-3 h-3', fill: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 20 20' }, 
                        React.createElement('path', { fillRule: 'evenodd', d: 'M3.172 5.172a4 4 0 015.656 0L10 6.343l1.172-1.171a4 4 0 115.656 5.656L10 17.657l-6.828-6.829a4 4 0 010-5.656z', clipRule: 'evenodd' })
                      )
                    : React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-3 h-3', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' }, 
                        React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M4.318 6.318a4.5 4.5 0 000 6.364L12 20.364l7.682-7.682a4.5 4.5 0 00-6.364-6.364L12 7.636l-1.318-1.318a4.5 4.5 0 00-6.364 0z' })
                      )
                )
              )
            )
          );
        })
      ),
      
      // Show more/less toggle
      listings.length > 4 && React.createElement('button', {
        onClick: function() { toggleLocation(locationKey); },
        className: 'w-full text-center text-xs text-green-950 py-2 hover:underline flex items-center justify-center gap-1'
      },
        React.createElement('span', null, isExpanded ? 'Show less' : `Show ${listings.length - 4} more`),
        React.createElement('svg', {
          className: 'w-3 h-3 transition-transform ' + (isExpanded ? 'rotate-180' : ''),
          fill: 'none',
          stroke: 'currentColor',
          viewBox: '0 0 24 24'
        },
          React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M19 9l-7 7-7-7' })
        )
      )
    );
  };
  
  // ===== MAIN RENDER =====
  
  // Loading state
  if (loading && listings.length === 0) {
    return React.createElement('div', { className: 'grid ' + gridCols + ' gap-3' },
      Array.from({ length: 8 }).map(function(_, i) {
        return React.createElement('div', { 
          key: i, 
          className: 'bg-white rounded-lg shadow-md overflow-hidden animate-pulse' 
        },
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'h-40 bg-gray-200' }),
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'p-2 space-y-2' },
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'h-4 bg-gray-200 rounded w-3/4' }),
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'h-3 bg-gray-200 rounded w-full' })
          )
        );
      })
    );
  }

  return React.createElement('div', { className: 'px-4 pb-20' },
    
    // Search result count
    searchTerm && React.createElement('div', { className: 'mb-3 text-sm text-gray-600' },
      filteredCount + ' result' + (filteredCount === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' found for "' + searchTerm + '"'
    ),

    // MAIN RESULTS SECTION (always shown if any)
    listings.length > 0 && React.createElement('div', { className: 'mb-8' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'grid ' + gridCols + ' gap-3' },
        listings.map(function(listing) {
          const isOwner = user && user.uid === listing.userId;
          const isFav = favorites[listing.id] || false;
          const isChecking = checkingFavorites[listing.id] || false;

          return React.createElement('div', {
            key: listing.id,
            'data-listing-card': '1',
            className: 'bg-white rounded-lg shadow-md overflow-hidden cursor-pointer hover:shadow-lg transition page-transition',
            onClick: function() { onListingClick(listing); }
          },
            // ... (existing listing card code - same as above)
            // Use the same card structure as in the location sections
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'relative ' + cardSizes.image + ' bg-gray-200' },
              React.createElement('img', {
                src: listing.images?.[0]
                  ? window.CloudinaryHelpers.getCardUrl(listing.images[0])
                  : '/vault/img/no-image.jpg',
                alt: listing.title,
                className: 'w-full h-full object-cover',
                loading: 'lazy',
                onError: function(e) { e.target.src = '/vault/img/no-image.jpg'; }
              }),
              React.createElement('div', { className: 'absolute bottom-1 left-1 bg-green-950 text-white px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold ' + cardSizes.price },
                '‚Ç¶' + (listing.price ? listing.price.toLocaleString() : '0')
              )
            ),
            
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'p-2 ' + spacing },
              React.createElement('h3', { className: 'font-bold text-gray-900 mb-0.5 line-clamp-1 ' + cardSizes.title }, 
                listing.title
              ),
              React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-600 mb-1 line-clamp-1 ' + cardSizes.address }, 
                listing.address
              ),
              
              React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex flex-wrap gap-0.5 mb-1' },
                !listing.agentToggle && React.createElement('span', { 
                  className: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700 px-1 py-0.5 rounded ' + cardSizes.badge 
                }, 'Agent-Free'),
                listing.propertyType && React.createElement('span', { 
                  className: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 px-1 py-0.5 rounded ' + cardSizes.badge 
                }, listing.propertyType)
              ),
              
              React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center justify-between pt-1 border-t border-gray-100' },
                React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex gap-1' },
                  user && !isOwner && React.createElement('button', { 
                    onClick: function(e) { onStartChat(listing.userId, listing.id, e); }, 
                    className: 'text-gray-500 hover:text-green-950 p-1 rounded hover:bg-gray-100 transition ' + cardSizes.button 
                  },
                    React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-4 h-4', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' }, 
                      React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M8 12h.01M12 12h.01M16 12h.01M21 12c0 4.418-4.03 8-9 8a9.863 9.863 0 01-4.255-.949L3 20l1.395-3.72C3.512 15.042 3 13.574 3 12c0-4.418 4.03-8 9-8s9 3.582 9 8z' })
                    )
                  ),
                  
                  React.createElement('button', { 
                    onClick: function(e) { onShare(listing, e); }, 
                    className: 'text-gray-500 hover:text-blue-600 p-1 rounded hover:bg-gray-100 transition ' + cardSizes.button 
                  },
                    React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-4 h-4', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' }, 
                      React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M8.684 13.342C8.886 12.938 9 12.482 9 12c0-.482-.114-.938-.316-1.342m0 2.684a3 3 0 110-2.684m0 2.684l6.632 3.316m-6.632-6l6.632-3.316m0 0a3 3 0 105.367-2.684 3 3 0 00-5.367 2.684zm0 9.316a3 3 0 105.368 2.684 3 3 0 00-5.368-2.684z' })
                    )
                  )
                ),
                
                React.createElement('button', {
                  onClick: function(e) { onToggleFavorite(listing.id, e); },
                  disabled: isChecking,
                  className: 'p-1 rounded hover:bg-gray-100 transition ' + cardSizes.button + ' ' + 
                            (isFav ? 'text-red-500 hover:text-red-700' : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-red-500') + 
                            (isChecking ? ' opacity-50 cursor-wait' : '')
                },
                  isFav
                    ? React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-4 h-4', fill: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 20 20' }, 
                        React.createElement('path', { fillRule: 'evenodd', d: 'M3.172 5.172a4 4 0 015.656 0L10 6.343l1.172-1.171a4 4 0 115.656 5.656L10 17.657l-6.828-6.829a4 4 0 010-5.656z', clipRule: 'evenodd' })
                      )
                    : React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-4 h-4', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' }, 
                        React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M4.318 6.318a4.5 4.5 0 000 6.364L12 20.364l7.682-7.682a4.5 4.5 0 00-6.364-6.364L12 7.636l-1.318-1.318a4.5 4.5 0 00-6.364 0z' })
                      )
                )
              )
            )
          );
        })
      )
    ),

    // NO RESULTS FOUND SECTION
    listings.length === 0 && !loading && React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-center py-12 mb-8 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-5xl mb-3' }, 'üè†'),
      React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-500 text-lg mb-2' }, 
        'No listings match "' + searchTerm + '"'
      ),
      React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-400 text-sm mb-6' },
        'Try adjusting your search or filters'
      ),
      
      // Quick suggestions
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'max-w-md mx-auto' },
        React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-xs text-gray-500 mb-3' }, 'Try searching for:'),
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex flex-wrap gap-2 justify-center' },
          ['Lagos', 'Abuja', 'Port Harcourt', '2 bedroom', 'Self contain'].map(function(suggestion) {
            return React.createElement('button', {
              key: suggestion,
              onClick: function() {
                onSearchChange(suggestion);
                onSearchSubmit(suggestion);
              },
              className: 'bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-sm transition'
            }, suggestion);
          })
        )
      ),
      
      // Post listing button
      React.createElement('button', { 
        onClick: function() { 
          if (user) {
            window.__openAuthModal('post', {});
          } else {
            window.__openAuthModal('signup', '/post');
          }
        }, 
        className: 'mt-6 bg-green-950 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-green-800 transition ' + bodyTextSize 
      }, 'Post a Listing')
    ),

    // LOCATION-BASED SECTIONS (only shown when main results are present OR when no results)
    React.createElement('div', { className: 'space-y-6' },
      
      // If we have a suggested state and there are listings there
      searchContext?.suggestedState && searchContext.stateListings?.length > 0 &&
      renderLocationSection(
        `Also available in ${searchContext.suggestedState} State`,
        `state-${searchContext.suggestedState}`,
        searchContext.stateListings,
        searchContext.suggestedState
      ),
      
      // If we have matching LGAs
      searchContext?.matchingLGAs && Object.entries(searchContext.lgaListings || {}).map(function([key, listings]) {
        const [state, lga] = key.split('|');
        return renderLocationSection(
          `Properties in ${lga}, ${state}`,
          key,
          listings,
          state,
          lga
        );
      }),
      
      // Other states with available listings
      searchContext?.otherStates && searchContext.otherStates.map(function(state) {
        const key = `other-${state}`;
        
        // Load listings for this state if not already loaded
        if (!locationListings[key] && !loading) {
          setTimeout(function() {
            loadLocationListings('state', state);
          }, 100);
        }
        
        const listings = locationListings[key];
        if (!listings || listings.length === 0) return null;
        
        return renderLocationSection(
          `More properties in ${state}`,
          key,
          listings,
          state
        );
      })
    ),

    // Loading more indicator
    loadingMore && React.createElement('div', { className: 'grid ' + gridCols + ' gap-3 mt-3' },
      Array.from({ length: 4 }).map(function(_, i) {
        return React.createElement('div', { 
          key: i, 
          className: 'bg-white rounded-lg shadow-md overflow-hidden animate-pulse' 
        },
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'h-40 bg-gray-200' }),
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'p-2 space-y-2' },
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'h-4 bg-gray-200 rounded w-3/4' }),
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'h-3 bg-gray-200 rounded w-full' })
          )
        );
      })
    ),

    // End of results
    !hasMore && listings.length > 0 && 
    React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-center py-4 text-gray-400 text-sm' }, 
      "You've reached the end"
    )
  );
}

window.ListingGrid = ListingGrid;

// pages/home/components/LocationSearch.js
function LocationSearch({ onLocationSelect }) {
  const [query, setQuery] = React.useState('');
  const [results, setResults] = React.useState([]);
  const [showResults, setShowResults] = React.useState(false);
  const [searching, setSearching] = React.useState(false);
  const searchRef = React.useRef(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e) => {
      if (searchRef.current && !searchRef.current.contains(e.target)) {
        setShowResults(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const searchLocation = async (text) => {
    if (text.length < 3) {
      setResults([]);
      return;
    }

    setSearching(true);
    
    try {
      // Use Nominatim for location search
      const response = await fetch(
        `https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?format=json&q=${encodeURIComponent(text + ', Nigeria')}&limit=5`,
        { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'UnaDomot/1.0' } }
      );
      const data = await response.json();
      setResults(data);
      setShowResults(true);
    } catch (error) {
      
    } finally {
      setSearching(false);
    }
  };

  const debouncedSearch = React.useCallback(
    debounce(searchLocation, 500), []
  );

  const handleInputChange = (e) => {
    const value = e.target.value;
    setQuery(value);
    debouncedSearch(value);
  };

  const handleSelect = (result) => {
    setQuery(result.display_name.split(',')[0]);
    setShowResults(false);
    onLocationSelect({
      lat: parseFloat(result.lat),
      lng: parseFloat(result.lon),
      name: result.display_name
    });
  };

  return React.createElement('div', {
    ref: searchRef,
    className: 'relative flex-1'
  },
    React.createElement('input', {
      type: 'text',
      value: query,
      onChange: handleInputChange,
      placeholder: 'Search location...',
      className: 'w-full pl-9 pr-8 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-full text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-950'
    }),
    React.createElement('svg', {
      className: 'absolute left-3 top-2.5 w-4 h-4 text-gray-400',
      fill: 'none',
      stroke: 'currentColor',
      viewBox: '0 0 24 24'
    },
      React.createElement('path', {
        strokeLinecap: 'round',
        strokeLinejoin: 'round',
        strokeWidth: '2',
        d: 'M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0z'
      })
    ),
    searching && React.createElement('div', {
      className: 'absolute right-3 top-2.5 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-green-950 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin'
    }),

    showResults && results.length > 0 && React.createElement('div', {
      className: 'absolute top-full left-0 right-0 mt-1 bg-white rounded-lg shadow-xl border border-gray-200 z-50 max-h-60 overflow-y-auto'
    },
      results.map((r, i) => 
        React.createElement('button', {
          key: i,
          onClick: () => handleSelect(r),
          className: 'w-full text-left px-4 py-2 hover:bg-green-50 text-sm border-b last:border-0'
        }, r.display_name)
      )
    )
  );
}

// Debounce helper
function debounce(func, wait) {
  let timeout;
  return function executedFunction(...args) {
    const later = () => {
      clearTimeout(timeout);
      func(...args);
    };
    clearTimeout(timeout);
    timeout = setTimeout(later, wait);
  };
}

window.LocationSearch = LocationSearch;

function PriceRangeSlider({ minPrice, maxPrice, onMinChange, onMaxChange, onApply }) {
  const [localMin, setLocalMin] = React.useState(minPrice || '');
  const [localMax, setLocalMax] = React.useState(maxPrice || '');
  const [showPresets, setShowPresets] = React.useState(false);
  
  const presets = [
    { label: 'Under ‚Ç¶500k', min: '', max: '500000' },
    { label: '‚Ç¶500k - ‚Ç¶1M', min: '500000', max: '1000000' },
    { label: '‚Ç¶1M - ‚Ç¶3M', min: '1000000', max: '3000000' },
    { label: '‚Ç¶3M - ‚Ç¶5M', min: '3000000', max: '5000000' },
    { label: 'Above ‚Ç¶5M', min: '5000000', max: '' }
  ];
  
  const handleApply = () => {
    onApply(localMin, localMax);
  };
  
  const handlePresetSelect = (preset) => {
    setLocalMin(preset.min);
    setLocalMax(preset.max);
    onApply(preset.min, preset.max);
    setShowPresets(false);
  };
  
  const formatNaira = (value) => {
    if (!value) return '';
    return `‚Ç¶${Number(value).toLocaleString()}`;
  };
  
  return React.createElement('div', { className: 'bg-white rounded-xl shadow-lg p-4' },
    // Header with presets toggle

// pages/home/components/RecentViews.js
function RecentViews({ onListingSelect, maxItems = 5 }) {
  const [recentViews, setRecentViews] = React.useState([]);
  const [showRecent, setShowRecent] = React.useState(false);
  
  // Load recently viewed from localStorage
  React.useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const views = localStorage.getItem('recent_views');
      if (views) {
        setRecentViews(JSON.parse(views).slice(0, maxItems));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Error loading recent views:', e);
    }
    
    // Listen for new views
    const handleNewView = (e) => {
      if (e.detail?.listing) {
        setRecentViews(prev => {
          const filtered = prev.filter(v => v.id !== e.detail.listing.id);
          const updated = [e.detail.listing, ...filtered].slice(0, maxItems);
          try {
            localStorage.setItem('recent_views', JSON.stringify(updated));
          } catch (err) {}
          return updated;
        });
      }
    };
    
    window.addEventListener('listing-viewed', handleNewView);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('listing-viewed', handleNewView);
  }, [maxItems]);
  
  const clearRecent = () => {
    setRecentViews([]);
    localStorage.removeItem('recent_views');
  };
  
  if (recentViews.length === 0) return null;
  
  return React.createElement(React.Fragment, null,
    // Recent views button
    React.createElement('button', {
        onClick: () => setShowRecent(!showRecent),
        className: 'bg-white rounded-full shadow-lg p-3 transition-all hover:scale-110 relative'
      },
      React.createElement('svg', {
          className: 'w-5 h-5',
          fill: 'none',
          stroke: 'currentColor',
          viewBox: '0 0 24 24'
        },
        React.createElement('path', {
          strokeLinecap: 'round',
          strokeLinejoin: 'round',
          strokeWidth: '2',
          d: 'M12 8v4l3 3m6-3a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z'
        })
      ),
      React.createElement('span', {
        className: 'absolute -top-1 -right-1 bg-blue-500 text-white text-xs rounded-full min-w-[18px] h-[18px] flex items-center justify-center'
      }, recentViews.length)
    ),
    
    // Recent views panel
    showRecent && React.createElement('div', {
        className: 'absolute bottom-20 left-4 right-4 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl border border-gray-200 z-50 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto'
      },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'p-3 border-b border-gray-100 flex justify-between items-center sticky top-0 bg-white' },
        React.createElement('h3', { className: 'font-bold text-gray-900' }, 'Recently Viewed'),
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex gap-2' },
          React.createElement('button', {
            onClick: clearRecent,
            className: 'text-xs text-red-500 hover:text-red-700'
          }, 'Clear'),
          React.createElement('button', {
            onClick: () => setShowRecent(false),
            className: 'text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600'
          }, '‚úï')
        )
      ),
      
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'p-2' },
        recentViews.map(listing =>
          React.createElement('div', {
              key: listing.id,
              onClick: () => {
                onListingSelect(listing.id);
                setShowRecent(false);
              },
              className: 'flex gap-3 p-2 hover:bg-gray-50 rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition'
            },
            React.createElement('img', {
              src: listing.images?.[0] ?
                window.CloudinaryHelpers?.getThumbnailUrl(listing.images[0]) :
                '/vault/img/no-image.jpg',
              className: 'w-16 h-16 rounded-lg object-cover',
              onError: (e) => { e.target.src = '/vault/img/no-image.jpg'; }
            }),
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex-1' },
              React.createElement('h4', { className: 'font-medium text-sm' }, listing.title),
              React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1' },
                `${listing.lga || ''}, ${listing.state || ''}`
              ),
              React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-sm font-bold text-green-950 mt-1' },
                `‚Ç¶${listing.price?.toLocaleString()}/month`
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  );
}

// pages/home/components/SearchBar.js - WITH ARROW/X TOGGLE (FIXED)

function SearchBar({
  searchTerm,
  onSearchChange,
  onSearchSubmit,
  onClearSearch,
  showDropdown,
  setShowDropdown,
  searchHistory,
  suggestions,
  onSelectSuggestion,
  onClearHistory,
  searchInputRef,
  searchDropdownRef,
  touchTargetSize,
  showToast,
  isSearchActive // New prop to know if we're in search mode
}) {
  const handleKeyDown = function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      onSearchSubmit(searchTerm);
      setShowDropdown(false);
    }
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      setShowDropdown(false);
    }
  };
  
  const handleSearchClick = function() {
    if (searchTerm.trim()) {
      onSearchSubmit(searchTerm);
      setShowDropdown(false);
    }
  };
  
  const handleClearClick = function() {
    onClearSearch();
    setShowDropdown(false);
    // Focus back on input after clearing
    if (searchInputRef.current) {
      searchInputRef.current.focus();
    }
  };
  
  const highlightMatch = function(text, query) {
    if (!query) return text;
    const index = text.toLowerCase().indexOf(query.toLowerCase());
    if (index === -1) return text;
    
    return React.createElement('span', null,
      text.substring(0, index),
      React.createElement('strong', { className: 'bg-yellow-100 font-normal' },
        text.substring(index, index + query.length)
      ),
      text.substring(index + query.length)
    );
  };
  
  // Get icon based on suggestion type
  const getSuggestionIcon = function(suggestion) {
    if (suggestion.icon) return suggestion.icon;
    return 'üîç';
  };
  
  // Determine which button to show - Arrow when typing, X when search is active
  const showArrow = searchTerm.length > 0 && !isSearchActive;
  const showX = isSearchActive;
  
  return React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex-1 relative' },
    React.createElement('div', { className: 'relative' },
      React.createElement('input', {
        ref: searchInputRef,
        type: 'text',
        placeholder: 'Search locations, property types, bedrooms...',
        value: searchTerm,
        onChange: function(e) {
          onSearchChange(e.target.value);
          setShowDropdown(true);
        },
        onFocus: function() { setShowDropdown(true); },
        onKeyDown: handleKeyDown,
        className: 'w-full pl-9 pr-12 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-full focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-950 focus:border-transparent text-sm'
      }),
      
      // Search icon (always visible)
      React.createElement('svg', {
          className: 'absolute left-3 top-2.5 w-4 h-4 text-gray-400 pointer-events-none',
          fill: 'none',
          stroke: 'currentColor',
          viewBox: '0 0 24 24'
        },
        React.createElement('path', {
          strokeLinecap: 'round',
          strokeLinejoin: 'round',
          strokeWidth: '2',
          d: 'M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0z'
        })
      ),
      
      // Dynamic button - Arrow or X
      (showArrow || showX) && React.createElement('button', {
          onClick: showArrow ? handleSearchClick : handleClearClick,
          className: `absolute right-2.5 top-1.5 rounded-full w-7 h-7 flex items-center justify-center transition ${
            showArrow 
              ? 'bg-green-950 text-white hover:bg-green-800' 
              : 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-300'
          }`,
          'aria-label': showArrow ? 'Search' : 'Clear search'
        },
        showArrow ?
        React.createElement('svg', {
            className: 'w-4 h-4',
            fill: 'none',
            stroke: 'currentColor',
            viewBox: '0 0 24 24'
          },
          React.createElement('path', {
            strokeLinecap: 'round',
            strokeLinejoin: 'round',
            strokeWidth: '2.5',
            d: 'M9 5l7 7-7 7'
          })
        ) :
        React.createElement('svg', {
            className: 'w-4 h-4',
            fill: 'none',
            stroke: 'currentColor',
            viewBox: '0 0 24 24'
          },
          React.createElement('path', {
            strokeLinecap: 'round',
            strokeLinejoin: 'round',
            strokeWidth: '2.5',
            d: 'M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12'
          })
        )
      )
    ),
    
    // Search dropdown
    showDropdown && (searchTerm.length === 0 ? searchHistory.length > 0 : suggestions.length > 0) &&
    React.createElement('div', {
        ref: searchDropdownRef,
        className: 'absolute top-full left-0 right-0 mt-1 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-xl border border-gray-100 z-50 overflow-hidden max-h-96 overflow-y-auto'
      },
      
      // Search history section
      searchTerm.length === 0 && searchHistory.length > 0 &&
      React.createElement(React.Fragment, null,
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 border-b border-gray-50 bg-gray-50' },
          React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide' }, 'Recent searches'),
          React.createElement('button', {
            onClick: onClearHistory,
            className: 'text-xs text-gray-400 hover:text-red-500 transition'
          }, 'Clear')
        ),
        searchHistory.map(function(h, i) {
          return React.createElement('button', {
              key: i,
              onClick: function() { onSelectSuggestion(h); },
              className: 'w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 hover:bg-gray-50 text-left text-sm text-gray-700 transition border-b border-gray-50 last:border-0'
            },
            React.createElement('svg', {
                className: 'w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0',
                fill: 'none',
                stroke: 'currentColor',
                viewBox: '0 0 24 24'
              },
              React.createElement('path', {
                strokeLinecap: 'round',
                strokeLinejoin: 'round',
                strokeWidth: '2',
                d: 'M12 8v4l3 3m6-3a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z'
              })
            ),
            h
          );
        })
      ),
      
      // Suggestions with categories
      searchTerm.length > 0 && suggestions.length > 0 &&
      React.createElement('div', null,
        suggestions.map(function(item, index) {
          // Render header
          if (item.type === 'header') {
            return React.createElement('div', {
              key: 'header-' + index,
              className: 'px-3 py-1.5 bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-100 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500'
            }, item.text);
          }
          
          // Render suggestion item
          return React.createElement('button', {
              key: item.type + '-' + item.text + '-' + index,
              onClick: function() { onSelectSuggestion(item.text); },
              className: 'w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 hover:bg-green-50 text-left text-sm text-gray-700 transition border-b border-gray-50 last:border-0'
            },
            React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-base' }, getSuggestionIcon(item)),
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex-1' },
              highlightMatch(item.text, searchTerm)
            ),
            React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-[10px] text-gray-400 bg-gray-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full' },
              item.category
            )
          );
        })
      ),
      
      // No results message
      searchTerm.length > 0 && suggestions.length === 0 &&
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'px-3 py-4 text-center text-sm text-gray-400' },
        'No matches found for "', searchTerm, '"'
      )
    )
  );
}

window.SearchBar = SearchBar;

// pages/home/components/LocationSearch.js
function LocationSearch({ onLocationSelect }) {
  const [query, setQuery] = React.useState('');
  const [results, setResults] = React.useState([]);
  const [showResults, setShowResults] = React.useState(false);
  const [searching, setSearching] = React.useState(false);
  const searchRef = React.useRef(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e) => {
      if (searchRef.current && !searchRef.current.contains(e.target)) {
        setShowResults(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const searchLocation = async (text) => {
    if (text.length < 3) {
      setResults([]);
      return;
    }

    setSearching(true);
    
    try {
      // Use Nominatim for location search
      const response = await fetch(
        `https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?format=json&q=${encodeURIComponent(text + ', Nigeria')}&limit=5`,
        { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'UnaDomot/1.0' } }
      );
      const data = await response.json();
      setResults(data);
      setShowResults(true);
    } catch (error) {
      
    } finally {
      setSearching(false);
    }
  };

  const debouncedSearch = React.useCallback(
    debounce(searchLocation, 500), []
  );

  const handleInputChange = (e) => {
    const value = e.target.value;
    setQuery(value);
    debouncedSearch(value);
  };

  const handleSelect = (result) => {
    setQuery(result.display_name.split(',')[0]);
    setShowResults(false);
    onLocationSelect({
      lat: parseFloat(result.lat),
      lng: parseFloat(result.lon),
      name: result.display_name
    });
  };

  return React.createElement('div', {
    ref: searchRef,
    className: 'relative flex-1'
  },
    React.createElement('input', {
      type: 'text',
      value: query,
      onChange: handleInputChange,
      placeholder: 'Search location...',
      className: 'w-full pl-9 pr-8 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-full text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-950'
    }),
    React.createElement('svg', {
      className: 'absolute left-3 top-2.5 w-4 h-4 text-gray-400',
      fill: 'none',
      stroke: 'currentColor',
      viewBox: '0 0 24 24'
    },
      React.createElement('path', {
        strokeLinecap: 'round',
        strokeLinejoin: 'round',
        strokeWidth: '2',
        d: 'M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0z'
      })
    ),
    searching && React.createElement('div', {
      className: 'absolute right-3 top-2.5 w-4 h-4 border-2 border-green-950 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin'
    }),

    showResults && results.length > 0 && React.createElement('div', {
      className: 'absolute top-full left-0 right-0 mt-1 bg-white rounded-lg shadow-xl border border-gray-200 z-50 max-h-60 overflow-y-auto'
    },
      results.map((r, i) => 
        React.createElement('button', {
          key: i,
          onClick: () => handleSelect(r),
          className: 'w-full text-left px-4 py-2 hover:bg-green-50 text-sm border-b last:border-0'
        }, r.display_name)
      )
    )
  );
}

// Debounce helper
function debounce(func, wait) {
  let timeout;
  return function executedFunction(...args) {
    const later = () => {
      clearTimeout(timeout);
      func(...args);
    };
    clearTimeout(timeout);
    timeout = setTimeout(later, wait);
  };
}

window.LocationSearch = LocationSearch;

// pages/home/components/map/MapCore.js - FULL WORKING VERSION (No Hooks)



window.useMapCore = function(mapRef, mapInstanceRef, onMapReady) {
  
  
  // Track state manually (not using React hooks)
  let mapReady = false;
  let lastLoadBounds = null;
  
  // Check if Leaflet is loaded
  const checkLeaflet = function() {
    if (window.L) {
      
      mapReady = true;
      
      // If mapRef already has a current value, we could auto-init here
      // But we'll let the component call initMap explicitly
      return true;
    } else {
      console.error('‚ùå Leaflet not found');
      return false;
    }
  };
  
  // Run check immediately
  checkLeaflet();
  
  // If Leaflet not loaded, try again after delay
  if (!window.L) {
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (window.L) {
        
        mapReady = true;
      }
    }, 500);
  }
  
  // Initialize map
  const initMap = function(center = [9.0820, 8.6753], zoom = 6) {
    
    
    // Check prerequisites
    if (!window.L) {
      console.error('‚ùå Leaflet not available');
      return null;
    }
    
    if (!mapReady) {
      console.error('‚ùå Map not ready');
      return null;
    }
    
    if (!mapRef || !mapRef.current) {
      console.error('‚ùå Map ref not available');
      return null;
    }
    
    if (mapInstanceRef && mapInstanceRef.current) {
      
      return mapInstanceRef.current;
    }
    
    try {
      
      
      // Create map instance
      const map = window.L.map(mapRef.current, {
        fadeAnimation: false,
        zoomAnimation: false,
        zoomControl: false
      }).setView(center, zoom);
      
      // Add tile layer (OpenStreetMap)
      window.L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
        attribution: '¬© OpenStreetMap Contributors',
        maxZoom: 19
      }).addTo(map);
      
      // Add zoom control
      window.L.control.zoom({
        position: 'bottomright'
      }).addTo(map);
      
      // Store map instance
      if (mapInstanceRef) {
        mapInstanceRef.current = map;
      }
      
      
      
      // Call onMapReady callback if provided
      if (onMapReady && typeof onMapReady === 'function') {
        onMapReady(map);
      }
      
      return map;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('‚ùå Map initialization error:', error);
      return null;
    }
  };
  
  // Set lastLoadBounds
  const setLastLoadBounds = function(bounds) {
    lastLoadBounds = bounds;
  };
  
  // Return the core functions and state
  return {
    mapReady: mapReady,
    initMap: initMap,
    lastLoadBounds: lastLoadBounds,
    setLastLoadBounds: setLastLoadBounds
  };
};

// pages/home/components/map/MapGeolocation.js

window.useGeolocation = function(mapInstance, onLocationFound) {
  const [userLocation, setUserLocation] = React.useState(null);
  const [locationStatus, setLocationStatus] = React.useState('idle');
  const [locationError, setLocationError] = React.useState('');
  
  const getUserLocation = (showToast) => {
    setLocationStatus('loading');
    setLocationError('');
    
    if (!navigator.geolocation) {
      setLocationStatus('error');
      setLocationError('Geolocation is not supported by your browser');
      showToast?.('üìç GPS not supported on this device', 'error');
      return;
    }
    
    const options = {
      enableHighAccuracy: true,
      timeout: 10000,
      maximumAge: 0
    };
    
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (position) => {
        const location = {
          lat: position.coords.latitude,
          lng: position.coords.longitude,
          accuracy: position.coords.accuracy
        };
        
        setUserLocation(location);
        setLocationStatus('success');
        
        if (mapInstance) {
          mapInstance.setView([location.lat, location.lng], 15);
          
          const userMarker = window.L.circleMarker([location.lat, location.lng], {
            radius: 8,
            color: '#3b82f6',
            weight: 2,
            fillColor: '#60a5fa',
            fillOpacity: 0.6,
            className: 'pulse-dot'
          }).addTo(mapInstance);
          
          userMarker.bindPopup(`
            <div class="text-center">
              <strong>You are here</strong><br/>
              <span class="text-[10px]">Accuracy: ¬±${Math.round(location.accuracy)}m</span>
            </div>
          `).openPopup();
        }
        
        if (onLocationFound) onLocationFound(location);
        showToast?.('üìç Found your location!', 'success');
      },
      (error) => {
        setLocationStatus('error');
        
        let userMessage = '';
        switch (error.code) {
          case error.PERMISSION_DENIED:
            userMessage = 'Please allow location access in your browser settings';
            break;
          case error.POSITION_UNAVAILABLE:
            userMessage = 'GPS signal not found. Try moving to an open area.';
            break;
          case error.TIMEOUT:
            userMessage = 'GPS taking too long. Check your connection and try again.';
            break;
          default:
            userMessage = 'Could not determine your location';
        }
        
        setLocationError(userMessage);
        showToast?.(`üìç Location error: ${userMessage}`, 'error');
        
      },
      options
    );
  };
  
  return {
    userLocation: userLocation,
    locationStatus: locationStatus,
    locationError: locationError,
    getUserLocation: getUserLocation
  };
};
