// pages/home/components/map/MapLayers.js - COMPLETE WITH REALTIME FAVORITES

window.useMapLayers = function(mapInstance, allListings, user, favorites, onListingSelect, onToggleFavorite, onStartChat, onShare, onEdit, onDelete, activePopupRef, forceClosePopup) {
  
  
  const continentLayerRef = React.useRef(null);
  const countryLayerRef = React.useRef(null);
  const stateLayerRef = React.useRef(null);
  const lgaLayerRef = React.useRef(null);
  
  const [continentCount, setContinentCount] = React.useState(0);
  const [countryCount, setCountryCount] = React.useState(0);
  const [stateCounts, setStateCounts] = React.useState({});
  const [lgaCounts, setLgaCounts] = React.useState({});
  const [currentZoom, setCurrentZoom] = React.useState(6);
  const [selectedRegion, setSelectedRegion] = React.useState(null);
  const [regionListings, setRegionListings] = React.useState([]);
  const [showRegionPanel, setShowRegionPanel] = React.useState(false);
  const [currentRegionIndex, setCurrentRegionIndex] = React.useState(0);

  // Compute counts per admin region
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!allListings.length || !window.nigeriaStates) {
      return;
    }

    setContinentCount(allListings.length);
    setCountryCount(allListings.length);

    const stateCountsMap = {};
    const lgaCountsMap = {};

    window.nigeriaStates.forEach(state => {
      stateCountsMap[state.name] = 0;
      
      state.lgas.forEach(lga => {
        const key = `${state.name}|${lga.name}`;
        lgaCountsMap[key] = 0;
      });
    });

    allListings.forEach(listing => {
      if (listing.state && stateCountsMap.hasOwnProperty(listing.state)) {
        stateCountsMap[listing.state]++;
        
        if (listing.lga) {
          const lgaKey = `${listing.state}|${listing.lga}`;
          if (lgaCountsMap.hasOwnProperty(lgaKey)) {
            lgaCountsMap[lgaKey]++;
          }
        }
      }
    });

    setStateCounts(stateCountsMap);
    setLgaCounts(lgaCountsMap);
  }, [allListings]);

  // Get listings for a region
  const getListingsForRegion = (regionType, regionName, stateName = null) => {
    if (regionType === 'continent') {
      return allListings;
    } else if (regionType === 'country') {
      return allListings;
    } else if (regionType === 'state') {
      return allListings.filter(l => l.state === regionName);
    } else if (regionType === 'lga') {
      return allListings.filter(l => l.lga === regionName && l.state === stateName);
    }
    return [];
  };

  // Create region popup content with navigation - MATCHES MOBILE CARD
  const createRegionPopup = (regionType, regionName, stateName, count, regionListings, marker, currentIdx = 0) => {
    
    // Get current favorites from global state
    const currentFavorites = window.FavoritesHelpers?.getCurrentFavorites() || {};
    
    // Navigation callbacks
    const goToPrevListing = () => {
      const newIndex = currentIdx > 0 ? currentIdx - 1 : regionListings.length - 1;
      setCurrentRegionIndex(newIndex);
      
      if (activePopupRef.current) {
        const newContent = window.createPopupContent(
          regionListings,
          newIndex,
          user,
          currentFavorites,
          onStartChat,
          onShare,
          onListingSelect,
          onToggleFavorite,
          onEdit,
          onDelete,
          () => {
            if (mapInstance) {
              mapInstance.closePopup();
              activePopupRef.current = null;
            }
          },
          () => {
            const prevIdx = newIndex > 0 ? newIndex - 1 : regionListings.length - 1;
            setCurrentRegionIndex(prevIdx);
            if (activePopupRef.current) {
              activePopupRef.current.setPopupContent(
                createRegionPopup(regionType, regionName, stateName, count, regionListings, marker, prevIdx)
              );
            }
          },
          () => {
            const nextIdx = newIndex < regionListings.length - 1 ? newIndex + 1 : 0;
            setCurrentRegionIndex(nextIdx);
            if (activePopupRef.current) {
              activePopupRef.current.setPopupContent(
                createRegionPopup(regionType, regionName, stateName, count, regionListings, marker, nextIdx)
              );
            }
          }
        );
        activePopupRef.current.setPopupContent(newContent);
      }
    };
    
    const goToNextListing = () => {
      const newIndex = currentIdx < regionListings.length - 1 ? currentIdx + 1 : 0;
      setCurrentRegionIndex(newIndex);
      
      if (activePopupRef.current) {
        const newContent = window.createPopupContent(
          regionListings,
          newIndex,
          user,
          currentFavorites,
          onStartChat,
          onShare,
          onListingSelect,
          onToggleFavorite,
          onEdit,
          onDelete,
          () => {
            if (mapInstance) {
              mapInstance.closePopup();
              activePopupRef.current = null;
            }
          },
          () => {
            const prevIdx = newIndex > 0 ? newIndex - 1 : regionListings.length - 1;
            setCurrentRegionIndex(prevIdx);
            if (activePopupRef.current) {
              activePopupRef.current.setPopupContent(
                createRegionPopup(regionType, regionName, stateName, count, regionListings, marker, prevIdx)
              );
            }
          },
          () => {
            const nextIdx = newIndex < regionListings.length - 1 ? newIndex + 1 : 0;
            setCurrentRegionIndex(nextIdx);
            if (activePopupRef.current) {
              activePopupRef.current.setPopupContent(
                createRegionPopup(regionType, regionName, stateName, count, regionListings, marker, nextIdx)
              );
            }
          }
        );
        activePopupRef.current.setPopupContent(newContent);
      }
    };
    
    return window.createPopupContent(
      regionListings,
      currentIdx,
      user,
      currentFavorites,
      onStartChat,
      onShare,
      onListingSelect,
      onToggleFavorite,
      onEdit,
      onDelete,
      () => {
        if (mapInstance) {
          mapInstance.closePopup();
          activePopupRef.current = null;
        }
      },
      goToPrevListing,
      goToNextListing
    );
  };
  
  // Force close any open popup
  const forceClosePopupLocal = () => {
    if (mapInstance) {
      mapInstance.closePopup();
      mapInstance.eachLayer((layer) => {
        if (layer._popup) {
          mapInstance.closePopup(layer._popup);
        }
      });
      activePopupRef.current = null;
    }
  };

  // Create admin markers
  const createAdminMarkers = function() {
    if (!mapInstance || !window.L || !window.nigeriaStates) {
      return;
    }

    if (continentLayerRef.current) mapInstance.removeLayer(continentLayerRef.current);
    if (countryLayerRef.current) mapInstance.removeLayer(countryLayerRef.current);
    if (stateLayerRef.current) mapInstance.removeLayer(stateLayerRef.current);
    if (lgaLayerRef.current) mapInstance.removeLayer(lgaLayerRef.current);

    continentLayerRef.current = window.L.layerGroup();
    countryLayerRef.current = window.L.layerGroup();
    stateLayerRef.current = window.L.layerGroup();
    lgaLayerRef.current = window.L.layerGroup();

    // CONTINENT LEVEL
    if (continentCount > 0) {
      const continentMarker = window.L.marker([9.0820, 8.6753], {
        icon: window.L.divIcon({
          html: `<div class="admin-cluster continent-cluster" style="background-color: #0a3622; color: white; border-radius: 50%; width: 40px; height: 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px; border: 2px solid white; box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);">${window.formatClusterCount(continentCount)}</div>`,
          className: 'admin-cluster',
          iconSize: [40, 40]
        }),
        title: 'Africa',
        riseOnHover: true
      });
      
      const continentListings = getListingsForRegion('continent', 'Africa');
      
      continentMarker.bindPopup(() => {
        return createRegionPopup('continent', 'Africa', null, continentCount, continentListings, continentMarker, 0);
      }, {
        closeButton: false,
        autoClose: false,
        closeOnClick: false,
        maxWidth: 280
      });

      continentMarker.on('click', () => {
        if (forceClosePopup) forceClosePopup();
        
        setTimeout(() => {
          continentMarker.openPopup();
          activePopupRef.current = continentMarker;
          setSelectedRegion({ type: 'continent', name: 'Africa', listings: continentListings });
          setCurrentRegionIndex(0);
        }, 10);
      });
      
      continentLayerRef.current.addLayer(continentMarker);
    }

    // COUNTRY LEVEL
    if (countryCount > 0) {
      const countryMarker = window.L.marker([9.0820, 8.6753], {
        icon: window.L.divIcon({
          html: `<div class="admin-cluster country-cluster" style="background-color: #052e16; color: white; border-radius: 50%; width: 35px; height: 35px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: bold; font-size: 13px; border: 2px solid white; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);">${window.formatClusterCount(countryCount)}</div>`,
          className: 'admin-cluster',
          iconSize: [35, 35]
        }),
        title: 'Nigeria',
        riseOnHover: true
      });
      
      const countryListings = getListingsForRegion('country', 'Nigeria');
      
      countryMarker.bindPopup(() => {
        return createRegionPopup('country', 'Nigeria', null, countryCount, countryListings, countryMarker, 0);
      }, {
        closeButton: false,
        autoClose: false,
        closeOnClick: false,
        maxWidth: 280
      });

      countryMarker.on('click', () => {
        if (forceClosePopup) forceClosePopup();
        
        setTimeout(() => {
          countryMarker.openPopup();
          activePopupRef.current = countryMarker;
          setSelectedRegion({ type: 'country', name: 'Nigeria', listings: countryListings });
          setCurrentRegionIndex(0);
        }, 10);
      });
      
      countryLayerRef.current.addLayer(countryMarker);
    }

    // STATE LEVEL
    window.nigeriaStates.forEach(state => {
      const count = stateCounts[state.name] || 0;
      if (count === 0) return;

      const stateMarker = window.L.marker([state.lat, state.lng], {
        icon: window.L.divIcon({
          html: `<div class="admin-cluster state-cluster" style="background-color: #166534; color: white; border-radius: 50%; width: 32px; height: 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: bold; font-size: 12px; border: 2px solid white; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);">${window.formatClusterCount(count)}</div>`,
          className: 'admin-cluster',
          iconSize: [32, 32]
        }),
        title: `${state.name} State`,
        riseOnHover: true
      });

      const stateListings = getListingsForRegion('state', state.name);

      stateMarker.bindPopup(() => {
        return createRegionPopup('state', state.name, null, count, stateListings, stateMarker, 0);
      }, {
        closeButton: false,
        autoClose: false,
        closeOnClick: false,
        maxWidth: 280
      });

      stateMarker.on('click', () => {
        if (forceClosePopup) forceClosePopup();
        
        setTimeout(() => {
          stateMarker.openPopup();
          activePopupRef.current = stateMarker;
          setSelectedRegion({ type: 'state', name: state.name, listings: stateListings });
          setCurrentRegionIndex(0);
        }, 10);
      });

      stateLayerRef.current.addLayer(stateMarker);
    });

    // LGA LEVEL
    window.nigeriaStates.forEach(state => {
      state.lgas.forEach(lga => {
        const key = `${state.name}|${lga.name}`;
        const count = lgaCounts[key] || 0;
        if (count === 0) return;

        const lgaMarker = window.L.marker([lga.lat, lga.lng], {
          icon: window.L.divIcon({
            html: `<div class="admin-cluster lga-cluster" style="background-color: #22c55e; color: white; border-radius: 50%; width: 28px; height: 28px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: bold; font-size: 11px; border: 2px solid white; box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);">${window.formatClusterCount(count)}</div>`,
            className: 'admin-cluster',
            iconSize: [28, 28]
          }),
          title: `${lga.name}, ${state.name}`,
          riseOnHover: true
        });

        const lgaListings = getListingsForRegion('lga', lga.name, state.name);

        lgaMarker.bindPopup(() => {
          return createRegionPopup('lga', lga.name, state.name, count, lgaListings, lgaMarker, 0);
        }, {
          closeButton: false,
          autoClose: false,
          closeOnClick: false,
          maxWidth: 280
        });

        lgaMarker.on('click', () => {
          if (forceClosePopup) forceClosePopup();
          
          setTimeout(() => {
            lgaMarker.openPopup();
            activePopupRef.current = lgaMarker;
            setSelectedRegion({ type: 'lga', name: lga.name, state: state.name, listings: lgaListings });
            setCurrentRegionIndex(0);
          }, 10);
        });

        lgaLayerRef.current.addLayer(lgaMarker);
      });
    });
  };

  // Update layers based on zoom
  const updateLayersForZoom = function(zoom) {
    if (!mapInstance) return;

    setCurrentZoom(zoom);

    // Close any open popup when zoom changes
    if (forceClosePopup) forceClosePopup();

    if (continentLayerRef.current) mapInstance.removeLayer(continentLayerRef.current);
    if (countryLayerRef.current) mapInstance.removeLayer(countryLayerRef.current);
    if (stateLayerRef.current) mapInstance.removeLayer(stateLayerRef.current);
    if (lgaLayerRef.current) mapInstance.removeLayer(lgaLayerRef.current);

    if (zoom <= 3) {
      if (continentLayerRef.current) mapInstance.addLayer(continentLayerRef.current);
    } else if (zoom <= 5) {
      if (countryLayerRef.current) mapInstance.addLayer(countryLayerRef.current);
    } else if (zoom <= 8) {
      if (stateLayerRef.current) mapInstance.addLayer(stateLayerRef.current);
    } else if (zoom <= 11) {
      if (lgaLayerRef.current) mapInstance.addLayer(lgaLayerRef.current);
    }
  };

  return {
    continentLayerRef,
    countryLayerRef,
    stateLayerRef,
    lgaLayerRef,
    continentCount,
    countryCount,
    stateCounts,
    lgaCounts,
    currentZoom,
    createAdminMarkers,
    updateLayersForZoom,
    regionListings,
    showRegionPanel,
    setShowRegionPanel,
    selectedRegion,
    setSelectedRegion,
    currentRegionIndex,
    setCurrentRegionIndex
  };
};

// pages/home/components/map/MapMarkers.js

window.useMapMarkers = function(
  mapInstance,
  visibleListings,
  user,
  favorites,
  onStartChat,
  onShare,
  onListingSelect,
  onToggleFavorite,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  setCurrentPopupIndex,
  setCurrentPopupListing,
  setPopupListings,
  activePopupRef,
  forceClosePopup
) {
  const markersRef = React.useRef(new Map());
  
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!mapInstance || !window.L) return;
    
    const markers = markersRef.current;
    
    // Clear existing markers
    markers.forEach(marker => mapInstance.removeLayer(marker));
    markers.clear();
    
    // Create new markers for visible listings
    visibleListings.forEach(listing => {
      if (!listing.lat || !listing.lng) return;
      
      const marker = window.L.marker([listing.lat, listing.lng], {
        title: listing.title,
        riseOnHover: true,
        icon: window.L.divIcon({
          className: 'custom-listing-pin',
          iconSize: [30, 30],
          iconAnchor: [15, 30],
          popupAnchor: [0, -30],
          html: '<div class="custom-listing-pin"></div>'
        })
      });
      
      // Store the current nearby listings for this marker
      const nearbyListings = visibleListings.filter(l => {
        const distance = window.calculateDistance(
          listing.lat, listing.lng,
          l.lat, l.lng
        );
        return distance < 5;
      });
      
      const index = nearbyListings.findIndex(l => l.id === listing.id);
      
      // Create navigation callbacks
      const goToPrevListing = () => {
        const newIndex = index > 0 ? index - 1 : nearbyListings.length - 1;
        const newListing = nearbyListings[newIndex];
        
        const newMarker = markers.get(newListing.id);
        if (newMarker) {
          if (forceClosePopup) forceClosePopup();
          setTimeout(() => {
            newMarker.openPopup();
            activePopupRef.current = newMarker;
            setCurrentPopupIndex(newIndex);
            setCurrentPopupListing(newListing);
            setPopupListings(nearbyListings);
          }, 10);
        }
      };
      
      const goToNextListing = () => {
        const newIndex = index < nearbyListings.length - 1 ? index + 1 : 0;
        const newListing = nearbyListings[newIndex];
        
        const newMarker = markers.get(newListing.id);
        if (newMarker) {
          if (forceClosePopup) forceClosePopup();
          setTimeout(() => {
            newMarker.openPopup();
            activePopupRef.current = newMarker;
            setCurrentPopupIndex(newIndex);
            setCurrentPopupListing(newListing);
            setPopupListings(nearbyListings);
          }, 10);
        }
      };
      
      marker.bindPopup(() => {
        return window.createPopupContent(
          nearbyListings,
          index,
          user,
          favorites,
          onStartChat,
          onShare,
          onListingSelect,
          onToggleFavorite,
          onEdit,
          onDelete,
          // onClose callback
          () => {
            if (mapInstance) {
              mapInstance.closePopup();
              activePopupRef.current = null;
              setCurrentPopupListing(null);
            }
          },
          // onPrevListing callback
          goToPrevListing,
          // onNextListing callback
          goToNextListing
        );
      }, {
        closeButton: false,
        autoClose: false,
        closeOnClick: false,
        maxWidth: 280 // Allow full card width
      });
      
      marker.on('click', () => {
        if (forceClosePopup) forceClosePopup();
        
        setTimeout(() => {
          marker.openPopup();
          activePopupRef.current = marker;
          setCurrentPopupIndex(index);
          setCurrentPopupListing(listing);
          setPopupListings(nearbyListings);
        }, 10);
      });
      
      marker.on('popupopen', () => {
        activePopupRef.current = marker;
      });
      
      marker.on('popupclose', () => {
        activePopupRef.current = null;
        setCurrentPopupListing(null);
      });
      
      markers.set(listing.id, marker);
      marker.addTo(mapInstance);
    });
    
  }, [visibleListings, mapInstance, user, favorites]);
  
  return markersRef;
};

window.createPopupContent = function(

  const popupDiv = document.createElement('div');
  popupDiv.className = 'relative p-0 min-w-[200px] max-w-[230px] bg-white rounded-lg overflow-hidden shadow-lg';
  
  const currentListing = listings[initialIndex];

    if (hasMultipleImages) {

      nextImageBtn.onclick = (e) => {

        currentImageIndex = (currentImageIndex + 1) % listingImages.length;
        img.src = window.getListingImageUrl(currentListing, currentImageIndex);

      };
    }
    
    // Price tag

    priceTag.innerText = '‚Ç¶' + (currentListing.price ? currentListing.price.toLocaleString() : '0');
    imageContainer.appendChild(priceTag);
    
  } else {

    fallbackDiv.className = 'w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center text-gray-400';
    fallbackDiv.innerHTML = 'No image';
    imageContainer.appendChild(fallbackDiv);
  }
  
  // Build popup HTML structure
  popupDiv.innerHTML = `
    <div class="relative">
      <!-- Close button -->
      <button class="popup-close absolute top-1 right-1 z-30 bg-white/90 hover:bg-white rounded-full w-6 h-6 flex items-center justify-center shadow-md transition hover:scale-110" title="Close">

      </button>
      
      <!-- Region counter -->
      <div class="absolute top-1 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-30 bg-green-950 text-white text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full shadow-md">
        ${initialIndex + 1}/${listings.length}
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
  
  const mainContainer = popupDiv.querySelector('.relative');
  mainContainer.insertBefore(imageContainer, mainContainer.firstChild);
  
  // ===== OWNER CONTROLS - AT BOTTOM RIGHT OF IMAGE =====
  if (isOwner) {

    ownerControls.className = 'absolute bottom-1 right-1 flex gap-1 z-30';
    ownerControls.innerHTML = `
      <button class="edit-btn bg-blue-600 text-white p-1.5 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:bg-blue-700 transition" title="Edit listing">

      </button>
      <button class="delete-btn bg-red-500 text-white p-1.5 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:bg-red-600 transition" title="Delete listing">
        <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
          <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16" />

      </button>
    `;
    imageContainer.appendChild(ownerControls);
  }
  
  // Format location: LGA, State
  const locationParts = [];
  if (currentListing.lga) locationParts.push(currentListing.lga);
  if (currentListing.state) locationParts.push(currentListing.state);
  const locationText = locationParts.join(', ') || '';
  
  // ===== ROLE BADGE HTML (will be conditionally added) =====
  const userType = currentListing.userType || 'user';
  const roleBadgeHtml = (userType && userType !== 'user') 
    ? `<div class="mb-1">
        <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-medium ${
          userType === 'landlord' 
            ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-700 border border-green-200' 
            : 'bg-gray-700 text-white border border-gray-800'

        <button class="fav-btn p-1 rounded hover:bg-gray-100 transition ${isFav ? 'text-red-500' : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-red-500'}"

        <button class="view-details-btn bg-green-950 text-white text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-green-800 transition font-medium"

        <span>Next</span>
        <svg class="w-3 h-3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
          <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 5l7 7-7 7" />

      </button>

  `;
  
  mainContainer.appendChild(contentDiv);
  
  // ===== FUNCTION TO SHOW DELETE MODAL =====
  const showDeleteModal = () => {
    // Close the popup first
    if (onClose) onClose();
    
    // Check if DeleteConfirmationModal exists
    if (!window.DeleteConfirmationModal) {
      console.error('DeleteConfirmationModal not available');
      const toastEvent = new CustomEvent('show-toast', {
        detail: { message: 'Delete system unavailable', type: 'error' }
      });
      window.dispatchEvent(toastEvent);
      return;
    }
    
    // Create container for modal
    const deleteModalContainer = document.createElement('div');
    deleteModalContainer.id = 'map-delete-modal-container';
    document.body.appendChild(deleteModalContainer);
    
    // Render DeleteConfirmationModal
    if (window.ReactDOM) {
      window.ReactDOM.render(
        window.React.createElement(window.DeleteConfirmationModal, {
          isOpen: true,
          onClose: () => {
            window.ReactDOM.unmountComponentAtNode(deleteModalContainer);
            document.body.removeChild(deleteModalContainer);
          },
          onConfirm: async () => {
            try {
              // DIRECT DATABASE DELETE - No prop drilling!
              await db.collection('listings').doc(currentListing.id).update({
                status: 'deleted',
                deletedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
              });
              
              // Show success toast
              const toastEvent = new CustomEvent('show-toast', {
                detail: { message: 'Listing deleted successfully', type: 'success' }
              });
              window.dispatchEvent(toastEvent);
              
              // Close modal
              window.ReactDOM.unmountComponentAtNode(deleteModalContainer);
              document.body.removeChild(deleteModalContainer);
              
              // Refresh listings if needed
              if (window.__homePageState?.refreshListings) {
                window.__homePageState.refreshListings();
              }
              
            } catch (error) {
              console.error('Delete error:', error);
              const toastEvent = new CustomEvent('show-toast', {
                detail: { message: 'Failed to delete listing', type: 'error' }
              });
              window.dispatchEvent(toastEvent);
            }
          },
          listingTitle: currentListing.title,
          isDeleting: false
        }),
        deleteModalContainer
      );
    }
  };
  
  // ===== EVENT LISTENERS =====
  let reportModalContainer = null;
  
  const openReportModal = () => {
    if (onClose) onClose();
    
    if (!window.ReportModal) {
      const toastEvent = new CustomEvent('show-toast', {
        detail: { message: 'Reporting system unavailable', type: 'error' }
      });
      window.dispatchEvent(toastEvent);
      return;
    }
    
    if (!reportModalContainer) {
      reportModalContainer = document.createElement('div');
      reportModalContainer.id = 'map-report-modal-container';
      document.body.appendChild(reportModalContainer);
    }
    
    if (window.ReactDOM) {
      window.ReactDOM.render(
        window.React.createElement(window.ReportModal, {
          targetId: currentListing.id,
          targetType: 'listing',
          reportedBy: user ? user.uid : null,
          onClose: () => {
            if (reportModalContainer) {
              window.ReactDOM.unmountComponentAtNode(reportModalContainer);
              document.body.removeChild(reportModalContainer);
              reportModalContainer = null;
            }
            const toastEvent = new CustomEvent('show-toast', {
              detail: { message: 'Report submitted. Thank you!', type: 'success' }
            });
            window.dispatchEvent(toastEvent);
          }
        }),
        reportModalContainer
      );
    }
  };
  
  const unsubscribe = window.FavoritesHelpers?.subscribeToFavorites((newFavorites) => {
    const newIsFav = newFavorites[currentListing.id] || false;
    const favBtn = popupDiv.querySelector('.fav-btn');
    const currentIsFav = favBtn?.classList.contains('text-red-500') || false;
    
    if (favBtn && newIsFav !== currentIsFav) {
      const svg = favBtn.querySelector('svg');
      
      if (newIsFav) {
        favBtn.classList.add('text-red-500');
        favBtn.classList.remove('text-gray-500');
        if (svg) svg.setAttribute('fill', 'currentColor');
        favBtn.title = 'Remove from favorites';
      } else {
        favBtn.classList.remove('text-red-500');
        favBtn.classList.add('text-gray-500');
        if (svg) svg.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
        favBtn.title = 'Save to favorites';
      }
    }
  });
  
  // Close button
  popupDiv.querySelector('.popup-close')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (unsubscribe) unsubscribe();
    if (onClose) onClose();
  });
  
  // Navigation between different listings
  popupDiv.querySelector('.popup-prev-listing')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (onPrevListing) onPrevListing();
  });
  
  popupDiv.querySelector('.popup-next-listing')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (onNextListing) onNextListing();
  });
  
  // Chat button - ONLY FOR NON-OWNERS
  popupDiv.querySelector('.chat-btn')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    
    const currentUser = auth.currentUser;
    if (!currentUser) {
      window.__openAuthModal?.('login', window.location.pathname);
      return;
    }
    
    const verificationCheck = window.VerificationHelpers?.checkEmailVerification(currentUser, 'send messages');
    if (!verificationCheck?.allowed) {
      const message = verificationCheck?.message || 'Please verify your email';
      const toastEvent = new CustomEvent('show-toast', {
        detail: { message, type: 'warning' }
      });
      window.dispatchEvent(toastEvent);
      return;
    }
    
    onStartChat?.(currentListing.userId, currentListing.id, { stopPropagation: () => {} });
  });
  
  // Share button
  popupDiv.querySelector('.share-btn')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    onShare?.(currentListing, { stopPropagation: () => {} });
  });
  
  // View details button
  popupDiv.querySelector('.view-details-btn')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    onListingSelect(currentListing.id);
    if (onClose) onClose();
  });
  
  // Favorite button
  popupDiv.querySelector('.fav-btn')?.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    e.preventDefault();
    
    const btn = e.currentTarget;
    const listingId = btn.dataset.id;
    
    if (!listingId) return;
    
    if (window.FavoritesHelpers?.toggleFavoriteFromPopup) {
      await window.FavoritesHelpers.toggleFavoriteFromPopup(listingId, btn);
    }
  });
  
  // Edit button - ONLY FOR OWNERS
  popupDiv.querySelector('.edit-btn')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (window.__openAuthModal) {
      window.__openAuthModal('post', { listingId: currentListing.id });
    }
    if (onClose) onClose();
  });
  
  // Delete button - DIRECT DATABASE DELETE
  popupDiv.querySelector('.delete-btn')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    showDeleteModal();
  });
  
  popupDiv.addEventListener('click', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
  
  return popupDiv;
};

// pages/home/components/SearchBar.js
function SearchBar({
  searchTerm,
  onSearchChange,
  onSearchSubmit,
  showDropdown,
  setShowDropdown,
  searchHistory,
  suggestions,
  onSelectSuggestion,
  onClearHistory,
  searchInputRef,
  searchDropdownRef,
  touchTargetSize,
  showToast
}) {
  const handleKeyDown = function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      onSearchSubmit(searchTerm);
      setShowDropdown(false);
    }
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      setShowDropdown(false);
      onSearchChange('');
    }
  };
  
  const highlightMatch = function(text, query) {
    if (!query) return text;
    const index = text.toLowerCase().indexOf(query.toLowerCase());
    if (index === -1) return text;
    
    return React.createElement('span', null,
      text.substring(0, index),
      React.createElement('strong', { className: 'bg-yellow-100' },
        text.substring(index, index + query.length)
      ),
      text.substring(index + query.length)
    );
  };
  
  return React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex-1 relative' },
    React.createElement('div', { className: 'relative' },
      React.createElement('input', {
        ref: searchInputRef,
        type: 'text',
        placeholder: 'Search properties, locations...',
        value: searchTerm,
        onChange: function(e) {
          onSearchChange(e.target.value);
          setShowDropdown(true);
        },
        onFocus: function() { setShowDropdown(true); },
        onKeyDown: handleKeyDown,
        className: 'w-full pl-9 pr-8 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-full focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-950 focus:border-transparent text-sm'
      }),
      // Search icon
      React.createElement('svg', {
          className: 'absolute left-3 top-2.5 w-4 h-4 text-gray-400 pointer-events-none',
          fill: 'none',
          stroke: 'currentColor',
          viewBox: '0 0 24 24'
        },
        React.createElement('path', {
          strokeLinecap: 'round',
          strokeLinejoin: 'round',
          strokeWidth: '2',
          d: 'M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0z'
        })
      ),
      // Search button
      searchTerm && React.createElement('button', {
          onClick: function() {
            onSearchSubmit(searchTerm);
            setShowDropdown(false);
          },
          className: 'absolute right-2.5 top-1.5 bg-green-950 text-white rounded-full w-7 h-7 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-green-800 transition',
          'aria-label': 'Search'
        },
        React.createElement('svg', {
            className: 'w-3.5 h-3.5',
            fill: 'none',
            stroke: 'currentColor',
            viewBox: '0 0 24 24'
          },
          React.createElement('path', {
            strokeLinecap: 'round',
            strokeLinejoin: 'round',
            strokeWidth: '2.5',
            d: 'M9 5l7 7-7 7'
          })
        )
      )
    ),
    
    // Search dropdown
    showDropdown && (searchTerm.length === 0 ? searchHistory.length > 0 : suggestions.length > 0) &&
    React.createElement('div', {
        ref: searchDropdownRef,
        className: 'absolute top-full left-0 right-0 mt-1 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-xl border border-gray-100 z-50 overflow-hidden'
      },
      searchTerm.length === 0 && React.createElement(React.Fragment, null,
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 border-b border-gray-50' },
          React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-xs font-medium text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wide' }, 'Recent searches'),
          React.createElement('button', {
            onClick: onClearHistory,
            className: 'text-xs text-gray-400 hover:text-red-500 transition'
          }, 'Clear')
        ),
        searchHistory.map(function(h, i) {
          return React.createElement('button', {
              key: i,
              onClick: function() { onSelectSuggestion(h); },
              className: 'w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 hover:bg-gray-50 text-left text-sm text-gray-700 transition'
            },
            React.createElement('svg', {
                className: 'w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0',
                fill: 'none',
                stroke: 'currentColor',
                viewBox: '0 0 24 24'
              },
              React.createElement('path', {
                strokeLinecap: 'round',
                strokeLinejoin: 'round',
                strokeWidth: '2',
                d: 'M12 8v4l3 3m6-3a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z'
              })
            ),
            h
          );
        })
      ),
      searchTerm.length > 0 && suggestions.map(function(s, i) {
        return React.createElement('button', {
            key: i,
            onClick: function() { onSelectSuggestion(s); },
            className: 'w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 hover:bg-green-50 text-left text-sm text-gray-700 transition'
          },
          React.createElement('svg', {
              className: 'w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-600 flex-shrink-0',
              fill: 'none',
              stroke: 'currentColor',
              viewBox: '0 0 24 24'
            },
            React.createElement('path', {
              strokeLinecap: 'round',
              strokeLinejoin: 'round',
              strokeWidth: '2',
              d: 'M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0z'
            })
          ),
          highlightMatch(s, searchTerm)
        );
      })
    )
  );
}

// pages/home/components/map/index.js - WITH UNIFIED NOTIFICATION BELL

function MapViewEmbed({
  listings,
  onListingSelect,
  height = 'calc(100vh - 250px)',
  user,
  favorites,
  onToggleFavorite,
  onStartChat,
  onShare,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  onOpenFilterModal,
  onMapReady,
  center: initialCenter,
  zoom: initialZoom = 6
}) {
  
  
  const mapRef = React.useRef(null);
  const mapInstanceRef = React.useRef(null);
  const activePopupRef = React.useRef(null);
  
  const [allListings, setAllListings] = React.useState([]);
  const [visibleListings, setVisibleListings] = React.useState([]);
  const [loadingMore, setLoadingMore] = React.useState(false);
  const [currentPopupIndex, setCurrentPopupIndex] = React.useState(0);
  const [popupListings, setPopupListings] = React.useState([]);
  const [currentPopupListing, setCurrentPopupListing] = React.useState(null);
  const [showAccessibility, setShowAccessibility] = React.useState(false);
  
  // ===== TRACK MAP CENTER AND ZOOM FOR PARENT =====
  const [currentCenter, setCurrentCenter] = React.useState(initialCenter || [9.0820, 8.6753]);
  const [currentZoom, setCurrentZoom] = React.useState(initialZoom);
  
  // ===== FORCE CLOSE POPUP HELPER =====
  const forceClosePopup = React.useCallback(() => {
    if (mapInstanceRef.current) {
      mapInstanceRef.current.closePopup();
      mapInstanceRef.current.eachLayer((layer) => {
        if (layer._popup) {
          mapInstanceRef.current.closePopup(layer._popup);
        }
      });
      activePopupRef.current = null;
      setCurrentPopupListing(null);
    }
  }, []);
  
  // ===== HANDLE GRID VIEW SWITCH =====
  const handleGridSwitch = () => {
    const event = new CustomEvent('view-mode-changed', { 
      detail: { mode: 'grid' } 
    });
    window.dispatchEvent(event);
    localStorage.setItem('home_view_mode', 'grid');
  };
  
  // Initialize map core
  const core = window.useMapCore(mapRef, mapInstanceRef);
  
  // Initialize all listings
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const withCoords = listings.filter(l => l.lat && l.lng);
    setAllListings(withCoords);
    setVisibleListings(withCoords.slice(0, 50));
  }, [listings]);
  
  // Initialize map when ready
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!core.mapReady || !mapRef.current || mapInstanceRef.current) return;
    
    const center = initialCenter || [9.0820, 8.6753];
    const zoom = initialZoom || 6;
    
    const map = core.initMap(center, zoom);
    if (!map) return;
    
    setCurrentCenter(center);
    setCurrentZoom(zoom);
    
    if (onMapReady) {
      onMapReady(map);
    }
    
    map.on('moveend', () => {
      const newCenter = map.getCenter();
      const newZoom = map.getZoom();
      setCurrentCenter([newCenter.lat, newCenter.lng]);
      setCurrentZoom(newZoom);
      
      if (onMapReady) {
        onMapReady(map, { center: [newCenter.lat, newCenter.lng], zoom: newZoom });
      }
    });
    
    const handleMapClick = () => {
      forceClosePopup();
    };
    
    map.on('click', handleMapClick);
    map.__clickHandler = handleMapClick;
    
  }, [core.mapReady, forceClosePopup, onMapReady, initialCenter, initialZoom]);
  
  // Admin layers
  const layers = window.useMapLayers(
    mapInstanceRef.current,
    allListings,
    user,
    favorites,
    onListingSelect,
    onToggleFavorite,
    onStartChat,
    onShare,
    onEdit,
    onDelete,
    activePopupRef,
    forceClosePopup
  );
  
  // Create admin layers when map is ready
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!mapInstanceRef.current || !core.mapReady) return;
    
    layers.createAdminMarkers();
    layers.updateLayersForZoom(mapInstanceRef.current.getZoom());
    
    const onZoomEnd = () => {
      const newZoom = mapInstanceRef.current.getZoom();
      layers.updateLayersForZoom(newZoom);
    };
    
    mapInstanceRef.current.on('zoomend', onZoomEnd);
    
    return () => {
      mapInstanceRef.current?.off('zoomend', onZoomEnd);
    };
  }, [core.mapReady, layers.continentCount, layers.countryCount, layers.stateCounts, layers.lgaCounts]);
  
  // Individual markers
  window.useMapMarkers(
    mapInstanceRef.current,
    [],
    user,
    favorites,
    onStartChat,
    onShare,
    onListingSelect,
    onToggleFavorite,
    onEdit,
    onDelete,
    setCurrentPopupIndex,
    setCurrentPopupListing,
    setPopupListings,
    activePopupRef,
    forceClosePopup
  );
  
  // Geolocation
  const geolocation = window.useGeolocation(mapInstanceRef.current, (location) => {
    if (mapInstanceRef.current) {
      const bounds = mapInstanceRef.current.getBounds();
      loadListingsInBounds(bounds);
    }
  });
  
  // Toast helper
  const showToast = (message, type = 'info') => {
    const toastEvent = new CustomEvent('show-toast', {
      detail: { message, type }
    });
    window.dispatchEvent(toastEvent);
  };
  
  // Load listings in current bounds
  const loadListingsInBounds = (bounds) => {
    if (!allListings.length) return;
    
    setLoadingMore(true);
    
    const inBounds = allListings.filter(listing => {
      return bounds.contains([listing.lat, listing.lng]);
    });
    
    const expandedBounds = bounds.pad(0.5);
    
    const nearBounds = allListings.filter(listing => {
      return expandedBounds.contains([listing.lat, listing.lng]) &&
        !inBounds.includes(listing);
    });
    
    const newVisible = [...new Set([...visibleListings, ...inBounds, ...nearBounds])];
    
    setVisibleListings(newVisible);
    setLoadingMore(false);
  };
  
  // Map move handler
  const handleMapMove = () => {
    if (!mapInstanceRef.current) return;
    
    const bounds = mapInstanceRef.current.getBounds();
    const zoom = mapInstanceRef.current.getZoom();
    
    if (zoom < 7) return;
    
    if (core.lastLoadBounds) {
      const center = bounds.getCenter();
      const lastCenter = core.lastLoadBounds.getCenter();
      const distance = window.calculateDistance(
        center.lat, center.lng,
        lastCenter.lat, lastCenter.lng
      );
      
      if (distance < 10) return;
    }
    
    loadListingsInBounds(bounds);
    core.setLastLoadBounds(bounds);
  };
  
  // Set up moveend listener
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!mapInstanceRef.current) return;
    
    mapInstanceRef.current.on('moveend', handleMapMove);
    
    return () => {
      mapInstanceRef.current?.off('moveend', handleMapMove);
    };
  }, [mapInstanceRef.current, allListings, visibleListings]);
  
  if (!core.mapReady) {
    return React.createElement('div', {
        className: 'w-full flex items-center justify-center bg-gray-100 rounded-lg',
        style: { height }
      },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-center' },
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-3 border-green-950 border-t-transparent mx-auto mb-2' }),
        React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-xs text-gray-600' }, 'Loading map...')
      )
    );
  }
  
  // Render map with controls
  return React.createElement('div', {
      className: 'relative w-full',
      style: { height }
    },
    
    // Floating Top Bar
    React.createElement('div', {
      className: 'absolute top-2 left-0 right-0 flex items-center justify-between px-3 z-30'
    },
      // Left side - Accessibility + Notification
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex gap-2' },
        // Accessibility button
        React.createElement('button', {
          onClick: () => setShowAccessibility(true),
          className: 'bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-sm hover:bg-white rounded-full w-9 h-9 flex items-center justify-center shadow-md transition hover:scale-110',
          title: 'Accessibility options'
        },
          React.createElement('img', {
            src: '/vault/img/accessibility.png',
            alt: 'Accessibility',
            className: 'w-5 h-5'
          })
        ),
        
        // Notification bell - USING THE SAME COMPONENT AS GRID VIEW
        user && React.createElement('div', { className: 'relative' },
          React.createElement(window.NotificationBell, {})
        )
      ),
      
      // Right side - Grid toggle
      React.createElement('button', {
        onClick: handleGridSwitch,
        className: 'bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-sm hover:bg-white rounded-full px-4 py-2 flex items-center gap-2 shadow-md transition hover:scale-105 font-medium text-sm',
        title: 'Switch to grid view'
      },
        React.createElement('svg', {
          className: 'w-4 h-4',
          fill: 'none',
          stroke: 'currentColor',
          viewBox: '0 0 24 24'
        },
          React.createElement('path', {
            strokeLinecap: 'round',
            strokeLinejoin: 'round',
            strokeWidth: '2',
            d: 'M4 6a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2V6zM14 6a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2h-2a2 2 0 01-2-2V6zM4 16a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2v-2zM14 16a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2h-2a2 2 0 01-2-2v-2z'
          })
        ),
        React.createElement('span', null)
      )
    ),
    
    // Accessibility Modal
    showAccessibility && window.AccessibilityModal && 
      React.createElement(window.AccessibilityModal, {
        onClose: () => {

          document.body.style.overflow = 'unset';

// pages/home/components/map/useNavigation.js
// NEW FILE - Create this

window.useNavigation = function(items, initialIndex = 0) {
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = React.useState(initialIndex);
  
  // Ensure index is within bounds when items change
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (items.length === 0) {
      setCurrentIndex(0);
    } else if (currentIndex >= items.length) {
      setCurrentIndex(0);
    }
  }, [items.length, currentIndex]);
  
  const goToNext = React.useCallback(() => {
    if (items.length === 0) return;
    setCurrentIndex(prev => (prev + 1) % items.length);
  }, [items.length]);
  
  const goToPrev = React.useCallback(() => {
    if (items.length === 0) return;
    setCurrentIndex(prev => (prev - 1 + items.length) % items.length);
  }, [items.length]);
  
  const goToIndex = React.useCallback((index) => {
    if (index >= 0 && index < items.length) {
      setCurrentIndex(index);
    }
  }, [items.length]);
  
  return {
    currentIndex,
    currentItem: items[currentIndex],
    totalItems: items.length,
    goToNext,
    goToPrev,
    goToIndex,
    hasMultiple: items.length > 1,
    isFirst: currentIndex === 0,
    isLast: currentIndex === items.length - 1
  };
};

// pages/home/components/map/utils.js
// Shared utility functions

// ===== SMART COUNT FORMATTING - More compact at smaller sizes =====
window.formatClusterCount = function(count) {
  if (count >= 1000000) {
    const millions = Math.floor(count / 1000000);
    const remainder = count % 1000000;
    if (remainder > 0) {
      return `${millions}M+`;
    }
    return `${millions}M`;
  } else if (count >= 1000) {
    const thousands = Math.floor(count / 1000);
    const remainder = count % 1000;
    if (remainder > 0) {
      return `${thousands}K+`;
    }
    return `${thousands}K`;
  } else if (count >= 100) {
    const hundreds = Math.floor(count / 100);
    const remainder = count % 100;
    if (remainder > 0) {
      return `${hundreds}H+`;
    }
    return `${hundreds}H`;
  } else {
    return count.toString();
  }
};

// ===== DISTANCE CALCULATION (Haversine formula) =====
window.calculateDistance = function(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2) {
  const R = 6371;
  const dLat = (lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI / 180;
  const dLon = (lon2 - lon1) * Math.PI / 180;
  const a =
    Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
    Math.cos(lat1 * Math.PI / 180) * Math.cos(lat2 * Math.PI / 180) *
    Math.sin(dLon / 2) * Math.sin(dLon / 2);
  const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
  return R * c;
};

// ===== IMAGE URL HELPER - Updated to match card styling exactly =====
window.getListingImageUrl = function(listing, index = 0) {
  if (!listing.images || listing.images.length === 0) {
    return '/vault/img/no-image.jpg';
  }
  
  const imageId = listing.images[index];
  
  if (typeof imageId === 'string' && imageId.startsWith('http')) {
    return imageId;
  }
  
  // Use same card URL as listing cards for consistency
  if (window.CloudinaryHelpers && window.CloudinaryHelpers.getCardUrl) {
    return window.CloudinaryHelpers.getCardUrl(imageId);
  }
  
  return `https://res.cloudinary.com/djddnda47/image/upload/c_fill,w_400,h_300,f_auto,q_auto/unadomot/listings/${imageId}`;
};

// pages/home/hooks/useCarousel.js
function useCarousel(initialListings = []) {
  const [carouselListings, setCarouselListings] = React.useState(initialListings);
  const [currentCarouselIndex, setCurrentCarouselIndex] = React.useState(0);
  const [carouselLoading, setCarouselLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [touchStart, setTouchStart] = React.useState(null);
  const [touchEnd, setTouchEnd] = React.useState(null);
  
  const carouselTimerRef = React.useRef(null);

  const fetchCarouselListings = React.useCallback(async function() {
    setCarouselLoading(true);
    
    try {
      const result = await FirestoreQueries.query({
        collection: 'listings',
        where: [['status', '==', 'available']],
        orderBy: 'createdAt',
        orderDirection: 'desc',
        limit: HOME_CONSTANTS.CAROUSEL.LIMIT
      });
      
      if (result.data.length > 0) {
        setCarouselListings(result.data);
      }
    } catch(err) {
      
    } finally {
      setCarouselLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const goToNextSlide = React.useCallback(function() {
    setCurrentCarouselIndex(function(p) { 
      return p === carouselListings.length - 1 ? 0 : p + 1; 
    });
  }, [carouselListings.length]);

  const goToPrevSlide = React.useCallback(function() {
    setCurrentCarouselIndex(function(p) { 
      return p === 0 ? carouselListings.length - 1 : p - 1; 
    });
  }, [carouselListings.length]);

  const resetCarouselTimer = React.useCallback(function() {
    if (carouselTimerRef.current) {
      clearInterval(carouselTimerRef.current);
      carouselTimerRef.current = setInterval(goToNextSlide, HOME_CONSTANTS.CAROUSEL.INTERVAL);
    }
  }, [goToNextSlide]);

  const handleTouchStart = React.useCallback(function(e) {
    setTouchStart(e.targetTouches[0].clientX);
  }, []);

  const handleTouchMove = React.useCallback(function(e) {
    setTouchEnd(e.targetTouches[0].clientX);
  }, []);

  const handleTouchEnd = React.useCallback(function() {
    if (!touchStart || !touchEnd) return;
    
    const d = touchStart - touchEnd;
    
    if (d > HOME_CONSTANTS.CAROUSEL.TOUCH_THRESHOLD) { 
      goToNextSlide(); 
      resetCarouselTimer(); 
    } else if (d < -HOME_CONSTANTS.CAROUSEL.TOUCH_THRESHOLD) { 
      goToPrevSlide(); 
      resetCarouselTimer(); 
    }
    
    setTouchStart(null); 
    setTouchEnd(null);
  }, [touchStart, touchEnd, goToNextSlide, goToPrevSlide, resetCarouselTimer]);

  // Auto-play timer
  React.useEffect(function() {
    if (carouselListings.length === 0) return;
    
    if (carouselTimerRef.current) clearInterval(carouselTimerRef.current);
    carouselTimerRef.current = setInterval(goToNextSlide, HOME_CONSTANTS.CAROUSEL.INTERVAL);
    
    return function() { 
      if (carouselTimerRef.current) clearInterval(carouselTimerRef.current); 
    };
  }, [carouselListings.length, goToNextSlide]);

  return {
    carouselListings,
    setCarouselListings,
    currentCarouselIndex,
    setCurrentCarouselIndex,
    carouselLoading,
    carouselFavorites: {},
    checkingCarouselFavorites: {},
    fetchCarouselListings,
    goToNextSlide,
    goToPrevSlide,
    resetCarouselTimer,
    touchHandlers: {
      onTouchStart: handleTouchStart,
      onTouchMove: handleTouchMove,
      onTouchEnd: handleTouchEnd
    }
  };
}

window.useCarousel = useCarousel;

// pages/home/hooks/useFavorites.js
function useFavorites(user) {
  const [favorites, setFavorites] = React.useState({});
  const [checkingFavorites, setCheckingFavorites] = React.useState({});
  const { openModal } = window.useAuthModal();
  const showToast = window.useToast?.() || function() {};

  const toggleFavorite = React.useCallback(async function(listingId, e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    
    if (!user) { 
      openModal('login', window.location.pathname); 
      return; 
    }
    
    const prev = favorites[listingId] || false;
    
    setFavorites(function(f) { return { ...f, [listingId]: !prev }; });
    setCheckingFavorites(function(c) { return { ...c, [listingId]: true }; });
    
    try {
      const next = await FavoritesHelpers.toggleFavorite(user.uid, listingId);
      setFavorites(function(f) { return { ...f, [listingId]: next }; });
      showToast(next ? '‚úì Saved to favorites' : '‚úì Removed from favorites');
    } catch(err) {
      setFavorites(function(f) { return { ...f, [listingId]: prev }; });
      showToast('Failed to update favorites', 'error');
    } finally {
      setCheckingFavorites(function(c) { return { ...c, [listingId]: false }; });
    }
  }, [user, favorites, openModal, showToast]);

  const loadFavorites = React.useCallback(async function(listingsArray) {
    if (!user || !listingsArray?.length) return;
    
    const map = {};
    
    for (let i = 0; i < listingsArray.length; i += 10) {
      await Promise.all(listingsArray.slice(i, i + 10).map(async function(l) {
        try { 
          map[l.id] = await FavoritesHelpers.checkIsFavorite(user.uid, l.id); 
        } catch(e) {}
      }));
    }
    
    setFavorites(map);
  }, [user]);

  return {
    favorites,
    setFavorites,
    checkingFavorites,
    setCheckingFavorites,
    toggleFavorite,
    loadFavorites
  };
}

window.useFavorites = useFavorites;

// pages/home/hooks/useFilters.js
function useFilters(initialFilters = null) {
  const [showFilters, setShowFilters] = React.useState(false);
  const [filters, setFilters] = React.useState(
    initialFilters || HOME_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_FILTERS
  );
  const [tempFilters, setTempFilters] = React.useState({ ...filters });
  const [availableLgas, setAvailableLgas] = React.useState([]);
  
  // Update LGAs when state changes
  React.useEffect(function() {
    if (tempFilters.state) {
      const s = (window.nigeriaStates || []).find(function(x) {
        return x.name === tempFilters.state;
      });
      setAvailableLgas(s ? s.lgas.map(lga => lga.name) : []);
      
      if (tempFilters.lga && s && !s.lgas.some(lga => lga.name === tempFilters.lga)) {
        setTempFilters(function(p) { return { ...p, lga: '' }; });
      }
    } else {
      setAvailableLgas([]);
    }
  }, [tempFilters.state, tempFilters.lga]);
  
  const activeFilterCount = React.useMemo(function() {
    let c = 0;
    if (filters.minPrice) c++;
    if (filters.maxPrice) c++;
    if (filters.state) c++;
    if (filters.lga) c++;
    if (filters.bedrooms) c++;
    if (filters.propertyType) c++;
    if (filters.furnishing) c++;
    if (filters.agentOnly) c++;
    if (filters.noAgentFees) c++;
    return c;
  }, [filters]);
  
  const openFilterModal = React.useCallback(function() {
    setTempFilters({ ...filters });
    setShowFilters(true);
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  }, [filters]);
  
  const closeFilterModal = React.useCallback(function() {
    setShowFilters(false);
    document.body.style.overflow = 'unset';
  }, []);
  
  const applyFilters = React.useCallback(function() {
    setFilters({ ...tempFilters });
    closeFilterModal();
  }, [tempFilters, closeFilterModal]);
  
  const clearAllFilters = React.useCallback(function() {
    setTempFilters(HOME_CONSTANTS.DEFAULT_FILTERS);
  }, []);
  
  const updateFilter = React.useCallback(function(key, value) {
    setTempFilters(function(prev) {
      if (key === 'state') {
        return { ...prev, [key]: value, lga: '' };
      }
      if (key === 'agentOnly' && value) {
        return { ...prev, agentOnly: true, noAgentFees: false };
      }
      if (key === 'noAgentFees' && value) {
        return { ...prev, noAgentFees: true, agentOnly: false };
      }
      return { ...prev, [key]: value };
    });
  }, []);
  
  return {
    filters,
    setFilters,
    tempFilters,
    setTempFilters,
    showFilters,
    setShowFilters,
    availableLgas,
    activeFilterCount,
    openFilterModal,
    closeFilterModal,
    applyFilters,
    clearAllFilters,
    updateFilter
  };
}

window.useFilters = useFilters;

// pages/home/hooks/useListings.js
function useListings(initialState) {
  const [listings, setListings] = React.useState(initialState?.listings || []);
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [loadingMore, setLoadingMore] = React.useState(false);
  const [hasMore, setHasMore] = React.useState(true);
  const [lastVisible, setLastVisible] = React.useState(null);
  const [usingIndex, setUsingIndex] = React.useState(true);

  const loadListings = React.useCallback(async function(reset = false) {
    if (reset) { 
      setListings([]); 
      setLastVisible(null); 
      setHasMore(true); 
    }
    
    setLoading(true);
    
    try {
      // ===== CHANGED: Only fetch 'available' listings (not pending_review or rejected) =====
      const result = await FirestoreQueries.query({
        collection: 'listings',
        where: [['status', '==', 'available']], // Only show approved listings
        orderBy: 'createdAt',
        orderDirection: 'desc',
        limit: HOME_CONSTANTS.PAGINATION.PAGE_SIZE,
        startAfter: !reset ? lastVisible : null
      });
      
      setUsingIndex(result.usingIndex);
      
      if (result.data.length > 0) {
        setListings(function(prev) { 
          return reset ? result.data : [...prev, ...result.data]; 
        });
        
        setLastVisible(result.lastVisible);
        setHasMore(result.hasMore);
      } else {
        setHasMore(false);
      }
    } catch(err) {
      
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [lastVisible]);

  return {
    listings,
    setListings,
    loading,
    setLoading,
    loadingMore,
    setLoadingMore,
    hasMore,
    setHasMore,
    lastVisible,
    setLastVisible,
    usingIndex,
    loadListings
  };
}

window.useListings = useListings;

// pages/home/hooks/useOtherLocations.js
function useOtherLocations(currentListings = [], currentSearchTerm = '', currentFilters = {}) {
  const [otherLocationListings, setOtherLocationListings] = React.useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const [hasMore, setHasMore] = React.useState(true);
  const [lastVisible, setLastVisible] = React.useState(null);

  const getOtherLocations = React.useCallback(async function(reset = false) {
    // Don't fetch if no search term
    if (!currentSearchTerm || currentSearchTerm.length < 2) {
      setOtherLocationListings([]);
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      // Get current location context from search
      // If user searched for "Ikeja", exclude Ikeja listings
      const searchLower = currentSearchTerm.toLowerCase();
      
      // Find which locations are already shown
      const shownLocations = new Set();
      currentListings.forEach(l => {
        if (l.lga) shownLocations.add(l.lga.toLowerCase());
        if (l.state) shownLocations.add(l.state.toLowerCase());
      });

      // Build query to get listings from OTHER locations
      let query = db.collection('listings')
        .where('status', '==', 'available')
        .orderBy('createdAt', 'desc')
        .limit(12);

      // Apply existing filters (price, property type, etc.) but NOT location
      if (currentFilters.minPrice) {
        query = query.where('price', '>=', Number(currentFilters.minPrice));
      }
      if (currentFilters.maxPrice) {
        query = query.where('price', '<=', Number(currentFilters.maxPrice));
      }
      if (currentFilters.propertyType) {
        query = query.where('propertyType', '==', currentFilters.propertyType);
      }
      if (currentFilters.bedrooms) {
        if (currentFilters.bedrooms === '5+') {
          query = query.where('bedrooms', '>=', '5');
        } else {
          query = query.where('bedrooms', '==', currentFilters.bedrooms);
        }
      }
      if (currentFilters.furnishing) {
        query = query.where('furnishing', '==', currentFilters.furnishing);
      }

      // Apply pagination
      if (!reset && lastVisible) {
        query = query.startAfter(lastVisible);
      }

      const snapshot = await query.get();
      
      // Filter out listings from locations already shown
      const otherListings = [];
      snapshot.forEach(doc => {
        const data = { id: doc.id, ...doc.data() };
        
        // Check if this listing is from a different location
        const listingLga = data.lga?.toLowerCase() || '';
        const listingState = data.state?.toLowerCase() || '';
        
        // Skip if from any shown location
        if (shownLocations.has(listingLga) || shownLocations.has(listingState)) {
          return;
        }
        
        // Also skip if it matches the search term directly
        if (data.title?.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
            data.description?.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
            data.address?.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower)) {
          return;
        }
        
        otherListings.push(data);
      });

      setOtherLocationListings(prev => 
        reset ? otherListings : [...prev, ...otherListings]
      );
      
      setLastVisible(snapshot.docs[snapshot.docs.length - 1]);
      setHasMore(snapshot.docs.length === 12);
      
    } catch (err) {
      
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [currentSearchTerm, currentListings, currentFilters, lastVisible]);

  // Reset when search term changes
  React.useEffect(() => {
    setOtherLocationListings([]);
    setLastVisible(null);
    setHasMore(true);
    if (currentSearchTerm) {
      getOtherLocations(true);
    }
  }, [currentSearchTerm, currentFilters.minPrice, currentFilters.maxPrice, 
      currentFilters.propertyType, currentFilters.bedrooms, currentFilters.furnishing]);

  return {
    otherLocationListings,
    loadingOtherLocations: loading,
    hasMoreOtherLocations: hasMore,
    loadMoreOtherLocations: () => getOtherLocations(false)
  };
}

window.useOtherLocations = useOtherLocations;

// pages/home/hooks/useSearch.js - COMPLETE WITH ALL FILTER OPTIONS

function useSearch(initialTerm = '') {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = React.useState(initialTerm);
  const [showSearchDropdown, setShowSearchDropdown] = React.useState(false);
  const [searchHistory, setSearchHistory] = React.useState(function() {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ud_search_history') || '[]');
    } catch (e) {
      return [];
    }
  });
  
  const searchInputRef = React.useRef(null);
  const searchDropdownRef = React.useRef(null);
  
  const saveSearchHistory = React.useCallback(function(term) {
    if (!term || term.trim().length < HOME_CONSTANTS.SEARCH.MIN_CHARS) return;
    
    const cleaned = term.trim();
    setSearchHistory(function(prev) {
      const filtered = prev.filter(function(h) {
        return h.toLowerCase() !== cleaned.toLowerCase();
      });
      const updated = [cleaned, ...filtered].slice(0, HOME_CONSTANTS.SEARCH.MAX_HISTORY);
      
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('ud_search_history', JSON.stringify(updated));
      } catch (e) {}
      
      return updated;
    });
  }, []);
  
  const clearSearchHistory = React.useCallback(function() {
    setSearchHistory([]);
    try { localStorage.removeItem('ud_search_history'); } catch (e) {}
  }, []);
  
  // ===== ENHANCED: Include all filter options from actual listings =====
  const getSearchSuggestions = React.useCallback(function(listings) {
    if (!searchTerm || searchTerm.length < 1) return [];
    
    const q = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
    const seen = new Set();
    const results = {
      locations: [],
      propertyTypes: [],
      bedrooms: [],
      furnishing: [],
      titles: []
    };
    
    listings.forEach(function(l) {
      // 1. LOCATIONS (State & LGA)
      if (l.state && l.state.toLowerCase().includes(q) && !seen.has('state_' + l.state)) {
        seen.add('state_' + l.state);
        results.locations.push({
          text: l.state,
          type: 'state',
          icon: 'üó∫Ô∏è',
          category: 'State'
        });
      }
      
      if (l.lga && l.lga.toLowerCase().includes(q) && !seen.has('lga_' + l.lga)) {
        seen.add('lga_' + l.lga);
        results.locations.push({
          text: l.lga,
          type: 'lga',
          icon: 'üìç',
          category: 'LGA'
        });
      }
      
      // 2. PROPERTY TYPES
      if (l.propertyType && l.propertyType.toLowerCase().includes(q) && !seen.has('type_' + l.propertyType)) {
        seen.add('type_' + l.propertyType);
        results.propertyTypes.push({
          text: l.propertyType,
          type: 'propertyType',
          icon: 'üè†',
          category: 'Property Type'
        });
      }
      
      // 3. BEDROOMS
      if (l.bedrooms && l.bedrooms.toLowerCase().includes(q) && !seen.has('bed_' + l.bedrooms)) {
        seen.add('bed_' + l.bedrooms);
        results.bedrooms.push({
          text: l.bedrooms + (l.bedrooms === 'Self-contain' ? '' : ' Bedroom' + (l.bedrooms === '1' ? '' : 's')),
          type: 'bedrooms',
          icon: 'üõèÔ∏è',
          category: 'Bedrooms',
          rawValue: l.bedrooms
        });
      }
      
      // 4. FURNISHING
      if (l.furnishing && l.furnishing.toLowerCase().includes(q) && !seen.has('furn_' + l.furnishing)) {
        seen.add('furn_' + l.furnishing);
        results.furnishing.push({
          text: l.furnishing,
          type: 'furnishing',
          icon: 'ü™ë',
          category: 'Furnishing'
        });
      }
      
      // 5. TITLES (for specific property searches)
      if (l.title && l.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) && !seen.has('title_' + l.title)) {
        seen.add('title_' + l.title);
        results.titles.push({
          text: l.title,
          type: 'title',
          icon: 'üìã',
          category: 'Property'
        });
      }
    });
    
    // Combine all results with category headers
    const allResults = [];
    
    // Add locations first
    if (results.locations.length > 0) {
      allResults.push({ type: 'header', text: 'üìç Locations' });
      results.locations.forEach(r => allResults.push(r));
    }
    
    // Add property types
    if (results.propertyTypes.length > 0) {
      allResults.push({ type: 'header', text: 'üè† Property Types' });
      results.propertyTypes.forEach(r => allResults.push(r));
    }
    
    // Add bedrooms
    if (results.bedrooms.length > 0) {
      allResults.push({ type: 'header', text: 'üõèÔ∏è Bedrooms' });
      results.bedrooms.forEach(r => allResults.push(r));
    }
    
    // Add furnishing
    if (results.furnishing.length > 0) {
      allResults.push({ type: 'header', text: 'ü™ë Furnishing' });
      results.furnishing.forEach(r => allResults.push(r));
    }
    
    // Add titles last
    if (results.titles.length > 0) {
      allResults.push({ type: 'header', text: 'üìã Specific Properties' });
      results.titles.forEach(r => allResults.push(r));
    }
    
    return allResults.slice(0, 15); // Limit total results
  }, [searchTerm]);
  
  // Click outside handler
  React.useEffect(function() {
    function handleClickOutside(e) {
      if (searchDropdownRef.current && !searchDropdownRef.current.contains(e.target) &&
        searchInputRef.current && !searchInputRef.current.contains(e.target)) {
        setShowSearchDropdown(false);
        if (searchTerm.trim().length > 1) saveSearchHistory(searchTerm);
      }
    }
    
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return function() { document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside); };
  }, [searchTerm, saveSearchHistory]);
  
  return {
    searchTerm,
    setSearchTerm,
    showSearchDropdown,
    setShowSearchDropdown,
    searchHistory,
    searchInputRef,
    searchDropdownRef,
    saveSearchHistory,
    clearSearchHistory,
    getSearchSuggestions
  };
}

window.useSearch = useSearch;
