// pages/home/index.js - COMPLETE WITH SEARCH TOGGLE (ARROW ‚Üí X) AND FAVORITES TOAST
// Includes: delete modal, owner controls, other locations, recommendations, desktop layout

function HomePage({ user, navigate, cachedState, locationState }) {
  // ===== HOOKS =====
  const accessibility = window.useAccessibility?.() || {
    settings: { fontSize: 'normal', highContrast: false, reduceMotion: false, dyslexicFont: false, showLinks: false },
    updateSetting: function() {},
    resetSettings: function() {}
  };

  const { settings } = accessibility;
  
  // Custom hooks
  const listingsHook = window.useListings(cachedState);
  const favoritesHook = window.useFavorites(user);
  const searchHook = window.useSearch(cachedState?.searchTerm || '');
  const filtersHook = window.useFilters(cachedState?.filters);
  const carouselHook = window.useCarousel(cachedState?.carouselListings);
  
  // ===== USE TOAST HOOK =====
  const { showToast, ToastComponent } = window.useToast?.() || { 
    showToast: () => {}, 
    ToastComponent: null 
  };
  
  // ===== SEARCH TOGGLE STATE =====
  const [isSearchActive, setIsSearchActive] = React.useState(false);
  
  // ===== OTHER LOCATIONS HOOK =====
  const otherLocationsHook = window.useOtherLocations(
    listingsHook.listings,
    searchHook.searchTerm,
    filtersHook.filters
  );
  
  // ===== RECOMMENDATIONS HOOK =====
  const [recommendedListings, setRecommendedListings] = React.useState([]);
  const [recommendationsLoading, setRecommendationsLoading] = React.useState(false);
  
  // ===== DELETE MODAL STATE =====
  const [showDeleteModal, setShowDeleteModal] = React.useState(false);
  const [listingToDelete, setListingToDelete] = React.useState(null);
  const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = React.useState(false);
  
  // Toast state
  const [toast, setToast] = React.useState({ show: false, message: '', type: 'success' });
  const [showAccessibility, setShowAccessibility] = React.useState(false);
  
  const feedContainerRef = React.useRef(null);
  const toastTimeoutRef = React.useRef(null);
  const { openModal } = window.useAuthModal();

  // ===== View mode state (grid or map) =====
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = React.useState(() => {
    if (cachedState?.viewMode) {
      return cachedState.viewMode;
    }
    if (locationState?.from === 'listing-detail' && locationState?.returnTo === 'map') {
      return 'map';
    }
    return localStorage.getItem('home_view_mode') || 'grid';
  });

  // ===== Map-related state =====
  const [mapCenter, setMapCenter] = React.useState(() => {
    if (cachedState?.mapCenter) {
      return cachedState.mapCenter;
    }
    if (locationState?.mapCenter) {
      return locationState.mapCenter;
    }
    return null;
  });
  
  const [mapZoom, setMapZoom] = React.useState(() => {
    if (cachedState?.mapZoom) {
      return cachedState.mapZoom;
    }
    if (locationState?.mapZoom) {
      return locationState.mapZoom;
    }
    return 6;
  });
  
  const [mapInstance, setMapInstance] = React.useState(null);
  
  // Scroll detection
  const { scrollDirection, scrollY } = window.useScrollDirection({ container: feedContainerRef });
  const [showSearchBar, setShowSearchBar] = React.useState(true);

  // ===== DETECT DESKTOP MODE =====
  const [isDesktop, setIsDesktop] = React.useState(window.innerWidth >= 768);
  
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleResize = () => {
      setIsDesktop(window.innerWidth >= 768);
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
  }, []);

  // Layout helpers
  const layout = window.AccessibilityLayout || {
    getGridCols: function() { return 'grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4'; },
    getCardSize: function() { return { image: 'h-40', title: 'text-sm', price: 'text-sm', address: 'text-xs', badge: 'text-[10px]', button: 'text-xs' }; },
    getContainerPadding: function() { return 'px-4 py-4'; },
    getBodyTextSize: function() { return 'text-base'; },
    getHeadingSize: function() { return 'text-2xl'; },
    getSpacing: function() { return 'space-y-3'; },
    getTouchTargetSize: function() { return 'min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px]'; },
    getLineHeight: function() { return 'leading-relaxed'; }
  };

  // Desktop grid classes
  const desktopGridCols = isDesktop ? 'desktop-card-grid' : layout.getGridCols(settings.fontSize, 'listings');
  const cardSizes = layout.getCardSize(settings.fontSize);
  const bodyTextSize = layout.getBodyTextSize(settings.fontSize);
  const headingSize = layout.getHeadingSize(settings.fontSize, 'h2');
  const spacing = layout.getSpacing(settings.fontSize);

  // ===== COMPUTED VALUES =====
  const searchSuggestions = React.useMemo(function() {
    return searchHook.getSearchSuggestions(listingsHook.listings);
  }, [searchHook.searchTerm, listingsHook.listings]);

  // Apply filters to listings
  const filteredListings = React.useMemo(function() {
    return window.ScoringHelpers?.filterListings(
      listingsHook.listings, 
      searchHook.searchTerm, 
      filtersHook.filters
    ) || [];
  }, [listingsHook.listings, searchHook.searchTerm, filtersHook.filters]);

  const sortedListings = React.useMemo(function() {
    return window.ScoringHelpers?.sortListings(
      filteredListings,
      filtersHook.filters.sortBy,
      window.AffinityHelpers?.loadAffinity() || {}
    ) || [];
  }, [filteredListings, filtersHook.filters.sortBy]);

  // ===== LOAD RECOMMENDATIONS WHEN NO RESULTS =====
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const loadRecommendations = async () => {
      const hasActiveFilters = filtersHook.activeFilterCount > 0;
      const hasSearchTerm = searchHook.searchTerm && searchHook.searchTerm.length >= 2;
      const hasNoResults = sortedListings.length === 0;
      
      if ((hasActiveFilters || hasSearchTerm) && hasNoResults) {
        setRecommendationsLoading(true);
        
        try {
          const affinity = window.AffinityHelpers?.loadAffinity() || {};
          
          let query = db.collection('listings')
            .where('status', '==', 'available')
            .limit(20);
          
          const preferredStates = [];
          const preferredTypes = [];
          const preferredBedrooms = [];
          
          Object.keys(affinity).forEach(key => {
            if (key.startsWith('state_')) preferredStates.push(key.replace('state_', ''));
            if (key.startsWith('type_')) preferredTypes.push(key.replace('type_', ''));
            if (key.startsWith('bed_')) preferredBedrooms.push(key.replace('bed_', ''));
          });
          
          const snapshot = await query.get();
          let listings = snapshot.docs.map(doc => ({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() }));
          
          listings = listings.map(listing => {
            let score = 0;
            if (preferredStates.includes(listing.state)) score += 3;
            if (preferredTypes.includes(listing.propertyType)) score += 2;
            if (preferredBedrooms.includes(listing.bedrooms)) score += 1;
            return { ...listing, score };
          });
          
          listings.sort((a, b) => (b.score || 0) - (a.score || 0));
          setRecommendedListings(listings.slice(0, 12));
          
        } catch (err) {
          console.error('Error loading recommendations:', err);
        } finally {
          setRecommendationsLoading(false);
        }
      } else {
        setRecommendedListings([]);
      }
    };
    
    loadRecommendations();
  }, [
    searchHook.searchTerm, 
    sortedListings.length, 
    filtersHook.activeFilterCount,
    filtersHook.filters.minPrice,
    filtersHook.filters.maxPrice,
    filtersHook.filters.state,
    filtersHook.filters.lga,
    filtersHook.filters.bedrooms,
    filtersHook.filters.propertyType,
    filtersHook.filters.furnishing,
    filtersHook.filters.agentOnly,
    filtersHook.filters.noAgentFees
  ]);

  // ===== EFFECTS =====
  React.useEffect(function() {
    if (user && listingsHook.listings.length > 0) {
      favoritesHook.loadFavorites(listingsHook.listings);
    }
  }, [user, listingsHook.listings]);

  // Load carousel favorites
  React.useEffect(function() {
    if (user && carouselHook.carouselListings.length > 0) {
      (async function() {
        const map = {};
        await Promise.all(carouselHook.carouselListings.map(async function(l) {
          try { map[l.id] = await window.FavoritesHelpers?.checkIsFavorite(user.uid, l.id); } catch(e) {}
        }));
        if (carouselHook.setCarouselFavorites) {
          carouselHook.setCarouselFavorites(map);
        }
      })();
    }
  }, [user, carouselHook.carouselListings]);

  // Restore cached state
  React.useEffect(function() {
    if (!cachedState) return;
    if (cachedState.currentCarouselIndex !== undefined) {
      carouselHook.setCurrentCarouselIndex(cachedState.currentCarouselIndex);
    }
    if (cachedState.searchTerm) {
      searchHook.setSearchTerm(cachedState.searchTerm);
    }
  }, [cachedState, carouselHook, searchHook]);

  // ===== HANDLE VIEW TOGGLE - FIXED VERSION =====
  const handleViewToggle = React.useCallback(() => {
    // Use functional update to ensure we have the latest state
    setViewMode(prevMode => {
      const newMode = prevMode === 'grid' ? 'map' : 'grid';
      localStorage.setItem('home_view_mode', newMode);
      
      // Dispatch event for other components (like Layout)
      const event = new CustomEvent('view-mode-changed', { 
        detail: { mode: newMode } 
      });
      window.dispatchEvent(event);
      
      // Also update window.__homePageState immediately
      if (window.__homePageState) {
        window.__homePageState.viewMode = newMode;
      }
      
      return newMode;
    });
  }, []); // Empty dependency array is fine because we use functional update

  // ===== SAVE STATE FOR CACHE =====
  React.useEffect(function() {
    let mapCenterState = mapCenter;
    let mapZoomState = mapZoom;
    let scrollPosition = feedContainerRef.current?.scrollTop || 0;
    
    if (mapInstance) {
      const center = mapInstance.getCenter();
      mapCenterState = [center.lat, center.lng];
      mapZoomState = mapInstance.getZoom();
    }
    
    window.__homePageState = { 
      searchTerm: searchHook.searchTerm, 
      filters: filtersHook.filters, 
      currentCarouselIndex: carouselHook.currentCarouselIndex, 
      listings: listingsHook.listings, 
      hasMore: listingsHook.hasMore, 
      usingIndex: listingsHook.usingIndex, 
      carouselListings: carouselHook.carouselListings,
      viewMode: viewMode,
      mapCenter: mapCenterState,
      mapZoom: mapZoomState,
      scrollPosition: scrollPosition,
      setSearchTerm: searchHook.setSearchTerm,
      handleSearchSubmit: handleSearchSubmit,
      openFilterModal: filtersHook.openFilterModal,
      handleViewToggle: handleViewToggle,
      timestamp: Date.now()
    };
    
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('homepage_state', JSON.stringify({
        viewMode: viewMode,
        mapCenter: mapCenterState,
        mapZoom: mapZoomState,
        filters: filtersHook.filters,
        searchTerm: searchHook.searchTerm,
        currentCarouselIndex: carouselHook.currentCarouselIndex,
        timestamp: Date.now()
      }));
    } catch (e) {}
    
    return function() { delete window.__homePageState; };
  }, [
    searchHook.searchTerm, 
    filtersHook.filters, 
    carouselHook.currentCarouselIndex, 
    listingsHook.listings, 
    listingsHook.hasMore, 
    listingsHook.usingIndex, 
    carouselHook.carouselListings,
    viewMode,
    mapCenter,
    mapZoom,
    mapInstance,
    handleViewToggle
  ]);

  // Scroll control for search bar (mobile only)
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!isDesktop) {
      setShowSearchBar(!(scrollDirection === 'down' && scrollY > 50));
    }
  }, [scrollDirection, scrollY, isDesktop]);

  // Load initial data
  React.useEffect(function() {
    if (!cachedState?.carouselListings || cachedState.carouselListings.length === 0) {
      carouselHook.fetchCarouselListings();
    }
  }, [cachedState]);

  React.useEffect(function() {
    if (!cachedState?.listings || cachedState.listings.length === 0) {
      listingsHook.loadListings();
    }
  }, [cachedState]);

  // Restore scroll position
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (cachedState?.scrollPosition && feedContainerRef.current) {
      feedContainerRef.current.scrollTop = cachedState.scrollPosition;
    }
  }, [cachedState]);

  // ===== LISTEN FOR VIEW MODE CHANGES =====
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleViewModeChange = (event) => {
      const newMode = event.detail?.mode || event.detail;
      if (newMode === 'grid') {
        setViewMode('grid');
        localStorage.setItem('home_view_mode', 'grid');
      }
    };
    
    window.addEventListener('view-mode-changed', handleViewModeChange);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('view-mode-changed', handleViewModeChange);
  }, []);

  // ===== HANDLERS =====
  // Use the showToast from useToast hook
  const showToastMessage = showToast;

  // Listen for toast events (backward compatibility)
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleToast = (e) => {
      showToastMessage(e.detail.message, e.detail.type);
    };
    window.addEventListener('show-toast', handleToast);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('show-toast', handleToast);
  }, [showToastMessage]);

  // ===== FAVORITES HANDLER WITH TOAST =====
  const handleToggleFavorite = React.useCallback(async (listingId, e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    
    if (!user) {
      openModal('login', window.location.pathname);
      return;
    }
    
    const previousState = favoritesHook.favorites[listingId] || false;
    
    // Optimistic update
    favoritesHook.setFavorites(prev => ({ ...prev, [listingId]: !previousState }));
    
    try {
      const newState = await FavoritesHelpers.toggleFavorite(user.uid, listingId);
      
      // Update with actual server response
      favoritesHook.setFavorites(prev => ({ ...prev, [listingId]: newState }));
      
      showToastMessage(
        newState ? '‚úì Saved to favorites' : '‚úì Removed from favorites',
        'success'
      );
      
    } catch (error) {
      // Revert on error
      favoritesHook.setFavorites(prev => ({ ...prev, [listingId]: previousState }));
      showToastMessage('Failed to update favorites', 'error');
    }
  }, [user, openModal, favoritesHook, showToastMessage]);

  // ===== SEARCH HANDLERS WITH TOGGLE =====
  const handleSearchSubmit = React.useCallback(function(term) {
    if (term.trim().length > 1) {
      searchHook.saveSearchHistory(term);
      const count = sortedListings.length;
      setIsSearchActive(true); // Mark search as active - turns arrow into X
      showToastMessage(
        count > 0 ? count + ' result' + (count === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' found' : 'No listings match your search', 
        count > 0 ? 'success' : 'info'
      );
    }
  }, [searchHook, sortedListings, showToastMessage]);

  const handleClearSearch = React.useCallback(function() {
    searchHook.setSearchTerm('');
    setIsSearchActive(false); // Exit search mode - X disappears
    showToastMessage('Search cleared', 'info');
  }, [searchHook, showToastMessage]);

  const handleSelectSuggestion = React.useCallback(function(suggestion) {
    searchHook.setSearchTerm(suggestion);
    searchHook.setShowSearchDropdown(false);
    searchHook.saveSearchHistory(suggestion);
    setIsSearchActive(true); // Mark search as active
    setTimeout(() => {
      const count = sortedListings.length;
      showToastMessage(
        count > 0 ? count + ' result' + (count === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' found' : 'No listings match your search', 
        count > 0 ? 'success' : 'info'
      );
    }, 100);
  }, [searchHook, sortedListings, showToastMessage]);

  // ===== USE CENTRALIZED VERIFICATION CHECK =====
  const handleStartChat = React.useCallback(async function(landlordId, listingId, e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    
    if (!user) {
      openModal('login', window.location.pathname);
      return;
    }
    
    // ===== USE CENTRALIZED VERIFICATION CHECK =====
    const verificationCheck = window.VerificationHelpers?.checkEmailVerification(user, 'send messages');
    if (!verificationCheck?.allowed) {
      const message = verificationCheck?.message || 'Please verify your email to send messages';
      showToastMessage(message, 'warning');
      
      const event = new CustomEvent('show-verification-warning', {
        detail: { message }
      });
      window.dispatchEvent(event);
      
      return;
    }
    
    if (user.uid === landlordId) {
      showToastMessage('You cannot chat with yourself', 'error');
      return;
    }
    
    try {
      showToastMessage('Starting conversation...', 'info');
      
      if (!window.ChatHelpers) {
        throw new Error('Chat system not available');
      }
      
      const chatId = await window.ChatHelpers.getOrCreateListingChat(
        user.uid,
        landlordId,
        listingId,
        'Is this still available?'
      );
      
      if (!chatId) {
        throw new Error('No chat ID returned');
      }
      
      navigate('/chat?chat=' + chatId);
      
    } catch (err) {
      showToastMessage(err.message || 'Failed to start chat. Please try again.', 'error');
    }
  }, [user, openModal, navigate, showToastMessage]);

  const handleShare = React.useCallback(async function(listing, e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    await window.ShareHelpers?.shareNaijaStyle(listing, { showToast: showToastMessage });
  }, [showToastMessage]);

  const handleDeleteListing = React.useCallback(async function(listingId) {
    if (!user) return;
    
    try {
      await db.collection('listings').doc(listingId).update({
        status: 'deleted',
        deletedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
      });
      
      listingsHook.setListings(function(prev) { 
        return prev.filter(function(l) { return l.id !== listingId; }); 
      });
      carouselHook.setCarouselListings(function(prev) { 
        return prev.filter(function(l) { return l.id !== listingId; }); 
      });
      
      showToastMessage('Listing deleted successfully');
    } catch(err) {
      showToastMessage('Failed to delete listing', 'error');
    }
  }, [user, showToastMessage, listingsHook, carouselHook]);

  const handleEditListing = React.useCallback(function(listingId) {
    openModal('post', { listingId: listingId });
  }, [openModal]);

  // ===== DELETE MODAL HANDLERS =====
  const handleOpenDeleteModal = React.useCallback(function(listingId) {
    const listing = listingsHook.listings.find(l => l.id === listingId);
    setListingToDelete(listing);
    setShowDeleteModal(true);
  }, [listingsHook.listings]);

  const handleCloseDeleteModal = React.useCallback(function() {
    setShowDeleteModal(false);
    setListingToDelete(null);
  }, []);

  const handleConfirmDelete = React.useCallback(async function() {
    if (!listingToDelete) return;
    
    setIsDeleting(true);
    
    try {
      await db.collection('listings').doc(listingToDelete.id).update({
        status: 'deleted',
        deletedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
      });
      
      listingsHook.setListings(function(prev) { 
        return prev.filter(function(l) { return l.id !== listingToDelete.id; }); 
      });
      carouselHook.setCarouselListings(function(prev) { 
        return prev.filter(function(l) { return l.id !== listingToDelete.id; }); 
      });
      
      showToastMessage('Listing deleted successfully');
      handleCloseDeleteModal();
    } catch(err) {
      showToastMessage('Failed to delete listing', 'error');
    } finally {
      setIsDeleting(false);
    }
  }, [listingToDelete, listingsHook, carouselHook, showToastMessage, handleCloseDeleteModal]);

  // ===== Handle listing click =====
  const handleListingClick = React.useCallback(function(listing) {
    window.AffinityHelpers?.saveAffinity(listing);
    
    let mapCenterState = mapCenter;
    let mapZoomState = mapZoom;
    let scrollPosition = feedContainerRef.current?.scrollTop || 0;
    
    if (mapInstance && viewMode === 'map') {
      const center = mapInstance.getCenter();
      mapCenterState = [center.lat, center.lng];
      mapZoomState = mapInstance.getZoom();
    }
    
    navigate('/listing/' + listing.id, { 
      from: 'home',
      returnTo: viewMode,
      mapCenter: mapCenterState,
      mapZoom: mapZoomState,
      scrollPosition: scrollPosition
    });
  }, [navigate, mapInstance, viewMode, mapCenter, mapZoom]);

  // ===== Handle location selection =====
  const handleLocationSelect = (location) => {
    if (location.lat && location.lng) {
      setMapCenter([location.lat, location.lng]);
      setMapZoom(12);
      showToastMessage(`üìç Showing properties in ${location.display}`, 'success');
    }
  };

  // ===== Determine if we should show recommendations =====
  const showRecommendations = React.useMemo(() => {
    const hasActiveFilters = filtersHook.activeFilterCount > 0;
    const hasSearchTerm = searchHook.searchTerm && searchHook.searchTerm.length >= 2;
    const hasNoResults = sortedListings.length === 0;
    
    return (hasActiveFilters || hasSearchTerm) && hasNoResults && recommendedListings.length > 0;
  }, [filtersHook.activeFilterCount, searchHook.searchTerm, sortedListings.length, recommendedListings.length]);

  // ===== RENDER =====
  return React.createElement(React.Fragment, null,
    
    // Toast notification (from hook)
    ToastComponent,

    // Main scrollable container
    React.createElement('div', {
      ref: feedContainerRef,
      className: `h-full overflow-y-auto bg-green-50 ${bodyTextSize} ${
        isDesktop 
          ? 'desktop-content-wrapper' 
          : ''
      }`,
      onScroll: function(e) {
        if (listingsHook.handleScroll) listingsHook.handleScroll(e);
      }
    },

      // ===== MOBILE STICKY SEARCH/FILTER BAR (hidden on desktop) =====
      !isDesktop && viewMode === 'grid' && React.createElement('div', { 
        className: `sticky top-0 z-30 bg-green-50/95 backdrop-blur-sm border-b border-gray-200 px-4 py-4 transition-transform duration-300 ${
          showSearchBar ? 'translate-y-0' : '-translate-y-full'
        }`
      },
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center gap-2' },

          // Filter button
          React.createElement(window.FilterBar || FilterBar, {
            activeFilterCount: filtersHook.activeFilterCount,
            onOpenFilters: filtersHook.openFilterModal,
            touchTargetSize: 'min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px]'
          }),

          // Search bar with toggle props
          React.createElement(window.SearchBar || SearchBar, {
            searchTerm: searchHook.searchTerm,
            onSearchChange: searchHook.setSearchTerm,
            onSearchSubmit: handleSearchSubmit,
            onClearSearch: handleClearSearch,
            showDropdown: searchHook.showSearchDropdown,
            setShowDropdown: searchHook.setShowSearchDropdown,
            searchHistory: searchHook.searchHistory,
            suggestions: searchSuggestions,
            onSelectSuggestion: handleSelectSuggestion,
            onClearHistory: searchHook.clearSearchHistory,
            searchInputRef: searchHook.searchInputRef,
            searchDropdownRef: searchHook.searchDropdownRef,
            touchTargetSize: 'min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px]',
            showToast: showToastMessage,
            isSearchActive: isSearchActive
          }),

          // View toggle button
          React.createElement(ViewToggle, {
            viewMode: viewMode,
            onToggle: handleViewToggle
          }),

          // Notification bell
          user && window.NotificationBell ? 
            React.createElement(window.NotificationBell, { key: 'notif' }) : null,

          // Accessibility button
          React.createElement('button', {
            onClick: function() { setShowAccessibility(true); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; },
            className: 'p-2 text-gray-600 hover:text-green-950 rounded-full hover:bg-gray-100 transition min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px]',
            'aria-label': 'Accessibility options'
          },
            React.createElement('img', { 
              src: '/vault/img/accessibility.png', 
              alt: '', 
              className: 'w-5 h-5', 
              'aria-hidden': 'true' 
            })
          )
        )
      ),

      // ===== FILTER MODAL =====
      filtersHook.showFilters && React.createElement(FilterModal, {
        show: filtersHook.showFilters,
        onClose: filtersHook.closeFilterModal,
        filters: filtersHook.filters,
        tempFilters: filtersHook.tempFilters,
        availableLgas: filtersHook.availableLgas,
        onUpdateFilter: filtersHook.updateFilter,
        onApply: filtersHook.applyFilters,
        onClear: filtersHook.clearAllFilters,
        activeFilterCount: filtersHook.activeFilterCount,
        hideLocationFilters: false,
        onLocationSelect: handleLocationSelect,
        mapInstance: mapInstance,
        isDesktop: isDesktop
      }),

      // Accessibility modal
      showAccessibility && React.createElement(AccessibilityModal, {
        onClose: function() { 
          setShowAccessibility(false); 
          document.body.style.overflow = 'unset'; 
        },
        settings,
        updateSetting: accessibility.updateSetting,
        resetSettings: accessibility.resetSettings
      }),

      // Conditional content: GRID VIEW or MAP VIEW
      viewMode === 'grid' 
        ? React.createElement(React.Fragment, null,
            // ===== DESKTOP CAROUSEL =====
            React.createElement('div', { className: isDesktop ? 'desktop-carousel' : 'px-4' },
              React.createElement(Carousel, {
                listings: carouselHook.carouselListings,
                currentIndex: carouselHook.currentCarouselIndex,
                loading: carouselHook.carouselLoading,
                onSlideChange: carouselHook.setCurrentCarouselIndex,
                onPrev: carouselHook.goToPrevSlide,
                onNext: carouselHook.goToNextSlide,
                touchHandlers: carouselHook.touchHandlers,
                user,
                favorites: favoritesHook.favorites,
                checkingFavorites: favoritesHook.checkingFavorites,
                onToggleFavorite: handleToggleFavorite,
                onStartChat: handleStartChat,
                onShare: handleShare,
                onEdit: handleEditListing,
                onDelete: handleOpenDeleteModal,
                onNavigate: navigate,
                cardSizes,
                headingSize
              })
            ),

            // ===== MAIN LISTINGS GRID =====
            React.createElement('div', { className: isDesktop ? '' : 'px-4 pb-20' },
              // Search result count
              (searchHook.searchTerm || filtersHook.activeFilterCount > 0) && 
                React.createElement('div', { className: isDesktop ? 'mb-4 text-sm text-gray-600 px-6' : 'mb-3 text-sm text-gray-600' },
                  sortedListings.length === 0 
                    ? 'No listings match your criteria'
                    : sortedListings.length + ' result' + (sortedListings.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' found'
                ),

              // Main results grid
              React.createElement('div', { className: isDesktop ? desktopGridCols : 'grid ' + layout.getGridCols(settings.fontSize, 'listings') + ' gap-3 mb-8' },
                sortedListings.map(function(listing) {
                  const isOwner = user && user.uid === listing.userId;
                  const isFav = favoritesHook.favorites[listing.id] || false;
                  const isChecking = favoritesHook.checkingFavorites[listing.id] || false;

                  return React.createElement('div', {
                    key: listing.id,
                    'data-listing-card': '1',
                    className: isDesktop ? 'desktop-card' : 'bg-white rounded-lg shadow-md overflow-hidden cursor-pointer hover:shadow-lg transition page-transition',
                    onClick: function() { handleListingClick(listing); }
                  },
                    // Image section
                    React.createElement('div', { className: isDesktop ? 'desktop-card-image' : 'relative ' + cardSizes.image + ' bg-gray-200' },
                      React.createElement('img', {
                        src: listing.images?.[0]
                          ? window.CloudinaryHelpers.getCardUrl(listing.images[0])
                          : '/vault/img/no-image.jpg',
                        alt: listing.title,
                        className: 'w-full h-full object-cover',
                        loading: 'lazy',
                        onError: function(e) { e.target.src = '/vault/img/no-image.jpg'; }
                      }),
                      
                      // ===== OWNER CONTROLS =====
                      isOwner && React.createElement('div', { className: 'absolute top-1 right-1 flex gap-0.5 z-10' },
                        React.createElement('button', { 
                          onClick: function(e) { 
                            e.stopPropagation(); 
                            handleEditListing(listing.id); 
                          }, 
                          className: 'bg-blue-600 text-white p-1 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:bg-blue-700 transition', 
                          title: 'Edit' 
                        },
                          React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-3 h-3', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' }, 
                            React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M11 5H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v11a2 2 0 002 2h11a2 2 0 002-2v-5m-1.414-9.414a2 2 0 112.828 2.828L11.828 15H9v-2.828l8.586-8.586z' })
                          )
                        ),
                        React.createElement('button', { 
                          onClick: function(e) { 
                            e.stopPropagation(); 
                            handleOpenDeleteModal(listing.id);
                          }, 
                          className: 'bg-red-500 text-white p-1 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:bg-red-600 transition', 
                          title: 'Delete' 
                        },
                          React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-3 h-3', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' }, 
                            React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16' })
                          )
                        )
                      ),
                      
                      // Price tag
                      React.createElement('div', { className: 'absolute bottom-2 left-2 bg-green-950 text-white px-2 py-1 rounded-md font-bold text-sm shadow-lg z-20' },
                        '‚Ç¶' + (listing.price ? listing.price.toLocaleString() : '0')
                      )
                    ),
                    
                    // Listing details
                    React.createElement('div', { className: isDesktop ? 'desktop-card-content' : 'p-2 ' + spacing },
                      React.createElement('h3', { className: isDesktop ? 'desktop-card-title' : 'font-bold text-gray-900 mb-0.5 line-clamp-1 ' + cardSizes.title }, listing.title),
                      React.createElement('p', { className: isDesktop ? 'desktop-card-location' : 'text-gray-600 mb-1 line-clamp-1 ' + cardSizes.address }, 
                        isDesktop 
                          ? [listing.lga, listing.state].filter(Boolean).join(', ')
                          : listing.address
                      ),
                      
                      // ===== UPDATED: Role badge using listingRole =====
                      React.createElement('div', { className: isDesktop ? 'flex items-center gap-2 mb-2' : 'flex flex-wrap gap-0.5 mb-1' },
                        listing.listingRole && listing.listingRole !== 'user' &&
                          React.createElement(RoleBadge, { 
                            user: { userType: listing.listingRole }, 
                            size: 'xs' 
                          })
                      ),
                      
                      // Action buttons
                      React.createElement('div', { className: isDesktop ? 'flex items-center justify-between mt-2' : 'flex items-center justify-between pt-1 border-t border-gray-100' },
                        React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex gap-1' },
                          user && !isOwner && React.createElement('button', {
                            onClick: function(e) { handleStartChat(listing.userId, listing.id, e); },
                            className: 'text-gray-500 hover:text-green-950 p-1 rounded hover:bg-gray-100 transition text-xs',
                            title: 'Send message'
                          },
                            React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-4 h-4', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' },
                              React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M8 12h.01M12 12h.01M16 12h.01M21 12c0 4.418-4.03 8-9 8a9.863 9.863 0 01-4.255-.949L3 20l1.395-3.72C3.512 15.042 3 13.574 3 12c0-4.418 4.03-8 9-8s9 3.582 9 8z' })
                            )
                          ),
                          React.createElement('button', {
                            onClick: function(e) { handleShare(listing, e); },
                            className: 'text-gray-500 hover:text-blue-600 p-1 rounded hover:bg-gray-100 transition text-xs',
                            title: 'Share'
                          },
                            React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-4 h-4', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' },
                              React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M8.684 13.342C8.886 12.938 9 12.482 9 12c0-.482-.114-.938-.316-1.342m0 2.684a3 3 0 110-2.684m0 2.684l6.632 3.316m-6.632-6l6.632-3.316m0 0a3 3 0 105.367-2.684 3 3 0 00-5.367 2.684zm0 9.316a3 3 0 105.368 2.684 3 3 0 00-5.368-2.684z' })
                            )
                          )
                        ),
                        React.createElement('button', {
                          onClick: function(e) { handleToggleFavorite(listing.id, e); },
                          disabled: isChecking,
                          className: `p-1 rounded hover:bg-gray-100 transition text-xs ${
                            isFav ? 'text-red-500 hover:text-red-700' : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-red-500'
                          } ${isChecking ? ' opacity-50 cursor-wait' : ''}`,
                          title: isFav ? 'Remove from favorites' : 'Save to favorites'
                        },
                          isFav
                            ? React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-4 h-4', fill: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 20 20' },
                                React.createElement('path', { fillRule: 'evenodd', d: 'M3.172 5.172a4 4 0 015.656 0L10 6.343l1.172-1.171a4 4 0 115.656 5.656L10 17.657l-6.828-6.829a4 4 0 010-5.656z', clipRule: 'evenodd' })
                              )
                            : React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-4 h-4', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' },
                                React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M4.318 6.318a4.5 4.5 0 000 6.364L12 20.364l7.682-7.682a4.5 4.5 0 00-6.364-6.364L12 7.636l-1.318-1.318a4.5 4.5 0 00-6.364 0z' })
                              )
                        )
                      )
                    )
                  );
                })
              ),

              // ===== OTHER LOCATIONS SECTION =====
              (searchHook.searchTerm && searchHook.searchTerm.length >= 2 && 
               (sortedListings.length === 0 || otherLocationsHook.otherLocationListings.length > 0)) &&

// pages/home/utils/affinity.js
const AffinityHelpers = {
  // Load affinity from localStorage
  loadAffinity: function() {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ud_affinity') || '{}');
    } catch(e) { 
      return {}; 
    }
  },

  // Save affinity when user interacts with a listing
  saveAffinity: function(listing) {
    if (!listing) return;
    
    const affinity = this.loadAffinity();
    
    if (listing.propertyType) {
      affinity['type_' + listing.propertyType] = (affinity['type_' + listing.propertyType] || 0) + 1;
    }
    if (listing.state) {
      affinity['state_' + listing.state] = (affinity['state_' + listing.state] || 0) + 1;
    }
    if (listing.bedrooms) {
      affinity['bed_' + listing.bedrooms] = (affinity['bed_' + listing.bedrooms] || 0) + 1;
    }
    
    try { 
      localStorage.setItem('ud_affinity', JSON.stringify(affinity)); 
    } catch(e) {}
  },

  // Get user preferences based on affinity
  getUserPreferences: function() {
    return this.loadAffinity();
  },

  // Clear all affinity data
  clearAffinity: function() {
    try {
      localStorage.removeItem('ud_affinity');
    } catch(e) {}
  }
};

window.AffinityHelpers = AffinityHelpers;

// pages/home/utils/scoring.js
function scoreListing(listing, affinity) {
  let score = 0;
  
  // Time decay (newer = higher score)
  const ageHours = listing.createdAt
    ? (Date.now() / 1000 - listing.createdAt.seconds) / 3600
    : 720;
  score += Math.max(0, 40 - ageHours * 0.05);

  // Affinity boost
  if (listing.propertyType) {
    score += Math.min(20, (affinity['type_' + listing.propertyType] || 0) * 4);
  }
  if (listing.state) {
    score += Math.min(10, (affinity['state_' + listing.state] || 0) * 2);
  }
  if (listing.bedrooms) {
    score += Math.min(10, (affinity['bed_' + listing.bedrooms] || 0) * 2);
  }

  // Random noise for variety
  score += Math.random() * 20;

  return score;
}

function sortListings(listings, sortBy, affinity) {
  const sorted = [...listings];
  
  if (sortBy === 'smart') {
    sorted.sort(function(a, b) { 
      return scoreListing(b, affinity) - scoreListing(a, affinity); 
    });
  } else if (sortBy === 'price_low') {
    sorted.sort(function(a, b) { 
      return (a.price || 0) - (b.price || 0); 
    });
  } else if (sortBy === 'price_high') {
    sorted.sort(function(a, b) { 
      return (b.price || 0) - (a.price || 0); 
    });
  }
  
  return sorted;
}

function filterListings(listings, searchTerm, filters) {
  let filtered = [...listings];

  // Apply search term
  if (searchTerm) {
    const q = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
    filtered = filtered.filter(function(l) {
      return [l.title, l.description, l.address, l.state, l.lga].some(function(f) {
        return f && f.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      });
    });
  }

  // Apply filters
  if (filters.minPrice) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(function(l) { 
      return l.price >= Number(filters.minPrice); 
    });
  }
  if (filters.maxPrice) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(function(l) { 
      return l.price <= Number(filters.maxPrice); 
    });
  }
  if (filters.state) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(function(l) { 
      return l.state === filters.state; 
    });
  }
  if (filters.lga) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(function(l) { 
      return l.lga === filters.lga; 
    });
  }
  if (filters.bedrooms) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(function(l) {
      return filters.bedrooms === '5+' 
        ? Number(l.bedrooms) >= 5 
        : l.bedrooms === filters.bedrooms;
    });
  }
  if (filters.propertyType) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(function(l) { 
      return l.propertyType === filters.propertyType; 
    });
  }
  if (filters.furnishing) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(function(l) { 
      return l.furnishing === filters.furnishing; 
    });
  }
  if (filters.agentOnly) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(function(l) { 
      return l.agentToggle === true; 
    });
  }
  if (filters.noAgentFees) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(function(l) { 
      return l.agentToggle === false; 
    });
  }

  return filtered;
}

window.ScoringHelpers = {
  scoreListing,
  sortListings,
  filterListings
};

// pages/listing-detail/components/Badges.js
function Badges({ listing }) {
  const badges = [];
  
  // Property type badge
  if (listing.propertyType) {
    badges.push(
      React.createElement('span', {
        key: 'type',
        className: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm'
      }, listing.propertyType)
    );
  }
  
  // ===== UPDATED: Role badge using listingRole =====
  // Shows Landlord or Agent badge based on listing.listingRole
  const listingRole = listing.listingRole;
  
  if (listingRole === 'landlord') {
    badges.push(
      React.createElement('span', {
        key: 'landlord',
        className: 'inline-flex items-center bg-green-100 text-green-700 border border-green-200 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm'
      }, 'Landlord')
    );
  } else if (listingRole === 'agent') {
    badges.push(
      React.createElement('span', {
        key: 'agent',
        className: 'inline-flex items-center bg-gray-700 text-white border border-gray-800 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm'
      }, 'Agent')
    );
  }
  
  if (badges.length === 0) return null;
  
  return React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-6' },
    ...badges
  );
}

window.Badges = Badges;

// pages/listing-detail/components/CommentForm.js - With Email Verification Check
function CommentForm({
  user,
  value,
  onChange,
  onSubmit,
  isSubmitting,
  placeholder = 'Add a comment...'
}) {
  const [showVerificationWarning, setShowVerificationWarning] = React.useState(false);
  
  // ===== USE VERIFICATION HOOK =====
  const { checkVerification, resendVerification } = window.useVerification?.() || {
    checkVerification: () => true,
    resendVerification: async () => false
  };
  
  // ===== UPDATED: Use centralized verification check =====
  const handleSubmit = function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!user) {
      // Let the original flow handle login redirect
      onSubmit(e);
      return;
    }
    
    // Use centralized verification check
    if (!checkVerification(user, 'post comments')) {
      setShowVerificationWarning(true);
      setTimeout(() => setShowVerificationWarning(false), 5000);
      return;
    }
    
    onSubmit(e);
  };
  
  // ===== UPDATED: Use centralized resend function =====
  const handleResendVerification = async function() {
    const success = await resendVerification(user);
    if (success) {
      ToastHelpers?.success('Verification email sent! Please check your inbox.');
    } else {
      ToastHelpers?.error('Failed to send verification email. Please try again.');
    }
  };
  
  return React.createElement(React.Fragment, null,
    // ===== VERIFICATION WARNING =====
    showVerificationWarning && React.createElement('div', {
        className: 'mb-4 p-3 bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-800 rounded-lg border border-yellow-200 flex items-center justify-between'
      },
      React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-sm' }, '‚ö†Ô∏è Please verify your email to post comments.'),
      React.createElement('button', {
        onClick: handleResendVerification,
        className: 'ml-2 text-xs bg-yellow-100 px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-yellow-200 transition whitespace-nowrap'
      }, 'Resend')
    ),
    
    React.createElement('form', { onSubmit: handleSubmit, className: 'mb-6' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'relative' },
        React.createElement('textarea', {
          value: value,
          onChange: onChange,
          placeholder: user ? placeholder : 'Sign in to comment',
          disabled: !user || isSubmitting,
          rows: 2,
          className: `w-full p-3 pr-12 border border-gray-300 rounded-2xl resize-none max-h-32 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-950 focus:border-transparent ${
            !user || isSubmitting ? 'bg-gray-100' : 'bg-white'
          }`
        }),
        
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'absolute right-12 bottom-3 text-xs text-gray-400' },
          value.length + '/500'
        ),
        
        React.createElement('button', {
            type: 'submit',
            disabled: !user || !value.trim() || isSubmitting,
            className: `absolute right-3 bottom-3 p-1 rounded-full transition flex-shrink-0 ${
            !user || !value.trim() || isSubmitting
              ? 'text-gray-300 cursor-not-allowed'
              : 'text-green-950 hover:text-green-700'
          }`
          },
          isSubmitting ?
          React.createElement('div', {
            className: 'w-5 h-5 border-2 border-green-950 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin'
          }) :
          React.createElement('svg', {
              className: 'w-6 h-6',
              fill: 'none',
              stroke: 'currentColor',
              viewBox: '0 0 24 24'
            },
            React.createElement('path', {
              strokeLinecap: 'round',
              strokeLinejoin: 'round',
              strokeWidth: '2',
              d: 'M12 19l9 2-9-18-9 18 9-2zm0 0v-8'
            })
          )
        )
      )
    )
  );
}

window.CommentForm = CommentForm;

// pages/listing-detail/components/CommentItem.js - SIMPLIFIED (uses data directly)
function CommentItem({
  comment,
  currentUserId,
  onProfileClick,
  formatTime
}) {
  if (!comment) return null;
  
  // Data comes directly from the comment document
  const isTemp = comment.isTemp || false;
  const userName = comment.userName || comment.user?.name || 'User';
  const userPhoto = comment.userPhotoURL || comment.user?.photoURL || null;
  const userId = comment.userId;
  const userType = comment.userType || comment.user?.userType || 'user';
  const userUsername = comment.userUsername || null; // Username if available
  const text = comment.text || '';
  const createdAt = comment.createdAt;
  
  // Profile click handler - passes userId to parent which resolves to username URL
  const handleProfileClick = () => {
    onProfileClick(userId, userUsername);
  };
  
  return React.createElement('div', {
      className: `bg-gray-50 p-4 rounded-lg ${isTemp ? 'opacity-70' : ''}`
    },
    React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-start gap-3 mb-2' },
      
      // User avatar
      React.createElement('div', {
          className: 'w-10 h-10 rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-green-200 flex-shrink-0 cursor-pointer',
          onClick: handleProfileClick
        },
        userPhoto ?
        React.createElement('img', {
          src: userPhoto,
          alt: userName,
          className: 'w-full h-full object-cover',
          onError: function(e) {
            e.target.onerror = null;
            e.target.style.display = 'none';
            e.target.parentNode.innerHTML = '<div class="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center text-green-800 font-bold">' +
              (userName ? userName.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : 'U') + '</div>';
          }
        }) :
        React.createElement('div', {
            className: 'w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center text-green-800 font-bold'
          },
          userName ? userName.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : 'U'
        )
      ),
      
      // Comment content
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex-1' },
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap' },
          React.createElement('p', {
            className: 'font-medium text-sm cursor-pointer hover:underline',
            onClick: handleProfileClick
          }, userName),
          
          // Show username as @ if available
          userUsername && React.createElement('span', {
            className: 'text-xs text-gray-400'
          }, `@${userUsername}`),
          
          React.createElement(RoleBadge, { user: { userType }, size: 'sm' }),
          
          React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-xs text-gray-400' },
            isTemp ? 'Sending...' : (formatTime ? formatTime(createdAt) : '')
          )
        )
      ),
      
      // Only reaction button
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center gap-1' },
        React.createElement(ReactionButton, {
          contentType: 'comments',
          contentId: comment.id,
          reactionType: 'helpful',
          size: 'xs',
          showCount: true
        })
      )
    ),
    
    // Comment text
    React.createElement('p', {
      className: 'text-gray-700 text-sm mb-3 pl-13',
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML: { __html: text }
    })
  );
}

window.CommentItem = CommentItem;

// pages/listing-detail/components/CommentsSection.js - SIMPLIFIED (no replies)
function CommentsSection({
  comments,
  commentsLoading,
  commentsExpanded,
  onToggleExpand,
  currentUserId,
  formatTime,
  onProfileClick
}) {
  const displayComments = commentsExpanded ? comments : comments.slice(0, 5);
  const hasMoreComments = comments.length > 5 && !commentsExpanded;
  
  if (commentsLoading && comments.length === 0) {
    return React.createElement('div', { className: 'space-y-4 py-4' },
      Array.from({ length: 3 }).map(function(_, i) {
        return React.createElement('div', {
            key: i,
            className: 'animate-pulse flex gap-3'
          },
          React.createElement('div', {
            className: 'w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-gray-200 flex-shrink-0'
          }),
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex-1 space-y-2' },
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'h-3 bg-gray-200 rounded w-1/3' }),
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'h-3 bg-gray-200 rounded w-full' }),
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'h-3 bg-gray-200 rounded w-2/3' })
          )
        );
      })
    );
  }
  
  if (comments.length === 0) {
    return React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-center text-gray-500 py-8' },
      'No comments yet. Be the first to share your thoughts!'
    );
  }
  
  return React.createElement('div', { className: 'space-y-4' },
    displayComments.map(function(comment) {
      return React.createElement(CommentItem, {
        key: comment.id,
        comment: comment,
        currentUserId: currentUserId,
        onProfileClick: onProfileClick,
        formatTime: formatTime
      });
    }),
    
    // "Show more comments" button
    hasMoreComments &&
    React.createElement('button', {
        onClick: onToggleExpand,
        className: 'w-full text-center text-green-950 text-sm py-3 hover:underline flex items-center justify-center gap-1'
      },
      React.createElement('span', null, 'Show ' + (comments.length - 5) + ' more comments'),
      React.createElement('svg', {
          className: 'w-4 h-4',
          fill: 'none',
          stroke: 'currentColor',
          viewBox: '0 0 24 24'
        },
        React.createElement('path', {
          strokeLinecap: 'round',
          strokeLinejoin: 'round',
          strokeWidth: '2',
          d: 'M19 9l-7 7-7-7'
        })
      )
    )
  );
}

window.CommentsSection = CommentsSection;

                  d: 'M8 12h.01M12 12h.01M16 12h.01M21 12c0 4.418-4.03 8-9 8a9.863 9.863 0 01-4.255-.949L3 20l1.395-3.72C3.512 15.042 3 13.574 3 12c0-4.418 4.03-8 9-8s9 3.582 9 8z' 
                })
              )
            ),
            
            // Share button
            React.createElement('button', {
              onClick: onShareClick,
              className: 'p-1.5 bg-white/90 text-gray-700 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:bg-white transition',
              title: 'Share listing'
            },
              React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-5 h-5', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' },
                React.createElement('path', { 
                  strokeLinecap: 'round', 
                  strokeLinejoin: 'round', 
                  strokeWidth: '2', 
                  d: 'M8.684 13.342C8.886 12.938 9 12.482 9 12c0-.482-.114-.938-.316-1.342m0 2.684a3 3 0 110-2.684m0 2.684l6.632 3.316m-6.632-6l6.632-3.316m0 0a3 3 0 105.367-2.684 3 3 0 00-5.367 2.684zm0 9.316a3 3 0 105.368 2.684 3 3 0 00-5.368-2.684z' 
                })
              )
            )
          ),

          // Image indicators (bottom center)
          hasImages && images.length > 1 &&
          React.createElement('div', { 
            className: 'absolute bottom-3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 flex gap-1.5 pointer-events-auto z-20' 
          },
            images.map(function(_, i) {
              return React.createElement('button', {
                key: i,
                onClick: function() { onImageSelect(i); },
                className: `w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full transition ${
                  i === selectedImage ? 'bg-white scale-125' : 'bg-white/50'
                }`
              });
            })
          )
        )
      )
    )
  );
}

function Lightbox({ 
  show, 
  image, 
  onClose, 
  onPrev, 
  onNext, 
  hasMultiple,
  title 
}) {
  if (!show || !image) return null;

  return React.createElement('div', {
    className: 'fixed inset-0 bg-black/95 z-50 flex items-center justify-center',
    onClick: onClose
  },
    React.createElement('button', {
      onClick: onClose,
      className: 'absolute top-4 right-4 text-white bg-black/50 hover:bg-black/70 rounded-full p-3 z-10'
    }, '‚úï'),
    
    React.createElement('img', {
      src: window.CloudinaryHelpers.getUrl(image, { 
        width: LISTING_DETAIL_CONSTANTS.IMAGE.LIGHTBOX_WIDTH, 
        quality: LISTING_DETAIL_CONSTANTS.IMAGE.LIGHTBOX_QUALITY 
      }),
      alt: title,
      className: 'max-w-full max-h-full object-contain p-4'
    }),
    
    hasMultiple && React.createElement(React.Fragment, null,
      React.createElement('button', {
        onClick: function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); onPrev(); },
        className: 'absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 bg-white/20 hover:bg-white/40 text-white rounded-full p-4'
      }, '‚Üê'),
      React.createElement('button', {
        onClick: function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); onNext(); },
        className: 'absolute right-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 bg-white/20 hover:bg-white/40 text-white rounded-full p-4'
      }, '‚Üí')
    )
  );
}

// pages/listing-detail/hooks/useComments.js - WITH PHOTO IN COMMENT
function useComments(listingId, user) {
  const [comments, setComments] = React.useState([]);
  const [commentsLoading, setCommentsLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [commentsExpanded, setCommentsExpanded] = React.useState(false);
  
  const [newComment, setNewComment] = React.useState('');
  const [submittingComment, setSubmittingComment] = React.useState(false);
  
  // Track comment IDs and pending temps
  const commentIds = React.useRef(new Set());
  const pendingTempMessages = React.useRef(new Map()); // clientTimestamp -> {tempId, text}
  
  const unsubscribeRef = React.useRef(null);
  
  // ===== FETCH CURRENT USER DATA FOR USERNAME =====
  const [currentUserData, setCurrentUserData] = React.useState(null);
  
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;
    
    const fetchUserData = async () => {
      try {
        const userDoc = await db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).get();
        if (userDoc.exists) {
          setCurrentUserData(userDoc.data());
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error fetching user data:', err);
      }
    };
    
    fetchUserData();
  }, [user]);
  
  // ===== REAL-TIME LISTENER FOR COMMENTS =====
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!listingId) {
      setCommentsLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    
    // Clean up previous listener
    if (unsubscribeRef.current) {
      unsubscribeRef.current();
      unsubscribeRef.current = null;
    }
    
    setCommentsLoading(true);
    
    const listingRef = db.collection('listings').doc(listingId);
    
    // Listen to comments only
    unsubscribeRef.current = listingRef.collection('comments')
      .orderBy('createdAt', 'desc')
      .limit(50)
      .onSnapshot(
        async (snapshot) => {
            try {
              const commentsToAdd = [];
              const commentsToUpdate = [];
              const commentsToRemove = [];
              
              // Process each change
              for (const change of snapshot.docChanges()) {
                const commentId = change.doc.id;
                const data = change.doc.data();
                const clientTimestamp = data.clientTimestamp;
                
                if (change.type === 'added') {
                  // Check if this matches a pending temp message
                  if (clientTimestamp && pendingTempMessages.current.has(clientTimestamp)) {
                    const tempData = pendingTempMessages.current.get(clientTimestamp);
                    
                    // Replace temp comment with real one
                    setComments(prev => prev.map(c =>
                      c.id === tempData.tempId ?
                      {
                        id: commentId,
                        ...data,
                        // Use the data directly from the comment document
                        user: {
                          name: data.userName || 'User',
                          photoURL: data.userPhotoURL || null,
                          userType: data.userType || 'user',
                          username: data.userUsername || null
                        },
                        reactionCounts: data.reactionCounts || {},
                        isTemp: false
                      } :
                      c
                    ));
                    
                    // Clean up tracking
                    commentIds.current.delete(tempData.tempId);
                    pendingTempMessages.current.delete(clientTimestamp);
                    commentIds.current.add(commentId);
                    
                    continue;
                  }
                  
                  // Skip if we already have this ID
                  if (commentIds.current.has(commentId)) {
                    continue;
                  }
                  
                  commentIds.current.add(commentId);
                  
                  // Use data directly from comment document
                  commentsToAdd.push({
                    id: commentId,
                    ...data,
                    user: {
                      name: data.userName || 'User',
                      photoURL: data.userPhotoURL || null,
                      userType: data.userType || 'user',
                      username: data.userUsername || null
                    },
                    reactionCounts: data.reactionCounts || {},
                    isTemp: false
                  });
                  
                } else if (change.type === 'modified') {
                  // Update existing comment
                  commentsToUpdate.push({
                    id: commentId,
                    ...data,
                    user: {
                      name: data.userName || 'User',
                      photoURL: data.userPhotoURL || null,
                      userType: data.userType || 'user',
                      username: data.userUsername || null
                    },
                    reactionCounts: data.reactionCounts || {},
                    isTemp: false
                  });
                  
                } else if (change.type === 'removed') {
                  commentIds.current.delete(commentId);
                  commentsToRemove.push(commentId);
                }
              }
              
              // Apply all changes in batch
              if (commentsToAdd.length > 0) {
                setComments(prev => {
                  const combined = [...prev, ...commentsToAdd].sort((a, b) => {
                    const aTime = a.createdAt?.seconds || 0;
                    const bTime = b.createdAt?.seconds || 0;
                    return bTime - aTime;
                  });
                  return combined;
                });
              }
              
              if (commentsToUpdate.length > 0) {
                setComments(prev => {
                  const updated = [...prev];
                  commentsToUpdate.forEach(updatedComment => {
                    const index = updated.findIndex(c => c.id === updatedComment.id);
                    if (index !== -1) {
                      updated[index] = updatedComment;
                    }
                  });
                  return updated;
                });
              }
              
              if (commentsToRemove.length > 0) {
                setComments(prev => prev.filter(c => !commentsToRemove.includes(c.id)));
              }
              
              setCommentsLoading(false);
            } catch (error) {
              
              setCommentsLoading(false);
            }
          },
          (error) => {
                     setCommentsLoading(false);
          }
      );
    
    return () => {
      if (unsubscribeRef.current) {
        unsubscribeRef.current();
        unsubscribeRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, [listingId]);
  
  // ===== SUBMIT COMMENT =====
  const handleSubmitComment = React.useCallback(async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!user) {
      window.__openAuthModal?.('login', window.location.pathname);
      return;
    }
    
    const trimmed = newComment.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return;
    
    setSubmittingComment(true);
    
    const tempId = 'temp_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9);
    const timestamp = Date.now();
    const clientTimestamp = timestamp / 1000; // Use seconds for Firestore
    
    // Get user data including username
    const userDisplayName = user.displayName || user.name || 'User';
    const userPhoto = user.photoURL || null;
    const userType = currentUserData?.userType || 'user';
    const userUsername = currentUserData?.username || null;
    
    // Create optimistic comment with user data embedded
    const optimisticComment = {
      id: tempId,
      userId: user.uid,
      userName: userDisplayName,
      userPhotoURL: userPhoto,
      userType: userType,
      userUsername: userUsername,  // ===== ADD USERNAME =====
      text: CommentHelpers.sanitizeComment(trimmed),
      createdAt: { seconds: clientTimestamp },
      user: {
        name: userDisplayName,
        photoURL: userPhoto,
        userType: userType,
        username: userUsername
      },
      reactionCounts: {},
      isTemp: true
    };
    
    // Store mapping for later replacement
    pendingTempMessages.current.set(clientTimestamp, {
      tempId: tempId,
      user: optimisticComment.user,
      text: trimmed
    });
    
    commentIds.current.add(tempId);
    
    // Add optimistic comment to state
    setComments(prev => [optimisticComment, ...prev]);
    
    // Clear input immediately
    setNewComment('');
    
    try {
      // Add to Firestore with user data embedded
      const docRef = await db.collection('listings').doc(listingId)
        .collection('comments')
        .add({
          userId: user.uid,
          userName: userDisplayName,
          userPhotoURL: userPhoto,
          userType: userType,
          userUsername: userUsername,  // ===== ADD USERNAME =====
          text: CommentHelpers.sanitizeComment(trimmed),
          createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
          clientTimestamp: clientTimestamp,
          reactionCounts: {}
        });
      
      
      
    } catch (error) {
      
      
      // Remove optimistic comment on error
      setComments(prev => prev.filter(c => c.id !== tempId));
      
      // Remove from tracking on error
      commentIds.current.delete(tempId);
      pendingTempMessages.current.delete(clientTimestamp);
      
      // Show error to user
      alert('Failed to post comment. Please check your connection and try again.');
      
    } finally {
      setSubmittingComment(false);
    }
  }, [user, listingId, newComment, currentUserData]);
  
  // Clean up old temp mappings periodically
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      const now = Date.now() / 1000;
      const expired = [];
      
      pendingTempMessages.current.forEach((value, timestamp) => {
        if (now - timestamp > 30) { // 30 seconds timeout
          expired.push(timestamp);
        }
      });
      
      expired.forEach(timestamp => {
        const tempData = pendingTempMessages.current.get(timestamp);
        if (tempData) {
          // Remove stuck temp comments
          setComments(prev => prev.filter(c => c.id !== tempData.tempId));
          commentIds.current.delete(tempData.tempId);
          pendingTempMessages.current.delete(timestamp);
        }
      });
    }, 10000); // Check every 10 seconds
    
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);
  
  // ===== TOGGLE COMMENTS EXPANDED =====
  const toggleCommentsExpanded = React.useCallback(() => {
    setCommentsExpanded(prev => !prev);
  }, []);
  
  return {
    comments,
    commentsLoading,
    commentsExpanded,
    newComment,
    setNewComment,
    submittingComment,
    handleSubmitComment,
    toggleCommentsExpanded
  };
}

window.useComments = useComments;

// pages/listing-detail/hooks/useImageGallery.js
function useImageGallery(images = []) {
  const [selectedImage, setSelectedImage] = React.useState(0);
  const [showLightbox, setShowLightbox] = React.useState(false);
  const [touchStart, setTouchStart] = React.useState(null);
  const [touchEnd, setTouchEnd] = React.useState(null);
  
  const carouselTimerRef = React.useRef(null);

  const startCarouselTimer = React.useCallback(() => {
    if (carouselTimerRef.current) {
      clearInterval(carouselTimerRef.current);
    }
    
    if (images.length > 1) {
      carouselTimerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        setSelectedImage(prev => (prev + 1) % images.length);
      }, LISTING_DETAIL_CONSTANTS.CAROUSEL.INTERVAL);
    }
  }, [images.length]);

  const resetCarouselTimer = React.useCallback(() => {
    startCarouselTimer();
  }, [startCarouselTimer]);

  const nextImage = React.useCallback(() => {
    if (!images.length) return;
    setSelectedImage(prev => (prev + 1) % images.length);
    resetCarouselTimer();
  }, [images.length, resetCarouselTimer]);

  const prevImage = React.useCallback(() => {
    if (!images.length) return;
    setSelectedImage(prev => (prev - 1 + images.length) % images.length);
    resetCarouselTimer();
  }, [images.length, resetCarouselTimer]);

  const handleTouchStart = React.useCallback((e) => {
    setTouchStart(e.targetTouches[0].clientX);
  }, []);

  const handleTouchMove = React.useCallback((e) => {
    setTouchEnd(e.targetTouches[0].clientX);
  }, []);

  const handleTouchEnd = React.useCallback(() => {
    if (!touchStart || !touchEnd) return;
    
    const dist = touchStart - touchEnd;
    const threshold = LISTING_DETAIL_CONSTANTS.CAROUSEL.TOUCH_THRESHOLD;
    
    if (dist > threshold) nextImage();
    if (dist < -threshold) prevImage();
    
    setTouchStart(null);
    setTouchEnd(null);
  }, [touchStart, touchEnd, nextImage, prevImage]);

  const openLightbox = React.useCallback((index) => {
    setSelectedImage(index);
    setShowLightbox(true);
  }, []);

  const closeLightbox = React.useCallback(() => {
    setShowLightbox(false);
  }, []);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    startCarouselTimer();
    return () => {
      if (carouselTimerRef.current) {
        clearInterval(carouselTimerRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, [startCarouselTimer]);

  return {
    selectedImage,
    setSelectedImage,
    showLightbox,
    nextImage,
    prevImage,
    openLightbox,
    closeLightbox,
    touchHandlers: {
      onTouchStart: handleTouchStart,
      onTouchMove: handleTouchMove,
      onTouchEnd: handleTouchEnd
    }
  };
}

window.useImageGallery = useImageGallery;

// pages/listing-detail/hooks/useListing.js
function useListing(listingId, user) {
  const [listing, setListing] = React.useState(null);
  const [listingUser, setListingUser] = React.useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [isFavorite, setIsFavorite] = React.useState(false);
  const [checkingFavorite, setCheckingFavorite] = React.useState(false);
  const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = React.useState(false);
  
  const userCache = React.useRef({});
  
  const fetchUserData = React.useCallback(async (userId) => {
    if (!userId) return { name: LISTING_DETAIL_CONSTANTS.PLACEHOLDERS.UNKNOWN_USER };
    if (userCache.current[userId]) return userCache.current[userId];
    
    try {
      const userDoc = await db.collection('users').doc(userId).get();
      if (userDoc.exists) {
        const userData = userDoc.data();
        userCache.current[userId] = userData;
        return userData;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      
    }
    return { name: LISTING_DETAIL_CONSTANTS.PLACEHOLDERS.UNKNOWN_USER };
  }, []);
  
  const fetchListing = React.useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    
    try {
      const doc = await db.collection('listings').doc(listingId).get();
      if (!doc.exists) {
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      
      const data = { id: doc.id, ...doc.data() };
      setListing(data);
      
      if (data.userId) {
        const userData = await fetchUserData(data.userId);
        setListingUser({
          id: data.userId,
          ...userData,
          rating: LISTING_DETAIL_CONSTANTS.LANDLORD.DEFAULT_RATING,
          reviewCount: LISTING_DETAIL_CONSTANTS.LANDLORD.DEFAULT_REVIEW_COUNT
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [listingId, fetchUserData]);
  
  const checkFavoriteStatus = React.useCallback(async () => {
    if (!user || !listing) return;
    
    setCheckingFavorite(true);
    try {
      const status = await FavoritesHelpers.checkIsFavorite(user.uid, listing.id);
      setIsFavorite(status);
    } catch (error) {
      
    } finally {
      setCheckingFavorite(false);
    }
  }, [user, listing]);
  
  const toggleFavorite = React.useCallback(async () => {
    if (!user) {
      window.__openAuthModal?.('login', window.location.pathname);
      return;
    }
    
    setCheckingFavorite(true);
    try {
      const newStatus = await FavoritesHelpers.toggleFavorite(user.uid, listing.id);
      setIsFavorite(newStatus);
    } catch (error) {
      
    } finally {
      setCheckingFavorite(false);
    }
  }, [user, listing]);
  
  const deleteListing = React.useCallback(async () => {
    if (!user || user.uid !== listing?.userId) return;
    if (!confirm(LISTING_DETAIL_CONSTANTS.MESSAGES.DELETE_CONFIRM)) return;
    
    setIsDeleting(true);
    try {
      await db.collection('listings').doc(listing.id).update({
        status: 'deleted',
        deletedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
      });
      return true;
    } catch (err) {
      
      alert(LISTING_DETAIL_CONSTANTS.MESSAGES.DELETE_ERROR);
      return false;
    } finally {
      setIsDeleting(false);
    }
  }, [user, listing]);
  
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (listingId) fetchListing();
  }, [listingId, fetchListing]);
  
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (user && listing) checkFavoriteStatus();
  }, [user, listing, checkFavoriteStatus]);
  
  return {
    listing,
    listingUser,
    loading,
    isFavorite,
    checkingFavorite,
    isDeleting,
    toggleFavorite,
    deleteListing,
    refetch: fetchListing
  };
}

window.useListing = useListing;

// pages/listing-detail/index.js - With Pending/Rejected status handling
function ListingDetailPage({ user, navigate, locationState }) {
  const listingId = window.location.pathname.split('/')[2];
  const { openModal } = window.useAuthModal();

  // ===== DELETE MODAL STATE =====
  const [showDeleteModal, setShowDeleteModal] = React.useState(false);
  const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = React.useState(false);
  
  // ===== TAB STATE (like profile page) =====
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = React.useState('similar'); // 'similar' or 'comments'
  const [showAllComments, setShowAllComments] = React.useState(false);

  // Hooks
  const listingHook = window.useListing(listingId, user);
  const galleryHook = window.useImageGallery(listingHook.listing?.images);
  const commentsHook = window.useComments(listingId, user);
  
  // ===== Similar listings hook =====
  const [allListings, setAllListings] = React.useState([]);
  const similarHook = window.useSimilarListings?.(listingHook.listing, allListings) || {
    similarListings: [],
    loading: false,
    hasMore: false,
    loadMore: () => {}
  };

  // Destructure
  const {
    listing,
    listingUser,
    loading,
    isFavorite,
    checkingFavorite,
    deleteListing
  } = listingHook;

  const {
    selectedImage,
    showLightbox,
    nextImage,
    prevImage,
    openLightbox,
    closeLightbox,
    touchHandlers
  } = galleryHook;

  const {
    comments,
    commentsLoading,
    newComment,
    submittingComment,
    handleSubmitComment,
    setNewComment,
    loadMoreComments,
    hasMoreComments
  } = commentsHook;

  // ===== LOAD ALL LISTINGS FOR SIMILAR ALGORITHM =====
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const fetchAllListings = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await FirestoreQueries.query({
          collection: 'listings',
          where: [['status', '==', 'available']],
          limit: 100
        });
        setAllListings(result.data);
      } catch (err) {
        
      }
    };
    fetchAllListings();
  }, []);

  // ===== HANDLE BACK NAVIGATION =====
  const handleBack = React.useCallback(() => {
    if (locationState?.from === 'home') {
      navigate('/', {
        ...locationState,
        returning: true
      });
    } else {
      if (window.history.length > 1) {
        window.history.back();
      } else {
        navigate('/');
      }
    }
  }, [navigate, locationState]);

  // Handlers
  const handleEditClick = React.useCallback(() => {
    openModal('post', { listingId: listing.id });
  }, [listing, openModal]);

  // ===== DELETE CLICK OPENS MODAL =====
  const handleDeleteClick = React.useCallback(() => {
    setShowDeleteModal(true);
  }, []);

  // ===== CONFIRM DELETE HANDLER =====
  const handleConfirmDelete = React.useCallback(async () => {
    setIsDeleting(true);
    const success = await deleteListing();
    setIsDeleting(false);
    setShowDeleteModal(false);
    
    if (success) {
      if (locationState?.from === 'home') {
        navigate('/', locationState);
      } else {
        navigate('/listings');
      }
    }
  }, [deleteListing, navigate, locationState]);

  // ===== MESSAGE CLICK HANDLER =====
  const handleMessageClick = React.useCallback(async () => {
    if (!user) {
      openModal('login', window.location.pathname);
      return;
    }
    
    const verificationCheck = window.checkEmailVerification(user, 'send messages');
    if (!verificationCheck.allowed) {
      const toastEvent = new CustomEvent('show-toast', {
        detail: { message: verificationCheck.message, type: 'warning' }
      });
      window.dispatchEvent(toastEvent);
      
      const reminderEvent = new CustomEvent('show-verification-warning', {
        detail: { message: verificationCheck.message }
      });
      window.dispatchEvent(reminderEvent);
      
      return;
    }
    
    if (!listingUser) return;
    
    try {
      const chatId = await ChatHelpers.getOrCreateListingChat(
        user.uid, listingUser.id, listing.id, 'Is this still available?'
      );
      navigate('/chat?chat=' + chatId);
    } catch (err) {
      alert('Failed to start chat. Please try again.');
    }
  }, [user, listingUser, listing, navigate, openModal]);
  
  const handleShareClick = React.useCallback(async () => {
    await ShareHelpers.shareListing(listing, { style: 'naija' });
  }, [listing]);

  // ===== PROFILE CLICK HANDLER (UPDATED to use username) =====
  const handleProfileClick = React.useCallback((userId) => {
    // Check if we have the username for this user
    if (listingUser && listingUser.username) {
      navigate('/' + listingUser.username, {
        from: 'listing-detail',
        returnTo: locationState,
        listingId: listing.id
      });
    } else {
      // Fallback to user ID if username not available
      navigate('/profile/' + userId, {
        from: 'listing-detail',
        returnTo: locationState,
        listingId: listing.id
      });
    }
  }, [navigate, locationState, listing, listingUser]);

  const handleReportClick = React.useCallback(() => {
    setShowReport(true);
  }, []);

  // ===== SIMILAR LISTING CLICK HANDLER =====
  const handleSimilarListingClick = React.useCallback((similarListing) => {

    navigate('/listing/' + similarListing.id, {

      previousListingId: listing?.id

  const getStatusBadge = () => {

    }

  // Loading state
  if (loading) {

  if (!listing || listing.status === 'deleted') {

                  ),

              // "See More Comments" button
              hasMoreToShow && React.createElement('button', {

                className: 'w-full text-center text-green-950 text-sm py-2 hover:underline mb-6'
              }, `See all ${comments.length} comments ‚Üí`),

              // Load more comments button (for pagination)
              hasMoreComments && showAllComments && React.createElement('button', {
                onClick: loadMoreComments,
                disabled: commentsLoading,
                className: 'w-full text-center text-green-950 text-sm py-2 hover:underline mb-6'
              }, commentsLoading ? 'Loading...' : 'Load more comments'),

              // Recommendations after comments
              React.createElement('div', { className: 'mt-8 pt-6 border-t border-gray-200' },

                ),
                React.createElement(SimilarListings, {

                })
              )
            )

    // Report Modal
    showReport && window.ReportModal && React.createElement(window.ReportModal, {
      targetId: listing.id,
      targetType: 'listing',
      reportedBy: user ? user.uid : null,
      onClose: () => setShowReport(false)
    })
  );
}
