--- ./pages/listing-detail/utils/commentHelpers.js ---
// pages/listing-detail/utils/commentHelpers.js
const CommentHelpers = {
  sanitizeComment: function(text) {
    if (!text) return '';
    
    let sanitized = text.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '');
    sanitized = sanitized.replace(/javascript:/gi, '');
    sanitized = sanitized.replace(/data:/gi, '');
    sanitized = sanitized.replace(/vbscript:/gi, '');
    sanitized = sanitized.replace(/onerror=/gi, '');
    sanitized = sanitized.replace(/onload=/gi, '');
    sanitized = sanitized.replace(/onclick=/gi, '');
    sanitized = sanitized.replace(/eval\(/gi, '');
    sanitized = sanitized.slice(0, 500); // Use constant or default
    
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.textContent = sanitized;
    return div.innerHTML;
  },
  
  formatTime: function(timestamp) {
    if (!timestamp) return '';
    
    const date = timestamp.seconds ? new Date(timestamp.seconds * 1000) : new Date(timestamp);
    const now = new Date();
    const diff = now - date;
    
    if (diff < 60000) return 'Just now';
    if (diff < 3600000) return Math.floor(diff / 60000) + 'm ago';
    if (diff < 86400000) return Math.floor(diff / 3600000) + 'h ago';
    if (diff < 604800000) return Math.floor(diff / 86400000) + 'd ago';
    
    return date.toLocaleDateString();
  },
  
  createOptimisticComment: function(user, text) {
    return {
      id: 'temp_' + Date.now(),
      userId: user.uid,
      text: this.sanitizeComment(text),
      createdAt: { seconds: Date.now() / 1000 },
      user: {
        id: user.uid,
        name: user.displayName || 'User',
        photoURL: user.photoURL
      },
      isTemp: true
    };
  },
  
  getUserInitials: function(name) {
    return (name || 'U').charAt(0).toUpperCase();
  }
};

window.CommentHelpers = CommentHelpers;

// pages/profile/components/ListingsTab.js
function ListingsTab({ listings, user, navigate, onDelete, onEdit, loading, usingIndex }) {
  const activeListings = listings.filter(l => l.status !== 'deleted');
  const deletedListings = listings.filter(l => l.status === 'deleted');
  
  if (loading) {
    return React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-center py-16' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-gray-200 animate-pulse' })
    );
  }
  
  if (listings.length === 0) {
    return React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-center py-16 bg-white rounded-lg shadow-md' },
      React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-500 mb-4' }, "You haven't posted any listings yet."),
      React.createElement('button', {
        onClick: () => {
          if (window.__openAuthModal) window.__openAuthModal('post', {});
        },
        className: 'inline-block bg-green-950 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-green-800 transition cursor-pointer'
      }, 'Post Your First Listing')
    );
  }
  
  return React.createElement('div', null,
    
    activeListings.length > 0 &&
    React.createElement('div', { className: 'mb-8' },
      React.createElement('h3', { className: 'text-lg font-semibold mb-4 text-gray-700' }, 'Active Listings'),
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4' },
        activeListings.map(listing =>
          React.createElement(ListingCard, {
            key: listing.id,
            listing: listing,
            currentUserId: user.uid,
            onClick: () => navigate('/listing/' + listing.id),
            onDelete: onDelete,
            onEdit: onEdit
          })
        )
      )
    ),
    
    deletedListings.length > 0 &&
    React.createElement('div', null,
      React.createElement('h3', { className: 'text-lg font-semibold mb-4 text-gray-500' }, 'Removed Listings'),
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4' },
        deletedListings.map(listing =>
          React.createElement(ListingCard, {
            key: listing.id,
            listing: listing,
            currentUserId: user.uid,
            onDelete: onDelete
          })
        )
      )
    )
  );
}

window.ListingsTab = ListingsTab;

// pages/profile/components/ProfileHeader.js
function ProfileHeader({ profile, user, onEditClick, onAdminClick, onVerifyLandlord, onVerifyAgent }) {
  if (!profile) return null;
  
  // Check if current user is the super admin (your email)
  const isSuperAdmin = user?.email === 'oboobotenefiok@gmail.com';
  
  // Get verification data from profile
  const verified = profile.verified || {};
  const landlordVerified = verified.landlord;
  const agentVerified = verified.agent;
  
  const landlordStatus = landlordVerified?.status || null;
  const agentStatus = agentVerified?.status || null;
  
  const landlordRejectionReason = landlordVerified?.rejectionReason || '';
  const agentRejectionReason = agentVerified?.rejectionReason || '';
  
  // Get display name and username
  const displayName = profile.displayName || profile.name || 'User';
  const username = profile.username || 'username-not-set';
  
  // Helper to get button text and style based on status
  const getButtonConfig = (status, type) => {
    if (status === 'approved') {
      return {
        text: '‚úì Verified',
        className: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700 border border-green-200 cursor-default hover:bg-green-100',
        disabled: true
      };
    }
    if (status === 'pending') {
      return {
        text: '‚è≥ Pending',
        className: 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700 border border-yellow-200 cursor-default hover:bg-yellow-100',
        disabled: true
      };
    }
    if (status === 'rejected') {
      return {
        text: '‚ö†Ô∏è Reapply',
        className: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 border border-red-200 hover:bg-red-200 cursor-pointer',
        disabled: false
      };
    }
    return {
      text: 'Apply',
      className: 'bg-green-950 text-white hover:bg-green-800 cursor-pointer',
      disabled: false
    };
  };
  
  const landlordConfig = getButtonConfig(landlordStatus, 'landlord');
  const agentConfig = getButtonConfig(agentStatus, 'agent');
  
  return React.createElement('div', { className: 'bg-white rounded-lg shadow-md p-6 mb-8' },
    React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex justify-between items-start' },
      
      // Left side - User info
      React.createElement('div', null,
        // Display Name (editable, shows prominently)
        React.createElement('h1', { className: 'text-2xl font-bold' },
          displayName
        ),
        
        // Username (permanent, never changes, used for URL)
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center gap-2 mt-1' },
          React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-sm text-gray-500' },
            '@' + username
          )
        ),
        
        // ===== VERIFICATION STATUS SECTION (Unified) =====
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-gray-100' },
          React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 mb-2' }, 'Verification Status'),
          
          // Landlord verification row
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center justify-between py-2' },
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center gap-2' },
              React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-base' }, ''),
              React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-sm text-gray-700' }, 'Landlord')
            ),
            React.createElement('button', {
              onClick: landlordStatus !== 'approved' && landlordStatus !== 'pending' ? onVerifyLandlord : undefined,
              disabled: landlordConfig.disabled,
              title: landlordStatus === 'rejected' ? `Rejected: ${landlordRejectionReason}` : '',
              className: `text-xs px-3 py-1 rounded-lg transition ${landlordConfig.className} ${landlordConfig.disabled ? 'cursor-default' : ''}`
            }, landlordConfig.text)

// pages/profile/hooks/useListings.js
function useProfileListings(user) {
  const [listings, setListings] = React.useState([]);
  const [listingsLoading, setListingsLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const [usingIndex, setUsingIndex] = React.useState(true);
  
  const fetchListings = React.useCallback(async () => {
    if (!user) return;
    
    setListingsLoading(true);
    try {
      const result = await FirestoreQueries.query({
        collection: 'listings',
        where: [
          ['userId', '==', user.uid],
          ['status', '==', 'available']
        ],
        orderBy: 'createdAt',
        orderDirection: 'desc',
        limit: 50 // Get all active listings
      });
      
      setUsingIndex(result.usingIndex);
      setListings(result.data);
    } catch (err) {
      
    } finally {
      setListingsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [user]);
  
  React.useEffect(() => {
    fetchListings();
  }, [fetchListings]);
  
  const deleteListing = async (listingId) => {
    try {
      await db.collection('listings').doc(listingId).update({
        status: 'deleted',
        deletedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
      });
      setListings(prev => prev.filter(l => l.id !== listingId));
      return true;
    } catch (err) {
      
      return false;
    }
  };
  
  return {
    listings,
    listingsLoading,
    usingIndex,
    deleteListing,
    refetch: fetchListings
  };
}

window.useProfileListings = useProfileListings;

// pages/profile/hooks/useProfile.js
function useProfile(user) {
  const [profile, setProfile] = React.useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState('');
  
  const fetchProfile = React.useCallback(async () => {
    if (!user) return;
    
    try {
      const userDoc = await db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).get();
      
      if (userDoc.exists) {
        let userData = { id: userDoc.id, ...userDoc.data() };
        
        // ===== BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY: Convert old 'name' to 'displayName' =====
        if (userData.name && !userData.displayName) {
          userData.displayName = userData.name;
          // Optionally update the document to new format (can be done in migration)
        }
        
        // Ensure displayName exists
        if (!userData.displayName) {
          userData.displayName = user.displayName || 'User';
        }
        
        setProfile(userData);
      } else {
        // Create new user document with proper fields
        const newUserData = {
          displayName: user.displayName || 'User',
          username: null, // Will be set during signup, but here for safety
          email: user.email,
          createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
          lastActive: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
          replyRate: 0,
          phone: '',
          bio: '',
          isOnline: true,
          displayNameLastChanged: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
        };
        await db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).set(newUserData);
        setProfile({ id: user.uid, ...newUserData });
      }
      setError('');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching profile:', error);
      setError('Failed to load profile. Please refresh.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [user]);
  
  React.useEffect(() => {
    fetchProfile();
  }, [fetchProfile]);
  
  // Helper to check if display name can be changed (6 months cooldown)
  const canChangeDisplayName = React.useCallback(() => {
    if (!profile || !profile.displayNameLastChanged) return true;
    
    const sixMonths = 180 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // ~6 months
    const lastChanged = profile.displayNameLastChanged.seconds ?
      new Date(profile.displayNameLastChanged.seconds * 1000) :
      new Date(profile.displayNameLastChanged);
    
    const nextAvailable = new Date(lastChanged.getTime() + sixMonths);
    return nextAvailable <= new Date();
  }, [profile]);
  
  // Get next available date for display name change
  const getNextDisplayNameChangeDate = React.useCallback(() => {
    if (!profile || !profile.displayNameLastChanged) return null;
    
    const sixMonths = 180 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    const lastChanged = profile.displayNameLastChanged.seconds ?
      new Date(profile.displayNameLastChanged.seconds * 1000) :
      new Date(profile.displayNameLastChanged);
    
    return new Date(lastChanged.getTime() + sixMonths);
  }, [profile]);
  
  return {
    profile,
    setProfile,
    loading,
    error,
    setError,
    refetch: fetchProfile,
    canChangeDisplayName,
    getNextDisplayNameChangeDate
  };
}

window.useProfile = useProfile;

// pages/profile/hooks/useSettings.js
function useSettings() {
  const [openDropdowns, setOpenDropdowns] = React.useState({
    support: false,
    legal: false,
    version: false
  });
  const [activePopup, setActivePopup] = React.useState(null);
  const [versionInfo, setVersionInfo] = React.useState({
    current: PROFILE_CONSTANTS.VERSION.CURRENT,
    latest: null,
    updateAvailable: false,
    checking: false
  });
  
  const toggleDropdown = React.useCallback((dropdownName) => {
    setOpenDropdowns(prev => {
      if (prev[dropdownName]) {
        return { support: false, legal: false, version: false };
      }
      return {
        support: dropdownName === 'support',
        legal: dropdownName === 'legal',
        version: dropdownName === 'version'
      };
    });
  }, []);
  
  const closeAllDropdowns = React.useCallback(() => {
    setOpenDropdowns({ support: false, legal: false, version: false });
  }, []);
  
  const openPopup = React.useCallback((popupName) => {
    setActivePopup(popupName);
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  }, []);
  
  const closePopup = React.useCallback(() => {
    setActivePopup(null);
    document.body.style.overflow = 'unset';
  }, []);
  
  const checkForUpdates = React.useCallback(async () => {
    setVersionInfo(prev => ({ ...prev, checking: true }));
    
    try {
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
      const latestVersion = PROFILE_CONSTANTS.VERSION.LATEST;
      const current = versionInfo.current;
      
      setVersionInfo(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        latest: latestVersion,
        updateAvailable: latestVersion !== current,
        checking: false
      }));
    } catch (err) {
      setVersionInfo(prev => ({ ...prev, checking: false }));
    }
  }, [versionInfo.current]);
  
  return {
    openDropdowns,
    activePopup,
    versionInfo,
    toggleDropdown,
    closeAllDropdowns,
    openPopup,
    closePopup,
    checkForUpdates
  };
}

window.useSettings = useSettings;

// pages/profile/hooks/useUsername.js
function useUsername(initialUsername = '', profileUsername = '', isEdited = false) {
  const [username, setUsername] = React.useState(initialUsername);
  const [usernameAvailable, setUsernameAvailable] = React.useState(null);
  const [checkingUsername, setCheckingUsername] = React.useState(false);
  const [usernameError, setUsernameError] = React.useState('');
  const usernameTimer = React.useRef(null);
  
  const validateUsername = React.useCallback(async (value, userId) => {
    if (!value) {
      setUsernameAvailable(null);
      setUsernameError('');
      return;
    }
    
    if (value === profileUsername) {
      setUsernameAvailable(true);
      setUsernameError('');
      return;
    }
    
    const formatError = window.IDGenerator?.validateUsername(value);
    if (formatError) {
      setUsernameAvailable(null);
      setUsernameError(formatError);
      return;
    }
    
    setCheckingUsername(true);
    
    try {
      const exists = await window.IDGenerator?.checkUsernameExists(value, userId);
      setUsernameAvailable(!exists);
      setUsernameError(!exists ? '' : 'Username already taken');
    } catch (err) {
      setUsernameAvailable(null);
      setUsernameError('Error checking username');
    } finally {
      setCheckingUsername(false);
    }
  }, [profileUsername]);
  
  const debouncedValidate = React.useCallback((value, userId) => {
    if (usernameTimer.current) clearTimeout(usernameTimer.current);
    
    usernameTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
      validateUsername(value, userId);
    }, PROFILE_CONSTANTS.VALIDATION.USERNAME_CHECK_DELAY);
  }, [validateUsername]);
  
  const handleUsernameChange = React.useCallback((value, userId) => {
    if (isEdited) return;
    
    const sanitized = value.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_]/g, '');
    setUsername(sanitized);
    debouncedValidate(sanitized, userId);
  }, [isEdited, debouncedValidate]);
  
  React.useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (usernameTimer.current) clearTimeout(usernameTimer.current);
    };
  }, []);
  
  return {
    username,
    setUsername,
    usernameAvailable,
    checkingUsername,
    usernameError,
    handleUsernameChange
  };
}

window.useUsername = useUsername;

// pages/profile/index.js
function ProfilePage({ user, navigate, initialTab = 'listings', cachedState, locationState }) {
  // ===== HOOKS =====
  const profileHook = window.useProfile(user);
  const listingsHook = window.useProfileListings(user);
  const settingsHook = window.useSettings();
  const { openModal } = window.useAuthModal();
  
  // ===== RESTORE STATE FROM CACHE =====
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = React.useState(() => {
    if (cachedState?.activeTab) {
      return cachedState.activeTab;
    }
    if (initialTab) {
      return initialTab;
    }
    return 'listings';
  });
  
  const [showEditModal, setShowEditModal] = React.useState(() => {
    return cachedState?.showEditModal || false;
  });
  
  const [editing, setEditing] = React.useState(false);
  
  // ===== FORM STATE (displayName, not username) =====
  const [form, setForm] = React.useState({ 
    displayName: profileHook.profile?.displayName || cachedState?.form?.displayName || '',
    username: profileHook.profile?.username || cachedState?.form?.username || '',
    phone: profileHook.profile?.phone || cachedState?.form?.phone || '',
    bio: profileHook.profile?.bio || cachedState?.form?.bio || '' 
  });
  const [formErrors, setFormErrors] = React.useState({});
  const [originalDisplayName, setOriginalDisplayName] = React.useState('');
  
  const settingsRef = React.useRef(null);
  const pageRef = React.useRef(null);
  
  // ===== EFFECTS =====
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) {
      navigate('/');
      openModal('login', '/profile');
    }
  }, [user, navigate, openModal]);
  
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (profileHook.profile) {
      setForm({
        displayName: profileHook.profile.displayName || '',
        username: profileHook.profile.username || '',
        phone: profileHook.profile.phone || '',
        bio: profileHook.profile.bio || ''
      });
      setOriginalDisplayName(profileHook.profile.displayName || '');
    }
  }, [profileHook.profile]);
  
  // Click outside for dropdowns
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
      if (settingsRef.current && !settingsRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
        settingsHook.closeAllDropdowns();
      }
    };
    
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, [settingsHook]);
  
  // Restore scroll position after mount
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (cachedState?.scrollPosition && pageRef.current) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        pageRef.current.scrollTop = cachedState.scrollPosition;
      }, 50);
    }
  }, [cachedState]);
  
  // ===== HANDLERS =====
  const handleEditClick = () => {
    setForm({
      displayName: profileHook.profile?.displayName || '',
      username: profileHook.profile?.username || '',
      phone: profileHook.profile?.phone || '',
      bio: profileHook.profile?.bio || ''
    });
    setOriginalDisplayName(profileHook.profile?.displayName || '');
    setFormErrors({});
    setShowEditModal(true);
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  };
  
  const handleAdminClick = () => {
    navigate('/admin');
  };
  
  const handleEditClose = () => {
    setShowEditModal(false);
    document.body.style.overflow = 'unset';
  };
  
  const handleFormChange = (field, value) => {
    setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    if (formErrors[field]) {
      setFormErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: null }));
    }
  };
  
  // ===== VERIFICATION HANDLERS =====
  const handleVerifyLandlord = () => {
    navigate('/verify?role=landlord');
  };
  
  const handleVerifyAgent = () => {
    navigate('/verify?role=agent');
  };
  
  // ===== DISPLAY NAME VALIDATION =====
  const validateDisplayName = (value) => {
    const v = ValidationHelpers;
    if (!value || value.trim() === '') return 'Display name is required';
    if (value.length < 2) return 'Display name must be at least 2 characters';
    if (value.length > 60) return 'Display name is too long';
    if (!/^[a-zA-Z\s'-]+$/.test(value)) {
      return 'Display name can only contain letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes';
    }
    return null;
  };
  
  const validateForm = async () => {
    const errors = {};
    
    // Validate display name
    const displayNameError = validateDisplayName(form.displayName);
    if (displayNameError) errors.displayName = displayNameError;
    
    // Check cooldown for display name change
    const displayNameChanged = form.displayName !== originalDisplayName;
    if (displayNameChanged && !profileHook.canChangeDisplayName()) {
      const nextDate = profileHook.getNextDisplayNameChangeDate();
      errors.displayName = `You can only change your display name once every 6 months. Next available: ${nextDate?.toLocaleDateString() || 'later'}`;
    }
    
    // Phone validation (optional)
    if (form.phone && form.phone.trim()) {
      const phoneError = ValidationHelpers.validatePhone(form.phone, false);
      if (phoneError) errors.phone = phoneError;
    }
    
    // Bio validation (optional)
    if (form.bio && form.bio.trim()) {
      const bioError = ValidationHelpers.validateText(form.bio, 'Bio', {
        required: false,
        maxLength: 500
      });
      if (bioError) errors.bio = bioError;
    }
    
    setFormErrors(errors);
    return Object.keys(errors).length === 0;
  };
  
  const handleUpdate = async (e) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!await validateForm()) return;
    
    setEditing(true);
    
    try {
      const updateData = {
        lastActive: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
      };
      
      // Update display name if changed
      const displayNameChanged = form.displayName !== originalDisplayName;
      if (displayNameChanged) {
        updateData.displayName = ValidationHelpers.sanitizeInput(form.displayName.trim(), 'text');
        updateData.displayNameLastChanged = firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp();
      }
      
      // Update phone and bio
      if (form.phone !== profileHook.profile?.phone) {
        updateData.phone = form.phone ? ValidationHelpers.sanitizeInput(form.phone, 'phone') : '';
      }
      
      if (form.bio !== profileHook.profile?.bio) {
        updateData.bio = form.bio ? ValidationHelpers.sanitizeInput(form.bio, 'text') : '';
      }
      
      await db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).update(updateData);
      
      await profileHook.refetch();
      handleEditClose();
      setFormErrors({});
      
      // Show success toast
      if (displayNameChanged) {
        ToastHelpers?.success('Display name updated! Next change available in 6 months.');
      } else {
        ToastHelpers?.success('Profile updated successfully!');
      }
      
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Update error:', err);
      profileHook.setError(err.code === 'unavailable' ?
        'Network error. Please check your connection.' :
        'Failed to update profile. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setEditing(false);
    }
  };
  
  const handleDeleteListing = async (listingId) => {
    if (!confirm('Delete this listing? It will be hidden from others but remain in your history.')) return;
    
    const success = await listingsHook.deleteListing(listingId);
    if (!success) {
      profileHook.setError('Failed to delete listing. Please try again.');
    }
  };
  
  const handleEditListing = (listingId) => {
    openModal('post', { listingId });
  };
  
  // ===== SAVE STATE BEFORE UNLOAD =====
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const saveState = () => {
      const scrollPosition = pageRef.current?.scrollTop || 0;
      
      window.__profilePageState = {
        activeTab,
        showEditModal,
        form,
        scrollPosition,
        timestamp: Date.now()
      };
      
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('profile_state', JSON.stringify({
          activeTab,
          timestamp: Date.now()
        }));
      } catch (e) {}
    };
    
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', saveState);
    
    return () => {
      saveState(); // Save when component unmounts
      window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', saveState);
      delete window.__profilePageState;
    };
  }, [activeTab, showEditModal, form]);
  
  // ===== LOADING STATE =====
  if (profileHook.loading && !profileHook.profile) {
    return React.createElement('div', { className: 'min-h-screen bg-green-50' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-8' },
        React.createElement(SkeletonLoader.ProfileCard),
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'mb-6 border-b border-gray-200' },
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex gap-8' },
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'h-8 bg-gray-200 rounded w-24 animate-pulse' })
          )
        ),
        React.createElement(SkeletonLoader.ListingGrid, { count: 8, cols: 4 })
      )
    );
  }
  
  // ===== RENDER =====
  return React.createElement('div', { 
    ref: pageRef,
    className: 'min-h-screen bg-green-50 overflow-y-auto' 
  },
    React.createElement('div', { className: 'max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-8' },
      
      profileHook.error && React.createElement('div', {
        className: 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 p-4 rounded mb-6 border border-red-200'
      }, profileHook.error),
      
      React.createElement(ProfileHeader, {
        profile: profileHook.profile,
        user: user,
        onEditClick: handleEditClick,
        onAdminClick: handleAdminClick,
        onVerifyLandlord: handleVerifyLandlord,
        onVerifyAgent: handleVerifyAgent
      }),
      
      React.createElement(ProfileTabs, {
        activeTab: activeTab,
        onTabChange: setActiveTab
      }),
      
      activeTab === 'listings' &&
      React.createElement(ListingsTab, {
        listings: listingsHook.listings,
        user: user,
        navigate: navigate,
        onDelete: handleDeleteListing,
        onEdit: handleEditListing,
        loading: listingsHook.listingsLoading,
        usingIndex: listingsHook.usingIndex
      }),
      
      activeTab === 'settings' &&
      React.createElement(SettingsTab, {
        openDropdowns: settingsHook.openDropdowns,
        toggleDropdown: settingsHook.toggleDropdown,
        openPopup: settingsHook.openPopup,
        versionInfo: settingsHook.versionInfo,
        checkForUpdates: settingsHook.checkForUpdates,
        handleLogout: async () => {
          try {
            await auth.signOut();
            navigate('/');
          } catch (err) {
            profileHook.setError('Failed to log out. Please try again.');
          }
        },
        settingsRef: settingsRef
      })
    ),
    
    React.createElement(EditProfileModal, {
      show: showEditModal,
      onClose: handleEditClose,
      onSubmit: handleUpdate,
      form: form,
      onFormChange: handleFormChange,
      errors: formErrors,
      isSubmitting: editing,
      displayNameLastChanged: profileHook.profile?.displayNameLastChanged,
      canChangeDisplayName: profileHook.canChangeDisplayName(),
      nextChangeDate: profileHook.getNextDisplayNameChangeDate()
    }),
    
    settingsHook.activePopup && React.createElement(PopupModal, {
      popupName: settingsHook.activePopup,
      onClose: settingsHook.closePopup,
      onBackdropClick: (e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) settingsHook.closePopup();
      }
    })
  );
}

// pages/userByUsernamePage.js
function UserByUsernamePage({ navigate }) {
  const [error, setError] = React.useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);
  
  const username = window.location.pathname.split('/')[2];
  
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!username) {
      setError('No username provided');
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    
    const resolveUsername = async () => {
      try {
        if (window.IDGenerator) {
          const formatError = window.IDGenerator.validateUsername(username);
          if (formatError) {
                      }
        }
        
        const result = await FirestoreQueries.query({
          collection: 'users',
          where: [['username', '==', username]],
          limit: 1
        });
        
        if (result.data.length === 0) {
          setError('User not found');
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }
        
        const userId = result.data[0].id;
        navigate('/profile/' + userId);
        
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error resolving username:', err);
        setError('Failed to load user. Please try again.');
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    resolveUsername();
  }, [username, navigate]);
  
  if (loading) {
    return React.createElement('div', { className: 'min-h-screen bg-green-50 flex items-center justify-center' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-center' },
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gray-200 animate-pulse mx-auto mb-4' }),
        React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-600' }, 'Finding user...')
      )
    );
  }
  
  if (error) {
    return React.createElement('div', { className: 'min-h-screen bg-green-50 flex items-center justify-center' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-center max-w-md mx-auto px-4' },
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-6xl mb-4' }, 'üòï'),
        React.createElement('h2', { className: 'text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2' }, 'User Not Found'),
        React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-gray-600 mb-6' },
          error === 'User not found' ?
          `No user found with username "@${username}"` :
          error
        ),
        React.createElement('button', {
          onClick: () => navigate('/'),
          className: 'bg-green-950 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-green-800 transition cursor-pointer'
        }, 'Go Home')
      )
    );
  }
  
  return null;
}

window.UserByUsernamePage = UserByUsernamePage;
--- ./service-worker.js ---
const CACHE_NAME = 'unadomot-v1';
const OFFLINE_URL = '/offline.html';

// Assets to cache immediately
const PRECACHE_URLS = [
  '/',
  '/offline.html',
  '/vault/img/unadomot.jpg',
  '/styles/styles.css',
  '/styles/mobile.css',
  '/styles/desktop.css',
  '/styles/themes/dark.css',
  '/styles/themes/high-contrast.css',
  '/styles/themes/light.css',
  '/styles/accessibility-base.css'
];

self.addEventListener('install', (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.open(CACHE_NAME)
    .then(cache => cache.addAll(PRECACHE_URLS))
    .then(() => self.skipWaiting())
  );
});

self.addEventListener('activate', (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.keys().then(keys => {
      return Promise.all(
        keys.filter(key => key !== CACHE_NAME)
        .map(key => caches.delete(key))
      );
    }).then(() => clients.claim())
  );
});

self.addEventListener('push', (event) => {
  if (!event.data) return;
  try {
    const data = event.data.json();
    const isMessage = data.type === 'message' || (data.data && data.data.chatId);
    
    let options = {
      body: data.notification?.body || (isMessage ? 'New message' : 'Update from UnaDomot'),
      icon: '/vault/img/unadomot.jpg',
      badge: '/vault/img/unadomot.jpg',
      vibrate: [200, 100, 200],
      data: { ...data.data, type: isMessage ? 'message' : 'system' },
      actions: isMessage ? [
        { action: 'open-chat', title: 'üí¨ Open Chat' },
        { action: 'close', title: 'Dismiss' }
      ] : [
        { action: 'open', title: 'View' },
        { action: 'close', title: 'Dismiss' }
      ]
    };
    
    event.waitUntil(
      self.registration.showNotification(
        data.notification?.title || (isMessage ? 'New Message' : 'UnaDomot'),
        options
      )
    );
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Push error:', err);
  }
});

self.addEventListener('notificationclick', (event) => {
  event.notification.close();
  if (event.action === 'close') return;
  
  const data = event.notification.data;
  let url = '/';
  
  if (data?.type === 'message' && data?.chatId) {
    url = '/chat?chat=' + data.chatId;
  } else if (data?.listingId) {
    url = '/listing/' + data.listingId;
  } else if (data?.url) {
    url = data.url;
  }
  
  event.waitUntil(
    clients.matchAll({ type: 'window', includeUncontrolled: true })
    .then(clientList => {
      for (const client of clientList) {
        if (client.url.includes(window.location.origin) && client.focus) {
          client.postMessage({ type: 'NAVIGATE', url });
          return client.focus();
        }
      }
      return clients.openWindow(url);
    })
  );
});

// ===== MAIN FETCH HANDLER WITH OFFLINE FALLBACK =====
self.addEventListener('fetch', (event) => {
  // Skip cross-origin requests
  if (!event.request.url.startsWith(self.location.origin)) return;
  
  // For HTML navigation requests - serve offline page if offline
  if (event.request.mode === 'navigate') {
    event.respondWith(
      fetch(event.request)
      .catch(() => {
        return caches.match(OFFLINE_URL);
      })
    );
    return;
  }
  
  // For other requests - cache-first strategy
  event.respondWith(
    caches.match(event.request)
    .then(cachedResponse => {
      if (cachedResponse) {
        // Return cached version and update in background
        event.waitUntil(updateCache(event.request));
        return cachedResponse;
      }
      return fetch(event.request)
        .then(response => {
          return caches.open(CACHE_NAME)
            .then(cache => {
              cache.put(event.request, response.clone());
              return response;
            });
        })
        .catch(() => {
          // If asset fails, return generic offline asset
          if (event.request.url.match(/\.(jpg|jpeg|png|gif|svg)$/)) {
            return caches.match('/vault/img/unadomot.jpg');
          }
          return new Response('Offline', { status: 503 });
        });
    })
  );
});

// Helper to update cache in background
function updateCache(request) {
  return caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then(cache => {
    return fetch(request).then(response => {
      return cache.put(request, response);
    });
  });
}

// Handle messages from clients
self.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
  if (event.data && event.data.type === 'SKIP_WAITING') {
    self.skipWaiting();
  }
});

// services/firebase.js - COMPLETE VERSION (NO CONSOLE LOGS)
// Firebase configuration and initialization

const firebaseConfig = {
  apiKey: window.__ENV.FIREBASE_API_KEY,
  authDomain: window.__ENV.FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN,
  projectId: window.__ENV.FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID,
  storageBucket: window.__ENV.FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET,
  messagingSenderId: window.__ENV.FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID,
  appId: window.__ENV.FIREBASE_APP_ID,
  measurementId: window.__ENV.FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID
};

// Initialize Firebase if not already initialized
if (!firebase.apps.length) {
  firebase.initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
}

// Initialize services
const auth = firebase.auth();
const db = firebase.firestore();
const storage = firebase.storage();

// Enable offline persistence for Firestore (handles multi-tab gracefully)
db.enablePersistence({ synchronizeTabs: true })
  .then(() => {})
  .catch((err) => {});

// Make services globally available
window.auth = auth;
window.db = db;
window.storage = storage;

// Set auth session persistence to LOCAL (survives browser restarts)
auth.setPersistence(firebase.auth.Auth.Persistence.LOCAL)
  .then(() => {})
  .catch((err) => {});

// ===== ENHANCED PRESENCE SYSTEM FOR ONLINE/OFFLINE STATUS =====
let presenceInterval = null;
let currentUserId = null;
let isOfflineTimer = null;
let heartbeatRef = null;

// Function to update user status
const updateUserStatus = async (userId, isOnline) => {
  if (!userId) return;
  
  try {
    await db.collection('users').doc(userId).update({
      isOnline: isOnline,
      lastActive: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      ...(isOnline ? {} : { lastSeen: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp() })
    });
  } catch (err) {}
};

// Handle when user goes offline
const goOffline = () => {
  if (currentUserId) {
    updateUserStatus(currentUserId, false);
  }
  
  if (presenceInterval) {
    clearInterval(presenceInterval);
    presenceInterval = null;
  }
  
  if (heartbeatRef && currentUserId) {
    heartbeatRef.delete().catch(() => {});
    heartbeatRef = null;
  }
};

// Handle when user comes online
const goOnline = (userId) => {
  currentUserId = userId;
  
  if (isOfflineTimer) {
    clearTimeout(isOfflineTimer);
    isOfflineTimer = null;
  }
  
  updateUserStatus(userId, true);
  
  const tabId = Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9);
  heartbeatRef = db.collection('heartbeats').doc(userId + '_' + tabId);
  heartbeatRef.set({
    userId: userId,
    timestamp: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    tabId: tabId
  }).catch(() => {});
  
  if (presenceInterval) clearInterval(presenceInterval);
  presenceInterval = setInterval(() => {
    if (currentUserId && navigator.onLine) {
      if (heartbeatRef) {
        heartbeatRef.update({
          timestamp: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
        }).catch(() => {});
      }
      
      db.collection('users').doc(currentUserId).update({
        lastActive: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        isOnline: true
      }).catch(() => {});
    }
  }, 30000);
};

// ===== DETECT TAB/WINDOW CLOSE =====
window.addEventListener('beforeunload', function() {
  goOffline();
});

// ===== DETECT NETWORK CHANGES =====
window.addEventListener('online', function() {
  if (currentUserId) {
    goOnline(currentUserId);
    
    const toastEvent = new CustomEvent('show-toast', {
      detail: { message: '‚úÖ Back online!', type: 'success' }
    });
    window.dispatchEvent(toastEvent);
  }
});

window.addEventListener('offline', function() {
  goOffline();
  
  const toastEvent = new CustomEvent('show-toast', {
    detail: { message: 'üì° You are offline', type: 'warning' }
  });
  window.dispatchEvent(toastEvent);
});

// ===== CLEAN UP OLD HEARTBEATS =====
setInterval(async () => {
  const fiveMinutesAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 5 * 60 * 1000);
  
  try {
    const oldHeartbeats = await db.collection('heartbeats')
      .where('timestamp', '<', fiveMinutesAgo)
      .get();
    
    const batch = db.batch();
    oldHeartbeats.docs.forEach(doc => {
      batch.delete(doc.ref);
    });
    
    if (oldHeartbeats.size > 0) {
      await batch.commit();
    }
  } catch (err) {}
}, 300000);

// ===== CHECK FOR STALE ONLINE USERS =====
setInterval(async () => {
  const oneMinuteAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 60 * 1000);
  
  try {
    const activeHeartbeats = await db.collection('heartbeats')
      .where('timestamp', '>', oneMinuteAgo)
      .get();
    
    const activeUserIds = new Set();
    activeHeartbeats.docs.forEach(doc => {
      activeUserIds.add(doc.data().userId);
    });
    
    const usersRef = db.collection('users');
    const onlineUsers = await usersRef.where('isOnline', '==', true).get();
    
    const batch = db.batch();
    onlineUsers.docs.forEach(doc => {
      if (!activeUserIds.has(doc.id)) {
        batch.update(doc.ref, {
          isOnline: false,
          lastSeen: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
        });
      }
    });
    
    if (onlineUsers.size > 0) {
      await batch.commit();
    }
  } catch (err) {}
}, 60000);

// ===== LISTEN TO AUTH STATE =====
auth.onAuthStateChanged((user) => {
  if (presenceInterval) {
    clearInterval(presenceInterval);
    presenceInterval = null;
  }
  
  if (isOfflineTimer) {
    clearTimeout(isOfflineTimer);
    isOfflineTimer = null;
  }
  
  if (heartbeatRef) {
    heartbeatRef.delete().catch(() => {});
    heartbeatRef = null;
  }
  
  currentUserId = user?.uid || null;
  
  if (user) {
    if (navigator.onLine) {
      goOnline(user.uid);
    }

    // ===== GUARANTEED FIRESTORE VERIFICATION SYNC =====
    // Firebase Auth is the source of truth. When auth state fires and the Auth
    // object reports emailVerified=true, we ensure Firestore reflects that
    // regardless of which device or browser the user clicked the link on.
    // This is the only reliable place to guarantee the sync because it fires
    // on every session ‚Äî including sessions on different devices where
    // verify-email.html had no auth.currentUser available at the time
    // applyActionCode() was called.
    //
    // The write is only issued for password-provider accounts (Google sign-in
    // users are considered verified automatically and do not have this field).
    // Using set() with merge:true makes this fully idempotent ‚Äî safe to run
    // on every sign-in even if the field is already correct.
    const isPasswordProvider = user.providerData.some(
      (provider) => provider.providerId === 'password'
    );

    if (isPasswordProvider && user.emailVerified) {
      db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).set(
        {
          emailVerified: true,
          verifiedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
        },
        { merge: true }
      ).catch(() => {});
    }

    // NOTE: Do NOT call sendEmailVerification here. Issuing a new oobCode on
    // every auth-state change immediately invalidates any previously sent
    // verification link still in the user's inbox.
    // Verification emails are sent once: immediately after account creation in
    // SignupForm.js. Resending is handled explicitly via verify-email.html.
  } else {
    goOffline();
  }
});

// ===== HELPER FUNCTIONS =====
window.checkEmailVerification = function(user, action) {
  if (!user) {
    return {
      allowed: false,
      message: 'Please log in to ' + action
    };
  }
  
  if (!user.emailVerified && user.providerData.some(provider => provider.providerId === 'password')) {
    return {
      allowed: false,
      message: 'Please verify your email to ' + action + '. Check your inbox for the verification link.'
    };
  }
  
  return {
    allowed: true,
    message: ''
  };
};

// ===== CHANGED: Use verify-email.html in resend function too =====
window.resendVerificationEmail = async function(user) {
  if (!user) return false;
  try {
    await user.sendEmailVerification({
      url: window.location.origin + '/verify-email.html',
      handleCodeInApp: true
    });
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    return false;
  }
};

// ===== GET LAST SEEN FORMAT =====
window.getLastSeenText = function(lastSeen, isOnline) {
  if (isOnline) return 'Online now';
  if (!lastSeen) return 'Offline';
  
  try {
    let date;
    if (typeof lastSeen === 'number') {
      date = new Date(lastSeen * 1000);
    } else if (lastSeen && typeof lastSeen.toDate === 'function') {
      date = lastSeen.toDate();
    } else if (lastSeen instanceof Date) {
      date = lastSeen;
    } else {
      date = new Date(lastSeen);
    }
    
    if (isNaN(date.getTime())) return 'Offline';
    
    const now = new Date();
    const diff = now - date;
    const diffMinutes = diff / (1000 * 60);
    const diffHours = diff / (1000 * 60 * 60);
    const diffDays = diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
    
    if (diffMinutes < 1) {
      return 'Just now';
    }
    
    if (diffMinutes < 60) {
      return `${Math.floor(diffMinutes)} min ago`;
    }
    
    if (diffHours < 24) {
      return `${Math.floor(diffHours)} hours ago`;
    }
    
    if (diffDays < 2) {
      return 'Yesterday';
    }
    
    if (diffDays < 7) {
      return `${Math.floor(diffDays)} days ago`;
    }
    
    return date.toLocaleDateString();
    
  } catch (error) {
    return 'Offline';
  }
};

// ===== FOR TESTING: Manual auth state check =====
window.checkAuthState = function() {
  const user = auth.currentUser;
  return user;
};

--- ./storage.rules ---
  rules_version = '2';
service firebase.storage {
  match /b/{bucket}/o {
    // Function to check if user is authenticated
    function isAuthenticated() {
      return request.auth != null;
    }
    
    // Function to check if user owns the file
    function isOwner(userId) {
      return isAuthenticated() && request.auth.uid == userId;
    }
    
    // Listings images - anyone can read
    match /listings/{fileName} {
      allow read: if true;
      
      // Only authenticated users can upload
      allow write: if isAuthenticated() && 
                    // File size < 5MB
                    request.resource.size < 5 * 1024 * 1024 &&
                    // Must be image
                    request.resource.contentType.matches('image/.*');
    }
    
    // User avatars - private
    match /users/{userId}/{fileName} {
      allow read: if true;  // Avatars can be public
      allow write: if isOwner(userId) &&
                    request.resource.size < 2 * 1024 * 1024 &&
                    request.resource.contentType.matches('image/.*');
    }
    
    // Verification documents - extremely restricted
    match /verification/{userId}/{fileName} {
      allow read: if isOwner(userId);  // Only owner can view
      allow write: if isOwner(userId) &&
                    request.resource.size < 10 * 1024 * 1024 &&
                    request.resource.contentType.matches('application/(pdf|jpg|jpeg|png)');
    }
    
    // Default deny
    match /{allPaths=**} {
      allow read, write: if false;
    }
  }
}

--- ./utils/LazyLoad.js ---


const loadedScripts = {};

function loadScript(src) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    
    if (loadedScripts[src]) {
      resolve();
      return;
    }
    
    const script = document.createElement('script');
    script.src = src;
    script.async = true;
    
    script.onload = () => {
      loadedScripts[src] = true;
      resolve();
    };
    
    script.onerror = () => {
      reject(new Error(`Failed to load script: ${src}`));
    };
    
    document.head.appendChild(script);
  });
}

const componentCache = {};

async function lazyLoad(componentName, path) {
  if (componentCache[componentName]) {
    return componentCache[componentName];
  }
  
  /* Component may already be available via a deferred <script> tag */
  if (window[componentName]) {
    componentCache[componentName] = window[componentName];
    return window[componentName];
  }
  
  try {
    await loadScript(path);
    
    const component = window[componentName];
    if (!component) {
      throw new Error(`Component ${componentName} not found after loading ${path}`);
    }
    componentCache[componentName] = component;
    return component;
  } catch (error) {
    throw error;
  }
}

--- ./utils/cache.js ---
const AppCache = {
  
  // Cache stores
  listings: new Map(),
  listingExpiry: new Map(),
  
  users: new Map(),
  userExpiry: new Map(),
  
  chats: new Map(),
  chatExpiry: new Map(),
  messages: new Map(),
  
  // Page state cache
  pages: new Map(),
  pageExpiry: new Map(),
  
  // Default TTL: 5 minutes for data, 30 minutes for page state
  CACHE_TTL: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  PAGE_CACHE_TTL: 30 * 60 * 1000,
  
  /**
   * Get an item from cache
   * @param {string} type - Cache type (listings, users, chats, pages)
   * @param {string} key - Cache key
   * @returns {any} - Cached data or null
   */
  get(type, key) {
    const cache = this[`${type}Expiry`];
    const data = this[type]?.get(key);
    
    if (!data) return null;
    
    const expiry = cache?.get(key);
    const ttl = type === 'pages' ? this.PAGE_CACHE_TTL : this.CACHE_TTL;
    
    if (expiry && Date.now() > expiry) {
      this[type]?.delete(key);
      cache?.delete(key);
      return null;
    }
    
    return data;
  },
  
  /**
   * Set an item in cache
   * @param {string} type - Cache type
   * @param {string} key - Cache key
   * @param {any} data - Data to cache
   * @param {number} customTTL - Optional custom TTL
   */
  set(type, key, data, customTTL = null) {
    if (!this[type]) return;
    
    this[type].set(key, data);
    const expiryMap = this[`${type}Expiry`];
    if (expiryMap) {
      const ttl = customTTL || (type === 'pages' ? this.PAGE_CACHE_TTL : this.CACHE_TTL);
      expiryMap.set(key, Date.now() + ttl);
    }
    
    // Also store in sessionStorage for persistence across refreshes
    try {
      const cacheData = {
        data,
        expiry: Date.now() + (type === 'pages' ? this.PAGE_CACHE_TTL : this.CACHE_TTL)
      };
      sessionStorage.setItem(`${type}_${key}`, JSON.stringify(cacheData));
    } catch (e) {
      // Ignore storage errors
    }
  },
  
  /**
   * Get page state with special handling
   * @param {string} path - Page path
   * @returns {object|null} - Page state or null
   */
  getPage(path) {
    return this.get('pages', path);
  },
  
  /**
   * Save page state
   * @param {string} path - Page path
   * @param {object} state - Page state
   * @param {number} customTTL - Optional custom TTL
   */
  setPage(path, state, customTTL = null) {
    this.set('pages', path, state, customTTL);
  },
  
  /**
   * Preload data into cache
   * @param {string} type - Cache type
   * @param {string} key - Cache key
   * @param {Function} fetchFn - Function to fetch data if not cached
   * @returns {Promise<any>} - Cached or fetched data
   */
  preload(type, key, fetchFn) {
    const cached = this.get(type, key);
    if (cached) return Promise.resolve(cached);
    
    return fetchFn().then(data => {
      this.set(type, key, data);
      return data;
    });
  },
  
  /**
   * Clear cache
   * @param {string} type - Optional cache type
   * @param {string} key - Optional specific key
   */
  clear(type, key) {
    if (type && key) {
      // Clear specific item
      this[type]?.delete(key);
      this[`${type}Expiry`]?.delete(key);
      sessionStorage.removeItem(`${type}_${key}`);
      localStorage.removeItem(`route_${key}`); // Also clear route cache
    } else if (type) {
      // Clear entire cache type
      this[type]?.clear();
      this[`${type}Expiry`]?.clear();
      
      // Clear from sessionStorage
      Object.keys(sessionStorage).forEach(k => {
        if (k.startsWith(`${type}_`)) {
          sessionStorage.removeItem(k);
        }
      });
    } else {
      // Clear everything
      ['listings', 'users', 'chats', 'messages', 'pages'].forEach(t => {
        this[t]?.clear();
        this[`${t}Expiry`]?.clear();
      });
      
      // Clear all storage
      Object.keys(sessionStorage).forEach(k => {
        if (k.includes('_')) {
          sessionStorage.removeItem(k);
        }
      });
    }
  },
  
  /**
   * Check if cache is still valid
   * @param {string} type - Cache type
   * @param {string} key - Cache key
   * @returns {boolean} - Whether cache is valid
   */
  isValid(type, key) {
    const expiry = this[`${type}Expiry`]?.get(key);
    return expiry && Date.now() < expiry;
  },
  
  /**
   * Get cache age in milliseconds
   * @param {string} type - Cache type
   * @param {string} key - Cache key
   * @returns {number|null} - Age in ms or null
   */
  getAge(type, key) {
    const expiry = this[`${type}Expiry`]?.get(key);
    if (!expiry) return null;
    return Date.now() - (expiry - (type === 'pages' ? this.PAGE_CACHE_TTL : this.CACHE_TTL));
  },
  
  /**
   * Initialize cache from sessionStorage
   */
  init() {
    try {
      for (let i = 0; i < sessionStorage.length; i++) {
        const key = sessionStorage.key(i);
        const [type, ...idParts] = key.split('_');
        const id = idParts.join('_');
        
        if (type && id && this[type]) {
          const cached = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(key));
          if (cached.expiry > Date.now()) {
            this[type].set(id, cached.data);
            this[`${type}Expiry`].set(id, cached.expiry);
          }
        }
      }
      
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('‚ö†Ô∏è Cache initialization error:', e);
    }
  },
  
  /**
   * Get cache stats
   * @returns {object} - Cache statistics
   */
  getStats() {
    return {
      listings: this.listings.size,
      users: this.users.size,
      chats: this.chats.size,
      messages: this.messages.size,
      pages: this.pages.size,
      total: this.listings.size + this.users.size + this.chats.size + this.messages.size + this.pages.size
    };
  }
};

// Initialize cache
AppCache.init();

// Make globally available
window.AppCache = AppCache;

// utils/chat.js - COMPLETE FIXED VERSION
const MESSAGE_RATE_LIMIT = {
  MAX_MESSAGES: 20,
  TIME_WINDOW: 60000, // 1 minute
  MESSAGE_COOLDOWN: 1000, // 1 second
  MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH: 5000
};

const rateLimitStore = {
  userMessages: {},
  lastMessageTime: {}
};

// Clean up rate limit store every 5 minutes
setInterval(() => {
  const now = Date.now();
  
  // Clean up old message timestamps
  Object.keys(rateLimitStore.userMessages).forEach(userId => {
    rateLimitStore.userMessages[userId] = rateLimitStore.userMessages[userId]
      .filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < MESSAGE_RATE_LIMIT.TIME_WINDOW);
    
    if (rateLimitStore.userMessages[userId].length === 0) {
      delete rateLimitStore.userMessages[userId];
    }
  });
  
  // Clean up old last message times (older than 1 hour)
  Object.keys(rateLimitStore.lastMessageTime).forEach(userId => {
    if (now - rateLimitStore.lastMessageTime[userId] > 3600000) {
      delete rateLimitStore.lastMessageTime[userId];
    }
  });
}, 300000);

const sanitizeText = (text) => {
  if (!text) return '';
  
  let sanitized = String(text).trim();
  
  // Truncate if too long
  if (sanitized.length > MESSAGE_RATE_LIMIT.MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH) {
    sanitized = sanitized.slice(0, MESSAGE_RATE_LIMIT.MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH);
  }
  
  // Remove HTML tags and dangerous content
  sanitized = sanitized
    .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '')
    .replace(/javascript:/gi, '')
    .replace(/onerror=/gi, '')
    .replace(/onload=/gi, '')
    .replace(/onclick=/gi, '')
    .replace(/data:/gi, 'data-removed:')
    .replace(/vbscript:/gi, '')
    .replace(/eval\(/gi, '')
    .replace(/document\./gi, '')
    .replace(/window\./gi, '');
  
  return sanitized;
};

const checkRateLimit = (userId) => {
  const now = Date.now();
  
  // Initialize if needed
  if (!rateLimitStore.userMessages[userId]) {
    rateLimitStore.userMessages[userId] = [];
  }
  
  // Clean old messages for this user
  rateLimitStore.userMessages[userId] = rateLimitStore.userMessages[userId]
    .filter(timestamp => now - timestamp < MESSAGE_RATE_LIMIT.TIME_WINDOW);
  
  // Check cooldown
  if (rateLimitStore.lastMessageTime[userId]) {
    const timeSinceLastMessage = now - rateLimitStore.lastMessageTime[userId];
    if (timeSinceLastMessage < MESSAGE_RATE_LIMIT.MESSAGE_COOLDOWN) {
      const waitTime = Math.ceil((MESSAGE_RATE_LIMIT.MESSAGE_COOLDOWN - timeSinceLastMessage) / 1000);
      throw new Error(`Please wait ${waitTime} second${waitTime > 1 ? 's' : ''} before sending another message`);
    }
  }
  
  // Check rate limit
  if (rateLimitStore.userMessages[userId].length >= MESSAGE_RATE_LIMIT.MAX_MESSAGES) {
    throw new Error('Message limit reached. Please wait a moment before sending more messages.');
  }
  
  return true;
};

const updateRateLimit = (userId) => {
  const now = Date.now();
  
  if (!rateLimitStore.userMessages[userId]) {
    rateLimitStore.userMessages[userId] = [];
  }
  
  rateLimitStore.userMessages[userId].push(now);
  rateLimitStore.lastMessageTime[userId] = now;
};

const ChatHelpers = {
  
  /**
   * Generate a consistent chat ID from two user IDs and a listing ID
   */
  getChatId: function(userId1, userId2, listingId) {
    return [userId1, userId2, listingId].sort().join('_');
  },

  /**
   * Get or create a chat for a listing - FIXED VERSION with transaction
   */
  getOrCreateListingChat: async function(currentUserId, otherUserId, listingId, initialMessage = null) {
    if (!currentUserId || !otherUserId) {
      
      throw new Error('Both user IDs are required');
    }
    
    if (currentUserId === otherUserId) {
      throw new Error('Cannot create chat with yourself');
    }
    
    if (!listingId) {
      throw new Error('Listing ID is required - all chats must be about a listing');
    }
    
    try {
      const chatId = this.getChatId(currentUserId, otherUserId, listingId);
      
      
      const chatRef = db.collection('chats').doc(chatId);
      
      // Use a transaction to prevent race conditions
      return await db.runTransaction(async (transaction) => {
        const chatDoc = await transaction.get(chatRef);
        
        if (!chatDoc.exists) {
          
          
          // Fetch listing info
          let listingTitle = 'Property';
          let listingImage = null;
          try {
            const listingDoc = await db.collection('listings').doc(listingId).get();
            if (listingDoc.exists) {
              const listingData = listingDoc.data();
              listingTitle = listingData.title || 'Property';
              listingImage = listingData.images && listingData.images.length > 0 ? listingData.images[0] : null;
            }
          } catch (error) {
            
            // Continue anyway - we can still create the chat
          }
          
          // Create the chat document
          transaction.set(chatRef, {
            participants: [currentUserId, otherUserId],
            listingId: listingId,
            listingTitle: listingTitle,
            listingImage: listingImage,
            createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
            lastMessage: initialMessage ? (initialMessage.length > 100 ? initialMessage.slice(0, 100) + '...' : initialMessage) : null,
            lastMessageTime: initialMessage ? firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp() : null,
            lastSenderId: initialMessage ? currentUserId : null,
            participantInfo: {}
          });
          
          // Send initial message if provided
          if (initialMessage) {
            
            const messageRef = chatRef.collection('messages').doc();
            transaction.set(messageRef, {
              senderId: currentUserId,
              text: initialMessage,
              createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
              clientTimestamp: Date.now() / 1000,
              read: false,
              type: 'text'
            });
          }
        } else {
          
        }
        
        return chatId;
      });
    } catch (error) {
      
      throw new Error(`Failed to create chat: ${error.message}`);
    }
  },

  /**
   * Check if a chat already exists for a listing between two users
   */
  hasExistingListingChat: async function(userId1, userId2, listingId) {
    const chatId = this.getChatId(userId1, userId2, listingId);
    const chatDoc = await db.collection('chats').doc(chatId).get();
    return chatDoc.exists;
  },

  /**
   * Send a message in a chat
   */
  sendMessage: async function(chatId, senderId, text, options = null) {
    if (!chatId || !senderId) {
      throw new Error('Chat ID and sender ID are required');
    }
    
    // Check rate limit
    try {
      checkRateLimit(senderId);
    } catch (rateLimitError) {
      throw rateLimitError;
    }
    
    // Sanitize message text
    const sanitizedText = sanitizeText(text);
    
    if (!sanitizedText) {
      throw new Error('Message cannot be empty');
    }
    
    // Create message reference
    const messageRef = db.collection('chats').doc(chatId)
      .collection('messages').doc();
    
    // Base message object
    const message = {
      senderId: senderId,
      text: sanitizedText,
      createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      clientTimestamp: options?.clientTimestamp || Date.now() / 1000,
      read: false,
      type: 'text'
    };
    
    try {
      // Save message to Firestore
      await messageRef.set(message);
      
      // Update chat preview
      const previewText = sanitizedText.length > 100 
        ? sanitizedText.slice(0, 100) + '...' 
        : sanitizedText;
      
      await db.collection('chats').doc(chatId).update({
        lastMessage: previewText,
        lastMessageTime: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        lastSenderId: senderId
      });
      
      // Update rate limit after successful send
      updateRateLimit(senderId);
      
      return messageRef.id;
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error sending message:', error);
      
      if (error.code === 'permission-denied') {
        throw new Error('You do not have permission to send messages in this chat');
      } else if (error.code === 'not-found') {
        throw new Error('Chat not found');
      } else if (error.code === 'unavailable') {
        throw new Error('Network error. Please check your connection.');
      } else {
        throw new Error('Failed to send message. Please try again.');
      }
    }
  },
  
  /**
   * Get listing info for a chat
   */
  getChatListingInfo: async function(chatId) {
    try {
      const chatDoc = await db.collection('chats').doc(chatId).get();
      if (!chatDoc.exists) return null;
      
      const chatData = chatDoc.data();
      if (!chatData.listingId) return null;
      
      const listingDoc = await db.collection('listings').doc(chatData.listingId).get();
      if (!listingDoc.exists) return null;
      
      const listingData = listingDoc.data();
      return {
        id: listingDoc.id,
        ...listingData,
        images: listingData.images && listingData.images.length > 0 ? listingData.images : null
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching listing info:', error);
      return null;
    }
  },
  
  /**
   * Get the other participant in a chat
   */
  getOtherParticipant: function(chat, currentUserId) {
    if (!chat || !chat.participants || !currentUserId) return null;
    return chat.participants.find(id => id !== currentUserId);
  },
  
  /**
   * Format message timestamp for display
   */
  formatMessageTime: function(timestamp) {
    if (!timestamp) return '';
    
    try {
      let date;
      if (typeof timestamp === 'number') {
        date = new Date(timestamp * 1000);
      } else if (timestamp && typeof timestamp.toDate === 'function') {
        date = timestamp.toDate();
      } else if (timestamp instanceof Date) {
        date = timestamp;
      } else {
        date = new Date(timestamp);
      }
      
      if (isNaN(date.getTime())) return '';
      
      const now = new Date();
      const diff = now - date;
      const diffMinutes = diff / (1000 * 60);
      const diffHours = diff / (1000 * 60 * 60);
      const diffDays = diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
      
      if (diffMinutes < 1) {
        return 'Just now';
      } else if (diffMinutes < 60) {
        return `${Math.floor(diffMinutes)} min ago`;
      } else if (diffHours < 24) {
        return date.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
      } else if (diffDays < 2) {
        return 'Yesterday';
      } else if (diffDays < 7) {
        return date.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: 'short' });
      } else {
        return date.toLocaleDateString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error formatting time:', error);
      return '';
    }
  },
  
  /**
   * Format last seen for display
   */
  formatLastSeen: function(timestamp, isOnline = false) {
    if (!timestamp) return 'Offline';
    if (isOnline) return 'Online now';
    
    try {
      let date;
      if (typeof timestamp === 'number') {
        date = new Date(timestamp * 1000);
      } else if (timestamp && typeof timestamp.toDate === 'function') {
        date = timestamp.toDate();
      } else if (timestamp instanceof Date) {
        date = timestamp;
      } else {
        date = new Date(timestamp);
      }
      
      if (isNaN(date.getTime())) return 'Offline';
      
      const now = new Date();
      const diff = now - date;
      const diffMinutes = diff / (1000 * 60);
      const diffHours = diff / (1000 * 60 * 60);
      const diffDays = diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
      
      if (diffMinutes < 1) {
        return 'Just now';
      }
      
      if (diffMinutes < 60) {
        return `Last seen ${Math.floor(diffMinutes)} min ago`;
      }
      
      if (diffHours < 24 && date.getDate() === now.getDate()) {
        return `Last seen today at ${date.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}`;
      }
      
      if (diffDays < 2) {
        return `Last seen yesterday at ${date.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}`;
      }
      
      if (diffDays < 7) {
        return `Last seen ${date.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: 'long' })} at ${date.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}`;
      }
      
      return `Last seen ${date.toLocaleDateString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })}`;
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error formatting last seen:', error);
      return 'Offline';
    }
  },
  
  /**
   * Validate that a user has access to a chat
   */
  validateChatAccess: async function(chatId, userId) {
    try {
      const chatDoc = await db.collection('chats').doc(chatId).get();
      
      if (!chatDoc.exists) {
        return { valid: false, error: 'Chat not found' };
      }
      
      const chatData = chatDoc.data();
      
      if (!chatData.participants || !chatData.participants.includes(userId)) {
        return { valid: false, error: 'You do not have access to this chat' };
      }
      
      return { valid: true, chatData };
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error validating chat access:', error);
      return { valid: false, error: 'Failed to validate chat access' };
    }
  },
  
  /**
   * Mark a chat as read for a user
   */
  markChatAsRead: async function(chatId, userId) {
    if (!chatId || !userId) return;
    
    try {
      const chatRef = db.collection('chats').doc(chatId);
      
      await chatRef.update({
        [`lastRead.${userId}`]: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
      });
      
      const chatDoc = await chatRef.get();
      if (chatDoc.exists) {
        const chatData = chatDoc.data();
        if (chatData.lastSenderId && chatData.lastSenderId !== userId) {
          // Could update a counter here if needed
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error marking chat as read:', error);
    }
  },
  
  /**
   * Delete a message (soft delete or hard delete based on permissions)
   */
  deleteMessage: async function(chatId, messageId, userId) {
    if (!chatId || !messageId || !userId) {
      throw new Error('Chat ID, message ID, and user ID are required');
    }
    
    try {
      const messageRef = db.collection('chats').doc(chatId)
        .collection('messages').doc(messageId);
      
      const messageDoc = await messageRef.get();
      
      if (!messageDoc.exists) {
        throw new Error('Message not found');
      }
      
      const messageData = messageDoc.data();
      
      if (messageData.senderId !== userId) {
        throw new Error('You can only delete your own messages');
      }
      
      await messageRef.update({
        text: '[Message deleted]',
        deleted: true,
        deletedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
      });
      
      return true;
      
    } catch (error) {
      
      throw error;
    }
  }
};

const CloudinaryHelpers = {
  get CLOUD_NAME() {
    return window.__ENV.CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME;
  },

  getUrl: function(publicId, options = {}) {
    if (!publicId) return '/vault/img/no-image.jpg';
    if (publicId.startsWith('http')) return publicId; // Already a full URL
    
    const {
      width = 400,
        height = null,
        crop = 'fill',
        quality = 'auto',
        format = 'auto',
        type = 'general' // 'card', 'detail', 'thumbnail', 'carousel'
    } = options;
    
    let transformations = [];
    
    if (crop) transformations.push(`c_${crop}`);
    if (width) transformations.push(`w_${width}`);
    if (height) transformations.push(`h_${height}`);
    
    if (quality) transformations.push(`q_${quality}`);
    if (format) transformations.push(`f_${format}`);
    
    if (type === 'card') {
      transformations = [`c_fill,w_400,h_300,f_auto,q_auto`];
    } else if (type === 'detail') {
      transformations = [`c_fill,g_faces,w_1200,h_800,f_auto,q_auto:good`];
    } else if (type === 'thumbnail') {
      transformations = [`c_thumb,g_faces,w_100,h_100,f_auto,q_auto`];
    } else if (type === 'carousel') {
      transformations = [`c_fill,g_faces,w_800,h_450,f_auto,q_auto`];
    }
    
    const transformationString = Array.isArray(transformations) ?
      transformations.join(',') :
      transformations;
    
    return `https://res.cloudinary.com/${this.CLOUD_NAME}/image/upload/${transformationString}/${publicId}`;
  },
  
  getCardUrl: function(publicId) {
    return this.getUrl(publicId, { type: 'card' });
  },
  
  getDetailUrl: function(publicId) {
    return this.getUrl(publicId, { type: 'detail' });
  },
  
  getThumbnailUrl: function(publicId) {
    return this.getUrl(publicId, { type: 'thumbnail' });
  },
  
  getCarouselUrl: function(publicId) {
    return this.getUrl(publicId, { type: 'carousel' });
  }
};

window.CloudinaryHelpers = CloudinaryHelpers;

// utils/errors/ErrorBoundary.js
class ErrorBoundary extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false, error: null, errorInfo: null };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error) {
    return { hasError: true };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error, errorInfo) {
    // Log the error beautifully
    ErrorLogger.critical(error, {
      component: this.props.componentName || 'Unknown',
      errorInfo,
      ...this.props.context
    });

    this.setState({ error, errorInfo });
  }

  handleReset = () => {
    this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null, errorInfo: null });
    this.props.onReset?.();
  };

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      // You can render any custom fallback UI
      return React.createElement(ErrorFallback, {
        error: this.state.error,
        errorInfo: this.state.errorInfo,
        resetError: this.handleReset,
        fallback: this.props.fallback
      });
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

window.ErrorBoundary = ErrorBoundary;

// utils/errors/ErrorFallback.js
function ErrorFallback({ error, errorInfo, resetError, fallback }) {
  // Use custom fallback if provided
  if (fallback) {
    return typeof fallback === 'function' 
      ? fallback({ error, resetError }) 
      : fallback;
  }

  // Default fallback UI
  return React.createElement('div', {
    className: 'min-h-screen bg-red-50 flex items-center justify-center p-6'
  },
    React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-center max-w-md' },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-6xl mb-4 animate-bounce' }, 'üí•'),
      
      React.createElement('h2', { className: 'text-2xl font-bold text-red-800 mb-2' },
        'Something went wrong'
      ),
      
      React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-red-600 mb-4' },
        error?.message || 'An unexpected error occurred'
      ),
      
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'bg-red-100 rounded-lg p-4 mb-6 text-left text-sm font-mono overflow-auto max-h-40' },
        error?.stack || 'No stack trace available'
      ),
      
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex gap-3 justify-center' },
        React.createElement('button', {
          onClick: resetError,
          className: 'bg-red-600 text-white px-6 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-700 transition font-medium'
        }, 'Try Again'),
        
        React.createElement('button', {
          onClick: () => window.location.href = '/',
          className: 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 px-6 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-300 transition font-medium'
        }, 'Go Home')
      )
    )
  );
}

// utils/errors/ErrorLogger.js
const ErrorLogger = {
  logs: [],
  listeners: [],

  // Console styles for beautiful logging
  styles: {
    info: 'color: #3b82f6; font-weight: bold; background: #dbeafe; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px;',
    warning: 'color: #f59e0b; font-weight: bold; background: #fef3c7; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px;',
    error: 'color: #ef4444; font-weight: bold; background: #fee2e2; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px;',
    critical: 'color: #b91c1c; font-weight: bold; background: #fecaca; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; text-transform: uppercase;',
    timestamp: 'color: #6b7280; font-size: 0.85em;',
    location: 'color: #10b981; font-style: italic;'
  },

  log(level, error, context = {}) {
    const errorCode = error?.code || 'unknown';
    const errorMessage = error?.message || String(error);
    const userMessage = ERROR_MESSAGES[errorCode] || {
      title: 'Something Went Wrong',
      message: errorMessage,
      suggestion: 'Please try again or contact support.'
    };

    const logEntry = {
      id: Date.now() + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9),
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      level,
      code: errorCode,
      originalMessage: errorMessage,
      userMessage,
      context,
      stack: error?.stack || new Error().stack
    };

    this.logs.push(logEntry);
    
    // Beautiful console output
    this.prettyPrint(logEntry);
    
    // Store in localStorage for debugging (last 50 errors)
    this.persistLogs();
    
    // Notify listeners (for toast/UI updates)
    this.notifyListeners(logEntry);
    
    return logEntry;
  },

  prettyPrint(logEntry) {
    const icon = ERROR_ICONS[logEntry.level] || '‚ùì';
    const timestamp = new Date(logEntry.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString();
    
    console.groupCollapsed(
      `%c${icon} ${logEntry.level.toUpperCase()}%c ${logEntry.userMessage.title || 'Error'} %c@ ${timestamp}`,
      this.styles[logEntry.level],
      'color: inherit; font-weight: normal;',
      this.styles.timestamp
    );
    
    console.log('%cCode:', 'font-weight: bold;', logEntry.code);
    console.log('%cMessage:', 'font-weight: bold;', logEntry.originalMessage);
    
    if (Object.keys(logEntry.context).length > 0) {
      console.log('%cContext:', 'font-weight: bold;', logEntry.context);
    }
    
    if (logEntry.stack) {
      console.log('%cStack:', 'font-weight: bold;');
      console.log(logEntry.stack);
    }
    
    console.groupEnd();
  },

  info(error, context) {
    return this.log(ERROR_LEVELS.INFO, error, context);
  },

  warning(error, context) {
    return this.log(ERROR_LEVELS.WARNING, error, context);
  },

  error(error, context) {
    return this.log(ERROR_LEVELS.ERROR, error, context);
  },

  critical(error, context) {
    return this.log(ERROR_LEVELS.CRITICAL, error, context);
  },

  // Handle Firebase errors specially
  handleFirebaseError(error, context = {}) {
    const level = this.getFirebaseErrorLevel(error);
    return this.log(level, error, { ...context, source: 'firebase' });
  },

  getFirebaseErrorLevel(error) {
    const criticalErrors = [
      ERROR_CODES.AUTH.USER_DISABLED,
      ERROR_CODES.FIRESTORE.PERMISSION_DENIED
    ];
    
    if (criticalErrors.includes(error?.code)) {
      return ERROR_LEVELS.CRITICAL;
    }
    
    if (error?.code?.includes('network') || error?.code === ERROR_CODES.FIRESTORE.UNAVAILABLE) {
      return ERROR_LEVELS.WARNING;
    }
    
    return ERROR_LEVELS.ERROR;
  },

  persistLogs() {
    // Keep last 50 errors
    const recentLogs = this.logs.slice(-50);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('error_logs', JSON.stringify(recentLogs));
    } catch (e) {
      // Ignore storage errors
    }
  },

  subscribe(callback) {
    this.listeners.push(callback);
    return () => {
      this.listeners = this.listeners.filter(cb => cb !== callback);
    };
  },

  notifyListeners(logEntry) {
    this.listeners.forEach(callback => {
      try {
        callback(logEntry);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('Error in error listener:', e);
      }
    });
  },

  getLogs() {
    return this.logs;
  },

  clearLogs() {
    this.logs = [];
    localStorage.removeItem('error_logs');
  },

  // Format error for user display
  formatForUser(error) {
    const errorCode = error?.code || 'unknown';
    return ERROR_MESSAGES[errorCode] || {
      title: 'Error',
      message: error?.message || 'An unexpected error occurred',
      suggestion: 'Please try again.'
    };
  }
};

// Load persisted logs
try {
  const saved = localStorage.getItem('error_logs');
  if (saved) {
    ErrorLogger.logs = JSON.parse(saved);
  }
} catch (e) {}

window.ErrorLogger = ErrorLogger;
