// utils/errors/ErrorModal.js - CORRECTED VERSION
function ErrorModal({ error, onClose }) {
  if (!error) return null;

  const level = error.level || (window.ERROR_LEVELS ? window.ERROR_LEVELS.ERROR : 'error');
  const icon = window.ERROR_ICONS ? window.ERROR_ICONS[level] : '‚ùå';
  const userMessage = error.userMessage || (window.ErrorLogger ? window.ErrorLogger.formatForUser(error) : {
    title: 'Error',
    message: error.message || 'An error occurred',
    suggestion: 'Please try again.'
  });

  const bgColors = {
    info: 'bg-blue-50',
    warning: 'bg-yellow-50',
    error: 'bg-red-50',
    critical: 'bg-red-100'
  };

  const textColors = {
    info: 'text-blue-800',
    warning: 'text-yellow-800',
    error: 'text-red-800',
    critical: 'text-red-900'
  };

  const buttonColors = {
    info: 'bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700',
    warning: 'bg-yellow-600 hover:bg-yellow-700',
    error: 'bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700',
    critical: 'bg-red-700 hover:bg-red-800'
  };

  return React.createElement('div', {
    className: 'fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm',
    onClick: function(e) { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose(); }
  },
    React.createElement('div', {
      className: 'relative w-full max-w-md rounded-xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden ' + (bgColors[level] || 'bg-white') + ' border border-gray-200'
    },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'p-6' },
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-center gap-4 mb-4' },
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'text-4xl' }, icon),
          React.createElement('h2', { className: 'text-xl font-bold ' + (textColors[level] || 'text-gray-900') },
            userMessage.title
          )
        ),

        React.createElement('div', { className: 'space-y-3' },
          React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-base text-gray-700' },
            userMessage.message
          ),
          
          userMessage.suggestion && 
            React.createElement('div', { className: 'mt-4 p-3 rounded-lg bg-gray-100' },
              React.createElement('p', { className: 'text-sm text-gray-700' },
                React.createElement('span', { className: 'font-bold' }, 'üí° Suggestion: '),
                userMessage.suggestion
              )
            ),
          
          (error.code || error.stack) && 
            React.createElement('details', { className: 'mt-4 text-xs text-gray-500' },
              React.createElement('summary', { className: 'cursor-pointer hover:text-gray-700' },
                'Technical details'
              ),
              React.createElement('div', { className: 'mt-2 p-2 bg-gray-100 rounded font-mono whitespace-pre-wrap' },
                error.code && React.createElement('div', null, 'Code: ', error.code),
                error.stack && React.createElement('div', { className: 'mt-1' }, error.stack)
              )
            )
        ),

        React.createElement('div', { className: 'mt-6 flex justify-end' },
          React.createElement('button', {
            onClick: onClose,
            className: 'px-6 py-2 bg-green-950 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-green-800 transition font-medium'
          }, 'Close')
        )
      )
    )
  );
}

// utils/errors/ErrorProvider.js
const ErrorContext = React.createContext({
  showError: () => {},
  showToast: () => {},
  showModal: () => {},
  clearErrors: () => {},
  lastError: null
});

function ErrorProvider({ children }) {
  const [toastError, setToastError] = React.useState(null);
  const [modalError, setModalError] = React.useState(null);
  const [lastError, setLastError] = React.useState(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    // Subscribe to global error logger
    const unsubscribe = ErrorLogger.subscribe((logEntry) => {
      setLastError(logEntry);
      
      // Show toast for non-critical errors
      if (logEntry.level !== ERROR_LEVELS.CRITICAL) {
        showToast(logEntry);
      } else {
        showModal(logEntry);
      }
    });

    return unsubscribe;
  }, []);

  const showToast = (error) => {
    setToastError(error);
  };

  const showModal = (error) => {
    setModalError(error);
  };

  const clearErrors = () => {
    setToastError(null);
    setModalError(null);
  };

  const value = {
    showError: (error, options = {}) => {
      if (options.modal) {
        showModal(error);
      } else {
        showToast(error);
      }
    },
    showToast,
    showModal,
    clearErrors,
    lastError
  };

  return React.createElement(ErrorContext.Provider, { value },
    children,
    
    // Toast notifications
    toastError && React.createElement(ErrorToast, {
      error: toastError,
      onClose: () => setToastError(null),
      position: 'bottom-center',
      duration: 5000
    }),
    
    // Modal for critical errors
    modalError && React.createElement(ErrorModal, {
      error: modalError,
      onClose: () => setModalError(null)
    })
  );
}

const useError = () => React.useContext(ErrorContext);

window.ErrorContext = ErrorContext;
window.ErrorProvider = ErrorProvider;
window.useError = useError;

// utils/errors/ErrorToast.js
function ErrorToast({ 
  error, 
  onClose, 
  duration = 5000,
  position = 'bottom-center'
}) {
  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = React.useState(true);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setIsVisible(false);
      setTimeout(onClose, 300); // Allow fade out animation
    }, duration);

    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [duration, onClose]);

  if (!isVisible) return null;

  const level = error.level || ERROR_LEVELS.ERROR;
  const icon = ERROR_ICONS[level] || '‚ùå';
  const userMessage = error.userMessage || ErrorLogger.formatForUser(error);

  const bgColors = {
    [ERROR_LEVELS.INFO]: 'bg-blue-50 border-blue-200',
    [ERROR_LEVELS.WARNING]: 'bg-yellow-50 border-yellow-200',
    [ERROR_LEVELS.ERROR]: 'bg-red-50 border-red-200',
    [ERROR_LEVELS.CRITICAL]: 'bg-red-100 border-red-300'
  };

  const textColors = {
    [ERROR_LEVELS.INFO]: 'text-blue-800',
    [ERROR_LEVELS.WARNING]: 'text-yellow-800',
    [ERROR_LEVELS.ERROR]: 'text-red-800',
    [ERROR_LEVELS.CRITICAL]: 'text-red-900'
  };

  const positions = {
    'top-center': 'top-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2',
    'top-right': 'top-4 right-4',
    'top-left': 'top-4 left-4',
    'bottom-center': 'bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2',
    'bottom-right': 'bottom-4 right-4',
    'bottom-left': 'bottom-4 left-4'
  };

  return React.createElement('div', {
    className: `fixed ${positions[position]} z-50 max-w-md w-full transform transition-all duration-300 ${
      isVisible ? 'translate-y-0 opacity-100' : 'translate-y-2 opacity-0'
    }`
  },
    React.createElement('div', {
      className: `rounded-lg border ${bgColors[level]} shadow-lg overflow-hidden`
    },
      React.createElement('div', { className: 'p-4' },
        React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex items-start' },
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex-shrink-0 text-2xl mr-3' }, icon),
          
          React.createElement('div', { className: 'flex-1' },
            React.createElement('h3', { className: `text-sm font-bold ${textColors[level]}` },
              userMessage.title
            ),
            React.createElement('p', { className: `text-sm mt-1 ${textColors[level].replace('800', '700')}` },
              userMessage.message
            ),
            userMessage.suggestion && 
              React.createElement('p', { className: `text-xs mt-2 ${textColors[level].replace('800', '600')}` },
                'üí° ' + userMessage.suggestion
              )
          ),
          
          React.createElement('button', {
            onClick: () => {
              setIsVisible(false);
              setTimeout(onClose, 300);
            },
            className: `ml-4 flex-shrink-0 ${textColors[level]} hover:opacity-75`
          },
            React.createElement('svg', { className: 'w-4 h-4', fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', viewBox: '0 0 24 24' },
              React.createElement('path', { strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round', strokeWidth: '2', d: 'M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12' })
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  );
}

window.ErrorToast = ErrorToast;

// utils/favorites.js - COMPLETE WITH ALL FUNCTIONS

const FavoritesHelpers = {
  
  // ===== GLOBAL STATE =====
  _favorites: {},
  _listeners: [],
  _unsubscribe: null,
  _currentUserId: null,
  
  /**
   * Initialize favorites listener
   */
  initFavoritesListener: function(userId) {
    // Don't re-initialize if same user
    if (this._currentUserId === userId && this._unsubscribe) {
      
      return;
    }
    
    // Clean up existing listener
    if (this._unsubscribe) {
      
      this._unsubscribe();
      this._unsubscribe = null;
    }
    
    this._currentUserId = userId;
    
    if (!userId) {
            this._favorites = {};
      this._notifyListeners();
      return;
    }
    
    
    const userRef = db.collection('users').doc(userId);
    const favoritesRef = userRef.collection('favorites');
    
    this._unsubscribe = favoritesRef.onSnapshot((snapshot) => {
      
      
      // Build new favorites object
      const newFavorites = {};
      snapshot.docs.forEach(doc => {
        newFavorites[doc.id] = true;
      });
      
      this._favorites = newFavorites;
      
      // Update cache
      if (window.AppCache) {
        AppCache.set('favorites', `user_${userId}`, Object.keys(newFavorites));
      }
      
      // Notify all listeners
      this._notifyListeners();
      
    }, (error) => {
          });
  },
  
  /**
   * Notify all listeners
   */
  _notifyListeners: function() {
    const favoritesCopy = { ...this._favorites };
    this._listeners.forEach(callback => {
      try {
        callback(favoritesCopy);
      } catch (e) {
        
      }
    });
  },
  
  /**
   * Get current favorites
   */
  getCurrentFavorites: function() {
    return { ...this._favorites };
  },
  
  /**
   * Check if a specific listing is favorited
   */
  isFavorite: function(listingId) {
    return !!this._favorites[listingId];
  },
  
  /**
   * Subscribe to favorites changes
   */
  subscribeToFavorites: function(callback) {
    this._listeners.push(callback);
    
    // Call immediately with current value
    callback({ ...this._favorites });
    
    // Return unsubscribe function
    return () => {
      this._listeners = this._listeners.filter(cb => cb !== callback);
    };
  },

  /**
   * Toggle favorite status for a listing
   */
  toggleFavorite: async function(userId, listingId, optimisticCallback = null) {
    if (!userId) throw new Error('Must be logged in');
    
    // Call optimistic callback if provided
    if (optimisticCallback) {
      optimisticCallback(true);
    }
    
    const favoriteRef = db.collection('users').doc(userId)
      .collection('favorites').doc(listingId);
    
    try {
      const favoriteDoc = await favoriteRef.get();
      
      if (favoriteDoc.exists) {
        // Remove from favorites
        await favoriteRef.delete();
                
        // Clear cache
        if (window.AppCache) {
          AppCache.clear('favorites', `user_${userId}`);
          AppCache.clear('favorites', `${userId}_${listingId}`);
        }
        
        // Track analytics if available
        if (window.analytics) {
          window.analytics.track('favorite_removed', {
            userId,
            listingId
          });
        }
        
        // Dispatch event for other components
        this.dispatchFavoriteEvent(listingId, false, userId);
        
        return false;
      } else {
        // Add to favorites
        await favoriteRef.set({
          listingId: listingId,
          savedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
        });
        
        
        // Clear user favorites cache
        if (window.AppCache) {
          AppCache.clear('favorites', `user_${userId}`);
        }
        
        // Track analytics if available
        if (window.analytics) {
          window.analytics.track('favorite_added', {
            userId,
            listingId
          });
        }
        
        // Dispatch event for other components
        this.dispatchFavoriteEvent(listingId, true, userId);
        
        return true;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      
      
      // Revert optimistic update on error
      if (optimisticCallback) {
        optimisticCallback(false);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  /**
   * Dispatch a favorite changed event
   */
  dispatchFavoriteEvent: function(listingId, isFavorite, userId) {
    const event = new CustomEvent('favorite-changed', {
      detail: { 
        listingId, 
        isFavorite, 
        userId,
        timestamp: Date.now()
      },
      bubbles: true
    });
    window.dispatchEvent(event);
    
  },

  /**
   * Check if a listing is favorited (with cache)
   */
  checkIsFavorite: async function(userId, listingId, useCache = true) {
    if (!userId) return false;
    
    // Check cache first
    if (useCache && window.AppCache) {
      const cached = AppCache.get('favorites', `${userId}_${listingId}`);
      if (cached !== null) return cached;
    }
    
    try {
      const favoriteRef = db.collection('users').doc(userId)
        .collection('favorites').doc(listingId);
      
      const favoriteDoc = await favoriteRef.get();
      const isFavorite = favoriteDoc.exists;
      
      // Update cache
      if (window.AppCache) {
        AppCache.set('favorites', `${userId}_${listingId}`, isFavorite);
      }
      
      return isFavorite;
    } catch (error) {
      
      return false;
    }
  },

  /**
   * Get fresh favorite status for a listing (skip cache)
   */
  getFreshFavoriteStatus: async function(userId, listingId) {
    if (!userId || !listingId) return false;
    
    try {
      const favoriteRef = db.collection('users').doc(userId)
        .collection('favorites').doc(listingId);
      
      const favoriteDoc = await favoriteRef.get();
      return favoriteDoc.exists;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error getting fresh favorite status:', error);
      return false;
    }
  },

  /**
   * Get fresh favorite status for multiple listings at once
   */
  getFreshFavoritesForListings: async function(userId, listings) {
    if (!userId || !listings || !listings.length) return {};
    
    const results = {};
    
    // Process in batches to avoid too many requests
    const batchSize = 10;
    for (let i = 0; i < listings.length; i += batchSize) {
      const batch = listings.slice(i, i + batchSize);
      
      await Promise.all(batch.map(async (listing) => {
        try {
          const favoriteRef = db.collection('users').doc(userId)
            .collection('favorites').doc(listing.id);
          
          const favoriteDoc = await favoriteRef.get();
          results[listing.id] = favoriteDoc.exists;
        } catch (e) {
          results[listing.id] = false;
        }
      }));
    }
    
    return results;
  },

  /**
   * Get all favorites for a user
   */
  getFavorites: async function(userId) {
    if (!userId) return [];
    
    // Check cache
    if (window.AppCache) {
      const cached = AppCache.get('favorites', `user_${userId}`);
      if (cached) return cached;
    }
    
    try {
      const userRef = db.collection('users').doc(userId);
      
      const result = await FirestoreQueries.query({
        collection: 'favorites',
        ref: userRef,
        orderBy: 'savedAt',
        orderDirection: 'desc',
        limit: 100
      });
      
      if (result.data.length === 0) return [];
      
      const favoriteIds = result.data.map(f => f.id);
      const savedAtMap = {};
      result.data.forEach(f => {
        savedAtMap[f.id] = f.savedAt;
      });
      
      // Get full listing details
      const listings = await FirestoreQueries.getDocs('listings', favoriteIds);
      
      // Add savedAt back to listings
      const enrichedListings = listings.map(listing => ({
        ...listing,
        savedAt: savedAtMap[listing.id]
      }));
      
      // Sort by savedAt (newest first)
      const sorted = enrichedListings.sort((a, b) => {
        const aTime = a.savedAt?.seconds || 0;
        const bTime = b.savedAt?.seconds || 0;
        return bTime - aTime;
      });
      
      // Update cache
      if (window.AppCache) {
        AppCache.set('favorites', `user_${userId}`, sorted);
      }
      
      return sorted;
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error getting favorites:', error);
      return [];
    }
  },

  /**
   * Listen to favorites in real-time - THIS WAS MISSING!
   */
  listenToFavorites: function(userId, callback) {
    if (!userId) return () => {};
    
    let listingCache = {};
    let favoritesList = [];
    let isLoading = true;
    
    const userRef = db.collection('users').doc(userId);
    const favoritesRef = userRef.collection('favorites').orderBy('savedAt', 'desc');
    
    const unsubscribeFavs = favoritesRef.onSnapshot(
      async function(snapshot) {
        if (isLoading) {
          callback({ loading: true, favorites: [] });
          isLoading = false;
        }
        
        const favoriteIds = snapshot.docs.map(doc => doc.id);
        const savedAtMap = {};
        snapshot.docs.forEach(doc => {
          savedAtMap[doc.id] = doc.data().savedAt;
        });
        
        // Fetch only new listings
        const idsToFetch = favoriteIds.filter(id => !listingCache[id]);
        
        if (idsToFetch.length > 0) {
          const fetchedListings = await FirestoreQueries.getDocs('listings', idsToFetch);
          fetchedListings.forEach(listing => {
            listingCache[listing.id] = listing;
          });
        }
        
        // Build favorites list
        favoritesList = favoriteIds
          .filter(id => listingCache[id])
          .map(id => ({
            ...listingCache[id],
            savedAt: savedAtMap[id]
          }));
        
        // Update cache
        if (window.AppCache) {
          AppCache.set('favorites', `user_${userId}`, favoritesList);
        }
        
        callback({ loading: false, favorites: favoritesList, usingIndex: true });
      },
      function(error) {
        console.error('Error in favorites listener:', error);
        
        // Fallback to polling
        const interval = setInterval(async () => {
          const favorites = await FavoritesHelpers.getFavorites(userId);
          callback({ loading: false, favorites, usingIndex: false });
        }, 30000);
        
        return () => clearInterval(interval);
      }
    );
    
    return function() {
      unsubscribeFavs();
    };
  },

  /**
   * Remove multiple favorites at once
   */
  batchRemoveFavorites: async function(userId, listingIds) {
    if (!userId || !listingIds.length) return;
    
    const batch = db.batch();
    const favoritesRef = db.collection('users').doc(userId).collection('favorites');
    
    listingIds.forEach(listingId => {
      batch.delete(favoritesRef.doc(listingId));
    });
    
    await batch.commit();
    
    // Clear cache
    if (window.AppCache) {
      AppCache.clear('favorites', `user_${userId}`);
      listingIds.forEach(id => {
        AppCache.clear('favorites', `${userId}_${id}`);
      });
    }
    
    // Dispatch events for each removed favorite
    listingIds.forEach(listingId => {
      this.dispatchFavoriteEvent(listingId, false, userId);
    });
  },

  /**
   * Toggle favorite from a popup element
   */
  toggleFavoriteFromPopup: async function(listingId, buttonElement) {
    // Check if user is logged in
    if (!window.auth?.currentUser) {
      const toastEvent = new CustomEvent('show-toast', {
        detail: { message: 'Please log in to save favorites', type: 'error' }
      });
      window.dispatchEvent(toastEvent);
      
      if (window.__openAuthModal) {
        window.__openAuthModal('login', window.location.pathname);
      }
      return { success: false, newState: null };
    }
    
    const userId = window.auth.currentUser.uid;
    
    // Disable button during operation
    buttonElement.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
    buttonElement.style.opacity = '0.5';
    
    try {
      // DIRECT DATABASE ACCESS
      const favoriteRef = db.collection('users').doc(userId)
        .collection('favorites').doc(listingId);
      
      const favoriteDoc = await favoriteRef.get();
      let newState;
      
      if (favoriteDoc.exists) {
        await favoriteRef.delete();
        newState = false;
        
      } else {
        await favoriteRef.set({
          listingId: listingId,
          savedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
        });
        newState = true;
        
      }
      
      // Update button appearance
      const svg = buttonElement.querySelector('svg');
      
      if (newState) {
        buttonElement.classList.add('text-red-500');
        buttonElement.classList.remove('text-gray-500');
        if (svg) svg.setAttribute('fill', 'currentColor');
        buttonElement.title = 'Remove from favorites';
      } else {
        buttonElement.classList.remove('text-red-500');
        buttonElement.classList.add('text-gray-500');
        if (svg) svg.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
        buttonElement.title = 'Save to favorites';
      }
      
      // Clear cache
      if (window.AppCache) {
        AppCache.clear('favorites', `user_${userId}`);
        AppCache.clear('favorites', `${userId}_${listingId}`);
      }
      
      // Dispatch event for other components
      this.dispatchFavoriteEvent(listingId, newState, userId);
      
      // Show success toast
      const toastEvent = new CustomEvent('show-toast', {
        detail: { 
          message: newState ? '‚úì Saved to favorites' : '‚úì Removed from favorites',
          type: 'success' 
        }
      });
      window.dispatchEvent(toastEvent);
      
      return { success: true, newState };
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('‚ùå Failed to toggle favorite:', error);
      
      const toastEvent = new CustomEvent('show-toast', {
        detail: { message: 'Failed to update favorites', type: 'error' }
      });
      window.dispatchEvent(toastEvent);
      
      return { success: false, newState: null };
      
    } finally {
      buttonElement.style.pointerEvents = '';
      buttonElement.style.opacity = '';
    }
  }
};

// Make sure initFavoritesListener is called when auth state changes
if (window.auth) {
  auth.onAuthStateChanged((user) => {
    if (user) {
      FavoritesHelpers.initFavoritesListener(user.uid);
    } else {
      FavoritesHelpers.initFavoritesListener(null);
    }
  });
}

// Make it globally available
window.FavoritesHelpers = FavoritesHelpers;

--- ./utils/firestoreQueries.js ---
// utils/firestoreQueries.js
const FirestoreQueries = {
  /**
   * Execute a Firestore query with automatic fallback to JS sorting when indexes are missing
   * @param {Object} options - Query options
   * @param {string} options.collection - Collection name
   * @param {Array} options.where - Array of where conditions [[field, operator, value], ...]
   * @param {string} options.orderBy - Field to order by
   * @param {string} options.orderDirection - 'asc' or 'desc'
   * @param {number} options.limit - Maximum number of documents to return
   * @param {Object} options.startAfter - Document to start after (for pagination)
   * @param {Function} options.mapFn - Optional mapping function for results
   * @param {Object} options.ref - Optional document reference for subcollections
   * @returns {Promise<Object>} - { data: Array, lastVisible: Object, hasMore: boolean, usingIndex: boolean }
   */
  async query(options) {
    const {
      collection,
      where = [],
      orderBy = null,
      orderDirection = 'desc',
      limit = 30,
      startAfter = null,
      mapFn = null,
      ref = null
    } = options;

    let usingIndex = true;
    let snapshot;
    let collectionRef;

    // Determine collection reference (main collection or subcollection)
    if (ref) {
      collectionRef = ref.collection(collection);
    } else {
      collectionRef = db.collection(collection);
    }

    try {
      // Try with index first
      let query = collectionRef;

      // Apply where clauses
      where.forEach(w => {
        query = query.where(w[0], w[1], w[2]);
      });

      // Apply orderBy if specified
      if (orderBy) {
        query = query.orderBy(orderBy, orderDirection);
      }

      // Apply limit
      query = query.limit(limit);

      // Apply pagination
      if (startAfter) {
        query = query.startAfter(startAfter);
      }

      snapshot = await query.get();
    } catch (indexError) {
      // Index missing - fall back to JS sorting
      
      usingIndex = false;

      // Build fallback query without orderBy
      let fallbackQuery = collectionRef;

      where.forEach(w => {
        fallbackQuery = fallbackQuery.where(w[0], w[1], w[2]);
      });

      const fallbackSnapshot = await fallbackQuery.get();
      
      // Convert to array and sort in JS
      let docs = fallbackSnapshot.docs.map(doc => ({
        id: doc.id,
        ...doc.data()
      }));

      // Manual sorting
      if (orderBy) {
        docs.sort((a, b) => {
          const aVal = a[orderBy]?.seconds || a[orderBy] || 0;
          const bVal = b[orderBy]?.seconds || b[orderBy] || 0;
          
          if (orderDirection === 'desc') {
            return bVal - aVal;
          } else {
            return aVal - bVal;
          }
        });
      }

      // Manual pagination
      const startIndex = startAfter ? limit : 0;
      const paginatedDocs = docs.slice(startIndex, startIndex + limit);

      // Create fake snapshot
      snapshot = {
        docs: paginatedDocs.map(data => ({
          id: data.id,
          data: () => data,
          exists: true
        })),
        empty: paginatedDocs.length === 0,
        size: paginatedDocs.length
      };
    }

    // Process results
    const data = snapshot.docs.map(doc => 
      mapFn ? mapFn(doc) : { id: doc.id, ...doc.data() }
    );

    const lastVisible = usingIndex && snapshot.docs.length > 0 
      ? snapshot.docs[snapshot.docs.length - 1] 
      : { offset: (startAfter?.offset || 0) + limit };

    const hasMore = usingIndex 
      ? snapshot.docs.length === limit
      : data.length === limit;

    return {
      data,
      lastVisible,
      hasMore,
      usingIndex
    };
  },

  /**
   * Listen to a collection with real-time updates and fallback
   * @param {Object} options - Same as query options
   * @param {Function} callback - Function to call with updates
   * @returns {Function} Unsubscribe function
   */
  listen(options, callback) {
    const {
      collection,
      where = [],
      orderBy = null,
      orderDirection = 'desc',
      limit = 30,
      ref = null
    } = options;

    let collectionRef;
    if (ref) {
      collectionRef = ref.collection(collection);
    } else {
      collectionRef = db.collection(collection);
    }

    // Build query
    let query = collectionRef;
    where.forEach(w => {
      query = query.where(w[0], w[1], w[2]);
    });
    
    if (orderBy) {
      query = query.orderBy(orderBy, orderDirection);
    }
    query = query.limit(limit);

    // Try with index first
    try {
      return query.onSnapshot(snapshot => {
        const data = snapshot.docs.map(doc => ({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() }));
        callback({ data, usingIndex: true, loading: false });
      }, async (error) => {
        // Index missing - use polling fallback
        
        
        const pollInterval = setInterval(async () => {
          const result = await this.query(options);
          callback({ ...result, loading: false });
        }, 30000);

        return () => clearInterval(pollInterval);
      });
    } catch (error) {
      // Fallback to polling
      const pollInterval = setInterval(async () => {
        const result = await this.query(options);
        callback({ ...result, loading: false });
      }, 30000);

      return () => clearInterval(pollInterval);
    }
  },

  /**
   * Get a single document by ID
   */
  async getDoc(collection, docId, ref = null) {
    const collectionRef = ref ? ref.collection(collection) : db.collection(collection);
    const doc = await collectionRef.doc(docId).get();
    return doc.exists ? { id: doc.id, ...doc.data() } : null;
  },

  /**
   * Get multiple documents by IDs
   */
  async getDocs(collection, ids, ref = null) {
    if (!ids.length) return [];
    
    const results = [];
    const batchSize = 10;
    
    for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i += batchSize) {
      const batch = ids.slice(i, i + batchSize);
      const collectionRef = ref ? ref.collection(collection) : db.collection(collection);
      const snapshot = await collectionRef.where('__name__', 'in', batch).get();
      
      snapshot.forEach(doc => {
        results.push({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() });
      });
    }
    
    return results;
  }
};

window.FirestoreQueries = FirestoreQueries;
--- ./utils/firestoreRetry.js ---


window.FirestoreRetry = {
  
  processPendingOperations: async function() {
    
    const pendingOps = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pendingFirestoreOps') || '[]');
    if (pendingOps.length === 0) return;
    
    const now = Date.now();
    const maxAge = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; 
    const successfulOps = [];
    const failedOps = [];
    
    for (const op of pendingOps) {
      
      if (now - op.timestamp > maxAge) {
        continue;
      }
      
      try {
        await this.processOperation(op);
        successfulOps.push(op);
      } catch (error) {
        failedOps.push(op);
      }
    }
    
    
    const remainingOps = [
      ...failedOps,
      ...pendingOps.filter(op => now - op.timestamp <= maxAge && !successfulOps.includes(op) && !failedOps.includes(op))
    ];
    
    localStorage.setItem('pendingFirestoreOps', JSON.stringify(remainingOps));
  },
  
  
  processOperation: async function(op) {
    switch (op.type) {
      case 'createUser':
        await this.createUserDocument(op.uid, op.data);
        break;
      case 'updateUser':
        await this.updateUserDocument(op.uid, op.data);
        break;
      default:
    }
  },
  
  
  createUserDocument: async function(uid, data) {
    const userDoc = await db.collection('users').doc(uid).get();
    
    if (!userDoc.exists) {
      await db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({
        name: data.name || 'User',
        email: data.email,
        userType: 'tenant',
        createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        lastActive: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        replyRate: 0,
        blockedUsers: [],
        authProvider: data.provider || 'email',
        avatar: data.photoURL || null,
        phone: '',
        bio: '',
        verified: null,
        ...data.additionalData
      });
    }
  },
  
  
  updateUserDocument: async function(uid, data) {
    await db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({
      lastActive: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      ...data
    });
  },
  
  
  init: function() {
    
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      setTimeout(() => this.processPendingOperations(), 5000);
    });
    
    
    window.addEventListener('online', () => {
      setTimeout(() => this.processPendingOperations(), 2000);
    });
    
    
    setInterval(() => this.processPendingOperations(), 30 * 60 * 1000); 
  }
};

// utils/geocoding.js - SIMPLE VERSION (only local dataset)
// Ready for LLM migration later

const GeocodingHelpers = {
  // Simple geocoding using only local dataset (nigeria-states.js)
  geocodeAddress: async (address, state, lga) => {
    if (!address || !state || !lga) {
      console.warn('Missing required fields for geocoding');
      return null;
    }
    
    
    
    // ONLY use local dataset (nigeria-states.js)
    if (window.nigeriaStates) {
      const stateData = window.nigeriaStates.find(s => s.name === state);
      if (stateData) {
        // Try to find LGA coordinates first (best accuracy)
        const lgaData = stateData.lgas?.find(l => l.name === lga);
        if (lgaData && lgaData.lat && lgaData.lng) {
          
          return {
            lat: lgaData.lat,
            lng: lgaData.lng,
            source: 'local',
            accuracy: 'lga-level'
          };
        }
        
        // Fallback to state coordinates
        if (stateData.lat && stateData.lng) {
          
          return {
            lat: stateData.lat,
            lng: stateData.lng,
            source: 'local',
            accuracy: 'state-level'
          };
        }
      }
    }
    
    // No coordinates found - return null
    
    return null;
  },
  
  // Batch geocode multiple addresses
  batchGeocode: async (addresses) => {
    const results = [];
    for (const addr of addresses) {
      const result = await GeocodingHelpers.geocodeAddress(addr.address, addr.state, addr.lga);
      results.push({ ...addr, ...result });
    }
    return results;
  },
  
  // Placeholder for future LLM integration
  migrateToLLM: function() {
    
    // When you're ready to add LLM, you'll replace this file
    // with your LLM-powered version
  }
};

window.GeocodingHelpers = GeocodingHelpers;

// utils/idGenerator.js
const IDGenerator = {
  
  CODE_CHARS: 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789',
  CODE_LENGTH: 6,
  
  // ===== LISTING CODE FUNCTIONS (already existing) =====
  generateListingCode: async function() {
    const today = new Date();
    const year = today.getFullYear().toString().slice(-2);
    const month = String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const day = String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    const dateCode = `${year}${month}${day}`;
    
    const counterRef = db.collection('dailyCounters').doc(dateCode);
    
    const newCounter = await db.runTransaction(async (transaction) => {
      const doc = await transaction.get(counterRef);
      const currentCounter = doc.exists ? doc.data().counter : 0;
      const nextCounter = currentCounter + 1;
      transaction.set(counterRef, { counter: nextCounter, updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp() });
      return nextCounter;
    });
    
    const counterPadded = String(newCounter).padStart(3, '0');
    const randomSuffix = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 5).toLowerCase();
    
    return `${dateCode}-${counterPadded}-${randomSuffix}`;
  },
  
  validateListingCode: function(code) {
    if (!code) return false;
    const pattern = /^\d{6}-\d{3}-[a-z0-9]{3}$/;
    return pattern.test(code);
  },
  
  extractDateFromCode: function(code) {
    if (!this.validateListingCode(code)) return null;
    const datePart = code.split('-')[0];
    const year = 2000 + parseInt(datePart.slice(0, 2));
    const month = parseInt(datePart.slice(2, 4)) - 1;
    const day = parseInt(datePart.slice(4, 6));
    return new Date(year, month, day);
  },
  
  generateUniqueListingCode: async function(maxAttempts = 3) {
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < maxAttempts; attempt++) {
      const code = await this.generateListingCode();
      
      try {
        const snapshot = await db.collection('listings')
          .where('listingCode', '==', code)
          .limit(1)
          .get();
        
        if (snapshot.empty) return code;
      } catch (error) {
        return code;
      }
    }
    throw new Error('Could not generate unique listing code after ' + maxAttempts + ' attempts');
  },
  
  // ===== NEW: Generate permanent username from name =====
  // Format: {firstName}{lastInitial}{4randomNumbers}
  // Example: John Doe ‚Üí johnd1234
  generateUsernameFromName: function(fullName) {
    if (!fullName) return null;
    
    // Clean and split name
    const nameParts = fullName.trim().split(/\s+/);
    const firstName = nameParts[0];
    const lastName = nameParts.length > 1 ? nameParts[nameParts.length - 1] : '';
    
    // Get first 4 letters of first name (pad with random letters if shorter)
    let firstPart = firstName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g, '').slice(0, 4);
    while (firstPart.length < 4) {
      firstPart += String.fromCharCode(97 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 26)); // a-z
    }
    
    // Get last initial (first letter of last name, or random if no last name)
    let lastInitial = '';
    if (lastName && lastName.length > 0) {
      lastInitial = lastName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g, '').charAt(0);
    }
    if (!lastInitial) {
      lastInitial = String.fromCharCode(97 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 26));
    }
    
    // Generate 4 random numbers
    const randomNum = Math.floor(Math.random() * 9000 + 1000); // 1000-9999
    
    return `${firstPart}${lastInitial}${randomNum}`;
  },
  
  // ===== NEW: Ensure username is unique (with retry) =====
  generateUniqueUsername: async function(fullName, maxAttempts = 5) {
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < maxAttempts; attempt++) {
      const username = this.generateUsernameFromName(fullName);
      const exists = await this.checkUsernameExists(username);
      if (!exists) return username;
    }
    // Fallback: add timestamp
    const fallback = this.generateUsernameFromName(fullName);
    return `${fallback}${Date.now().toString().slice(-2)}`;
  },
  
  // ===== USERNAME FUNCTIONS (existing, keep) =====
  generateUsernameSuggestion: function(name) {
    if (!name) return '';
    const base = name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 12);
    const random = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 5);
    return base + random;
  },
  
  validateUsername: function(username) {
    if (!username) return 'Username is required';
    if (username.length < 3) return 'Username must be at least 3 characters';
    if (username.length > 20) return 'Username must be less than 20 characters';
    if (!/^[a-z0-9_]+$/.test(username)) {
      return 'Username can only contain lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores';
    }
    return null;
  },
  
  checkUsernameExists: async function(username, excludeUserId = null) {
    if (!username) return false;
    
    try {
      const snapshot = await db.collection('users')
        .where('username', '==', username)
        .limit(1)
        .get();
      
      if (snapshot.empty) return false;
      
      if (excludeUserId && snapshot.docs[0].id === excludeUserId) return false;
      
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      return true;
    }
  },
  
  // ===== URL HELPERS (updated) =====
  getProfileUrl: function(username) {
    if (!username) return null;
    return '/' + username;
  },
  
  getListingUrl: function(listingCode) {
    if (!listingCode) return null;
    return '/listing/' + listingCode;
  },
  
  extractUsernameFromUrl: function(url) {
    const match = url.match(/^\/([a-z0-9_]+)(?:\/|$)/);
    return match ? match[1] : null;
  },
  
  extractListingCodeFromUrl: function(url) {
    const match = url.match(/\/listing\/(\d{6}-\d{3}-[a-z0-9]{3})/);
    return match ? match[1] : null;
  }
};

window.IDGenerator = IDGenerator;

// utils/loadingPriority.js
const LoadingPriority = {
  // Priority levels
  CRITICAL: 'critical',
  HIGH: 'high',
  MEDIUM: 'medium',
  LOW: 'low',
  
  // Script categories
  scripts: {
    critical: [
      '/services/firebase.js',
      '/utils/cache.js',
      '/utils/routeCache.js',
      '/components/Layout.js',
      '/components/Header.js'
    ],
    high: [
      '/pages/home/index.js',
      '/hooks/useListings.js',
      '/hooks/useFavorites.js',
      '/components/ListingCard.js'
    ],
    medium: [
      '/pages/profile/index.js',
      '/pages/FavoritesPage.js',
      '/components/ChatInterface.js',
      '/components/NotificationBell.js'
    ],
    low: [
      '/pages/admin/index.js',
      '/pages/terms/index.js',
      '/pages/privacy/index.js',
      '/components/ReportModal.js'
    ]
  },
  
  // Loaded scripts tracker
  loaded: new Set(),
  
  /**
   * Load scripts by priority
   * @param {string} priority - Priority level
   * @returns {Promise} - Promise that resolves when scripts are loaded
   */
  loadPriority: async function(priority) {
    const scripts = this.scripts[priority] || [];
    const promises = scripts.map(src => this.loadScript(src));
    return Promise.all(promises);
  },
  
  /**
   * Load a single script
   * @param {string} src - Script source
   * @returns {Promise} - Promise that resolves when script is loaded
   */
  loadScript: function(src) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      // Check if already loaded
      if (this.loaded.has(src)) {
        resolve();
        return;
      }
      
      // Check if script already exists in DOM
      if (document.querySelector(`script[src="${src}"]`)) {
        this.loaded.add(src);
        resolve();
        return;
      }
      
      const script = document.createElement('script');
      script.src = src;
      script.async = true;
      
      script.onload = () => {
        this.loaded.add(src);
        
        resolve();
      };
      
      script.onerror = () => {
        console.error(`‚ùå Failed to load: ${src}`);
        reject(new Error(`Failed to load script: ${src}`));
      };
      
      document.head.appendChild(script);
    });
  },
  
  /**
   * Load critical path first (homepage)
   * @param {string} preferredMode - 'grid' or 'map'
   */
  loadHomepage: async function(preferredMode = 'grid') {
    
    
    // Load critical scripts first
    await this.loadPriority(this.CRITICAL);
    
    // Load high priority scripts
    await this.loadPriority(this.HIGH);
    
    // Load mode-specific scripts
    if (preferredMode === 'map') {
      await this.loadScript('/pages/home/components/map/index.js');
      await this.loadScript('/pages/home/components/map/MapCore.js');
      await this.loadScript('/pages/home/components/map/MapLayers.js');
    }
    
    // Load remaining in background
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.loadPriority(this.MEDIUM);
      this.loadPriority(this.LOW);
    }, 1000);
  },
  
  /**
   * Preload a page for faster navigation
   * @param {string} page - Page name
   */
  preloadPage: function(page) {
    const pageScripts = {
      profile: ['/pages/profile/index.js', '/hooks/useProfile.js'],
      favorites: ['/pages/FavoritesPage.js'],
      chat: ['/pages/ChatPage.js', '/components/ChatInterface.js'],
      listing: ['/pages/listing-detail/index.js']
    };
    
    const scripts = pageScripts[page] || [];
    scripts.forEach(src => {
      const link = document.createElement('link');
      link.rel = 'prefetch';
      link.href = src;
      document.head.appendChild(link);
    });
  },
  
  /**
   * Initialize hover-based preloading
   */
  initHoverPreloading: function() {
    document.addEventListener('mouseover', (e) => {
      const link = e.target.closest('a, button');
      if (!link) return;
      
      const href = link.getAttribute('href') || link.dataset.path;
      if (!href) return;
      
      // Preload based on href
      if (href === '/profile') this.preloadPage('profile');
      if (href === '/favorites') this.preloadPage('favorites');
      if (href === '/chat') this.preloadPage('chat');
      if (href.startsWith('/listing/')) this.preloadPage('listing');
    }, { passive: true });
  },
  
  /**
   * Get loading stats
   */
  getStats: function() {
    return {
      loaded: Array.from(this.loaded),
      count: this.loaded.size,
      critical: this.scripts.critical.filter(s => this.loaded.has(s)).length,
      high: this.scripts.high.filter(s => this.loaded.has(s)).length,
      medium: this.scripts.medium.filter(s => this.loaded.has(s)).length,
      low: this.scripts.low.filter(s => this.loaded.has(s)).length
    };
  }
};

// Make globally available
window.LoadingPriority = LoadingPriority;

const MessagingHelpers = {
  
  requestPermission: async function(userId) {
    if (!messaging) {
      throw new Error('Firebase Messaging not available');
    }

    try {
      
      const permission = await Notification.requestPermission();
      
      if (permission !== 'granted') {
        throw new Error('Notification permission denied');
      }

      
      const token = await messaging.getToken({
        vapidKey: 'BJKy1_revy36h8_HyS_nYcKDHbBHMyDAYat_Ge0_5N2e_27yP62yZdjV7GrlsVZgURlPeVKgpIgQJCCQV5K6OOY' 
      });

      
      if (userId && token) {
        await db.collection('users').doc(userId).update({
          [`fcmTokens.${token}`]: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
        });
      }

      currentToken = token;
      return token;

    } catch (err) {
      throw err;
    }
  },

  
  deleteToken: async function(userId) {
    if (!messaging || !currentToken || !userId) return;

    try {
      
      await db.collection('users').doc(userId).update({
        [`fcmTokens.${currentToken}`]: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.delete()
      });

      
      await messaging.deleteToken(currentToken);
      currentToken = null;

    } catch (err) {
    }
  },

  
  onMessage: function(callback) {
    if (!messaging) return;

    return messaging.onMessage((payload) => {
      
      
      if (callback) {
        callback(payload);
      } else {
        
        if (payload.notification) {
          const notification = new Notification(payload.notification.title, {
            body: payload.notification.body,
            icon: '/vault/img/unadomot.jpg',
            badge: '/vault/img/unadomot.jpg',
            data: payload.data
          });

          notification.onclick = function() {
            if (payload.data && payload.data.chatId) {
              window.focus();
              if (window.__navigate) {
                window.__navigate('/chat?chat=' + payload.data.chatId);
              }
            }
          };
        }
      }
    });
  },

  
  isSupported: function() {
    return 'Notification' in window && 
           'serviceWorker' in navigator && 
           messaging !== null;
  },

  
  getPermissionStatus: function() {
    if (!('Notification' in window)) return 'unsupported';
    return Notification.permission;
  }
};

window.MessagingHelpers = MessagingHelpers;

// utils/notifications.js - With Email Verification Support
const NotificationHelpers = {
  unreadCounts: {},
  listeners: {},
  messageListeners: {}, // Separate listeners for chat badge
  
  init: async function(userId) {
    if (!userId) return;
    
    if (window.MessagingHelpers && MessagingHelpers.isSupported()) {
      const status = MessagingHelpers.getPermissionStatus();
      
      if (status === 'granted') {
        try {
          await MessagingHelpers.requestPermission(userId);
        } catch (err) {
          console.error('Error requesting notification permission:', err);
        }
      }
    }
  },
  
  requestPushPermission: async function(userId) {
    if (!window.MessagingHelpers) return false;
    
    try {
      await MessagingHelpers.requestPermission(userId);
      return true;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error requesting push permission:', err);
      return false;
    }
  },
  
  // ===== NEW: Check verification status and send reminder =====
  checkVerificationStatus: function(user) {
    if (!user) return null;
    
    // Only check email/password users
    const isEmailUser = user.providerData?.some(p => p.providerId === 'password');
    if (!isEmailUser) return null;
    
    if (!user.emailVerified) {
      return {
        needsVerification: true,
        message: 'Please verify your email to comment, message, and post listings.'
      };
    }
    
    return null;
  },
  
  // ===== NEW: Show verification reminder banner =====
  showVerificationReminder: function(user) {
    const status = this.checkVerificationStatus(user);
    if (!status) return null;
    
    // Create and show a persistent but dismissible banner
    const bannerId = 'verification-reminder';
    
    // Check if already shown and dismissed
    if (localStorage.getItem('verification-reminder-dismissed')) {
      const dismissedTime = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('verification-reminder-dismissed'));
      // Show again after 24 hours if still not verified
      if (Date.now() - dismissedTime < 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {
        return null;
      }
    }
    
    // Dispatch event to show banner
    const event = new CustomEvent('show-verification-reminder', {
      detail: { message: status.message }
    });
    window.dispatchEvent(event);
    
    return bannerId;
  },
  
  // ===== FOR CHAT ICON (Message counts only) =====
  listenToMessageCount: function(userId, callback) {
    if (!userId) return () => {};
    
    if (!this.messageListeners[userId]) {
      this.messageListeners[userId] = [];
    }
    this.messageListeners[userId].push(callback);
    
    callback(this.unreadCounts[userId] || 0);
    
    const processUnreadMessages = async () => {
      try {
        // Get all user's chats and check unread
        const chatsResult = await FirestoreQueries.query({
          collection: 'chats',
          where: [['participants', 'array-contains', userId]],
          limit: 100
        });
        
        let totalUnread = 0;
        
        // For each chat, check unread messages
        for (const chat of chatsResult.data) {
          const chatRef = db.collection('chats').doc(chat.id);
          const messagesResult = await FirestoreQueries.query({
            collection: 'messages',
            ref: chatRef,
            where: [
              ['read', '==', false],
              ['senderId', '!=', userId]
            ],
            limit: 1
          });
          
          if (messagesResult.data.length > 0) {
            totalUnread++;
          }
        }
        
        const displayCount = totalUnread > 99 ? '99+' : totalUnread;
        
        this.unreadCounts[userId] = displayCount;
        
        if (this.messageListeners[userId]) {
          this.messageListeners[userId].forEach(cb => cb(displayCount));
        }
        
        this.updateTabTitle(userId, displayCount);
        
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error processing unread messages:', error);
      }
    };
    
    // Try real-time listener first
    try {
      const messagesRef = db.collectionGroup('messages')
        .where('read', '==', false)
        .where('senderId', '!=', userId);
      
      const unsubscribe = messagesRef.onSnapshot(
        async () => {
          await processUnreadMessages();
        },
        (error) => {
          console.error('Error in messages snapshot, falling back to polling:', error);
          // Fallback to polling
          const interval = setInterval(processUnreadMessages, 30000);
          return () => clearInterval(interval);
        }
      );
      
      return () => {
        unsubscribe();
        if (this.messageListeners[userId]) {
          this.messageListeners[userId] = this.messageListeners[userId].filter(cb => cb !== callback);
        }
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error setting up message listener, using polling:', error);
      // Fallback to polling
      const interval = setInterval(processUnreadMessages, 30000);
      
      return () => {
        clearInterval(interval);
        if (this.messageListeners[userId]) {
          this.messageListeners[userId] = this.messageListeners[userId].filter(cb => cb !== callback);
        }
      };
    }
  },
  
  // ===== BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY =====
  listenToUnreadCount: function(userId, callback) {
    return this.listenToMessageCount(userId, callback);
  },
  
  // ===== FOR BELL ICON (System notifications only) =====
  listenToSystemNotifications: function(userId, callback) {
    if (!userId) return () => {};
    
    if (!this.listeners[userId]) {
      this.listeners[userId] = [];
    }
    this.listeners[userId].push(callback);
    
    // Initial callback with empty array
    callback([]);
    
    // Set up listener for user's notifications subcollection
    const userNotificationsRef = db.collection('users').doc(userId)
      .collection('notifications')
      .orderBy('createdAt', 'desc')
      .limit(50);
    
    const unsubscribe = userNotificationsRef.onSnapshot((snapshot) => {
      const notifications = snapshot.docs.map(doc => ({
        id: doc.id,
        ...doc.data()
      }));
      
      // Update unread count for bell badge
      const unreadCount = notifications.filter(n => !n.read).length;
      
      if (this.listeners[userId]) {
        this.listeners[userId].forEach(cb => cb(notifications));
      }
      
      // Also update tab title for unread system notifications
      if (unreadCount > 0) {
        this.updateTabTitle(userId, unreadCount);
      }
    });
    
    return () => {
      unsubscribe();
      if (this.listeners[userId]) {
        this.listeners[userId] = this.listeners[userId].filter(cb => cb !== callback);
      }
    };
  },
  
  updateTabTitle: function(userId, count) {
    const baseTitle = 'UnaDomot';
    document.title = count > 0 ? `(${count}) ${baseTitle}` : baseTitle;
  },
  
  markChatAsRead: async function(chatId, userId) {
    if (!chatId || !userId) return;
    
    try {
      await db.collection('chats').doc(chatId).update({
        [`lastRead.${userId}`]: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
      });
      
      const chatRef = db.collection('chats').doc(chatId);
      const messagesRef = chatRef.collection('messages');
      
      const result = await FirestoreQueries.query({
        collection: 'messages',
        ref: chatRef,
        where: [
          ['read', '==', false],
          ['senderId', '!=', userId]
        ],
        limit: 50
      });
      
      if (result.data.length > 0) {
        const batch = db.batch();
        result.data.forEach(message => {
          batch.update(messagesRef.doc(message.id), { read: true });
        });
        await batch.commit();
      }
      
      this.unreadCounts[userId] = 0;
      
      if (this.messageListeners[userId]) {
        this.messageListeners[userId].forEach(cb => cb(0));
      }
      
      this.updateTabTitle(userId, 0);
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error marking chat as read:', error);
    }
  },
  
  // ===== Mark a system notification as read =====
  markNotificationAsRead: async function(userId, notificationId) {
    if (!userId || !notificationId) return;
    
    try {
      await db.collection('users').doc(userId)
        .collection('notifications').doc(notificationId)
        .update({
          read: true,
          readAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
        });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error marking notification as read:', error);
    }
  },
  
  // ===== Mark all notifications as read =====
  markAllNotificationsAsRead: async function(userId) {
    if (!userId) return;
    
    try {
      const snapshot = await db.collection('users').doc(userId)
        .collection('notifications')
        .where('read', '==', false)
        .get();
      
      const batch = db.batch();
      snapshot.docs.forEach(doc => {
        batch.update(doc.ref, {
          read: true,
          readAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
        });
      });
      
      await batch.commit();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error marking all notifications as read:', error);
    }
  },
  
  // ===== Add a system notification (legacy method) =====
  addSystemNotification: function(userId, notification) {
    const systemNotification = {
      id: Date.now() + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9),
      read: false,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      ...notification
    };
    
    if (this.listeners[userId]) {
      this.listeners[userId].forEach(cb => cb([systemNotification]));
    }
    
    if (Notification.permission === 'granted') {
      new Notification(notification.title, {
        body: notification.body,
        icon: '/vault/img/unadomot.jpg',
        badge: '/vault/img/unadomot.jpg',
        data: notification
      });
    }
  },
  
  // ===== Get unread count for bell icon =====
  getUnreadCount: async function(userId) {
    if (!userId) return 0;
    
    try {
      const snapshot = await db.collection('users').doc(userId)
        .collection('notifications')
        .where('read', '==', false)
        .count()
        .get();
      
      return snapshot.data().count;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error getting unread count:', error);
      return 0;
    }
  },
  
  // ===== NEW: Add verification reminder notification =====
  addVerificationReminder: function(userId) {
    const notification = {
      type: 'verification_reminder',
      title: 'üîî Verify Your Email',
      body: 'Please verify your email to comment, message, and post listings.',
      read: false,
      createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      persistent: true
    };
    
    // Add to Firestore notifications
    db.collection('users').doc(userId)
      .collection('notifications')
      .add(notification)
      .catch(err => console.error('Error adding verification reminder:', err));
    
    return notification;
  }
};

window.NotificationHelpers = NotificationHelpers;

const PreloadHelpers = {
  
  preloadPage(pageName) {
    const pages = {
      'listings': '/pages/ListingsPage.js',
      'favorites': '/pages/FavoritesPage.js',
      'profile': '/pages/ProfilePage.js',
      'chat': '/pages/ChatPage.js'
    };
    
    const path = pages[pageName];
    if (path && !window.loadedScripts?.[path]) {
      const link = document.createElement('link');
      link.rel = 'prefetch';
      link.href = path;
      document.head.appendChild(link);
    }
  },
  
  
  initHoverPreloading() {
    document.addEventListener('mouseover', (e) => {
      const link = e.target.closest('a, button');
      if (!link) return;
      
      const href = link.getAttribute('href') || link.dataset.path;
      if (href === '/listings') this.preloadPage('listings');
      if (href === '/favorites') this.preloadPage('favorites');
      if (href === '/profile') this.preloadPage('profile');
      if (href === '/chat') this.preloadPage('chat');
    }, { passive: true });
  }
};

window.PreloadHelpers = PreloadHelpers;

// utils/reactionHelpers.js
const ReactionHelpers = {
  // Collection names
  REACTIONS_COLLECTION: 'reactions',
  
  // Reaction types
  TYPES: {
    LIKE: 'like',
    LOVE: 'love',
    LAUGH: 'laugh',
    HELPFUL: 'helpful',
    SUPPORT: 'support'
  },
  
  /**
   * Get the reactions subcollection reference for any content
   * @param {string} contentType - 'comment', 'listing', 'reply', etc.
   * @param {string} contentId - ID of the content
   * @returns {CollectionReference} Firestore collection reference
   */
  getReactionsRef: function(contentType, contentId) {
    return db.collection(contentType).doc(contentId).collection(this.REACTIONS_COLLECTION);
  },
  
  /**
   * Toggle a reaction for a user on any content
   * @param {Object} params
   * @param {string} params.contentType - 'comment', 'listing', etc.
   * @param {string} params.contentId - ID of content
   * @param {string} params.userId - User performing reaction
   * @param {string} params.reactionType - 'like', 'love', etc.
   * @returns {Promise<Object>} Result with new state and counts
   */
  toggleReaction: async function({ contentType, contentId, userId, reactionType }) {
    if (!contentType || !contentId || !userId || !reactionType) {
      throw new Error('Missing required parameters');
    }
    
    const reactionRef = this.getReactionsRef(contentType, contentId).doc(userId);
    const contentRef = db.collection(contentType).doc(contentId);
    
    try {
      const reactionDoc = await reactionRef.get();
      
      if (reactionDoc.exists) {
        const existing = reactionDoc.data();
        
        if (existing.type === reactionType) {
          // Remove reaction (toggle off)
          await db.runTransaction(async (transaction) => {
            transaction.delete(reactionRef);
            
            // Decrement count for this reaction type
            transaction.update(contentRef, {
              [`reactionCounts.${reactionType}`]: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(-1),
              updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
            });
          });
          
          return {
            active: false,
            type: null,
            counts: await this.getReactionCounts(contentType, contentId)
          };
        } else {
          // Change reaction type
          await db.runTransaction(async (transaction) => {
            transaction.update(reactionRef, {
              type: reactionType,
              updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
            });
            
            // Decrement old type, increment new type
            transaction.update(contentRef, {
              [`reactionCounts.${existing.type}`]: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(-1),
              [`reactionCounts.${reactionType}`]: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(1),
              updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
            });
          });
          
          return {
            active: true,
            type: reactionType,
            counts: await this.getReactionCounts(contentType, contentId)
          };
        }
      } else {
        // Add new reaction
        await db.runTransaction(async (transaction) => {
          transaction.set(reactionRef, {
            type: reactionType,
            userId: userId,
            createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
            updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
          });
          
          // Increment count for this reaction type
          transaction.update(contentRef, {
            [`reactionCounts.${reactionType}`]: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(1),
            updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
          });
        });
        
        return {
          active: true,
          type: reactionType,
          counts: await this.getReactionCounts(contentType, contentId)
        };
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error toggling reaction:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  },
  
  /**
   * Get reaction counts for any content
   * @param {string} contentType
   * @param {string} contentId
   * @returns {Promise<Object>} Counts by reaction type
   */
  getReactionCounts: async function(contentType, contentId) {
    try {
      const contentDoc = await db.collection(contentType).doc(contentId).get();
      if (!contentDoc.exists) return {};
      
      const data = contentDoc.data();
      return data.reactionCounts || {};
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error getting reaction counts:', error);
      return {};
    }
  },
  
  /**
   * Get user's reaction to specific content
   * @param {string} contentType
   * @param {string} contentId
   * @param {string} userId
   * @returns {Promise<string|null>} Reaction type or null
   */
  getUserReaction: async function(contentType, contentId, userId) {
    if (!userId) return null;
    
    try {
      const reactionRef = this.getReactionsRef(contentType, contentId).doc(userId);
      const reactionDoc = await reactionRef.get();
      return reactionDoc.exists ? reactionDoc.data().type : null;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error getting user reaction:', error);
      return null;
    }
  },
  
  /**
   * Listen to reactions in real-time
   * @param {string} contentType
   * @param {string} contentId
   * @param {string} userId - Current user (for personal reaction)
   * @param {Function} callback
   * @returns {Function} Unsubscribe function
   */
  listenToReactions: function(contentType, contentId, userId, callback) {
    const contentRef = db.collection(contentType).doc(contentId);
    
    // Listen to content doc for counts
    const unsubscribeContent = contentRef.onSnapshot((doc) => {
      if (doc.exists) {
        const data = doc.data();
        callback({
          counts: data.reactionCounts || {},
          loading: false
        });
      }
    });
    
    // Also listen to user's personal reaction if logged in
    let unsubscribeUser = null;
    if (userId) {
      const userReactionRef = this.getReactionsRef(contentType, contentId).doc(userId);
      unsubscribeUser = userReactionRef.onSnapshot((doc) => {
        callback({
          userReaction: doc.exists ? doc.data().type : null,
          counts: null, // Will be updated by content listener
          loading: false
        });
      });
    }
    
    return () => {
      unsubscribeContent();
      if (unsubscribeUser) unsubscribeUser();
    };
  },
  
  /**
   * Batch get reactions for multiple items (for list views)
   * @param {string} contentType
   * @param {Array} contentIds
   * @param {string} userId
   * @returns {Promise<Object>} Map of contentId -> { counts, userReaction }
   */
  batchGetReactions: async function(contentType, contentIds, userId) {
    if (!contentIds.length) return {};
    
    const results = {};
    const batchSize = 10;
    
    for (let i = 0; i < contentIds.length; i += batchSize) {
      const batch = contentIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);
      
      // Get content docs for counts
      const contentSnapshot = await db.collection(contentType)
        .where('__name__', 'in', batch)
        .get();
      
      contentSnapshot.forEach(doc => {
        results[doc.id] = {
          counts: doc.data().reactionCounts || {}
        };
      });
      
      // If user logged in, get their reactions
      if (userId) {
        for (const contentId of batch) {
          const reactionRef = this.getReactionsRef(contentType, contentId).doc(userId);
          const reactionDoc = await reactionRef.get();
          if (results[contentId]) {
            results[contentId].userReaction = reactionDoc.exists ? reactionDoc.data().type : null;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    return results;
  }
};

window.ReactionHelpers = ReactionHelpers;

// utils/routeCache.js - Enhanced route caching with localStorage persistence

const RouteCache = {
  // Cache storage
  _cache: new Map(),
  _expiry: new Map(),
  
  // Default TTL: 30 minutes
  DEFAULT_TTL: 30 * 60 * 1000,
  
  /**
   * Save route data to cache
   * @param {string} path - Route path
   * @param {object} data - Route data to cache
   * @param {number} ttl - Time to live in ms
   */
  set(path, data, ttl = this.DEFAULT_TTL) {
    const cacheKey = `route_${path}`;
    
    // Store in memory
    this._cache.set(cacheKey, data);
    this._expiry.set(cacheKey, Date.now() + ttl);
    
    // Store in localStorage for persistence
    try {
      const storageData = {
        data,
        expiry: Date.now() + ttl,
        timestamp: Date.now()
      };
      localStorage.setItem(cacheKey, JSON.stringify(storageData));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to save route to localStorage:', e);
    }
    
    
  },
  
  /**
   * Get route data from cache
   * @param {string} path - Route path
   * @returns {object|null} - Cached data or null
   */
  get(path) {
    const cacheKey = `route_${path}`;
    
    // Check memory cache first
    if (this._cache.has(cacheKey)) {
      const expiry = this._expiry.get(cacheKey);
      if (expiry > Date.now()) {
        return this._cache.get(cacheKey);
      } else {
        // Expired, clean up
        this._cache.delete(cacheKey);
        this._expiry.delete(cacheKey);
      }
    }
    
    // Check localStorage
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(cacheKey);
      if (stored) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);
        if (parsed.expiry > Date.now()) {
          // Restore to memory cache
          this._cache.set(cacheKey, parsed.data);
          this._expiry.set(cacheKey, parsed.expiry);
          return parsed.data;
        } else {
          // Expired, remove
          localStorage.removeItem(cacheKey);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to read route from localStorage:', e);
    }
    
    return null;
  },
  
  /**
   * Check if route exists in cache
   * @param {string} path - Route path
   * @returns {boolean}
   */
  has(path) {
    return this.get(path) !== null;
  },
  
  /**
   * Remove route from cache
   * @param {string} path - Route path
   */
  remove(path) {
    const cacheKey = `route_${path}`;
    
    this._cache.delete(cacheKey);
    this._expiry.delete(cacheKey);
    
    try {
      localStorage.removeItem(cacheKey);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to remove route from localStorage:', e);
    }
    
    
  },
  
  /**
   * Clear all routes from cache
   */
  clear() {
    this._cache.clear();
    this._expiry.clear();
    
    try {
      Object.keys(localStorage).forEach(key => {
        if (key.startsWith('route_')) {
          localStorage.removeItem(key);
        }
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to clear routes from localStorage:', e);
    }
    
    
  },
  
  /**
   * Get all cached routes
   * @returns {Array} - Array of cached route paths
   */
  getAll() {
    const routes = [];
    
    // Get from memory
    this._cache.forEach((_, key) => {
      routes.push(key.replace('route_', ''));
    });
    
    // Get from localStorage
    try {
      Object.keys(localStorage).forEach(key => {
        if (key.startsWith('route_') && !this._cache.has(key)) {
          routes.push(key.replace('route_', ''));
        }
      });
    } catch (e) {}
    
    return [...new Set(routes)]; // Remove duplicates
  },
  
  /**
   * Get cache statistics
   * @returns {object} - Cache stats
   */
  getStats() {
    const stats = {
      memory: this._cache.size,
      total: 0,
      routes: []
    };
    
    // Count localStorage items
    try {
      Object.keys(localStorage).forEach(key => {
        if (key.startsWith('route_')) {
          stats.total++;
          stats.routes.push(key.replace('route_', ''));
        }
      });
    } catch (e) {}
    
    return stats;
  },
  
  /**
   * Clean up expired cache entries
   */
  cleanup() {
    const now = Date.now();
    
    // Clean memory cache
    this._expiry.forEach((expiry, key) => {
      if (expiry <= now) {
        this._cache.delete(key);
        this._expiry.delete(key);
      }
    });
    
    // Clean localStorage
    try {
      Object.keys(localStorage).forEach(key => {
        if (key.startsWith('route_')) {
          const stored = localStorage.getItem(key);
          if (stored) {
            try {
              const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);
              if (parsed.expiry <= now) {
                localStorage.removeItem(key);
              }
            } catch (e) {
              localStorage.removeItem(key); // Invalid JSON, remove
            }
          }
        }
      });
    } catch (e) {}
    
    
  }
};

// Run cleanup every 10 minutes
setInterval(() => RouteCache.cleanup(), 10 * 60 * 1000);

// Make globally available
window.RouteCache = RouteCache;

--- ./utils/router.js ---


const Router = {
  
  currentPath: '/',
  
  
  callback: null,
  
  
  normalizePath(path) {
    
    let normalized = path.replace(window.location.origin, '');
    
    
    if (normalized === '/index.html' || normalized === '') {
      normalized = '/';
    }
    
    
    if (normalized !== '/' && normalized.endsWith('/')) {
      normalized = normalized.slice(0, -1);
    }
    
    return normalized;
  },
  
  
  init(routeCallback) {
    this.callback = routeCallback;
    
    
    const rawPath = window.location.pathname;
    this.currentPath = this.normalizePath(rawPath);
    
    
    this.callback(this.currentPath);
    
    
    window.addEventListener('popstate', (event) => {
      const rawPath = window.location.pathname;
      this.currentPath = this.normalizePath(rawPath);
      this.callback(this.currentPath);
    });
  },
  
  
  navigateTo(path) {
    
    if (!path.startsWith('/')) {
      path = '/' + path;
    }
    
    
    history.pushState(null, '', path);
    
    
    this.currentPath = path;
    
    
    if (this.callback) {
      this.callback(path);
    }
  }
};

const SanitizeHelpers = {
  
  escapeHtml: function(text) {
    if (!text) return '';
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.textContent = text;
    return div.innerHTML;
  },
  
  
  sanitizeMessage: function(text) {
    if (!text) return '';
    
    
    let sanitized = this.escapeHtml(text);
    
    
    
    
    return sanitized;
  },
  
  
  sanitizeText: function(text, maxLength = 500) {
    if (!text) return '';
    
    let sanitized = text.trim().slice(0, maxLength);
    
    return this.escapeHtml(sanitized);
  },
  
  
  sanitizeUrl: function(url) {
    if (!url) return '';
    
    if (url.startsWith('http:') || url.startsWith('https:') || url.startsWith('/')) {
      
      return url.replace(/javascript:/gi, '').replace(/<script>/gi, '');
    }
    return '';
  },
  
  
  sanitizeListing: function(listing) {
    if (!listing) return listing;
    
    const sanitized = { ...listing };
    
    
    if (sanitized.title) sanitized.title = this.escapeHtml(sanitized.title.slice(0, 200));
    if (sanitized.description) sanitized.description = this.escapeHtml(sanitized.description.slice(0, 5000));
    if (sanitized.address) sanitized.address = this.escapeHtml(sanitized.address.slice(0, 200));
    
    
    if (sanitized.amenities) {
      sanitized.amenities = sanitized.amenities.map(a => this.escapeHtml(a.slice(0, 100)));
    }
    
    return sanitized;
  }
};

window.SanitizeHelpers = SanitizeHelpers;
